sections.title: DAIKEN CRAFT-ALPHA9000
sections.overview: A planar speaker system using an   - wood diaphragm.The CRAFT -   9000 is a speaker jointly researched by the Chubu Corn Factory and the Wood Research Institute of Kyoto University. It was sold by Daiken Industry.Flat units with   - wood diaphragms are installed in the low and middle regions.The alpha-wood diaphragm has a 3-layer structure with carbon fiber cloth sandwiched between acetylated Sitka spruce and carbon fiber cloth. In the acetylation process, the hydrophilic hydroxyl group which is the main component of the wood is acetylated with acetic anhydride to scientifically improve the wood. Dimensional stability, aging change, rigidity and corrosion resistance are improved. In addition, Sitka spruce, which is also used for piano soundboards, uses carefully selected top-quality parts which cannot be obtained much from large trees of 100m height and 2m diameter.The woofer unit is equipped with a large magnetic circuit using a   180 mm, 15,000 gauss magnet.A ribbon-type tweeter is installed in the high frequency band, and by aligning each unit in the same plane, the shift of sound wave transmission is eliminated.The enclosure uses solid wood of Sitka spruce, which is more than the size of a piano.The enclosure is constructed with a rigid aluminum frame to provide a rich sound by vibrating the baffle. Each unit is fixed to a separate aluminum frame. A soundbar is attached to the back of the solid wood Sitka Spruce baffle to create a sound similar to a piano soundboard.It has a high quality urethane finish that makes use of the grain of the wood.

sections.title: DBX SF-ONE
sections.overview: A floor-type speaker system with a sound field control function.The SF-ONE consists of a speaker system SF-X 1 and a sound field controller SFC-1.When listening to the sound of a stereo system, the listener hears not only the direct sound coming from the speakers but also the reflected sound coming from all directions at the same time. The sound field for stereo reproduction is composed of components such as direction, volume, phase, and delay of the reflected sound.SF-ONE pursues a rich musical sense of reality through sound field control that combines the direction, quantity, and delay degree of direct and indirect waves to optimize them. Under the guidance of Dr. Mark F. Davis, an American acoustic psychologist, it was developed by pursuing the ideal radiation pattern of speakers that determine sound field control.In order to realize a speaker with an ideal radiation pattern, we have adopted the time versus intensity exchange effect, which is an acoustopsychological phenomenon. This effect compensates for the left-to-right bias on arrival by adding a reverse bias to the amplitude. We conclude that the speaker has directivity and must emit sound more strongly in one direction than in the other. To determine the radiation pattern with the appropriate time versus intensity exchange, we repeat the hearing test to obtain a correlation diagram of amplitude versus angle that gives the optimum sound localization. This enables us to analyze the radiation pattern of sound pressure contours using computer graphics.In addition, sound reflected by walls etc. is used as an acoustic delay to maintain ideal sound image fusion, and a fully horizontal radiation pattern is established by setting a backward radiation pattern with a forward horizontal radiation pattern as a mirror object.The vertical radiation pattern is set so that the sound quality does not change significantly regardless of the position of the listener, and the sound emitted above the speaker is sufficiently limited.Fourteen speaker units are used to achieve an ideal radiation pattern.Four 10-inch cone woofers for the low range and four 4 1 / 2-inch cone midrange woofers for the middle range, mounted on each of the four sides of the floor cabinet.In addition, 6 1/2inch domed tweeters are mounted on the upper hexagonal surface for high frequency.The four sided woofer and mid-range speakers have the same characteristics on the front and rear sides and different characteristics on the inside and outside sides. These units have three characteristics in total. The six tweeters combine four types of speakers : the inside and outside sides, two inside oblique sides, and two outside oblique sides. Each speaker has a different crossover frequency, frequency characteristics, and volume.The volume is set to the maximum on the inner side (facing side) for all bands, and then the strength is adjusted on both front and rear sides, and then on the outer side.The LF/MF crossover frequency is 450 Hz and the MF/HF crossover frequency is 3.15 kHz.The crossover design is a computer-driven design that not only matches the characteristics of each driver individually to provide the optimum sound field radiation pattern, but also maintains a constant input impedance throughout the entire drive, enabling the handling of power amplifiers with excellent power response.Dedicated controller SFC-1 is attached.In addition to the equalization function that ensures the overall characteristics of the SF-ONE, the SFC-1 is equipped with an ambience adjustment that controls the subtle nuances of the sound field, a unique Low/High compensation function, a power monitor circuit for speaker protection, and an auto-balance function.

sections.title: DBX DX3
sections.overview: Dbx's first CD player.DX3 is equipped with dbx's own DAIR, which enables Compression and Ambience control.Dbx's unique Digital Audio Impact Recovery (DAIR) function splits the audio band into two bands, low and high. Each band operates individually in response to musical transients, adding a total impact of up to + 10 dB. This allows you to play more vividly the sounds of brass instruments, cymbals, and percussion attacks.The compression function is a continuously variable function that reduces the + 6 dB peak (2 Vrms maximum output) to -20dBV and simultaneously raises the quiet level from -90dBV to -80dBV, so that the maximum dynamic range of 96 dB can be compressed to 60 dB, which is the same level as LP records.The Ambience control function introduces a new concept developed in the SF-ONE floor-type speaker system. It adds and subtracts LR signals in the mid - and high-frequency range to enhance digital sound. If you control it to the plus side, the sound field will be broad ; if you control it to the minus side, it will be tight.Two LSIs for CD-Player are used, one for signal processing and the other for servocontrol.In addition, a digital filter is incorporated into the signal processing LSI to greatly reduce the load on the following analog filter and prevent the deterioration of phase characteristics.The pickup unit uses a 3-beam system and realizes highly reliable tracing by directing three beams obliquely to the track, reading the signal with the center beam, and detecting the track shift in real time with the other two beams.The error correction method employs a double error correction method based on CIRC.Equipped with a 2-speed search function, if you press the SCAN key during performance, you can fast-forward / rewind while playing at a low speed for the first 3 seconds and at a high speed after that at approximately 1/4 of the normal volume.It is also equipped with functions such as track search, 9-track random program, repeat playback, and index search.The operation status of the DAIR/Compression function can be monitored by three rows of LEDs.The upper and lower LEDs respectively indicate the level change in the high and low ranges after passing through the dbx DYNAMICS circuit. In DAIR mode, they indicate the amount of dynamic range expansion. In Compression mode, they indicate the amount of compression with low levels of sound increasing. Conversely, when high levels of sound are decreasing, the center LED lights from right to left to indicate the amount of compression.

sections.title: DBX DX5
sections.overview: A CD player with a sound quality design and sound effects.A 16-bit 4-times oversampling digital filter is installed as a digital filter, and a third order low-pass filter is installed as an analog filter.This digital filter has an attenuation of more than 76 dB in the stopband of more than 24.1 kHz and eliminates the center frequency of unwanted components to 176.4 kHz. This enables the low-pass filter to be reduced after D/A conversion. As a result, excellent phase characteristics and transient response characteristics are obtained, and resolution is also improved compared to the 14-bit type.The glitchless 16-bit high-speed linear D/A converter is mounted on the D/A converter section independently on the left and right sides.By making the left and right independent, there is no phase shift between channels, and excellent sound localization and high frequency reproduction capability are obtained.A 3-beam laser pickup using a newly developed lens is used in the pickup section.In this method, in addition to the main beam that reads the signal, two sub-beams detect the track shift of the main beam in real time and control it with a servomechanism. This reduces the influence of disc eccentricity, warpage, scratches and dirt, and realizes stable tracing capability.Equipped with three unique sound effects features of dbx, you can adjust D. A. I. R., Compress, and Ambience.In D. A. I. R. (Digital Audio Impact Recovery), this function emphasizes the missing peak component.Even in a wide dynamic range CD, the dynamic range of live music, especially sharp peaks, is suppressed during recording, and D. A. I. R. emphasizes only the instantaneous attack sound, which is the lost peak component, when recorded.It detects a sudden increase in the level of the music signal and gives a strong impact of up to 10 dB. The effect is made natural by the two band operation of high and low band.Compress reduces the dynamic range of a CD from more than 90 dB to a minimum of 60 dB by suppressing large sounds and raising small sounds. This function is useful for low-volume playback in noisy environments or at midnight. It is also ideal for BGM applications.The reduction operation is two band division same as D. A. I. R.The Ambience adjusts the stereo separation by adding and reducing the LR signal in the mid and high range to control the sense of sound spread. Turn the volume to the left to make it tight, and turn it to the right to increase the sense of sound spread.16-track random program function, 1-track / All/A-B repeat function, skip search and index search function are equipped.Equipped with HF and LF 2-band point LED display Dinamics meter that can confirm the operation status of D. A. I. R. and Compress at a glance.Equipped with a touch control attenuator that can adjust the line-out level.Equipped with a headphone port with volume.It is equipped with an error collection display LED which displays the error correction status due to scratch or dirt of the disk.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.title: DBX DX900
sections.overview: CD player with improved sound quality by thorough anti-resonance design.The pickup section moves on two slider shafts for tracing. The DX900 uses a new material, zirconia ceramic for this slider shaft.This material has hardness and abrasion resistance close to that of diamond, and extremely excellent smoothness. It is less susceptible to vibration, and the tracing accuracy is further improved. Moreover, the initial characteristics are maintained for 10 times longer than that of conventional stainless steel materials, and the reliability of the tracking mechanism is improved.The mechanical deck, which is the base of the optical system and drive system, has a hybrid structure in which two kinds of materials with different resonance frequencies are integrated by outsert molding. As a result, high strength and processing accuracy are obtained, and at the same time, resonance sharpness is greatly reduced compared with single materials such as aluminum die-cast, and vibration control is greatly improved, and generation and transmission of unnecessary vibration are effectively reduced.In addition, a three point support system has been adopted for the support system of the entire mechanical deck. Two points on the panel side are supported by a three way flexible damper, and one point on the rear side is designed to be unloaded, thereby eliminating the effects of external vibrations and shocks.Extremely rigid black ceramic is used for the legs, and fine ceramic spacers are placed at four locations where the circuit board is attached to the chassis to prevent vibration transmission to the component parts.The digital filter uses a 16-bit 4-times oversampling digital filter.This eliminates the frequency lower limit of unwanted components from 24.1 kHz to 156.4 kHz and makes the low-pass filter after D/A conversion into a third order Bessel filter with extremely gentle cut-off characteristics, contributing to the simplification of analog circuits and improved sound quality.The D/A converter uses a 16-bit linear D/A converter, and the left and right channels are used independently to eliminate the phase shift between the channels.This D/A converter does not generate glitch, which is a kind of digital noise. It has a very simple structure that eliminates the need for a glitter circuit, which was indispensable in the past, and the analog circuit is only a third order Bessel filter.High-quality parts such as ceramic containing powder electrolytic capacitor, copper foil Styrofoam capacitor, LC-OFC wire rod, etc., which are examined with priority on sound quality are used.An optical transmission method using a photocoupler has been introduced for digital data transmission of emphasis and output mute to the analog system, and the circuits are electrically isolated from each other.The power supply circuit uses a separate system that completely separates digital circuits from analog circuits.It effectively prevents degradation of sound quality in analog circuits due to interference from the digital system and mixing of digital noise.Equipped with a digital output terminal.Self-calendaring 20 keys are used.The 20 keys for direct selection and the calendar function are docked, and the track number of songs recorded on the disc or program is directly displayed with the corresponding keys lit. The keys of songs that have finished playing are turned off so that you can check the progress of the music at a glance.In addition, it is equipped with the Up 10 key, and you can quickly select songs of Track No. 21 or higher.The display section has a multi-mode double display.It is designed with two separate displays that operate continuously. The upper large display shows the track number and number of songs as well as the operating status and the next operation procedure in alphabet. The lower display shows time information such as elapsed time, total playing time, and remaining time for each song. It also shows the index number and order of program songs.It has a program memory function of up to 24 songs.The program contents can be checked by the memory call function.Equipped with a random BGM play function.One track / all tracks / section, program track and peat function is equipped.It is equipped with skip search and index search.Equipped with a headphone port with volume.Wireless remote control with 20 keys is included.

sections.title: DCS P8I
sections.overview: The first integrated SACD/CD player in DCs.In order to realize perfect digital data processing, we pursue bit-perfect data reading and transmission.In the case of general equipment, when there is a missing part in the read data, the operation is carried out by the original program at that stage to supplement the missing part. However, in DCs, it is an absolute condition that the bit perfect data without the missing part is sent to the next conversion stage as it is. In order to realize this, the accuracy of the pickup program and mechanism is verified by reading approximately 64000 codes, and the bit perfect data is transmitted to the DAC section by adding the original software.A 5-bit, 2.822MS/s ring DAC is used for the DA conversion section, and the signal is converted into an analog signal without missing, manipulating or correcting data.The ring DAC has the advantage of excellent linearity, but it incorporates only the advantages of a 1-bit system which tends to generate clock error due to switching and generates noise and distortion, and a multi-bit converter which has a problem of linearity at a low level due to drift caused by time variation due to the resistor accuracy hurdle even though it is low noise.Equipped with digital input terminal, input from other transport can be used as DCs DAC with upsampling function.The clock circuit uses a carefully selected quartz oscillator VCXO clock.In addition, the word clock input terminal is mounted in order to support high-precision clock and synchronous operation with different DACs.Equipped with a digital output terminal.Each analog output has one balanced and one unbalanced system.The output level can be converted into 2 v and 6 v according to the operating conditions.Hybrid SACD discs are designed to play SACD first.PCM CD is upsampled into DSD data and converted into analog.The panel part is machined out of thick hard aluminum.The function buttons change to purple, red, green and blue depending on the status of SACD, CD, standby and menu, so that you can check the status of the P8i and the playing disc at a glance.There are 2 variations of the appearance, black and Platinum.

sections.overview: Master clock generator of Scarlatti series.By synchronizing the D/A converter and transport with a stable master clock with high accuracy, better playback is possible.A dual oscillator system is used for the circuit, and an aged crystal oscillator (VCXOx2) is selected and used as a match pair. Each master clock unit is built up by inputting the individual characteristics and characteristics into the internal DSP to improve stability against temperature and secular change.Eight output terminals are provided. Each of these terminals is equipped with a buffer to block defective components flowing back from the connected equipment.Crystal oscillation produces frequencies from 22.5792 or 24.5760 or MHz to 44.1 kHz or 48 kHz. sections.overview: A CD player with Lambda Super Linear Converter.The D/A converter is equipped with a LAMBDA (Ladder-form Multiple Bias D/A) super linear converter.The lambda method uses a newly developed LSI to divide digital data into two systems, each of which is shifted near the 0 cross point by applying digital bias in the + and - directions to eliminate 0 cross distortion in principle.When the reproduced digital data is smaller than the shift amount, there is no value crossing the original 0 cross point, so no 0 cross distortion occurs. Then, by adding the two shifted data after D/A conversion, the DC component is eliminated and the two shifted data are combined, so that an analog output with no 0 cross distortion can be obtained. There is no MSB inversion in these two data, and no 0 cross distortion occurs in the combined waveform. In addition, even if there is an error in any bit, the distortion is reduced to 1/2 because it is the average of the two signals.In this method, when the reproduced digital data exceeds the shift amount, distortion may occur because the reproduced digital data crosses the original 0 cross point. In order to solve this problem, the MSB correction with the super linear converter is used. In addition, when there is no or only a few peak signals in a single song (more than about 99.6% of the maximum level), the lambda eliminates the shift operation and uses the converter's dynamic range to ensure a wide dynamic range.The digital filter uses a 20-bit 8 x oversampling digital filter.In addition, DCD 780 introduces a noise-shaping technique that reduces audible requantization noise by feeding back only the round-off error component of the digital filter output and subtracting it from the incoming data.Equipped with a digital attenuator, the output level can be adjusted in 12 digital stages using a digital filter.Equipped with an auto-edit function that shows the appropriate tape length for the disc you want to record.This function automatically determines the interval between songs closest to 1/2 of the total recording time of the disc and displays the recording time in the first half and the second half.Equipped with a display ON/OFF switch.Equipped with a digital output terminal.Equipped with functions such as direct selection, automatic search, manual search, program of up to 20 songs, program call, repeat of all songs / program / A-B, pause standby, timer play, auto space, etc.Wireless remote control is included.

A D/A converter generally consists of 16 pairs of precise resistors. Slight errors in the resistance value can cause a variable ?? and sound quality degradation. sections.overview: A CD player with a Lambda S. L. C double D/A converter.The D/A converter is equipped with a Lambda S. L. C double D/A converter.Lambda is an abbreviation of LAMBDA (Ladder-from Multiple Bias D/A). It uses a newly developed LSI to divide digital data into two systems, each of which is shifted by applying a digital bias in the + and - directions near the 0 cross point to eliminate the 0 cross distortion in principle.In this method, when the digital data is smaller than the shift amount, there is no value crossing the original 0 cross point, so there is no 0 cross distortion. Furthermore, by adding the two data after D/A conversion, the DC component is removed and the two data are combined. Thus, an analog output with no 0 cross distortion can be obtained. These two data have no MSB inversion and no 0 cross distortion in the combined waveform. Moreover, even if there is an error in any bit, the distortion is reduced to 1/2 by averaging the two signals.In addition, if the digital data is at a level larger than the shift amount, it will cross the original 0 cross point, which may cause distortion. However, this distortion is also removed by the MSB correction of the S. L. C (Super Linear Converter). In addition, when there is no shift operation or only a few times in a single song at the peak level (approximately 99.6% or more of the maximum level), the lambda function stops shifting operations and uses the converter's dynamic range to ensure a wide dynamic range.The digital filter is equipped with an 8 x oversampling digital filter. By raising the sampling frequency by 8 x, the high-frequency noise of 24.1 kHz or higher included in the output of the converter is shifted to the higher range, making it easier to remove with the analog filter.Equipped with Denon's own digital pitch commander, the playback pitch of CDs can be changed up to   12.0%.This feature allows the digital PLL to adjust the pitch of the CD playback in 0.1% increments.Newly developed PU mechanism is adopted for the support part of the pickup part to improve vibration resistance.In addition, the accuracy of the reproduced signal is improved by incorporating an RF amplifier.Equipped with 4-step display dimmer function.Equipped with an optical digital output.Uses a gold-plated headphone terminal.Equipped with remote control electronic volume.It is equipped with functions such as index search.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.overview: This CD player is the second ordinary CD player equipped with a newly developed super linear converter.The D/A converter is equipped with a super linear converter incorporating Denon's PCM audio technology.In general, a 16-bit D/A converter requires 16 pairs of high-precision, high-stability resistors. However, a very small error in these resistors causes 0 crossing distortion, which is similar to the crossover distortion of a class B amplifier. This distortion occurs at the 0 point where the plus and minus sides of the signal meet. This distortion occurs regardless of the magnitude of the signal waveform, so it degrades the sound quality especially when the sound is small.The Super Linear Converter consists of a 16-bit high-precision D/A converter and a conversion error detection and correction circuit. First of all, it uses a high-precision and high-stability resistor and adopts a converter system that can easily correct errors to improve basic performance. Then, by adding a correction signal obtained by a conversion error detection and correction circuit to the obtained analog signal, the D/A conversion error is reduced and 0 cross distortion is eliminated.The mechanism section is equipped with a newly developed linear drive tracer, which realizes accurate and highly stable signal pickup over a long period of time.All the main parts of the mechanism, such as the arm center shaft and spindle shaft, are fixed in a thick solid aluminum die-cast chassis that is integrally molded to maintain the mounting accuracy over a long period of time. By damping and floating the die-cast chassis from the main chassis, the influence of external vibrations on the pickup is eliminated.In addition, the pickup is driven together with a fan-shaped trace arm, which adopts the same method as the DN-3000F that is directly driven by a servo motor for driving the pickup.In the center of the rotating system, a direct drive system using a DC servo motor developed for CD players is adopted.The amplifier circuit is configured as a DC amplifier for low distortion and wide dynamic range.The external power transformer eliminates the effect of leakage flux on the power supply.The secondary side of the power transformer is an independent Route 3 for the mechanism drive & servo unit, analog amplifier unit and digital display unit to eliminate interference between each section.The display section uses a computer-controlled centralized display.It is equipped with functions such as direct selection, program performance of up to 15 songs, index selection, intro search, skip monitor, call function, repeat all songs / between 2 points function, quick selection function, timer playback function, etc.

sections.overview: The first DENON CD player.A 3-spot type laser pickup is used for the pickup part.This method consists of a main laser spot for code detection and two sub laser spots for tracking error detection. The reflected light from these two laser spots for error detection is converted into an electrical signal before entering an error signal amplifier. If tracking is accurate, the output of the error signal amplifier is 0. If there is even a slight difference, the error signal amplifier produces an output as an input difference. This error output goes into a servo circuit and moves the objective lens to correct the position of the main laser spot.In addition, a focus servo system is adopted so that the focus of the focus lens always matches with the accuracy of   1 ? m against the vertical fluctuation of the disk.The signal read by the laser pickup is first amplified by a preamplifier to a level that is easy to process. Then, 0 or 1 is determined by a data straw circuit. Errors are detected and corrected. The signal is rearranged in the order before interleaving. After that, the signal is converted into an analog signal by a D/A converter.The D/A converter is equipped with a newly developed D/A converter. It generates a highly accurate signal internally in advance, uses it as a reference to configure the operation of the converter itself accurately, stores the value in the internal RAM (Random Access Memory), and automatically corrects errors caused by element variations.The drive system uses a direct drive system equipped with a DC servo motor developed for CD players.

A CD player with a Real 20-bit New Super Linear Converter.Specifications such as appearance are slightly different between DCD-3500 and DCD-3500G.The DCD 3500 is designed with a black aluminum front panel and side wood. The top panel is made of extruded aluminum with a thickness of 4 mm. The sides are made of side wood, steel plate and chassis. The legs are made of insulators made of sintered alloy covered with aluminum.The DCD DCD 3500 g has a double structure of real wood and steel plate, and the legs have a 6.5 cm diameter brass machined large insulator with four pieces for a total of 1.8 kg.The D/A converter is equipped with a newly developed real 20-bit New Super Linear Converter.In the Super Linear Converter, the 0 cross distortion is eliminated by adding a correction signal to the D/A converter using a conversion error correction circuit. Unlike the dynamic bit shift method using an attenuator or switching circuit, this method does not have a factor of non-linear distortion. In addition, the 0 cross distortion, which is a problem at low volume, is caused by the resistance error of the MSB which is the most influential bit in D/A conversion. Therefore, the distortion is eliminated by correcting this MSB. Moreover, in the DCD 3500, not only the MSB but also the 4 bits of 2 sb, 3 sb and 4 sb are corrected, and the distortion is eliminated by eliminating the distortion of the entire waveform.In addition, it employs a 2D/A system with independent left and right channels to eliminate the L/R time difference. The D/A conversion element uses an IC manufactured by Bar Brown of the United States.The digital filter uses an 8 x oversampling digital filter. sections.overview: A CD player with Real 20-bit ? -S. L. C.Real 20-bit ? (LAMBDA) -S. L. C is used for the D/A conversion part.LAMBDA stands for Ladder-form Multiple Bias D/A. Using a newly developed LSI, digital data is divided into two systems, each of which is shifted by applying digital bias in plus and minus directions near the 0 cross point, thereby eliminating 0 cross distortion in principle.With this method, when the reproduced digital data is smaller than the shift amount, there is no value crossing the original 0 cross point, so no 0 cross distortion occurs. When the two shifted data are added after D/A conversion, the DC component is removed and the two shifted data are combined. Thus, an analog output with no 0 cross distortion can be obtained. The two data have no MSB inversion, and no 0 cross distortion occurs in the combined waveform. Even if any bit is distorted, the average of the two signals reduces the distortion to 1/2.In addition, when the reproduced digital data is at a level larger than the shift amount, it crosses the original 0 cross point, which may cause distortion. However, in this case, the distortion is removed by the MSB correction of the super linear converter. In addition, when there is a momentary peak level (more than about 99.6% of the maximum level) that is completely absent or only a few times in a piece of music, LAMBDA stops the shift operation and uses the converter's dynamic range to ensure a wide dynamic range.The DDCD 3500 rg uses a 4D/A system instead of the conventional 2D/A converter system, which brings out the performance of the lambda system and greatly improves the SN ratio.The digital filter uses a 20-bit 8 x oversampling digital filter.In the analog circuit, interference between channels is eliminated by making the L/R configuration completely independent of the signal flow.The power supply is equipped with a digital transformer and an analog transformer independently to reduce interference between the digital and analog sections.We also use carefully selected parts such as large electrolytic capacitors for power supply circuits.In order to prevent digital noise from entering the analog circuit, the circuit board is completely isolated.In addition, bus bar lines, which are used only for commercial machines, are used for analog circuits to reduce ground impedance and prevent high frequencies from jumping in.The pickup part is floating by coil spring and low repulsion viscoelastic rubber to eliminate the effect of vibration.In addition, the vibration absorption effect is enhanced by using BMC (bulk molding compound) with large internal loss as a double BMC mechanical base that is used for both the pickup mechanical base and the mechanical chassis.The chassis eliminates the effect of internal vibration by dividing the mechanical part and power supply part, which may cause vibration, and the circuit system, in which the effect of vibration affects sound quality, into two parts by the center partition wall. In addition, the chassis adopts a double structure and the insulator uses sintered alloy to achieve complete vibration isolation.The chassis is fully copper-plated to guard against radio waves and porcelain noise.Uses gold hairline finish front panel and glossy wood cabinet.Equipped with a display dimmer function, you can adjust four levels of brightness : standard, approximately 2/3, approximately 1/3, and all lights off.Equipped with a variable output volume linked to a headphone.It also comes with headphones and a variable output ON/OFF switch.It is equipped with two coaxial and one optical digital outputs.It is equipped with time search, and it is possible to start the music by time designation and repeat performance between 2 points.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.overview: CD transport using top-loading mechanism.Top loading mechanism is adopted for the mechanism part, and tray part which tends to cause vibration is eliminated.In addition, a special air shield is applied to the door opening, and aluminum die-cast is used for the door to shut out external light.A thorough vibration suppression design has been adopted.First, in order to prevent vibration propagation from the floor, we have adopted a heavy-weight chassis frame made of sand mold casting and an insulator made of a composite material of aluminum and sintered alloy. In addition, we have adopted a weight balance in pursuit of rigidity without vibration and a 3-layer floating structure that blocks vibration frequency by absorbing back vibration.In addition, it uses a round form design to prevent external sound pressure and increase rigidity.The disc is fixed with a large diameter stabilizer that is attached to the entire surface of the disc. The light from the pickup is kept vertical and the micro-pits are accurately read. This reduces servo current without relying on the interpolation of the signal processing section.A linear motor is used as the drive motor, and the laser is irradiated at right angles to the CD surface by floating without contact and without using a gear. The linear motor improves the resolution of the fine feed of the pickup, and achieves high reading accuracy.In addition to the development and adoption of a high-torque cogging less motor, we have reduced reading errors caused by spindle motor rotation by means of a ruby bearing, an extremely thick spindle shaft with a diameter of 6 mm, large read RAM capacity, and inertial use of a large-diameter heavy-weight stabilizer.It supports five types of interfaces : ST-Link, Tos-Link, balanced line (AES/EBU balanced transmission) XLR, unbalanced line (two wire coaxial unbalanced transmission) RCA and BNC.The high-precision crystal oscillator circuit equipped with Level I realizes extremely high-quality transmission.Uses the ST Gen-Lock method to reduce jitter during digital transmission.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.overview: An AV amplifier that uses a discrete amplifier in the front and center to improve the sound quality during 2 ch playback.The two channel stereo playback of CDs has been improved by adopting a discrete configuration with the same power and response for the front and center channels and a circuit configuration equivalent to a pure amplifier.To reduce interference between video and audio, both sections are separated from the power supply.The Dolby Pro-Logic Decoder uses an IC jointly developed with a semiconductor manufacturer with a track record in the United States to improve SN and distortion.In order to keep the separation of each channel of the prologic always good, it is equipped with an auto input balance which compensates for the level difference between channels in real time.Equipped with 6-mode surround playback.You can freely choose from 4 modes of "normal mode", "phantom mode", "wide mode" and "3-channel logic mode" according to the size of the room and the contents of the speaker system. In addition, you can also surround playback of general stereo recording sources in 2 modes of "hall" and "studio".Since the delay time can be selected every 5 msec, the surround effect can be enhanced depending on the size of the listening room and the type of software.A test tone generation circuit is mounted, and the level can be set according to the listening condition.The surround preset memory function allows you to store the rear, center level, and delay time status of each surround, making it easy to set the delay time to enhance the surround effect.FL display with large multi-function display function is adopted.It is equipped with input / output terminals of four audio equipment systems and visual equipment Route 3.In addition, it has a center-out connector for the center speaker and a pre-out connector for sub-woofer connection for bass enhancement.It comes with a remote controller that can switch power ON/OFF, volume and input.

sections.overview: AV amplifier equipped with 32 bit floating point type DSP.Surround circuits of the same quality are used for all 7 channels, enabling 96 kHz processing from audio signal input to DSP processing and D/A output, enabling more accurate and precise surround processing.A 32-bit floating point type DSP (third generation SHARC) is used for the DSP for surround circuit processing.This DSP is compatible with 96 kHz signal input, and the signal processing capability is more than twice that of the conventional model, so the accuracy of various surround decoding processing is also improved.Uses a 96 kHz / 24-bit digital interface receiver.All seven channels of the power amplifier are fully discrete and have the same response. In addition, it realizes wide-range playback capable of up to 100 kHz playback, enabling not only impressive multi-channel surround playback but also high-quality 2-channel stereo playback.The power supply section is equipped with a large power transformer and a large-capacity block capacitor to ensure stable power supply.In addition, the chassis supporting large transformers is designed to be more integrated with the chassis combined with a high-rigidity transformer frame in consideration of sound insulation.It supports a wide range of surround formats, including 6.1 channel surround formats such as DTS-ES and Dolby Digital EX, and surround formats such as DTS96/24 and Dolby Pro LogicIIx.Equipped with a video conversion function to convert between signals connected to the image input terminal or S-image input terminal.Equipped with an on-screen display function, you can perform various setting operations while viewing the monitor screen.In addition, the front panel display can display the setting operation contents simultaneously, so the setup can be performed even when the monitor is turned off.Equipped with an auto surround mode function.This function allows you to automatically store the surround mode for each of the three input signals : Analog / PCM2ch, Bitstream (Dolby Digital, DTS, AAC) 2ch, and Bitstream multi-channel.When the type of input signal changes, the surround mode that is most suitable for each signal is automatically set.The subwoofer has eight selectable crossover frequencies that can be optimized for your speaker system.The built-in Rec out selector allows you to watch movies and audio while recording.Equipped with Route 3 D-image input port.This connector supports D4 video.8 ch pre-out terminal is mounted.It uses a newly designed aluminum front panel.Separate switches are installed for main power ON / OFF and on / standby.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.overview: An AV amplifier for Dolby Pro Logic.The Dolby Pro-Logic Surround System incorporates a directional enhancement circuit that dramatically improves the front-rear and left-right channel separation compared to conventional Dolby Surround playback.Especially in the wide mode and normal mode where a center speaker is added to the center of the front speaker, the sound that should be emitted from the center, such as the dialogue of an actor, is localized to an independent center channel instead of a synthesized sound of left and right, so that the sense of localization, movement, and dynamic feeling of sound is improved.For the Dolby Pro Logic, you can select the wide mode, which is best when the center speaker is of the same grade as the left and right speakers, the normal mode, which is best when the center channel is smaller than the left and right speakers, or the phantom mode, which is best when the center speaker is not used.In normal mode, the signal of 100 Hz or less is divided into left and right channels and output. In phantom mode, the signal is reproduced by the directional enhancement circuit to locate electrically to the center.The delay circuit uses a digital delay method, which greatly improves the SN ratio and distortion compared with analog methods.The delay time can be selected from 15, 20, and 30 msec.Equipped with a test tone generation circuit, fine level setting is possible.Surround mode is installed so that even normal stereo recording software can enjoy surround effects.The Surround mode can be selected from Hall / Stadium / Simulated Stereo. In particular, Simulated Stereo can be used to convert a mono source into a pseudo stereo.A pre-out terminal is provided so that power amplifiers can be added.The Rec Out Selector has two modes : Video and Audio. In the Video mode, you can select a recorded signal, and in the Audio mode, you can select a recorded signal. By combining these two modes, you can edit any combination of two different sources of audio and video. The recorded and recorded signals are output to the VCR1 and 2 jacks for recording, and to the DAT/Tape1, 2 and 3 jacks for recording.For devices equipped with both input and output terminals such as VCR and DAT/Tape, a built-in inhibit circuit is provided to prevent a loop between playback and recording.The basic circuit of the DENON pre-main amplifier advanced model is mounted on the front as it is.T20 MHz / Pc150W power transistor is used in single push-pull mode.The power supply section is equipped with a 4.8 kg power transformer.In order to prevent mutual interference between each circuit, each block of video signal board, audio signal board, power supply section and power amplifier section is separated by a chassis block for each function.It is equipped with a superimpose function that displays the operation status of functions and functions on the TV monitor screen, and a multi-functional enhancer function that allows you to either record on VCR3 or record on VCR1 or 2 while monitoring.Also, with the last function memory function, when the power is turned on/off by remote control, all functions are retained in the state immediately before the power is turned off.It comes with a remote control that can control not only AVC-2000 but also DENON CD players and cassette decks. By using the learning function, you can register and control up to 154 functions of TVs, videos, and other audio devices of other companies.

sections.overview:
AVC-2020 :   110,000 (around 1991)AVC-2020G :   117,000 (around 1992)

An AV amplifier with more powerful surround sound reproduction by adopting a discrete 6-ch power amplifier and newly developed Dolby Time Link Digital Delay.The front, center and rear amplifiers are all discrete and have the same power response to bring out the expressive power of pro-logic reproduction.In addition, the center channel amplifier for dual center is a 2-ch amplifier configuration, and is driven by one amplifier and one speaker.In order to eliminate interference between video and audio, which is a problem in AV amplifiers, both sections are completely separated from the power supply.In order to improve the surround playback sound, it is equipped with newly developed Dolby Time Link Digital Delay with a wide dynamic range and excellent dynamic characteristics, and the quality of the surround speaker playback sound is improved by approximately 12 db.The delay time can be adjusted every 0.5 msec to a maximum of 130 msec (15 ~ 30 msec for pro-logic playback).The pro-logic decoder uses an IC manufactured by PMI Inc. of the United States. The decoder has excellent dynamic range and distortion characteristics, and has improved sound quality, enabling purer surround sound reproduction.In addition, in order to keep the separation of each Pro-Logic channel in the best condition, it is equipped with auto input balance. Switching from manual method is also possible.Equipped with VDP direct function by mechanical relay for both video and audio parts.The audio portion is transmitted independently of the processor and switching function, enabling purer VDP playback. The video portion is also transmitted directly from the input to the monitor output, realizing a wide bandwidth of 0 Hz to 20 MHz + 0 -1dB.It is equipped with a AVSE circuit that enhances the bass sound and realizes more powerful surround sound reproduction.In addition, it is equipped with a cinema sound equalizer, so that the dialogue of the person can be reproduced more realistically.It is equipped with 4 modes of Dolby Pro Logic Surround System and 5 modes of surround mode such as Hall, simulated and live.Equipped with 4 ch discrete input / output terminal.Built-in preset memory function and superimpose function.S3Equipped with learning remote controller with function.This remote control is equipped with three system functions : a system remote control function, a system call function, and a system entry function. The system remote control function enables you to control DENON CD players, tuners, decks, etc. without having to learn them. The system call function enables you to memorize 15 key operations in one key operation.With the system entry function, it is possible to display the product name of the I/O device.In addition to the black color AVC-2020, there was the gold color AVC-2020G with side wood.

sections.overview:
AVC-2030 :   100,000 (around 1993)AVC-2030G :   110,000 (around 1993)

An AV amplifier with NEW super optical ClassA circuit and DSP, inheriting the know-how of pure amplifier.NEW super optical ClassA circuit is mounted on 3 ch of front / center amplifier.In this circuit, amplification operation is performed as pure class A at the level of listening power, and non-switching class A operation effective for improvement of crossover distortion and switching distortion is used at high output to enable high-quality amplification.The discrete configuration also improves sound quality similar to that of a stereo amplifier.To enable high-quality playback during CD playback, it is equipped with a direct function by means of a mechanical relay to minimize the transmission system from the input to the output of the preamplifier.In addition, a high-sound device is used in the preamplifier buffer circuit to improve the S/N ratio for 2-channel stereo playback.To prevent high-frequency noise from the video system, the power supply for the video and audio circuits is separated, and noise from the ground circuit is also eliminated.The Dolby Pro Logic Decoder uses an IC.In addition, depending on the source, you can choose between "widescreen mode" and "live mode" with adaptive matrix + DSP, "classic concert mode" and "rock concert mode" with DSP, etc.The DSP parameters can be set according to the system or room.It is equipped with a AVSE circuit for bass reproduction by Chikara Osako and a CINEMA equalizer that takes into account the transmission characteristics of the screen in theaters. This allows you to correct the part of the speech of a person whose high sound level is emphasized for theaters such as film software, and to reproduce the sound with a tone that is easy to hear.Digital and analog power sources, such as DSPs, which can generate noise, are separated to improve sound quality during surround sound reproduction.During 2-channel stereo playback, such as BYPASS or CD Direct, the digital power supply that is no longer required is automatically turned off to prevent audio quality degradation due to interference.It is equipped with an audio input Line 5 and four audio + video input systems. It is also equipped with an Hi-Vision connector for 4 ch discrete audio input.The REC OUT select function and a simulcast playback function that mixes audio and video from different sources.Gold plated terminal is used and FL tube display is used for the display.It comes with a learning remote controller with a pre-memory function that stores not only DENON AV components but also operation codes of major domestic manufacturers' products.There are AVC-2030 in black color and AVC-2030G in gold color with side wood.

sections.overview: AV amplifier equipped with D. D. S. C. in pursuit of high sound quality.The basic configuration of DENON's surround circuit is a combination of an analog prologic decoder (directional enhancement circuit) and a digital signal processing circuit (DSP). We have further advanced this method. The D. D.D. S. C. (Dynamic Discrete Surround Circuit) circuit uses separate DSPs, A/D converters, and D/A converters to perform A/D, DSP, and D/A processing, which was conventionally done in one chip. This improves signal processing capability and performance.In addition, by adopting newly developed IC in the pro-logic decoder, low distortion rate and high S/N are realized compared with conventional equipment.Since the analog and digital sections can be clearly separated, it is possible to minimize the effect of digital noise on the analog circuit.We have newly developed and adopted ICs for on-screen displays.An icon type character is used to display the current operation status on the screen in an easy-to-understand manner.The power amplifier uses a discrete configuration for each channel of the front and center.In order to reproduce CD players etc. with higher sound quality, it is equipped with a source direct function which bypasses each tone balance control circuit and transmits the signal to the power amplifier through a separate system.It is equipped with a AVSE circuit to amplify the low range that deepens the reality of AV sound and to realize more powerful sound reproduction.In addition, it is equipped with a cinema equalizer that can clearly and elegantly reproduce the dialogue of a person who has been recorded for movie software and other theaters with high frequency emphasis.It is equipped with a multi-source function equipped with a dedicated terminal for outputting video and audio input different from the video and audio input being reproduced in the set body.Equipped with a personal memory function, it is equipped with 3 modes of personal memory function that can store and recall combinations of input source and surround mode (including DSP parameter, AVSE and CINEMA ON/OFF).Equipped with a total of 11 surround modes.Four audio devices and four AV devices can be connected to the input terminal, and a gold-plated terminal is used.The front speaker can be switched between A and B.Pre-out and main-in terminals are mounted.It uses a large FL display that is easy to see.It comes with a remote controller equipped with a pre-memory function for storing operation codes of major domestic manufacturers, a system call function, a system remote function, and a learning function.

An AV amplifier compatible with Dolby Pro Logic that pursues solid dialogue, high quality sound, and powerful sound effects with high output at the core.The power amplifier section uses the same basic circuit as a full-scale Hi-Fi component amplifier to achieve a large output of 520W in total.The power supply unit uses a 2-transformer 4-power supply system that separates the audio system from the digital microcomputer system. sections.overview: A tuner amplifier that integrates a synthesizer tuner with 16-station preset and a pre-main amplifier with MC input.The tuner section uses a synthesizer system.In this system, the reference frequency obtained from the crystal oscillator and the frequency obtained by dividing the local oscillation frequency are compared in phase, and the varicap servocontrol is performed. Therefore, there is no drift of the local frequency due to temperature change, etc., and good and stable reception is possible.A 4-stage varicap and MOS FET are used in the front end to realize high sensitivity reception and improve the interference rejection capability. The intermediate frequency amplifier (IF) section employs a two stage linear phase ceramic filter configuration to reduce distortion. In addition, a new Quadrature detection circuit is used in the detection circuit.The AM tuner is an IF stage that combines a coil with two stages of newly developed 3-terminal type high-selectivity ceramic filters to suppress 9 kHz beat interference.In addition, we have adopted a low-impedance loop type antenna that is resistant to electric-field noise. This antenna is designed to be attached to and detached from the back panel so that it can be installed in a place with good reception.Each 8 FM/AM stations can be selected for memory music. After selecting the desired station, press the memory button and the preset 1 to 8 buttons to store the desired station.Equipped with an automatic tuning function, it automatically searches for the radio wave of the broadcasting station from the lower frequency to the higher frequency by pressing the auto button, stops at the tuning point and searches for the next tuning point by pressing the switch again.Manual tuning is possible by operating the up and down tuning buttons. The reception frequency is displayed on a digital counter, enabling you to catch weak radio waves that cannot be caught by automatic tuning. In addition, the frequency counting speed is designed to increase gradually by holding down the up / down tuning button.Each of the up / down tuning buttons changes by FM100kHz and AM9kHz in one push operation.It is equipped with a memory circuit for storing the state before turning off the power. In normal use, the memory lasts for about 3 months after turning off the power.Non-switching A system is adopted for the power amplifier section.In this system, a newly developed bias circuit is used for the bias current supply system of the power transistor, and the power transistor is controlled so that a stable bias current flows at all times to prevent cutoff of the power transistor, thereby eliminating switching distortion and reducing crossover distortion.The basic configuration of the power amplifier consists of a two stage DC-differential driver stage + a pure complimentary service push-pull stage and a newly developed real-time current limiter in the final stage.Regulation is improved by using a large transformer in the power supply section, and leakage flux is reduced by applying multiple shields to the core to cope with high-density construction inside the chassis.The tuner section and the preamplifier section (tone amplifier section) are supplied with secondary windings that are independent from the power circuit to reduce mutual interference.The tone control circuit uses a one time constant tone circuit.The basic configuration of this circuit is an NF-type tone circuit with a proven track record, but positive improvements have been added to it. This circuit greatly improves the frequency characteristics in the tone flat state, and the effect on sound quality is minimized by a unique circuit that reduces the amount of capacitors in the circuit.The equalizer amplifier section is compatible with both MC and MM cartridges.The circuit configuration is a direct-coupled system with a low-noise dual-FET in the first stage, eliminating the coupling and condenser. This reduces the deterioration of the sound quality at the input stage, and high-speed and high-gain amplification with an IC operational amplifier.In addition, the RIAA deviation is improved by adopting a precise RIAA element.The MC/MM selector switch is designed to remotely control the switch on the board by means of a flexible wired switch, thereby suppressing degradation of characteristics caused by wire routing.DENON's unique switch system is used for program selection.In this system, the switch on the panel drives the C-MOS IC on the circuit board and switches functions to prevent the deterioration of sound quality.Equipped with two speaker output jacks.Equipped with two tape deck input / output terminals.Equipped with a subsonic filter and loudness control.Equipped with double protection circuit to protect speakers and power transistors.

sections.overview: Head amplifier designed for MC cartridge.The HA-1000 uses a separate power supply system with independent power supply units.In addition, the main body has a magnetic shield made of silicon steel sheet so that the head amplifier can perform under all conditions.Eight PNP type low-noise transistors, which are advantageous for voltage noise, are used in parallel for the first input stage, which has the most influence on SN ratio, in order to reduce noise.The transistor used in the first stage is a PNP transistor with low current noise and voltage noise level of -147.5 db (V) per unit, which can be said to be the limit at present.The second stage and subsequent stages are designed to provide stable deep NFB with little influence of transistor characteristic variations. The second stage is a special current mirror type differential circuit to obtain high gain.The final stage consists of a Darlington complimentary service emitter-follower circuit with class A amplification, a wide dynamic range and low output impedance.The voltage gain of the HA-1000 can be switched between two stages of MC cartridge (32 db, 24 db) and three stages of MM cartridge (0 db, PASS).In the PASS mode, the input terminal is directly connected to the output terminal and the amplifier circuit jumps completely.Some commercially available MC cartridges have an output impedance of approximately 100  . In this case, there is a slight effect of inductance. Therefore, the input impedance of the HA-1000 is set to 100   to suppress the high frequency characteristics due to the capacitance of the tone arm code and head amplifier input.It has a built-in muting circuit to prevent unnecessary noise when switching.Equipped with a high-cut filter.

sections.overview: A step-up transformer designed to reduce low-frequency distortion in a wide band while taking into consideration the tendency of MC cartridges designed to have a wide band of frequency characteristics.In order to obtain linear and excellent characteristics, the step-up transformer is divided into two coils, and a sandwich wound structure with balanced division of the primary and secondary coils is adopted. This reduces the leakage inductance and distribution capacity and improves the high-frequency characteristics. In addition, a large inductance is adopted to improve the low-frequency characteristics and distortion factor, and the characteristics in the band are designed to be flat.Equipped with 3-stage switching function of 3  , 40   and PASS.In general, frequency characteristics deteriorate when multiple taps are taken out from the same winding, but in the AU-340, good characteristics are secured for each tap by effectively connecting two types of coils on the primary side.The core material is carefully selected Super Permalloy 0.2 mm thin plate with special heat treatment for low level use and laminated in many layers.Since this Super Permalloy is extremely delicate, a double cushion material is placed between the transformer and shield case to float it so that the magnetic properties are not damaged by mechanical shock from the outside.In order to block external noise, a permalloy multiple shield is used for each of the left and right transformers.Main parts such as boards and switches are also shielded with silicon steel sheets to reduce noise.Equipped with two input switching functions.Uses a lightweight push switch that fully takes into account contact resistance.Uses gold-plated input / output terminals.High-grade pin plug of low resistance, low capacity, gold plated terminal is included.

sections.overview:
* Announced in 1964  16,000 (around 1970)  19,000 (around 1978)  35,000 (around 2015)

A typical DENON MC cartridge.The DL 103 was jointly developed with NHK and announced in 1964. It is widely used as a monitor for broadcasting stations' music programs and record production processes.The DL-103 generator generates magnetic flux by passing magnetic field lines through an armature placed at right angles between parallel DC magnetic fields. The motion of the needle tip transmitted through the cantilever moves the armature, changes the magnetic flux density and direction, and generates output voltage corresponding to each of the left and right channels in the coil.In this structure, the center of vibration does not change even if the inclination of the armature changes due to the sinking of the needle tip by the needle pressure, so there is no bias in the output voltage. Therefore, the output voltage does not change due to the change of the needle pressure or the sinking of the needle tip, and the distortion does not increase.In order to realize both sufficient rigidity and weight reduction of equivalent mass at the same time, we have adopted a unique joint rod type double structure cantilever.In addition, by reducing the weight of the unique cross-shaped armature, double-structured cantilever, and needle tip diamond tip, the equivalent mass of the entire vibration system is kept small, increasing tracing capability and enabling ultra-wide band reproduction.The cantilever is supported by a single point support system, and is supported by a very thin piano wire (suspension wire) extending from the suspension. This structure prevents harmful vibrations in the length direction (the direction in which the sound groove of the record moves) of the cantilever. In addition, motion is free against vibrations in the vertical and horizontal directions of the stereo record, which is necessary for music signals, so distortion is less.Since the power generation coil is built into the cross-shaped armature independently on the left and right sides, the difference in sensitivity between the left and right channels is small and a good separation is achieved.A 0.2 mm square diamond tip is used for the needle tip. This needle tip has a curved radius of 0.65 mil = 16.5 microns and is attached to the cantilever by a special method that requires less adhesive, contributing to the weight reduction of the vibration system.In addition, since the diamond crystal axis is mounted with the hardest direction facing the contact surface of the sound groove of the record, it can be used for a long time.

A set that appeared as a thank-you model for the 15th anniversary of the birth of DL 103. A set of DL 103 and step-up transformer.This transformer has been newly designed with the best compatibility.

sections.overview: Based on the DL 103 and DL 103 s, this MC type cartridge was developed as the culmination of the DL 103 series.The basic structure of the vibration system uses a single point support system common to the DL-103 series.In this system, the cantilever is supported by an extra-fine piano wire (suspension wire) extending from the suspension. The cantilever does not undergo harmful vibration in the direction of the length of the sound groove (the direction of travel of the sound groove of the record). In addition, the cantilever can move freely against vibrations in the vertical and horizontal directions of the sound groove of the stereo record, which is necessary for signal reproduction, and the generation of distortion is reduced.Uses DENON's unique cross-shaped armature.This structure is lightweight, and combined with the light weight of the cantilever and diamond tip needle tip, the equivalent mass of the vibration system is kept small, and the power generation coil is independently wound around the cross-shaped armature, so that the sensitivity difference between the left and right channels is small and good separation is maintained.In order to take full advantage of the vibration system and power generation system, the DL-103D uses a unique double-structure cantilever of a joint rod type in a tapered shape to improve both rigidity and reduction of equivalent mass.The needle tip uses a special elliptical needle similar to the shape of a recording cutter needle. In addition, the material of the diamond tip is 0.1 mm square (0.2 mm square for DL-103, 0.15 mm square for DL-103S). This reduces the mass of the vibration system and realizes wide-band reproduction.This wider bandwidth improves crosstalk in the audible frequency band by 2 to 3 dB compared to the DL 103 s. In addition, since the mechanical impedance characteristic in the high frequency band is also improved, the deformation of the sound groove of the record is reduced, and the tracking performance of the sound groove of the needle tip is improved, and low distortion is realized.Since it is compatible with DL-103 and DL-103S, if the same head shell is used, there is no need to readjust the needle pressure and it can be replaced easily.

sections.overview: This MC cartridge is based on the DL 103 and has a lighter vibration system and greater compliance.The structure of the vibration system, power generation method, external dimensions, output voltage and electrical impedance are exactly the same as those of the DL-103.The cantilever is supported by an ultra-fine steel wire with a one point support system. The cantilever does not undergo harmful vibration in the length direction. In addition, vibration of the needle tip, which is important for stereo playback, in both directions is heavy, and compliance is the same. In addition, even if the needle tip sinks due to needle pressure, the center point of vibration does not change.A cross-shaped armature is used in the armature section to reduce the mass of the cantilever and to make it easy to wind the generator coils of the left and right channels symmetrically.DENON's unique double-structure cantilever is used.In this structure, the high-frequency characteristics can be changed quite freely by the combination of the length of the outer pipe and the inner pipe, and the characteristics can also be controlled by the combination of the material of both pipes and surface treatment.In the DL-103S, a special alloy is used for the cantilever, and the optimum combination of dimensions is adopted. In addition, the diamond tip is smaller and lighter than 0.15 mm square, and the high resonance frequency can be set at about 60 kHz, which is the limit, and excellent characteristics are obtained.The steel wire of the one point support is made slightly thinner than DL-103, and the damper material is changed to make the movement of the needle tip soft. This, combined with the weight reduction of the vibration system, means that the mechanical impedance is reduced not only in the audible frequency range but also from the low frequency range to the ultra-high frequency range. This increases the ability of the needle tip to follow the sound groove and prevents the needle from flying.The proper needle pressure is set at 1.8   0.3g, 0.7g lighter than DL-103. The dead weight is also 0.7g lighter than DL-103. Therefore, if the same head shell is used, it can be replaced without readjusting the needle pressure.The diamond tip of the needle uses an elliptical needle with special polishing similar to the shape of a recording cutter needle.Combined with its light mass and high tracking capability, it realizes playback with less tracing distortion and loss.The DL-103S also performs well on discrete 4-channel records.However, since the playback frequency range is over 60 kHz, unnecessary components over 45 kHz are played back, and these components become noise during demodulation.To cope with this problem, the pickup filter PUF-1 was sold separately as an option.

sections.overview: MC type cartridge using amorphous boron pipe.A new material, amorphous boron pipe with a thickness of 0.025 mm is used for the cantilever.Boron it is light, boron has an excellent specific rigidity (Young's modulus / density) and a melting point of 2,300 ?, making it the most suitable element for cantilever materials. Amorphous boron is an amorphous state filled with small particles, and its fracture strength is approximately three to four times greater than that of crystal boron, which is an assembly of large crystals.In order to use this material in the optimum condition, we have succeeded in forming ultra-thin pipes using our proprietary C. V. D. (Chemical Vapor Deposition) method, and have realized uniform and dense boron film surface.This reduces the effective mass of the vibration system to 0.168 mg, minimizes the mechanical impedance in the high-frequency range, and enables faithful and accurate tracing with light needle pressure.Solid diamond special elliptical needle has been adopted for the needle, achieving 0.01 mg or less.The tip of the boron pipe that fixes the needle is tapered and installed in a precise rectangular hole made by laser beam processing.The generator coil uses a rigid resin cross-shaped winding frame to lighten the entire vibration system and to achieve an optimum mass balance, eliminating the characteristic slack caused by split vibration. This winding frame method allows the coil to be wound symmetrically around the vibration system axis, and has the advantage of matching the characteristics of the left and right channels.For the internal structure, rare-earth cobalt magnet and rational yoke structure are adopted in order to obtain a small size and strong magnetic field. In addition, the vibration system is supported by the one point support system proven in the DL-303 and DL-103 series, so that the coil can always be held in the center of the magnetic field, and the generation of strain in the power generation system is kept low.

This prevents resonance phenomenon due to the shell and external induction noise due to lead wires, and ensures stable operation at all times.

sections.overview: Direct-drive type turntable inheriting the sound of DP-80.A double-structured turntable is used for the turntable.Structurally, it consists of a high-cut filter that connects the upper and lower turntables with springs and dampers, and the lower part is fixed to the motor shaft, which shuts out extraneous vibrations such as acoustic feedback from speakers and prevents the cartridge from picking up vibrations other than music signals.The DP-75 uses a zinc die-cast turntable for the upper part and an aluminum die-cast turntable for the lower part.An outrotor 3-phase AC servo motor is used as the drive motor.The servo mechanism uses DENON speed servomechanism with magnetic recording detection method. sections.overview: While inheriting the design image of the DP 3000, the appearance was made compact, and each part was simplified and the cost was reduced while maintaining the basic performance.A direct drive system is adopted as the drive system.Unlike the belt drive and idler drive systems, the direct drive system does not have a rotational flutter mechanism, so there is no wow transmission or rumble caused by these systems. In addition, the direct drive system can maintain stable performance over a long period of time because there is little wear.The servo circuit uses a speed detection mechanism based on a magnetic recording / reproducing method developed by DENON's station player.In this system, 1000 pulse signals are recorded with a high accuracy of less than 0.01% recording wavelength error using a special method on a magnetic material coated on the inner circumference of the rim of the turntable. These signals are then detected by a magnetic head in close proximity to the magnetic material. A demodulation circuit converts the voltage into a voltage proportional to the rotational speed of the turntable. This voltage is compared with a reference voltage corresponding to the specified speed. The difference voltage is used to control the torque of the motor so that the difference voltage becomes 0, and the turntable is kept at the specified speed by servoing.In addition to the high accuracy of the speed detection signal, the frequency is higher than that of other methods (500 Hz or higher), so it is stable even when the gain of the servo system is increased, and the response is fast and stable servo can be applied even in the region of uneven rotation.For the drive motor, the solid rotor type AC servo developed for direct drive also uses Oter.This motor is the same as that installed in the DP-3000. It has smooth rotation characteristics with less vibration compared to other synchronous motors and DC motors. Moreover, the driving waveform of the motor is also taken into consideration. There is almost no rumble, and the S / N ratio is over 60 dB.The switch adopts a slide system using a cam.The rotational speed can be changed by changing the circuit constant with a switch. This speed selection switch is linked with the power switch and allows you to select the speed and turn the power ON/OFF with one touch operation.The switch uses special high-grade grease used in cameras.Equipped with easy-to-understand built-in flash and flash shutter.

sections.overview: A direct drive turntable that inherits the performance and design of the DP 5000 and pursues cost performance.In the DP 5000, the pulse recorded inside the rim of the turntable is first detected by a magnetic head for speed detection. The pulse signal is amplified and passed through a limiter circuit. A demodulation circuit converts the change in speed into a change in voltage. This voltage is compared with a reference voltage set in advance to achieve the specified speed. The voltage difference is used to control the motor drive power supply voltage for servo control.As a result, the speed can be easily changed by changing the reference voltage. The circuit and elements used are highly stable, and highly reliable characteristics can be obtained even with temperature change, aging change, negative variable and simultaneously.In speed detection, the inside of the rim of the turntable is coated with a magnetic material with a large coercive force. Using a special method, pulses of a fixed wavelength are recorded with high precision and high density. This is detected by a magnetic head mounted at intervals of approximately 1/10mm.In this method, the wavelength error of recorded pulses is suppressed to less than 0.01%, and the frequency of detected pulses is approximately 1100 Hz at 33 1/3rpm because pulses are recorded at 2000 locations around the turntable.This frequency is more than 10 times higher than other methods, making it possible to greatly reduce the time constant of the integration circuit in the frequency-voltage conversion circuit.The turntable has a weight of 1.1 kg and an inertial mass of 160 kg ? cm.2Lightweight turntables have been adopted to speed up the start-up time, reduce the load on the bearing, and obtain long-term stable performance.The speed fine adjustment selection button can adjust the speed by   6% under variable conditions.The motor is a solid rotor type two phase torque motor with an extremely smooth rotating magnetic field, and a dedicated amplifier is used to drive the motor to reduce rumbling.

sections.overview: A pre-main amplifier designed with an emphasis on transmission characteristics.In the power amplifier section, all stages are directly connected DC amplifier configuration using discrete transistors. In the output stage, a newly developed 60W class epitaxial planar type fully symmetrical power transistor with little minority carrier accumulation effect and little switching distortion is adopted. The transistor used in the output stage does not change the finish condition between NPN and PNP, and has more reliability due to the symmetry.In addition, a large radiator with high heat radiation effect, a power supply circuit with large current capacity, and a differential amplifier with excellent DC balance are used to expand the transmission frequency band and to reduce low and high frequency distortion.The equalizer section employs a 3-stage direct-coupled E-E feedback type with a low-noise, high-voltage NPN transistor. In particular, a transistor with extremely high collector loss is used for the emitter follower of the final stage. As a result, the maximum output voltage of the equalizer amplifier is flattened to a high frequency range of 20 kHz. As a result, the allowable input of 10 kHz or higher, which had previously been problematic, is greatly improved.By using a carefully selected equalizer element, the RIAA deviation is kept within + 0. 2-0. 3 dB, making the total response of recording / reproducing flat.The tone circuit uses an NFB method with an emitter follower at the front stage.The Bass/Treble control uses a system that allows automatic defeat at the center point to flatten the transmission characteristics when the tone is flat.The speaker is protected by using a protective circuit with fast response speed.In addition, a detection circuit is provided to protect the power transistor.Equipped with a low filter.The speaker terminal has a screw-type structure to ensure reliable contact and reduce contact resistance.The power supply, filter and monitor switch use a new slide system.It has a unified design with the TU-332 FM tuner.
