sections.overview: A pre-main amplifier developed with an emphasis on the wide range response.The PMA 235 is designed not only with good frequency-to-amplification characteristics, but also with careful consideration of all physical characteristics including output bandwidth, input / output impedance, phase, transient characteristics, crosstalk, etc., even in the inaudible range.A pure complimentary service circuit using a Darlington power transistor of Motorola U.S.A. is adopted for the output stage of the power amplifier section. By combining a direct-coupled OCL circuit for all stages of differential amplification, a large radiator with good heat radiation effect, and a powerful power supply circuit, the sine wave continuous rated output has a margin and a stable design.The power supply section is equipped with a triple magnetic shield power transformer and a large-capacity power supply capacitor.The equalizer amplifier section uses a 3-stage direct-coupled emitter-emitter negative feedback circuit using a low-noise, high-voltage NPN transistor. It is operated at a high voltage of 53 v using a stabilized power supply without ripple voltage or voltage fluctuation. This increases the bare gain of the equalizer amplifier, increases the maximum output level, and ensures a maximum allowable input of 200 mVrms or more at 1 kHz.The large naked gain can apply deep negative feedback to suppress the high-frequency bounce phenomenon caused by the lack of RIAA negative feedback. In addition, the negative feedback circuit uses a film capacitor with an error of   1% and a non-inductive resistor with an error of   2% to achieve good RIAA deviation. At the same time, DC negative feedback is also adopted to ensure high accuracy up to the inaudible region, as well as improvements in ultra-low transient characteristics, SN ratio and harmonic distortion rate.A 3-stage direct connection circuit composed of NPN-FET-NPN transistor is adopted for the control amplifier section.In addition, a newly devised tone control negative feedback circuit is incorporated, and both Bass and Treble are automatically at the center. This eliminates an independent defeat switch and dramatically improves the frequency response at the time of defeat by flattening from 5 Hz to 300 kHz.The low filter has a cut-off frequency of 20 Hz as low as possible so as not to affect the low-frequency audio characteristics, and the attenuation characteristic is 12 dB due to the active type using transistors.When this filter circuit is OFF, the transistor circuit is degraded.The high filter has a characteristic of a simple octave of 6 dB.As for the internal structure, the power transformer is placed in the center of the rear part and the large radiator of the output stage is arranged on the left and right sides. This improves heat radiation and convection effect, eliminates structural waste, and improves the balance and separation of the left and right channels electrically.In order to make the power stage more stable and bring out the true value of the speaker, we carefully select the materials including wire and contact to lower the output impedance.The speaker terminal uses a screw structure with low contact resistance and reliable connection.In order to respond to erroneous operations such as short-circuiting of the speaker terminals, a unique protection circuit with an extremely fast response speed is incorporated to prevent damage to the power transistor.All printed circuit boards are made of copper-clad laminate with self-quenching properties. The power cord is coated with synthetic rubber, which is resistant to heat and aging, and is designed with safety in mind.Tantalum capacitors with high selection rank are used throughout the circuit to reduce switching noise.There was a wood cabinet as an option sold separately.

sections.overview: A pre-main amplifier that improves transmission characteristics while enhancing functions by newly devised tone circuits and filter circuits.The output terminal of the power amplifier is equipped with a 3-diffused mesa type PNP/NPN80W class power transistor with uniform characteristics, a pure complimentary service OCL circuit directly connected to all stages of differential-amplification, and a large power transformer made of highly permeable permalloy silicon steel core (Orient Core).In particular, the pre-stage differential amplifier circuit is separated from the large-current drive of the final stage by selecting the transistor and providing an independent power supply circuit, thereby improving stability.The equalizer amplifier uses an emitter-emitter negative feedback circuit in which three stages of NPN transistors are directly connected. The three transistors reduce the number of attached parts, and the simple circuit configuration ensures stability regardless of temperature or time.This circuit is operated at a high voltage of 70 v, and the voltage gain when no negative feedback is applied is very large. This allows the RIAA negative feedback and DC negative feedback to be applied deeply, further improving various characteristics.The PMA-255 uses a non-inductive resistor with a constant error of less than 1% for the negative feedback element, and along with the deep negative feedback, it achieves excellent RIAA deviation. In addition, the PMA is designed to maintain and improve the S / N ratio while widening the bandwidth by selecting the type with less noise generation from the type name selected in the design.On the PMA 255, the tone amplifier, filter and buffer circuits in the control amplifier section do not normally have gain. To obtain the voltage required to drive the power amplifier, a two stage booster amplifier with a gain of 14 dB is installed behind the volume. This booster amplifier ensures the loudness and tone control characteristics of the front and back circuits.The tone amplifier employs a modified BAX negative feedback type devised by DENON. It is a two stage direct-coupled circuit that combines low-noise FET amplification and emitter follower of PNP transistor. This method is easy to use for the negative feedback circuit that determines the control characteristics and has low waviness.Both Bass and Treble of the PMA 255 are rotary switches that can be adjusted in 2 dB steps. The central position of the knob automatically disables the capacitor of the feedback circuit.The filter circuit adopts a new replacement active type that uses transistors for both low and high frequencies.The buffer circuit is provided so as not to be affected by external wiring when the Pre-out terminal is used.The power transformer is placed in the center and the heat sink of the output stage is arranged on the left and right sides. This improves the convection effect of heat radiation and improves the balance and separation of the left and right channels.In addition, the power transformer is provided with a strict 6-layer magnetic shield, and the cabinet part for the amplifier input terminal is changed from steel plate to aluminum, reducing magnetic induction across the transformer, steel plate and input terminal, and improving the S / N ratio.In order to keep the resistance from the power transistor to the speaker output as low as possible, we carefully select wires, stabilizing wires, muting relay contacts and speaker terminals that have low specific resistance.A protection circuit with a fast response speed is provided to protect the power transistor from destruction due to short circuit of speaker circuit, etc.The printed circuit board is highly self-extinguishing, and the power cord is made of a synthetic rubber sheath cord that is resistant to heat and aging.Volume comes with a click stopper.This volume is structured so that the desired volume between steps can be obtained, while the resistance change is accurate like a rotary switch type.There was a wood cabinet as an option sold separately.

The 40 v power supply voltage, which is equivalent to that of a preamplifier, provides efficient dynamic range and linearity, and high S/N sound quality.

sections.overview: This is a pre-main amplifier equipped with a newly developed PCC system to bring out the essence of records.While maintaining almost the same configuration as the PMA-701, cost reduction has been attempted.The PCC (Phono Crosstalk Canceler) is a device that adds reverse crosstalk to the Phono Pickup type crosstalk and cancels it out. By using the attached adjustment record to operate two knobs, it is possible to improve the frequency range most easily perceived by the ear to approximately -40dB.The power amplifier section is composed of a direct-coupled OCL circuit for all stages of differential amplification. It is composed of a low-impedance power supply circuit, and new power transistors such as double epitaxial structure and triple diffusion structure are adopted for the output final stage respectively.To protect the speakers from errors and accidents, it has a built-in protection circuit with extremely fast response time and high reliability.In consideration of the effect on sound quality, we have adopted a relay with a special structure.In order to improve crosstalk caused by interference between channels, mutual interference is reduced by a circuit configuration in which two circuits are separated, and by disconnecting the power supply of a power circuit with high current and the power supply of a preamplifier circuit with low current.To prevent the small signal sent from the record player from being degraded by wiring or changeover switches, one phono input circuit is used and the input terminal is directly connected to the equalizer amplifier.This reduces the shielding wire and stray capacitance and improves the input impedance.In order to improve dynamic crosstalk, a two power transformer system is used for the power supply section, and a pre-main and main separately wound power supply trans configuration is used.

sections.overview: This pre-main amplifier is composed of two amplifiers, a super equalizer amplifier and a power amplifier.The basic configuration consists of two amplifier configuration consisting of only the MC/MM super equalizer amplifier and non-switching A power amplifier installed in the PMA-550/PMA-540. DENON technology has been introduced to enhance the completion.It employs a direct DC servo system that eliminates the coupling and condenser that degrade sound quality.All signal paths are designed without a capacitor, and there is no coupling capacitor from the MC input terminal to the SP output terminal that affects sound quality.The equalizer amplifier section is equipped with a super equalizer consisting of an NF-type DC amplifier with low-noise dual-FET and a CR-type equalizing filter to realize ultra-wide bandwidth.In addition, the gain and S/N are designed to focus on the MC cartridge in order to realize the advantages of the super equalizer.The power amplifier section uses a non-switching A method equipped with a 0 cross linear bias circuit.The 0 cross linear bias circuit is equipped with a high-speed thermal feedback circuit to further enhance the merits of the non-switching system. In addition to achieving quick stabilization of bias from power-on, high stability against external factors such as temperature change and time lapse is obtained.The tone control section is equipped with a real-time tone control circuit that does not involve active elements or large capacitors in the signal path.In this circuit, passive elements are incorporated into the feedback system of the power amplifier to enable wide range and smooth control.All input / output terminals are directly connected to the printed circuit board, and input / output switching is operated by a non-magnetic aluminum shaft to minimize the routing of wires.The REC-OUT OFF function is incorporated in consideration of the effect on sound quality.It is also equipped with a subsonic filter and loudness control.

sections.overview: Pre-main amplifier with super equalizer and real drive circuit.When using MC cartridges as well as MM cartridges, capacitors are removed from all stages of the signal path from the phono input terminal to the speaker output terminal.The fully capacitorless configuration is realized by adopting the direct DC servo circuit that is also included in the PMA 970. It effectively shuts out DC drift and ensures stability in the ultra-low frequency range.The EQ amplifier section is equipped with a super-equalizer that combines the advantages of the NF (feedback type) and CR (non-feedback type) types, thereby achieving excellent RIAA deviation.The super equalizer consists of an NF-type DC amplifier with low-noise dual FET and a CR-type equalizing filter. The first stage consists of parallel differential amplification with dual FET of direct DC servo system. This eliminates DC temperature drift while improving S/N and distortion factor.A real drive circuit is mounted to reduce distortion factor.This circuit focuses on the operation of the amplifier at the time of mounting the speaker and reduces the distortion of the amplifier at the time of reactive load. It realizes good characteristics even at high power and low distortion.The power amplifier consists of a first stage low-noise FET differential-direct-DC servo system + two stage transistor differential-3-stage pre-driver + Darlington connection complimentary service push-pull.In addition, it is equipped with a 0 cross linear bias circuit and a built-in high-speed thermal feedback circuit to further enhance the merits of the non-switching system. It stabilizes the bias quickly from power-on and realizes high stability against external factors such as temperature such as temperature change and time lapse. It not only eliminates switching distortion but also reduces crossover distortion.The tone circuit has a real-time tone control circuit.This circuit consists of only the passive elements necessary for tone control, and by incorporating them into the power amplifier, large capacitors harmful to sound quality are removed from the signal path.The power supply consists of a multi-shielded power transformer and a 30,000 ? F block capacitor.In order to reduce magnetic materials as much as possible, an L-angle and an aluminum radiator are combined, and the inside of the amplifier is organized neatly.In addition, the advantage of a simple circuit is improved by remote control of the input switching section to greatly shorten the signal path.It is equipped with a direct couple switch.In addition to the Rec out off function that eliminates the effect on sound quality, it is equipped with a subsonic filter and loudness control.

sections.overview: This pre-main amplifier is equipped with a super equalizer to take advantage of the cartridge performance.The basic configuration consists of two amplifiers, an MC/MM super equalizer amplifier and a non-switching A power amplifier. In addition to this simple configuration, a complete DC configuration is adopted from the MC input terminal to the SP output terminal without using a coupling capacitor in the signal path.This fully capacitor-less configuration is realized by installing DENON's direct DC servo system in both the equalizer and power amplifiers to shut out DC drift and achieve the sound quality inherent in DC-configured amplifiers.The EQ section is equipped with a super equalizer for use with cartridges capable of wide-band playback.The amplifier consists of an NF-type DC amplifier with newly developed low-noise dual FET and a CR-type equalizing filter. The first stage is parallel differential amplifier with dual FET of direct DC servo system.As a result, in addition to the ultra-wide range, we have obtained a high gain equivalent to that of a head amplifier for MC. It is also compatible with low-output MC cartridges.In addition, it is equipped with the dual listening mechanism of the cartridge, and not only the switching of MC/MM can be used, but also the comparison trial listening of 2 MC or 2 MM can be operated by the push button on the front panel.The power amplifier section is equipped with a direct DC servo type high gain non-switching A power amplifier.It consists of a low-impedance buffer amplifier with a first stage low-noise FET parallel differential + IC high-speed operational amplifier, a driver stage of a 3-stage differential current mirror, and a high-speed power transistor 2 parallel push-pull output stage. Direct DC servo is applied from the output terminal of the power amplifier to the first stage of the buffer amplifier. This improves the characteristics of the amplifier such as high speed, high gain, high stability, and low distortion factor.The bias circuit is DENON's unique 0 cross linear bias circuit and high-speed thermal feedback circuit. This eliminates switching distortion, which is the advantage of non-switching systems, and realizes highly stable operation.The tone circuit has real-time tone control.It is composed of only the passive elements necessary for tone control and does not have an amplifying function, so the distortion factor and S/N problem of the tone circuit itself are improved.The power supply is equipped with a large toroidal transformer with an emphasis on leakage flux and voltage fluctuation, and a 44,000 ? F block capacitor.This power supply section is located in the center of the left and right independent power amplifier sections, and adopts the layout of power current pure radiation construction method which makes wiring the shortest distance and L/Rch the equal distance.It is equipped with functions such as a direct couple switch, Rec out off function, an equalizer subsonic filter which is effective only when playing records, and a loudness control function.

sections.overview: Pre-main amplifier with built-in D/A converter.The D/A converter uses the "W Super Linear Converter" system, which has independent left and right channels. This system was developed based on the technology developed in the field of commercial digital (PCM) equipment.Since there is no conversion error (distortion) at large input, and two pairs of D/A converters are used, channel separation is excellent and there is no time difference between left and right channels.In addition, a 4 x oversampling digital filter has been adopted to improve linear phase characteristics.The coaxial digital input is mounted Route 3 and also equipped with an optical digital input.A digital audio multi-interface demodulation circuit with a digital input selector based on a high-speed C-MOS logic circuit automatically recognizes differences in sampling frequency and performs D/A conversion.Shield between the digital audio interface demodulation circuit and the D/A converter circuit.The interface circuit is equipped with a dedicated power supply independent from the secondary side of the transformer to prevent bypassing of the power supply circuit for digital signals, which is a source of noise from analog signals.In addition, by covering it with a shield case that is also used to prevent vibration of the chassis and circuit board, digital signals are prevented from leaking to the analog section.The power amplifier section is designed to increase power and simplify the circuit.A high-speed, large-capacity transistor is used in the final stage in a single push-pull operation. A low-noise, low-distortion operational amplifier is used in the first stage of the voltage amplification stage, and a complimentary service push-pull circuit is used in the second and third stages.Equipped with a digital direct input switch, the digital signal is converted to an analog signal and then directly connected to the power amplifier, enabling straight playback.In addition, one of the two speaker terminals (speaker B) uses a direct connection method that does not involve a changeover switch to reduce transmission loss.The power supply uses a 400 VA rank toroidal transformer and a 8,200 ? Fx4 electrolytic capacitor.In order to support playback of analog records, an equalizer amplifier composed of low-noise transistor differential amplification at the first stage is mounted.Audio and digital systems are separated from the power supply via a large heat sink to minimize the impact.Equipped with a subsonic filter for Phono.Newly designed reset-type high-speed protection circuit is adopted.Broadband real-time tone control is adopted.

(Signal Level Divided Construction) is adopted in order to suppress the mutual interference of each circuit.By dividing the signal handling into low-level blocks, high-level blocks, and microcomputer blocks that handle digital signals, electrical interference between each block is suppressed.The low-impedance volume reduces the impedance of the volume control circuit, preventing the S/N ratio and frequency characteristics from deteriorating at general listening levels.It is equipped with an equalizer amplifier that can be used with either MC or MM cartridge by switching operation.It is equipped with a source direct switch and can bypass control circuits such as Bass, Treble, Balance and Loudness by turning it on.The linked side of the AC outlet is linked to the remote power on/off.It comes with a system remote control that supports DENON CD players, cassette decks and tuners.In addition, the muting switch on the remote control body can be used to cancel the sound from the speaker.

sections.overview: This pre-main amplifier is equipped with a toroidal transformer and New Super Optical ClassA circuit for higher sound quality.DENON's proprietary NEW super optical ClassA circuit is incorporated into the power amplifier.The newly developed bias control circuit operates as pure A-class amplification up to general listening power level, and realizes sound quality unique to A-class. sections.overview: A pre-main amplifier developed in pursuit of the concept of Simple is Best.An integrated amplifier usually consists of a pre-stage amplifier section such as an equalizer amplifier, an intermediate control section such as a tone control amplifier, and a final stage amplifier section such as a power amplifier.In the direct-coupling method adopted in the PMA 700 z, the intermediate control section can be disconnected from the main circuit when it is not necessary, and a unique gain switch is provided to avoid unnecessary saturation. When the Toudin Feet and two filter switches are turned off, the signal from the equalizer amplifier and other function inputs only passes through active circuits with good transmission characteristics, such as emitter-follower stages and, if necessary, a + 10 dB booster amplifier, or through a nonreactive attenuator, and is connected to the power amplifier section with flat frequency characteristics in the range from 10 Hz to 150 kHz. This allows for less coloring and less playback sound.The power amplifier section uses a 2-stage Darlington pure complimentary service direct-coupled 2-power supply OCL circuit.DC stability and balance are required for all stages of OCL circuit and complimentary service circuit. However, PMA-700Z uses two differential amplifiers in the driver section to increase DC control capability and obtain stability. In addition, all stages of OCL improve low-frequency characteristics. Especially, output impedance is less than 0.16   from ultra-low frequency to 10 kHz.The Darlington transistor of the last stage configuration has a margin in the last stage by making it a discrete configuration, and switching distortion and crossover distortion are suppressed by ensuring the relativity of the complimentary service stage by carefully selecting the parts.The power supply section uses a high-efficiency power transformer and a non-inductive high-ripple capacitor.The tone control circuit uses an emitter follower for the first stage, a low-noise FET for the second stage, and a grounded collector amplified output for the third stage. The control characteristics are obtained by the tone control NF circuit which returns from the third stage to the second stage.Bass and Treble can be adjusted with precise 2-dB step spacing using 11-contact rotary switch.The tone control section is equipped with a turnover switch and a tone defeat switch.The turnover switch allows you to select two high and low turnover frequencies, the Defeat switch flattens between 20 Hz and 20 kHz, the Tone Defeat switch jumps to the tone amplifier, and the first stage emitter-follower output is directly input to the next filter switch. The tone amplifier is designed with no basic gain, so there is no change in level when the tone jumps.A Butterworth type filter circuit is used for both rumble and scratch noise.This circuit also has no gain in the passband, so there is no level problem even if the circuit jumps when the filter switch is turned off.In addition to the conventional muting switch, a 3-stage switching type gain switch and a unique level setting with a booster amplifier are adopted.There are three gain positions : + 10 dB, 0 dB and -10dB. At + 10 dB, a booster amplifier with a gain of 10 dB is used. This state corresponds to the level of conventional thinking. When using an average cartridge, the standard PMA-700Z is used with a gain of 0 dB and a volume of around -10dB. A gain of -10dB is useful when using a sensitive cartridge.The muting switch can reduce the volume by 20 dB based on a gain of 0 dB.The equalizer amplifier improves the allowable input level and reduces the noise level.Excellent RIAA deviation is a deviation with feedback from the final stage of the emitter-follower, which is less sensitive to selected high-precision parts and subsequent circuits.In addition, the Phono2 input is equipped with a grounded base type low-noise pre-amplifier for MC cartridge, so that switching between MC and MM is possible.The input circuit has a volume that can be adjusted when the rated output of the connected device is large to suppress distortion in the first stage amplifier.This volume has the maximum standard input sensitivity.An emitter-follower circuit is used for the recording output to avoid the effect of tape deck connection on sound quality.Also, a DIN connector is attached to the Tape terminal.The protection circuit is equipped with a final-stage transistor protection circuit and a speaker protection circuit.Equipped with functions such as a null balance switch, a mode switch for selecting Rev/Stereo/L + R/L/R, a speaker selector switch, a dubbing switch, and a monitor switch.Equipped with a loudness control.Built-in pre-out and main-in terminals allow the pre-amplifier and power amplifier sections to be used independently.

sections.overview: As the third generation of the 700 series, this pre-main amplifier has improved physical characteristics and sound quality.The equalizer amplifier is made of carefully selected low-noise transistors and high-precision parts, and consists of emitter-follower outputs. The RIAA deviation is kept within   0.2 dB by equalizing feedback from the last stage of the emitter-follower, which is not easily affected by subsequent circuits.The Phono2 input is equipped with a newly designed low-noise head amplifier for the MC cartridge and is a dedicated input for the MC cartridge.This head amplifier adopts a class A push-pull parallel connection configuration using four PNP and four NPN transistors each, improving the SN ratio when using MC cartridge.To handle very small input levels, it is directly connected to a dedicated head amplifier. In addition, the dedicated terminal is plated with bacteria to reduce contact resistance.An emitter-follower circuit is used for the Tape rec output circuit to avoid the effect of tape deck connections on sound quality.The control amplifier section uses a direct coupling method.The tone amplifier uses an emitter follower for the first stage, a low-noise FET for the second stage, and DENON's unique tone control NFB circuit, which is fed back from the amplified output of the third stage collector to the second stage, provides low-waviness control characteristics.An 11-contact rotary switch is used for adjusting the bass and treble, enabling accurate 2 db step switching.The turnover frequency can be switched between two levels of high and low, or in the case of DEFEAT, the tone amplifier is disconnected and the first stage emitter-follower output is directly input to the next filter switch.Equipped with a low filter and a high filter. Both filters use 18dB/oct. Butterworth type.The power amplifier section is DC configuration.Class A Darlington pure complimentary service push-pull OCL circuit is adopted for the output stage. Class A push-pull configuration of PNP and NPN is adopted from the first stage to the drive stage of the main in terminal. The power supply is separated from the output stage. This class A push-pull configuration improves the stability against temperature changes and power supply fluctuations in the entire power amplifier configuration. In addition, by providing stable bare characteristics with a high gain of approximately 90 dB, a stable NFB of approximately 62 dB is made possible. Low distortion reproduction from low output to rated output is achieved.In addition, the combination of PNP and NPN cancels the distortion by the push-pull configuration of all stages, and linearity is obtained over a wide dynamic range.The output protection circuit uses an electronic control circuit so that the sound is not cut even when an excessive input is input. In the unlikely event that a DC voltage appears at the speaker terminal, the relay operates to disconnect the speaker.The muting circuit at the time of power-on has also been improved so that no noise is generated even when it is turned off by an external switch such as a timer.In the internal structure, the voltage amplification part (front stage part and middle stage part) for handling small signal is contained in the shield case to prevent the effect of induction noise.The power transformer uses a cut core with less leakage flux and is sealed in a case.Equipped with a null balance switch that can be used for balance check, etc.Mode switch, speaker switch, dubbing switch, monitor switch, etc. are mounted.Equipped with a loudness control.Pre-out and main in terminals are mounted.

sections.overview: This is a pre-main amplifier equipped with a newly developed PCC system to bring out the essence of records.The PCC (Phono Crosstalk Canceler) is a device that adds reverse crosstalk to the Phono Pickup type crosstalk and cancels it out. By using the attached adjustment record to operate two knobs, it is possible to improve the frequency range most easily perceived by the ear to approximately -40dB.The power amplifier section is composed of a direct-coupled OCL circuit for all stages of differential amplification. It is composed of a low-impedance power supply circuit, and new power transistors such as double epitaxial structure and triple diffusion structure are adopted for the output final stage respectively.To protect the speakers from errors and accidents, it has a built-in protection circuit with extremely fast response time and high reliability.In consideration of the effect on sound quality, we have adopted a relay with a special structure.In order to improve crosstalk caused by interference between channels, mutual interference is reduced by a circuit configuration in which two circuits are separated, and by disconnecting the power supply of a power circuit with high current and the power supply of a preamplifier circuit with low current.To prevent the small signal sent from the record player from being degraded by wiring or changeover switches, one phono input circuit is used and the input terminal is directly connected to the equalizer amplifier.This reduces the shielding wire and stray capacitance and improves the input impedance.In order to improve dynamic crosstalk, a 3-power transformer system is used for the power supply.

sections.overview: This pre-main amplifier was developed by introducing original technologies such as a non-feedback 0 db amplifier, direct A system, and super equalizer.From the MC input terminal to the speaker output terminal, all stages are capacitorless (complete DC configuration) without using even a single capacitor in the main signal path. The signal path is made pure and high-speed.This fully capacitorless configuration uses the direct DC servo circuit installed in the PMA 970 and PMA 950 to suppress DC drift and ensure stability in the ultra-low frequency range.Equipped with an MC/MM super equalizer, this cartridge has excellent RIAA deviation characteristics of 20 Hz to 100 kHz   0.2 dB, exceeding the upper reproduction limit frequency of high-end cartridges.It consists of an NF-type DC amplifier with newly developed low-noise dual FET and a CR-type equalizing filter. The first stage consists of parallel differential amplification with dual FET of direct DC servo system.The power amplifier section uses a non-feedback 0 dB amplifier.The non-feedback 0 db amplifier compares the signal obtained from the output side of the main amplifier (main signal + distortion component, etc.) with the input signal by the direct distortion servo circuit, and extracts components other than the input signal (distortion, noise, etc.).This distortion component is amplified by the direct distortion servo circuit, inverted in phase, and applied to the input side of the main amplifier to cancel the distortion component and suppress the static distortion.In addition, the non-feedback 0 dB amplifier has a direct path in which the signal flows in only one direction, so no dynamic distortion occurs. In addition, noise components other than static distortion can be cancelled as a difference in the input signal by the effect of the direct distortion servo circuit. In addition, a buffer (emitter follower) is designed to separate the voltage and power amplification stages. Moreover, the voltage amplification stage is not affected by the speaker because there is no NFB loop, and the miscellaneous amplification stage can be simply constructed because no extra amplification by NFB is required.The circuit configuration of the power amplifier section is a three stage current mirror using a low-noise FET at the first stage. Low impedance is achieved by using a complimentary service emitter-follower, and it is completely separated from the power amplifier stage.The power amplifier stage is the output stage of the high-speed power transistor 2 parallel push-pull, and direct DC servo is applied from the output terminal to the first stage of the voltage amplifier to suppress DC drift and stabilize the ultra-low range.In addition, DENON's original 0 cross linear bias circuit is used for the output stage to eliminate switching distortion caused by power transistor cutoff.Speakers are equipped with a real drive circuit to reduce distortion under real load.In the Real Drive Circuit, a Real Drive Line with electronic elements is set, and the protection line is very close to the A. S. O. (Area of Safety Operating) line. Therefore, even if the speaker load operation line becomes large at high output, it does not interfere with the protection line, making it possible to perform high power drive to the limit of transistor performance.This reduces the distortion factor at the actual load of the speaker to approximately 1/50.The equalizer amplifier and power amplifier are separated by an aluminum radiator to eliminate mutual interference.Input switching is a remote control to shorten the wiring.The power supply uses a large toroidal transformer with an emphasis on voltage regulation and leakage flux, and a 44,000 ? F large-capacity capacitor.Real-time tone control is used for tone control.This is composed of only passive elements necessary for tone control, and there is no distortion factor or S/N problem of the tone circuit itself, and the effect on the main circuit is suppressed.By operating the switch on the front panel, it is also possible to compare and listen to 2 MC or 2 MM.Equipped with a Rec out selector, subsonic filter, direct coupling switch, mode switch for stereo reverse and monaural playback, and loudness control switch.Equipped with high-speed protection circuit.

Distortion components caused by active devices such as transistors are detected by a high-speed operational amplifier and only the distortion components are removed.In theory, static distortion (harmonic distortion, intermodulation distortion) is canceled out, and dynamic distortion (transient distortion) does not occur. This circuit has high stability.F for the last stageTA power transistor of 20 MHz / Pc150W is used in a single push mode, and linear amplification characteristics are obtained from very low volume to very high volume.The voltage amplification stage employs three differential amplification stages and the first stage employs an ultra-low noise FET to achieve low noise and DC configuration. sections.overview: A pre-main amplifier that pursues high efficiency and high output while taking advantage of the quality of class A operation.Although it is equipped with a class A power amplifier, it is equipped with a real bias circuit to achieve almost the same body size as an equivalent amplifier of class B operation.Using the same principle as the POA 3000 and PMA 970, the real bias circuit uses a method in which the bias current rises before the signal current. In addition to parallel use of power transistors, a real drive line with electronic elements is installed in the protection circuit to eliminate signal loss at the time of a large signal. When a general speaker system is connected, distortion near the high-output fo is reduced by approximately 1/50.The equalizer circuit consists of an NF-type DC amplifier with newly developed low-noise dual FET and a CR-type equalizing filter. The first stage is a 4-parallel differential amplifier circuit with direct DC servo dual FET to achieve low noise and high SN.The first stage of the equalizer employs a cascode bootstrap circuit that is not affected by input impedance to reduce distortion.Equipped with a highly stable original direct DC servo circuit, capacitors are removed from all signal paths from the MC input to the SP output.The tone control section consists of only the passive elements necessary for tone control. By incorporating these passive elements into the power amplifier, a high-capacity capacitor, which is harmful to sound quality, is eliminated from the signal path, making the configuration simple.In addition, the configuration of the main circuit is not affected even at the time of tone defeat.The power supply section is equipped with a large toroidal transformer and a 44,000 ? F block capacitor.In addition, in order to supply current to the left and right channels of the power stage under the same condition, the layout of the power current pure radiation construction method is adopted to shorten the wiring.In addition, the power transformer is well shielded to minimize the influence on signal circuits and external devices.Equipped with a high-speed protection circuit that doubles as a muting operation when the power switch is ON.It is equipped with a headphone jack with a high / low impedance switching function.It is equipped with functions such as a subsonic filter, loudness control, muting function and direct couple switch.Brazilian Rosewood-style side wood is attached to the side.

sections.overview: Pre-main amplifier with dual super non-feedback circuit.The PMA 960 is equipped with a dual super non-feedback circuit that enhances the non-feedback system.This circuit consists of a distortion servo circuit in which the N-channel and P-channel transistors of the power stage mutually cancel out the distortion.The dual super no-feedback circuit has no NFB loop that returns the signal to the input side, so the transmission speed of the signal approaches that of the bare circuit, and there is no dynamic distortion that greatly affects the auditory quality. It also has the advantage of theoretically making the static distortion 0 and increasing the slew rate.In addition, the dual super no-feedback circuit with a high removal effect has an excellent distortion removal effect up to the high-order harmonic distortion region of 20 kHz or more. In addition, since there is no NFB loop, the influence of the back electromotive force, etc. does not reach the voltage amplification stage (pre-driver stage, etc.) when the speaker is connected, and dynamic distortion does not occur. There are various other advantages.The flat amplifier, which is heavy for CD playback, has been thoroughly upgraded to high speed to improve the slew rate.In addition, it is fully capacitorless (fully DC configuration) for all signal paths and non-switching class A power amplification.A power transistor of Pc130W is connected in parallel to the output stage.The power supply is equipped with a large 390 VA toroidal transformer, four newly developed   50x100mm block capacitors (12,000 ? Fx4) for audio equipment with separate left and right channels near the output stage to avoid mutual interference, and a fast recovery diode for high-speed rectification. sections.overview: Pre-main amplifier developed with POA 3000 and PRA 2000 PRA technologies.In order to shorten the signal system, we have adopted a two amplifier configuration consisting of an equalizer amplifier and a power amplifier, so that the tone circuit cannot be used as a servo circuit at the front of the power stage.In addition, the direct DC servo circuit removes all capacitors from all signal paths from the MC input to the SP output to achieve a complete DC configuration.A direct DC servo circuit that realizes a capacitor-less configuration for all stages is used for the equalizer amplifier and power amplifier.In the direct DC servo system, stability in the ultra-low frequency range is ensured by shutting out minute latent DC drift. Moreover, since this circuit has an extremely simple configuration with only the parallel connection of the first stage FET differential amplifier and servo elements, characteristic degradation due to the servo circuit does not occur.The equalizer amplifier section is equipped with a non-feedback real-time equalizer with two DC linear amplifiers.This circuit consists of two stages of DC linear amplifier with newly developed low-noise dual FET and a CR-type equalizing filter. The first stage is a dual-FET parallel differential amplifier with direct DC servo system, which fundamentally eliminates DC temperature drift while improving S/N and distortion factor. In addition, high-frequency characteristics are also improved. In addition, a newly developed cascode differential bootstrap and a dual-transistor current mirror circuit are used together in order to reduce potential distortion and noise. In the voltage amplification stage of the next stage, the Darlington local feedback circuit is a class A push-pull circuit, which greatly reduces distortion. The CR-type equalizing filter of the SEPP output stage is driven with low impedance. The CR-type equalizing filter of the SEPP output stage is driven with low impedance. The CR-type equalizing filter is a thoroughly low-impedance type and uses a non-feedback type real-time equalizer system to obtain excellent SN ratio. In addition, high-precision elements carefully selected by a computer are used for the CR element.The latter amplifier, to which the signal from the equalizing filter is sent, has the same high-grade circuit structure as the former amplifier.   60 V is supplied to the former amplifier and   32 V is supplied to the latter amplifier from independent stabilizing power supply respectively. In addition, a high-output, high-speed, and high-voltage transistor of Pc300mW ? fT100MHz is used to realize a high output and wide dynamic range of clipping level 18 V.The equalizer amplifier section is a high-gain type equalizer focusing on the MC cartridge from the beginning, which brings out the power of the MC cartridge.The power amplifier section uses the circuit technology of the real bias circuit used in the power amplifier POA-3000, and realizes high power with class A operation.A real-bias circuit has three functions : setting and stabilizing control of a fixed bias, supply of a high-speed bias according to the magnitude of the signal, and peak-hold-reset operation in response to an unfavorable change in the signal. The circuit operates by detecting the input signal at a high speed, and then supplying the amount of bias necessary to maintain class A operation in the bias balanced drive circuit of the FET differential based on the detected signal. At this time, the bias current is stably controlled so that it does not fluctuate even if the power transistor generates heat. Therefore, the best condition is always maintained. In addition, the bias current rises faster than the signal current, and in order to eliminate cutoff due to time delay, a small amount of fixed bias current flows even when no signal is present. This enables the bias to rise faster than the signal current even when a high-frequency music signal with a fast rise comes in, and ensures class A operation.For the output transistor, newly developed high-speed power transistors (fT : 100 MHz, Pc : 120W) with excellent high-frequency characteristics are connected in parallel with two parallel push-pull connections on one side per channel to improve the linearity of hFE at high output.The buffer amplifier of the power amplifier section has a circuit configuration of "first stage low noise FET parallel differential cascode bootstrap direct DC servo + differential current mirror balanced drive + pure complimentary service push-pull". The pre-driver stage has a 3-stage differential current mirror output, which drives the class A power stage with low impedance.The power supply uses a large toroidal transformer (7.6 kg, 145 mm   x height 121 mm) and a 66,000 ? F large capacity block capacitor (63.5 mm   x height 120 mm).The voltage amplifier of the class A power amplifier is supplied from a stabilized power supply of   23 V, the power supply is supplied from a separate winding of   60 V, the equalizer amplifier is supplied from a separate winding of a stabilized power supply, and two DC linear amplifiers are supplied with   60 V and   32 V.In addition, the large toroidal transformer suppresses leakage flux by strict multiple shielding.Equipped with a protection circuit that also functions as a muting operation when the power switch is ON.It also has a DC protection circuit to prevent damage to the speakers due to DC output, and a temperature protection circuit to prevent damage to the transistors due to abnormal temperature rise of the radiator.The tone control employs a newly developed real-time tone control that eliminates harmful capacitors from the signal path.In order to prevent mutual interference between circuits, the power supply and signal amplification system, which occupy approximately 1/3 of the internal volume, are shielded by shield processing.In addition, all input / output terminals are directly connected to the shortest printed circuit board, and the various modes are operated by remote switches controlled by front panel knobs to minimize wire routing.The side wood has a Brazilian Rosewood-like mirror finish and the front panel has a champagne gold hard anodized finish.Equipped with a headphone jack with direct position.In addition to High/Low impedance switching, Direct is also installed. sections.overview: Pure A-class pre-main amplifier with built-in D/A converter.It is class A amplified up to 1W output (8  ) in consideration of the quality at low power.In class A push-pull operation, distortion is small, and the waveform of the sy passing current flowing through one transistor near the 0 cross becomes continuous instead of pulse. (linear-phase) low-pass filter.The digital input section consists of a coaxial digital input Route 3 and two optical digital input systems. This element is an amplifying element of the smallest unit and has a current supply capability 3 to 10 times that of the normal one. It is composed of a single push-pull circuit to achieve both expressive power and high power.The power supply section uses a High Current Dynamic power supply circuit with a newly developed block capacitor for audio equipment. A high-current Schottky barrier diode and a newly developed block electrolytic capacitor for rectification enable a stable current supply over the entire band.By connecting two transformers in parallel, the electrical and magnetic characteristics of the power transformer are greatly improved, and by using the L. C. (Leakage Canceling) mounting method, which cancels the influence of the magnetism of each other, the leakage flux, which is a source of noise in the amplifier, is reduced.The transformer is also mounted with a combination of special resin and rubber vibration isolator to enhance the floating effect and eliminate the effect on sound quality.To support next-generation audio, the volume circuit, tone circuit, and power amplifier circuit were reviewed and the upper limit of the reproduction frequency in actual use was set to 100 kHz.Built-in pre-out terminal and power direct input terminal.With the Power Direct Input jack, you can select Power Direct with the front panel selector by switching the switch on the back panel. In other positions, it operates as a pre-main amplifier.A carefully selected relay is used for the input switching to the power amplifier, and the pre-out terminal is also output from the discrete configuration flat amplifier of the MOS-FET output used in the PRA-S1 to improve the sound quality.The Precision Signal Ground circuit is installed to reduce the noise that flows into the ground circuit, which is the reference of signal amplification, and to stabilize the ground potential.In order to prevent interference between each circuit and the inflow of noise, power amplifier blocks are arranged symmetrically in a twin monaural configuration. In addition, shielding is thoroughly done according to the signal level. A 6-block separated structure using black treated steel plate with a thickness of 1.6 mm is used.The Precision Mechanical Ground structure reduces interference with other vibration sources such as power transformers by attaching a radiator dumped by elastic rubber and radiator stabilizer directly close to the FOOT, and also uses a top cover and volume knob with anti-vibration measures.The phono equalizer uses a discrete equalizer with a low-noise FET at the first stage, and is stabilized by a dedicated power supply to improve sound quality.MC cartridges are also supported by switching back panel switches.Parts such as OFC internal wiring material, inert gas enclosed relay, high sound quality carbon resistance and power radiator with excellent heat radiation effect are adopted.It uses a large speaker terminal with gold-plated brass machined parts. sections.overview: A pre-main amplifier developed as a successor to the PMA 2000 IV.The model name AE means Advanced Evolution, and it is positioned as a product that is related to SA series.The output stage uses a single push-pull circuit using UHC (Ultra High Current) -MOS.With the smallest amplifier element, it has a current supply capability 3 to 10 times that of the normal one, and it realizes both fine expressive power and high power.The power supply section is composed of a power supply circuit for the preamplifier that requires a stable voltage and a power supply circuit for the output stage that requires a large current, which are independent from the winding section of the power transformer. This configuration eliminates the effect of the operating current of the output stage and improves the resolution of the preamplifier section that handles small signals.A high-current Schottky barrier diode is used for rectification to support the expressive power of UHC-MOS with low-noise characteristics and high-speed operation, and a large-capacity block electrolytic capacitor for audio is used for power supply to provide a stable and clean power supply.The electrical and magnetic characteristics of the power transformer are greatly improved by connecting two transformers in parallel.In addition, by using the L. C. (Leakage Canceling) mounting method which cancels the influence of each other's magnetism to each other, the leakage flux which is a source of noise in the amplifier is also reduced.In addition, the transformer is mounted with a special resin or anti-vibration material to enhance the floating effect and eliminate adverse effects on sound quality.It has a power amp direct terminal that can be connected directly to the power amp from another preamp, and a pre-out terminal that can be connected to another power amp or a subwoofer.The Power Amp Direct function can be switched ON/OFF with a switch on the front panel, and the pre-out terminal is output from a MOS-FET discrete configuration flat amplifier, giving consideration to sound quality.By reviewing each of the volume circuit, tone circuit and power amplifier circuit, the upper limit of the frequency in actual use is secured to 100 kHz.Using the Precision Signal Ground circuit, the noise flowing into the ground circuit, which is the reference of signal amplification, is reduced to stabilize the ground potential.In order to thoroughly suppress the effect of vibration on sound quality, the Precision Mechanical Ground structure is adopted, which is a review of the vibration isolation structure. In mounting and positioning various parts, measures are taken to effectively eliminate the effect of external and internal vibration, and transparency and sound image localization are improved.The power transformer, which is the source of vibration, is mounted floating using multiple damping materials, and the radiator is dumped by elastic material and radiator stabilizer and directly attached near the leg part to prevent interference with other vibration sources such as the power transformer.The internal layout is a twin monaural configuration in which power amplifier blocks are arranged in L/R symmetry, and interference of each circuit and inflow of noise are suppressed.In addition, circuits with different signal levels are separated for complete shielding, and a 6-block separated structure using 1.6 mm thick black-treated steel plate eliminates the influence of interference between each block on sound quality.The equalizer amplifier has a discrete configuration using a low-noise FET for the first stage circuit.The power supply is also dedicated to the phono equalizer for stabilization.It is compatible with both MM and MC cartridges by switching the back panel switch.OFC wires are used at important points of internal wiring materials.For film capacitors, electrolytic capacitors, resistors, and inductors, we have adopted high-quality parts that have been examined and listened to through the development of PMA-SA1 and PMA-SA11.Machined gold plated pin jack is used for Phono and CD input.

It is a balanced direct design that allows direct input to a balanced power amplifier of BTL configuration.The equalizer amplifier uses a two stage dedicated constant-voltage power supply.When the Phono input is not used, the circuit and power supply can be completely shut off by turning the EQ Power switch OFF. This keeps the voltage applied to the UHC-MOS constant and solves the problem of large junction capacitance. Temperature stability is also remarkably improved, and the acoustic characteristics of the UHC-MOS are brought out stably.In the PMA-SA1, the cascode bootstrap connection realizes the ideal characteristics for the power amplifier stage, and the stable operation is obtained. This enables the voltage amplifier stage to be simple in structure, and ensures sound quality without coloring.The stable operation and drive capability of the UHC-MOS eliminates the source resistance that causes the music signal to be contaminated, and the speaker is directly connected to the output stage with high drive power.All stages are balanced amplifier configuration, and the internal voltage is kept low, making it possible to use an excellent device for constant voltage. Noise and interference between circuits are also kept low. Moreover, the output current of the speaker is isolated from the ground circuit, so that the speaker is driven only by the output stage.It has an inverted ? Balance circuit that supports both balanced and unbalanced inputs.This circuit eliminates the need for separate conversion circuits in the previous stage, and is designed to be directly input to the power stage of the balanced configuration.The volume is a 50-inch volume for high-end audio.It uses low-distortion carbon ink and a gold-plated multi-contact wire brush for more faithful music reproduction and accurate volume control up to a maximum attenuation of -120dB.In addition, a brass machined case is used for the volume case to eliminate the influence of external vibration and contamination of external noise.The power transformer is enclosed in a sand-cast case with excellent vibration isolation characteristics to reduce the effect of vibration. A sand-cast holder is also used to fix capacitors that are susceptible to vibration.In the power supply section, the output stage, which requires a large current, and the voltage amplification stage, which requires stability, are separated from each other at the transformer winding stage. In addition, high-capacity electrolytic capacitors with low-impedance electrode foils are combined with high-quality capacitors with different frequency characteristics to improve sound quality. In addition, low-loss, low-noise, high-speed Schottky barrier diodes are used in the rectifier element to provide sufficient current supply capability and clean current supply.In addition, control systems such as relays are separated from transformer windings to eliminate the influence on sound quality.A low-noise FET is used in the first stage of the phono equalizer circuit.This circuit is equipped with an independent stabilizing power supply circuit. When the equalizer circuit is not used, such as when playing a CD, the influence on the line input can be eliminated.It uses a Precision Signal Ground circuit, and the control circuit operates between two positive and negative power supplies to minimize the current flowing to the ground circuit and eliminate ground potential fluctuations caused by noise.As a result, the amplification reference potential is made clear and stable stereo images are reproduced.The internal layout uses a 6-block independent chassis configuration.The equalizer / input section, volume control section, voltage amplifier section, power amplifier section, power supply section and control section are arranged independently to eliminate interference between circuits.The 1.6 mm copper plated steel chassis protects the signal circuit from external vibration.Simple and straight, eliminating pre-out, main in terminal, tone control, loudness, muting, and headphone terminal.High sound quality parts are used after careful consideration.It uses machined gold plated pin jack and OFC internal wiring material, high tone resistance and condenser, cast iron drinking tank and large gold plated speaker terminal.It uses premium silver design.In addition, the volume knob is designed with natural wood.

The low-noise and high-current characteristics of high-speed operation enable low-noise, low-loss and high-speed power supply circuit.In addition, by combining a high-capacity electrolytic capacitor using a low-impedance electrode foil with a capacitor with different frequency characteristics, the characteristics are improved and a stable power supply is achieved over the entire reproduction frequency band.OFC wiring materials are used for wiring from the output of the power transformer to the output stage of the power amplifier to minimize energy loss.By adopting a twin monaural configuration in which the power amplifier blocks are independent on the left and right, and by adopting a 6-block structure in which circuits with different signal levels are separated and shielded, sound quality degradation due to interference between circuits and inflow of noise is suppressed. sections.overview: A top-of-the-line CD/SACD player with Advanced AL24 Processing.Newly developed Advanced AL24 Processing is installed in the reproduction system of PCM signal (CD / digital).In addition to the AL24 Processing Plus, which is a conventional bit extension technology, this circuit greatly improves the amount of information in the time domain by our own high-speed signal detection and processing technology. In addition to data expansion from 16-bit original information to 24-bit data, this circuit performs more fine-grained natural correction processing without losing original data by interpolation of data on the time axis and up-convert sampling using an algorithm developed by our own using large-capacity arithmetic processing devices such as DSP and FPGA.In addition, the digital filter is more adaptable, and it performs optimum filtering operation processing for pulse-response without ringing as well as for pulsatile tone data and attack sound. By this, spatial information such as the subtle nuances of music, the position of the performer, and the width, height and depth of the performance hall (stage) are reproduced more naturally.The mechanism uses an original drive mechanism, and all the controls (signal processing, drive circuit and firmware) are developed in-house to ensure high reliability.The DCD-SA1 uses a long-life brushless motor to cope with SACD playback when the disc rotates at high speed. The motor shaft length is extremely short to suppress vibration, thereby ensuring performance that can withstand high rotation.In addition, in order to absorb all variations, such as the misalignment of the optical axis when the laser beam is irradiated onto the disk, the mechanical flatness of the pickup mechanical base, and the mechanical tilt of the brushless motor shaft, all skew adjustments (tilt correction) are carried out to optimum signal reproduction and playability.The S. V. H. Loader, a hybrid anti-vibration structure using anti-vibration paint and metal plates, has been adopted for the loader mechanism, and a stable disk drive has been realized by the optimum design of the mechanism base floating.The master clock uses an oscillator with an oscillation accuracy of   1 ppm or less (at room temperature), which is more accurate than conventional models.By modularizing the circuit block, the influence of load capacity such as the substrate pattern is suppressed, and the oscillation output is extremely stable compared with a general crystal oscillator.In addition, high-precision design is carried out by investing know-how such as the routing of the pattern wiring on the clock substrate and the supply method to each IC. In particular, the physical distance between the clock and the DAC is shortened, and clock design that cannot be obtained only by internal oscillation centered on the DAC is carried out, which suppresses the effect of jitter noise.In addition, the DAC is used as a master and the PCM and DSD decoder LSIs are used as slaves to generate highly accurate clocks and perform D/A conversion.The D/A converter has a 4-DAC configuration. A two channel device is used for one channel to form a differential output circuit. The HOT and COLD circuits are independent of the D/A converter to form a fully differential balance circuit.Unlike the method in which the phase is inverted by the operational amplifier after the output of the D/A converter, there is no delay between HOT and COLD, making the circuit configuration ideal for distortion and sound quality.A differential drive circuit configuration is also used for the unbalanced output circuit.A triple floating structure has been adopted from the transformer base to the power transformer in order to thoroughly prevent vibration of the power transformer.First of all, four kinds of cushioning materials with different resonance frequencies are combined in the chassis mounting part of the transformer base of aluminum sand mold casting to suppress vibration transmission in a wide frequency band. Then, the fixing screw is floated between the transformer base and the transformer case with a fluorine resin washer and cushioning material. Furthermore, the power transformer itself is floated inside the case with a special filler material. In particular, the filling of this transformer is carried out in two stages over a long period of time so that the transformer itself does not touch the case.In addition, high-grade core material and OFC winding are adopted for the transformer body, and S/N and energy sense are improved by arranging the flux of the transformer for digital and audio to cancel each other.In order to suppress the influence of external vibration and internal fine vibration on sound quality, we have adopted a four layer bottom plate structure, cast iron insulator, hybrid structure panel, and vibration-proof design of the substrate.High rigidity is achieved by placing four flat chassis on the bottom plate of the chassis to confine resonance components in the plane direction of the chassis.The cast iron iron insulator, Denon has specified its own carbon content determined by sound quality tuning. In addition, special cushioning materials and natural fibers are sandwiched between the bottom plate to limit the effect of floor vibration over a wide range of frequencies.In addition, vibration analysis is carried out for each of the side, top and rear panels constituting the housing, and different types of members are combined to suppress the resonance frequency of each part. In particular, the top panel has a double-split structure to make the vibration mode more complicated, making it difficult to resonate even by itself.As an anti-vibration measure for the PCB, the transmission of minute vibrations is suppressed by floating the PCB with fluorine-based resin between the chassis and PCB.Equipped with a digital input terminal, it can also be used as a D/A converter.The digital input signal can be sampled at a frequency of up to 192 kHz and can be used as a high-quality D/A converter with the Advanced AL24 Processing.Pure Direct mode is installed.In this mode, the display and digital signal output are turned off. By turning off the high-pulse signal of the display driver circuit, adverse effects on the audio circuit are suppressed.Wireless remote control is included.There were two variations of the DCD-SA1 remote control depending on when it was sold. The RC-992 was listed in the 2004 catalog that was released and the RC-997 was replaced in the February 2005 catalog.

sections.overview: A SACD player developed by bringing together the best of pure audio technology.The DCD-SA10 has completely separate and independent CD and SACD sections. Dedicated circuits are installed for the pickup, servo circuit, decode circuit, audio circuit, audio circuit, and output terminal. In addition, the audio circuit is a separate board unit to minimize interference between the CD and SACD sections, and the dedicated circuit configuration maximizes the advantages of each circuit.The CD reproduction system is equipped with AL24 Processing Plus.This circuit is a higher precision arithmetic processing of the conventional AL24 Processing without changing the algorithm, and by realizing more reliable arithmetic processing, the music playback capability is improved.This enables high-bit expansion of data to 24 bits based on 16-bit CD data and high-sampling by 8 times over sampling to further reduce quantization distortion. In addition, pulse data can reproduce an impulse response without ringing by widening the pass band. In addition, an adaptive digital filter that automatically changes the cutoff band is inherited.SACD playback is capable of outputting up to 5.1 channels for multi-channel playback.The D/A converter is equipped with one of the highest specifications in the industry. Especially on the front channel, this D/A converter is used in monaural mode and each has its own differential output D/A converter, which is equivalent to the 4 dac configuration of a CD.The rear, center, and LFE channels also use the same D/A converter used for the front channel to ensure high sound quality during multi-channel playback.The peripheral circuit also uses high-quality sound components cultivated through the development of CD players.The CD D/A converter uses a multi-bit 24-bit D/A converter, which realizes faithful conversion of 24-bit high-sampling data obtained with the AL24 Processing Plus.The 24 bit multi-bit D/A converter is less susceptible to fluctuations in the power supply voltage (current), and the in-band quantization distortion level is constant regardless of frequency, enabling clear playback with less noise. In addition, a 4 dac configuration that uses two D/A converters per channel in differential operation, coupled with ? S. L. C., which theoretically eliminates 0 cross distortion, realizes transparent sound playback even for very small signals.The internal construction separates the circuit boards of the digital and analog sections, power supply, CD audio circuit, SACD audio circuit, display circuit, etc. to minimize interference and prevent sound quality degradation.In addition to adopting a center mechanical mount with high structural stability, we also adopted structural technologies such as a mechanical cover that reduces the effect of vibration from the drive mechanism to the circuit, a large insulator made of sintered alloy with vibration absorbing material attached, a 15 mm thick front panel, a triple structure bottom cover and a double structure top cover. While clarifying the mechanical earth, we have adopted a vibration isolation structure that completely eliminates the deterioration of sound caused by vibration from inside and outside.In addition, it uses a shield structure that covers digital circuits with copper-plated steel sheets to reduce the influence of electromagnetic waves on sound.The case for storing the power transformer and the base for mounting them are made of aluminum sand castings that have large internal loss and do not transmit vibration easily. This reduces the effect of vibration from the transformer part, which is the source of vibration, on sound quality.In addition, separate transformers are mounted for the digital and analog circuits, and the effect on other circuits is minimized by arranging the transformers symmetrically so as to cancel the ????????? between them.Hybrid structure S. V. H. loader is adopted.We have returned to the starting point that trays are unnecessary during playback. We have adopted a highly vibration-resistant paint containing protein for the trays themselves. In addition, we have minimized the impact of the trays on sound quality during playback by using lightweight and highly rigid aluminum die-cast shaft bearings with excellent vibration resistance and plates attached to the lower part of the trays to prevent subtle changes in the trays.Newly developed mechanism is adopted for the mechanism part, and it is compatible with SACD trace.The simple structure eliminates factors that degrade sound quality, such as eliminating the headphone circuit that loads the output section.In addition, carefully selected high-quality parts are used for 1.1 parts.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.overview: CD/SACD player equipped with Advanced AL24 Processing.Advanced AL24 Processing is installed in the PCM signal reproduction system, which was first installed in DCD-SA1.In addition to the data expansion from 16 bits to 24 bits by the conventional AL24 Processing, data interpolation on the time axis and up-conversion sampling are carried out by an algorithm developed by our company based on an approach including performance and sound quality. This realizes finer and natural interpolation reproduction without losing original data.A large-capacity arithmetic processing device is used for the circuit, so that data samples can be taken over a wide range and processed in a single stage. Compared with multi-stage digital filters, signal interpolation with higher arithmetic accuracy is possible.The filtering operation is also more adaptive. It controls the frequency characteristics outside the audible band even for dense music data and high-frequency continuous sounds, and performs filtering using the optimum algorithm. This enables optimal sound reproduction without the negative effects of aliasing noise and high-frequency response degradation.The mechanism is equipped with DENON's original drive mechanism.The drive motor for this mechanism uses a long-life brushless motor. The drive motor is placed close to the turntable to withstand the high-speed rotation of the SACD, and the motor shaft is designed to be extremely short.In addition, in order to absorb variations in the tilt of the turntable and pickup mechanical base, all skew adjustments (tilt correction) are performed to achieve optimum playability.The loader mechanism uses an S. V. H. loader, which is made of different materials and has enhanced anti-vibration effects. It supports stable data reading along with the optimally designed mechanical base floating.The clock circuit is equipped with a high-precision oscillator with specifications close to those of DCD-SA1.The circuit block of the oscillator is modularized, and stable oscillation accuracy is obtained without being affected by the substrate pattern.In addition, we have adopted a method of supplying each device with a DAC as a master, as in the case of the high-grade equipment. In particular, the most important clock (DSD clock) for SACD playback is supplied to the slave DSD decoder after division generation, and to the master DAC after correcting to the accuracy of the oscillator again to ensure high accuracy. This method realizes playback with less influence of jitter.Both the hot and cold sides of the balanced output receive the output directly from the dedicated D/A converter.Unlike the balanced output by an inverting amplifier, this method does not cause a difference or delay in sound quality between hot and cold, and the circuit configuration is advantageous in noise and sound quality.Unbalanced output is obtained by differential drive from balanced output.The power supply unit has a twin transformer configuration in which the digital and analog systems are completely separated from the power transformer to eliminate mutual interference. In addition, the effect of the transformer itself is minimized by arranging the magnetic flux leakage in the direction to cancel each other.Aluminum casting with excellent vibration damping characteristics is used for the mounting base to the chassis to suppress the vibration of the transformer itself, as well as the influence on each part and vibration from the outside.Thorough anti-vibration measures are taken.Using a flat plate structure of four bottom plates and two top plates, resonance in the plane direction is completely eliminated and s-lead from the outside is also suppressed. In addition, the side panel and rear panel have a two layer structure, and resonance is suppressed by combining different materials.The main chassis has a center mounted mechanism for weight balance, and the entire main chassis is plated with copper to reduce the influence of inductive noise.Sintered alloy insulators are used for the legs.The center of gravity of the set is lowered by using a sintered alloy with high rigidity, high specific gravity and excellent vibration characteristics. In addition, unnecessary vibration is suppressed in a wide frequency band by special cushioning material.It uses high-quality components selected for its track record in developing numerous digital players.In addition, the audio circuit board is floated with fluorine-based resin.Pre Direct Mode is included.This is a mode that turns off the display and digital output. By turning off the pulse signal for driving the display and digital data, the audio signal is not affected.Wireless remote control is included.

V. H. loader, which is well known for its hybrid structure combining different materials.The digital control circuit board is placed under the drive mechanism.A four layer glass-epoxy board is used for this board, taking into consideration the part layout and circuit pattern to reduce noise radiation.The entire board is shielded by thick steel plates and sandwiched and isolated from the chassis to prevent interference with the inside of the chassis.The D/A converter uses an advanced segment type, inherited from high-end models.The DCD-SA500 is compatible with both PCM and DSD signals like the one used in the DCD-SA100.This DAC was developed mainly for a high dynamic range (123 dB) with the aim of suppressing noise generation to the limit in order to improve audio characteristics. It has a simple structure with only a pure analog FIR filter in the post-stage of the D/A conversion section to achieve high sound quality.In the power supply section, the circuit boards for the digital and analog sections are laid out separately, and the power transformers for the digital and analog sections are mounted separately to minimize interference between each section and prevent sound quality degradation.The transformer is placed on the stagger to suppress leakage flux and fixed to a bracket made of thick steel to suppress resonance with the chassis.The audio block and power block are equipped with high-quality parts such as large block capacitors, which are used in high-end models.Bus management function corresponding to the arrangement of speakers for multi-channel playback is installed.The DCD-SA500 is equipped with speaker configuration and channel-to-channel balance adjustment functions so that you can set the optimum multi-channel playback environment while listening to test tones with your own speakers.The multi-channel output mode can be selected from the full-band Fix mode and the adjustable Vari mode.Equipped with surround circuit OFF function.In this mode, you can enjoy clearer stereo playback by automatically turning off the audio power of the specified channels such as surround, center, and subwoofer, thereby eliminating the negative influence on the 2-channel playback system.Wireless remote control is included.
