sections.overview: A DVD audio / video player with progressive output.It conforms to the THX Ultra standard, a quality standard advocated by Lucasfilm.It is compatible with the progressive system, which has approximately twice the amount of information compared to the interlaced system used for terrestrial TV broadcasting.For the DVD-A1, a new converter was jointly developed with Silicon Image, Inc. and is equipped with the "New Pure Progressive Circuit" which realizes more accurate and faster progressive conversion than the conventional one.This provides fast detection of 3-2 pull-down in film mode and reduces noise.In addition, four fields of images are stored in memory, and moving image information is detected and image correction is performed to compensate for image motion between fields. In contrast to the normal progressive method, which detects video signals in units of one field, the New Pure Progressive Method enables correction processing in units of one pixel, enabling more accurate discrimination of moving images and still images.In addition, it prevents flicker due to detection delay even for mixed film and video mode sources, and enables high-quality progressive playback of any disc.A 14bit/108MHz video DAC is used.Two video DACs, one for progressive signal processing and the other for interlaced signal processing, are used to eliminate interference between progressive and interlaced video signals.For more precise D/A conversion, the sampling rate is increased to 4 x oversampling for progressive video signals and to 8 x oversampling for interlaced video signals.A super sub-alias filter is used to cut off unwanted band signal components above the signal band of the video signal after D/A conversion.This filter has flat characteristics in the necessary band so that it does not adversely affect the video signal, and has sufficient cut-off characteristics in the unnecessary band to eliminate aliasing noise.The video S/N ratio is improved because a super subalias filter is provided for chroma as well as luminance signal.Noise Shaved Video (NSV) technology drives video noise into unwanted bands while an analog filter effectively removes noise to improve the S/N ratio of the video signal.Equipped with AL24 Processing Plus, an analog waveform reproduction technology that supports DVD Audio sampling frequency of 192 kHz.Using the input digital data as a clue, this system interpolates the digital data so that the sound becomes closer to the analog waveform that should have existed in the natural world. By reproducing 16-bit data such as CDs with 24-bit quality, this system increases the ability to reproduce music at low volumes such as reverberation.In addition, it inherits the Adaptive Digital Filter (Adaptive Line Pattern Harmonized Algorithm & Automatic Low Pass Filter Harmonic Adjustment) that automatically adjusts the cutoff band, which was a conventional feature, and suppresses the occurrence of folding distortion such as linking when a pulsed signal is reproduced.All channels of the D/A converter are equipped with a multi-24-bit D/A converter, and the front 2 ch is equipped with a 4 dac configuration.The multi-24-bit D / A converter is less susceptible to noise caused by fluctuations in the power supply voltage (current). Moreover, since the in-band quantization distortion level is constant regardless of frequency, clear playback that is less susceptible to noise is possible.Equipped with Dolby digital and DTS decoder.Equipped with an HDCD decoder.Equipped with S. V. H (Suppress Vibration Hybrid) loader.The tray uses highly vibration-resistant paint and a large plate at the rear of the tray to prevent delicate deformation, ensuring stable rotation and absorbing vibration.In order to prevent adverse effects of external vibration, a vibration isolation design is provided.The base plate of the chassis is a 4-layer hybrid 6 mm thick structure consisting of 1.2 mm thick copper plated steel plate and 3 sheets of 1.6m steel plate.In addition, sintered alloy insulators are used to absorb vibrations from the outside.In addition, the base plate, side and front reinforcing plates, and four 1.2 mm thick copper-plated steel plates are used, and the chassis is composed of three boxes, so that the power supply, video, digital circuit, and audio circuit are structurally separated and the strength is increased.In addition, copper plating brings the ground potential of the entire chassis closer to the same potential, which increases the effect of suppressing electrical noise.In addition, three types of 1.2 mm thick plates with different shapes are used for the top cover, and 2.5 mm thick die-cast aluminum panels are used for the side.A cast-aluminum mechanical base is used between the DVD mechanical unit and the transformer and the chassis.By using parts made of different materials, it is possible to absorb the vibration of itself and also to absorb external vibration to ensure stable operation.Separate power supplies are used for signal processing blocks and video blocks to eliminate interference with other blocks.Audio circuit boards, video circuit boards, digital circuit boards, and power circuit boards are independently laid out for each block to eliminate interference with other circuits.A copper bypass plate is used for the ground pattern of the audio circuit and power supply circuit to reduce the impedance of the ground.High-quality parts such as electrolytic capacitors for audio are used in the audio block and power supply block for audio.Equipped with DENON LINK, balance output by high-speed transfer element is possible between compatible DENON AV amplifiers.(The gold model released after November 2002 and the limited production black model were equipped with DENON LINK S. E. capable of transmitting all high-quality digital signals with full specs, from 192kHz/24bit high-quality 2-channel digital signals of DVD-Audio to multi-channel signals of PCM.)Equipped with a digital input terminal, the AL24 Processing Plus can be used with external digital devices.Pure Direct Mode is installed to achieve pure audio playback.In this mode, you can turn off the digital signal output, video signal output, and display, which tend to interfere with analog audio signals, and output only audio signals.Two modes can be set, and the stored mode can be switched with the pure direct switch on the body panel.You can adjust Contrast, Brightness, Hue, Sharpness, and Gamma to your desired image quality.For accurate multi-channel playback, you can set the speaker configuration and delay time to suit the conditions of the room in which playback is performed while watching the monitor screen.It supports MP3 digital audio compression and CD-R/RW playback, making it possible to play MP3 files recorded on a PC.JPEG images recorded on CD-R/RW can be played back.Both NTSC and PAL signals are supported.It is possible to play Kodak Picture CD.Comes with a self-illuminated remote control.There was also a black model with limited production.

sections.overview: A DVD player equipped with AL24 Processing and compatible with the THX ultra standard.It is equipped with AL24 Processing, an original analog waveform reproduction technology.AL24 Processing is an analog waveform reproduction technology that is a further evolution of Adaptive Line Pattern Harmonized Algorithm Processing. It further reduces quantization distortion and supports high-bit and high-sampling.This circuit generates low-order 8-bit data through internal arithmetic processing by installing twice as many low-order data generation circuits as conventional ones. The high-order 16-bit data is added to the low-order 8-bit data to obtain 24-bit quality output. This complements signals lost when digital data is recorded on CDs and other media, and reproduces the sound with a smooth analog waveform that is as close as possible to the sound that should have existed before recording.AL24 Processing supports 18 -, 20 -, and 24-bit digital input as well as 16-bit input, and 96 kHz sampling frequency.In addition, we inherited an adaptive digital filter that automatically changes the cutoff band. When music data is generated, it is played flat to the ultra-high frequency just below fs/2 (fs : sampling frequency), and when pulse data is played back, it is possible to reproduce impulse response with little ringing by expanding the pass band.The D/A converter is equipped with a 24-bit / 96 kHz sampling D/A converter and realizes high specifications by ultra-high precision conversion with 4 dac configuration.Equipped with an HDCD decoder, it can play HDCD from HDCD-encoded CDs.HDCD has two major characteristics, peak extension and low-level extension. Peak extension prevents sound distortion level extension, which boosts low-level signals for recording and improves S/N as a kind of noise reduction.It complies with the THX ultra standard and meets the Lucasfilm DVD player requirements for video and audio quality and operability for connection.For video, there are requirements for quality in terms of 60 factors that determine the video S/N, as well as the accuracy of reproduction of luminance and color-difference signals. For audio, there are requirements for quality in terms of 30 factors such as S/N, frequency characteristics, and distortion factor. In terms of operation, there are requirements for quality in terms of 20 items. DVD 5000 satisfies all of these requirements.Equipped with digital input terminals (one optical and one coaxial system), it can also be used as a DAC unit with AL24 Processor and D/A converter.Since the digital output signal can be linked with the Source switch, it can also be used as a digital selector.It supports DTS bit stream output, and you can enjoy DTS5.1 ch surround by connecting a commercially available DTS decoder and AV amplifier.The video circuit is equipped with a high-speed, high-precision 10-bit / 27-MHz video DAC and high-precision video decoder.Equipped with color difference (component) video output, Y signal, Cb (Pb) signal and Cr (Pr) signal recorded on DVD can be directly D/A converted and output.A self-oscillating red laser pickup with a wavelength of 650 nm is used in the pickup section.In addition, the pickup lens has a hologram that is integrally molded so that one pickup can handle DVDs and music CDs with different focal lengths, and reliability is enhanced by its simple structure.The servo system employs a digital servo system to ensure optimal servo control for various variable factors caused by disk and digital processing.The internal structure adopts a center mechanical layout system with a low center of gravity. The drive part, which is a source of vibration, is located in the lower center and is firmly fixed to the high-rigidity copper-plated chassis with a FIX mechanical bracket.In addition, a copper plate is installed in the rear of the tray to ensure stability of the rotating system and to suppress unnecessary vibration. In addition, the mechanical part and digital, video and audio parts are separated by copper plated steel plates to eliminate interference and vibration between circuits.High rigidity is ensured by 15 mm thick aluminum front panel, double top cover and four bottom cover.In addition, a sintered alloy insulator with vibration absorbing material is used to eliminate the effect of external and internal vibrations on sound and image quality.The power supply uses a 3-transformer system that separates audio, digital, and control power.We also use special transformers filled with anti-vibration material for both audio and digital transformers.In addition to the detachable OFC extra-thick AC cord, high-sound electrolytic capacitor, high-sound film capacitor, high-sound carbon resistance, and selective operational amplifier for sound quality, we use parts that have been selected in the development of the S series.All audio and video jacks and S terminal are gold-plated.The voice FIX terminal uses a large separate type.It is equipped with a GUI function for various settings, and you can set the operation status, various settings and disc information during playback on the monitor screen.Self-illuminated remote controller is included.

In Character Search, enter the first character of the title you want to search, the next character,. to narrow down the titles of the entered characters and display them on the display. In Initial Character Switching Search, you can switch the initial character to A-B-C,. to display a list of titles with the initial character.By using the USB connector (PC Control connector) for connecting to a PC on the back and the included application DENON Music Manager, you can import music files from your PC and manage songs stored on your hard disk on your PC.In this application, you can change the contents of the playlist (change list name, add / delete / delete all songs). In addition, you can display the list of songs on the hard disk and edit the song information.You can import music files from a PC by folder or by file.This application is for Windows XP SP2.You cannot import music protected by DRM, etc. Also, files saved with CHR-F103 cannot be played by other PCs due to DENON original encryption.You can play Internet radio.Access radio stations from a customized list for DENON of the radio station database service VTuner on the Internet.Equipped with a music server function, you can play music files PC can be played on CHR-F103 via LAN.This feature uses The Designed to DLNA Guidelines (D2G) and Windows Media Connect technology, and supports MP3, WAV (LPCM), and WMA audio formats.You can play MP3 or WMA music files by directly connecting a USB player to the USB port on the front panel.A large display compatible with Japanese and Chinese characters is used for the display section.The D/A converter uses a 192 kHz / 24-bitD / A converter.The digital filter uses an 8-times oversampling digital filter.You can play MP3 or WMA audio files burned to CD-R/RW.Equipped with an optical digital output terminal.When you play a CD, you can select two types of playback patterns for repeat play and program playback.By upgrading the system with DRA-F102, operation such as timer playback, auto function, auto power on, etc. is possible.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.overview: This is a stereo tape deck that inherits the technology of the DH-710F/DH-610S and newly adopts a direct tension servo.A direct drive capstan system is adopted for the mechanism.The capstan motor uses an outer rotor type AC servo motor with low vibration and smooth rotation. In addition, the capstan motor uses a speed servo system with a high-precision recording detection method to ensure high performance.The capstan diameter and accuracy (roundness) meet broadcasting station standards, and durability and reliability are ensured by applying a hard chromium treatment.Equipped with a newly developed direct tension servo.In this mechanism, the servo arm constantly detects gradual changes in back tension caused by changes in the feed radius on the feed reel side, uneven winding of the tape, and sudden changes in tape tension caused by eccentricity of the reel. The movement of the arm is transmitted directly to the brake band wound around the brake drum for approximately 1 1/4 (approximately 450 degrees) to keep the tape tension constant.For example, when the tape tension is increased, the servo arm moves, the brake band is loosened, the brake pressure is reduced, and feedback acts to keep the tape tension constant. The backspring compensates for changes in the weight of the reel and tape, and changes in the friction coefficient between the brake drum and the brake band due to environmental conditions.This mechanism has the same performance as an electronic tension servo, and we have developed and adopted new materials for brake shoes that are not affected by environmental conditions and aging.The direct tension servo does not damage the tape because it is extremely fast from tension detection to response, the vibration generated by the motor is eliminated because voltage is not applied to the supply side reel motor, and the start-up characteristic of the tape is improved because impedance rollers are not required.Equipped with brake servo.This mechanism not only facilitates tape setting because the servo is activated when the tape is hooked on the roller of the servo arm, but also operates the back-tension servo during running or until the tape stops completely.The servo effect can also be achieved while the power is turned off.By installing a guide roller and scrape filter, minute vibration of the tape is efficiently suppressed, and sound quality with less modulation noise is obtained.The drive mechanism, head, and amplifier are all mounted on a frame made of all-aluminum casting, improving machining accuracy and preventing the entire mechanism from getting out of order, greatly contributing to the improvement of overall characteristics.By adopting a high hardness Permalloy type narrow gap head, the frequency characteristics are improved.In addition, a special shape is adopted in order to reduce the shape effect that causes the expansion of the low frequency range.The power supply for the amplifier section is a high voltage (35 v). In particular, in order to eliminate sound distortion and clip in the recording amplifier, the dynamic margin is provided with a sufficient margin like a professional model, and the margin is provided with more than 10 dB above the saturation level of the tape, which is more than 30 dB above the standard recording level.In addition, the playback amplifier is a 3-stage direct connection type to improve the quality of the playback sound.The microphone input consists of a microphone amplifier with a high dynamic margin of 55 dB relative to the reference recording input level and a microphone attenuator with a 12 dB attenuation.The mixing circuit of the line and microphone contains the same mixing amplifier as the DH-710F/610S.Using a continuously variable bias / equalizer, you can set the bias amount and recording equalizer characteristics to the optimum values according to the tape you are using.The operation control part is a direct function using IC logic.This allows you to move from any operation mode to the next mode without going through a stop. Inside the deck, it automatically checks that the tape has stopped completely before moving to the next operation, so tape safety is not affected.Equipped with Rec mute/Pause mechanism.If you want to create a white space between songs during recording, you can press and hold the Pause button to activate the Rec mute mechanism and create an unrecorded portion for any length of time, which is effective for editing the recording. After that, simply release the Pause button to return to the normal pause (recording standby).An optical sensor type non-contact safety switch has been adopted for the winding side tension arm to improve reliability.Timer recording and playback mechanism is installed.Remote control is possible.You can use headphones from low impedance type to high impedance type.It can be used either horizontally or vertically.

sections.overview: This is an authentic 38/2 track tape deck developed by DENON which is highly evaluated for professional equipment in broadcasting stations and studios.A direct drive capstan system is adopted for the mechanism.The DENON proprietary magnetic recording playback method is used to detect the rotational speed of the direct drive capstan motor. This method reduces wow flutter and achieves extremely fast tape start-up characteristics. In this method, the rotational speed of the motor is controlled by detecting pulses accurately recorded magnetically on the outer circumference of the wheel attached to the shaft of the capstan motor. The capstan motor used in the DH-610S has a smooth outer rotor shape and uses a magnetic material specifically developed to minimize vibration.It uses the same electronic tension servo as the DH-710/710S. This mechanism detects the tension of the tape during travel and controls the AC voltage applied to the reel motor. During recording and playback, the tape tension (back tension) between the supply reel and the capstan is kept constant and optimum regardless of the reel size or tape winding diameter. During fast-forwarding and rewinding, the tape tension wound on the reel is kept constant and optimum regardless of the reel size or tape winding diameter.This reduces the wow in the ultra-low range caused by eccentricity of the reel and uneven winding of the tape. In addition, wear of the head and tape is small because excessive tension is not required. In addition, head touch is always stable because the tape tension near the head is constant regardless of the tape winding diameter of the supply reel. In addition, excellent orientation and reality are obtained because there is little phase variation between stereo channels.The DH-610S uses a scrape filter roller to reduce the distance to the capstan as much as possible. In addition to reducing the longitudinal vibration of the tape on the head surface, we are seeking optimum conditions such as the angle of the tape in contact with the head and the shape of the head. We also aim to reduce the FM modulation noise by minimizing the flutter generated by the capstan drive system.A newly designed special guide roller is used for the part where the tape touches other than the head and the tape shifter. Regardless of the type of tape used, both stable running and magnetic surface protection are achieved.A hard permalloy head for broadcasting stations with a wide track width is used for the head, and excellent recording and reproduction characteristics with little noise and little distortion are obtained. In addition, the large size of the reproducing head suppresses low-frequency fluctuations (shape effect) in frequency characteristics at 38cm/s.Cue / pause lever is used.This lever operates in pause mode during recording and playback, and in cue mode in conjunction with the muting switch during fast-forward, rewind and stop.The bias amount and recording EQ characteristics are continuously adjustable so that they can be adjusted according to the tape.A high bias frequency of 180 kHz is used to prevent beat interference when recording FM broadcasts.The last stage of the recording amplifier connected to the recording head is a push-pull circuit, and the maximum allowable output level of the recording amplifier is 30 dB or more relative to the reference level as in the case of professional machines.It is equipped with a meter with a changeover switch for peak level indication and VU indication.Equipped with a microphone attenuator, 12 dB attenuation can be achieved with one touch operation.When used according to the sensitivity and operating conditions of the microphone, the SN ratio is good and microphone recording with a wide dynamic range is possible.Equipped with a playback volume with Klix/Kluk? top.Separately sold options included a shoulder belt and a connector plate to which a square cannon connector (for line input / output only) can be attached.

sections.overview: This is a tape deck that has all the technology to aim at a full-scale 38/2 track high performance deck.Direct Drive 2 capstan system is adopted for the mechanism part.The two capstan blocks the contact surface between the tape and the head from external (reel side) vibration elements to stabilize the tape running on the head surface. In addition, the DH-710F adopts a direct drive system in which the main capstan is directly connected to an AC motor, and a newly designed direct drive 2 capstan in which the motor shaft and sub-capstan are connected by a special inelastic belt.In addition, the speed servo of the outer rotor capstan motor uses DENON's unique high-precision magnetic recording detection method to achieve excellent wow flutter characteristics.An electronic tension servo is used for both the feed reel motor and the take-up reel motor.By controlling the AC current flowing through the reel motor, the tape tension is kept constant not only during recording and playback but also during fast-forwarding and rewinding, regardless of the reel size or the amount of remaining tape.The 2-capstan system and electronic tension servo improve the basic running characteristics of the wake-up characteristics and wow flutter. In addition, the tape path is shortened by making the distance between the two capstan as close as possible, eliminating the longitudinal vibration and microvibration of the tape as much as possible, and reducing noise caused by FM modulation.The tape is designed to run straight between the left and right tape tension arms except during recording and playback, making it easy to set up the tape and eliminating the need for a tape shifter.In addition, the parts that contact the tape other than the head use a newly designed guide roller. Since all parts are rotating bodies, stable running characteristics can be obtained even when thin tapes such as long play tapes are used.In addition, a one way air damper is used for the left and right tension arms to prevent excessive tension at the start.The capstan shaft is 12 mm of 12 mm according to broadcasting station standards to improve reliability. Moreover, precision processing to the limit increases roundness and hard chrome processing improves durability.Uses Sendust alloy head developed independently for the head part.The use of a broadcasting station head with a wide track width reduces noise, provides excellent recording and playback characteristics with little distortion, and maintains stable performance even in long-term use.In particular, the playhead has been finished with a special shape that reduces the low-frequency bulge due to the shape effect. The shape effect is caused by the shape of the surface where the head comes into contact with the tape. However, by finishing the shape of the head so that the tape gradually separates from the head, the shape effect is minimized.Both the microphone amplifier and the recording amplifier maintain a large margin to enable recording with a wide dynamic range.In addition, it is equipped with a microphone attenuator so that even high-quality live sound sources can be recorded with plenty of time.The frame precision machined aluminum casting integrated frame is used for the frame part.This enables accurate mounting of the head system and the tape running system, suppressing mechanical distortion caused by aging and maintaining initial performance for a long period of time.The bias amount and recording equalizer characteristics are continuously variable, and can be adjusted according to the attached tape-specific BIAS/EQ adjustment table to maximize the recording tape's capabilities.In addition, a high-frequency recording bias (200 kHz for the DF 710 f) is used to improve the S/N ratio and prevent B when recording an FM stereo broadcast transmission.You can easily check the reference playback level by adjusting the playback volume knob to the reference position of the long line.Equipped with a level meter that can be switched between peak level indication and VU indication.Remote control is possible.Can be used horizontally and vertically.

This structure prevents the deterioration of directional frequency characteristics due to the influence of the vibration of the plate itself and the influence of reflection caused by the conventional thin flat plate acoustic lens.A horn type unit is installed in the high frequency range.Special light alloy It uses a driver unit with a diaphragm and a full-scale phase equalizer, and an aluminum-milled hyperbolic horn.The enclosure uses a lumber core of 19 mm thickness made of carefully selected material for the entire surface except for the baffle.It is also equipped with a variable acoustic resistance unit on the back to keep the playback limits and best transient characteristics.

sections.overview:
Price unknown (1 unit, around early 1970 s)

A speaker system that has been developed over many years.40RW09 which is 40 cm cone type woofer is mounted in the low range.The diaphragm is composed of non-prescone paper mixed with collagen fibers and a roll edge molded with urethane foam. In order to improve linearity, this unit adopts a new method of increasing air compliance between the back surface of the damper and the voice coil gap. The voice coil adopts an edgewise wound voice coil.The magnetic circuit has an external magnetic structure using 16 Arnaud magnets 40   x25mm. The top plate has a thickness of 15 mm, and the magnetic flux density of the bridge is obtained together with 80   center pole.Aluminum die-cast frame is used for the frame.A horn type unit using a driver unit HMD-9, an exponential horn and a newly developed acoustic lens HL-100C is mounted in the middle range.The HMD-9 uses a special light alloy 45   diaphragm, and is a rear type driver unit with precision hand-made processing. The magnetic circuit uses eight Alnico magnets 25   x15mm and eight 25   x20mm.The HL-100C consists of multiple layers of conical punching plates with different diameters at the opening of a horn-type speaker. This prevents the deterioration of directional frequency characteristics due to the influence of the vibration of the plate itself and the influence of reflection caused by the conventional thin flat plate acoustic lens.Driver unit HTD-9 and horn H-2500L are mounted in the high range.The HTD-9 is a unit equipped with a special light alloy diaphragm and a full-scale phase-equalizer. It can be freely used for 1400 hz cut-off horn.The H-2500L is equipped with a diffuser with a hypervolic horn and open-celled foam sponge.The enclosure uses a lumber core of 36 mm thick and carefully selected material for the entire surface except for the baffle.It is also equipped with a variable acoustic resistance unit on the back to keep the playback limits and best transient characteristics.The exterior has a walnut oil finish.

sections.title: DENON-COLUMBIA DENON
sections.overview: A 2-way speaker system that pursues realistic music playback without breaking the harmony of music.25RW15 which is a 25 cm cone type woofer is mounted in the low range.The diaphragm of this unit is made of collagen cone. Collagen fiber is extracted from animal skin by a special chemical treatment and fused with the material of corn paper. While maintaining rigidity, only internal loss is controlled to an appropriate value, thereby suppressing split resonance region and high frequency resonance.In addition, by using collagen fibers for the edge, the disturbance of characteristics due to the inverse vibration between the cone paper and the edge is minimized. In addition, the flexibility of collagen fibers allows the lowest resonance frequency to be lowered.40 dt 01, which is a 4 cm dome type tweeter, is installed in the high range.In this unit, a flexible natural fiber material is used for the diaphragm, a special coating material is applied by hand several times to the dome part, and a special glass fiber is used for sound absorption processing inside the dome, giving excellent directional characteristics and flat characteristics without significant peaks or dips.In addition, a stable free edge type supporting the diaphragm for large amplitude is used for the edge part.A 120   x60   x17 barium ferrite magnet is used for the magnetic circuit, and a steel-clad aluminum wire is used for the voice coil to extend the allowable input resistance and high-frequency characteristics.The network uses a 6dB/oct. configuration with excellent phase characteristics.An air-core coil with low DC resistance is used for the network element in consideration of distortion at large input, etc., and an MF type capacitor is used in parallel in order to reduce sound quality and capacity error.Equipped with continuously variable level control for high frequency band.The enclosure has a symmetrical design, 20 mm hard particle board material, and a full-surface real wood finish.In addition, three types of sound absorbing materials with different densities are used inside the enclosure to eliminate standing waves, while acoustic braking is applied to the woofer to control the low frequency range.

Moreover, in order to improve the high-frequency characteristics, an ultrathin aluminum foil molded product is used for the center cap to reduce the moving mass.By arranging two of these tweeters vertically, directivity in the left-right direction is suppressed.In order to prevent interference through the cabinet of each unit, the mounting part to each unit and cabinet is sealed with butyl putty material to buffer, and air leakage from the area around the set screw is prevented.We use air-core coils for the network except for the coil that goes into the woofer, and use plain foil type capacitors with low dielectric loss to reduce current distortion.

sections.title: DENON-COLUMBIA DENON
sections.overview: This 3-way speaker system is equipped with a unit jointly developed by DENON and Peerless (Denmark).A 25 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.In pursuit of linearity, this unit makes use of sound latitude characteristics which is DENON's original measurement technology in addition to the conventional measurement method, and makes the vibration system and support system closer to the ideal.In addition to using Scandinavian pulp as the material for the cone paper, by adopting the air dry method (the fine airy paper fiber construction) based on the latest technology, we have succeeded in maintaining the soft fiber structure as it is. In addition, by uniformly coating the cone paper with acrylic resin using a special spray, the division vibration of the cone paper in the high frequency range is controlled, and a heavy low sound with less harmonic distortion is realized.In addition, a large flat type damper has been adopted to improve the dynamic linearity by carefully examining the material and impregnation agent. The edge is molded into a roll of foamed polyurethane and the back surface is coated with a damping agent to suppress the resonance of the edge itself, eliminating the mid-range colorization, preventing the leakage of sound waves of different phases from inside the cabinet, and improving the sense of orientation.The voice coil is made of aluminum bobbin with excellent heat radiation effect and reduced diametral deflection. It is treated with high heat-resistant adhesive which shows strong adhesion even at high temperatures to achieve high input resistance.In the middle area, it is equipped with a 10 cm cone type skoker which is same as the upper model such as SC 306.The back chamber and frame are integrated by light alloy die-casting to prevent the strong air pressure and vibration from the woofer from adversely affecting the Skoker's vibration system.The chamber is filled with ring-shaped glass wool to absorb reflected sound, and the chamber inner wall is tapered to prevent standing waves from occurring.The diaphragm uses Peerless and DENON technologies to reduce weight. It also uses non-prescone paper coated with a damping agent on the back. It also uses aluminum voice coil bobbins and rolled edges coated with urethane foam with a damping agent.A 3.2 cm soft dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.Light alloy A specially developed woven fabric diaphragm is assembled on a die-cast plate, and the directional characteristics and power response are improved by reducing the effective diameter of the diaphragm.In addition, aluminum is used for the voice coil bobbin to increase heat radiation effect, and heat-resistant treatment is applied to improve input resistance.To maximize the power of the unit, the mounting of the tweeter and woofer is a sandwich support system. sections.overview: A series of speaker enclosure technologies, such as the D.A. S. structure, and new technologies are adopted to further enhance the speaker system.A direct drive circuit is installed in the network.This technology employs a Big Laminated Orient Core (BLOC) coil instead of a choke coil inserted in series between the woofer and the amplifier to reduce the loss of low-temperature energy and at the same time improve the damping factor. A. S. structure enclosure has been adopted to suppress the internal standing wave and eliminate plate vibration. sections.overview: This is a speaker system developed by inheriting various speaker technologies demonstrated in DENON's highest class floor type speaker system SC 5000 to the maximum extent.A 30 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.Similar to SC-5000, High-M / P diaphragm with integrated rib structure is used for the diaphragm. This diaphragm is made of wood pulp mixed with refined ramie fiber. After carefully beating it to control the distribution of fiber length, it is manufactured with an integrated rib pattern by a new technology that makes paper. As a result, in addition to the physical properties of low density and moderate internal loss of paper, it achieves both extremely light weight and high rigidity.This rib pattern is formed by 5 concentric circular ribs and 13 radial ribs. While reducing the static mass of the cone section by about 10%, the rigidity is doubled by the conventional paper cone, and the deflection (deformation) of the diaphragm under Dainyu force is prevented. Peaks and dips are also suppressed, harmonic distortion is reduced and flat frequency characteristics are realized.The drive section is composed of a large ferrite magnet with a diameter of 156 mm. A voice coil with a diameter of 60 mm is used for the voice coil in consideration of balance. An aluminum bobbin with high heat radiation effect is used for this voice coil.The support system consists of a large flat damper with a linear motion corrugate curve with greatly improved linearity, and an edge formed into a roll of urethane foam and coated with a damping agent from the back surface to expand linearity.Thick die-cast frame is used for the frame.The mid-range is equipped with a 10 cm cone type squaker.The High-M-T guidance plate is used for the diaphragm. It is made of a woven fabric of high-elasticity fibers, which is a kind of polymer compound, reinforced with epoxy resin, and maintains an ideal internal loss over a wider band than wood pulp, while achieving hardness approximately three times that of paper. The Skoker uses a double-layered structure of two High-M-T diaphragms so that the folds of the woven fabric are 45 degrees to each other. The direction of surface rigidity is uniform, and uniform internal loss is extended over a wider band. It is possible to expand the piston motion range and reduce resonance Q in the split resonance range, and the sound pressure frequency characteristics are further flattened.The magnetic circuit is combined with a large ferrite magnet with the same diameter of 100 mm as the diaphragm to achieve high efficiency and a combination with a high heat-resistant voice coil to achieve high input resistance.Aluminum die-cast frame is used for the frame.A 5 cm cone type tweeter is installed in the high range.The diaphragm has a semi-dome shape. The center dome portion is made of a special aluminum alloy with a thickness of 30 microns to increase the area of the dome portion, and the balance between the diaphragm portion and sound pressure radiation has been sufficiently examined. The cone portion is made of a High-M-T diaphragm, which is the same material as the Scorker, to expand the piston motion region and reduce the resonance Q in the divided resonance region, and flatten the summer frequency characteristics.In addition, by eliminating the damper and connecting the diaphragm directly to the voice coil bobbin, loss of driving force is eliminated, and the weight of the entire vibration system is reduced to achieve high-speed response.A ferrite magnet with a diameter of 100 mm is used for the magnetic circuit. By combining it with a voice coil that is lightweight and heat-resistant, it achieves high efficiency and high input resistance.Aluminum die-cast frame is used for the frame.Level control is provided for the middle and high frequencies.Direct wiring and one point ground connection are used in the network section to minimize losses in the circuit.The enclosure is hermetically sealed.Hard particle board is used for the plate material, and the sound image localization is improved by the symmetrical design of the unit layout.The exterior has a walnut natural wood finish.

sections.overview: This floor-type speaker system was developed over a period of four years to accommodate digital sources.Twelve peripheral and related patents and two utility models have been awarded for realizing this speaker.A 40 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The High-M / P vibration plate is used for the vibration plate. While taking advantage of the excellent properties of paper, structural rigidity is greatly increased. This vibration plate is made by blending refined ramie fiber with wood pulp, which has a higher Young's modulus than wood pulp. After careful beating treatment to control the distribution of fiber length, it is manufactured by a newly developed special papermaking technology into an integrated structure with a rib pattern. High rigidity is obtained. This rib pattern is formed by concentric circular and radial ribs, and rigidity is improved by about 2 times compared with conventional ones. At the same time, peaks and dips are suppressed, and increase of harmonic distortion is suppressed, and flat frequency characteristics are realized.Outer diameter   220 mm, 4.8x10 for the drive system5Using a large ferrite magnet of maxwell and 11,000 gauss, it achieves high efficiency with output sound pressure level of 98 db and instantaneous maximum sound pressure level of 128 db.In addition, the center pole of approximately   100 mm is provided with a hole part in order to reduce non-linear distortion of air due to sudden change of air flow and impedance change near the lowest resonance frequency at large amplitude. This center pole is equipped with a special shape control ring made of copper in order to reduce current distortion of the drive part. The current distortion is improved by more than 10 dB, and cavity resonance inside the magnetic circuit is prevented to prevent distortion.The large diameter voice coil of   100 mm uses polyamide imide resin coated ribbon copper wire with excellent electrical conductivity. It is wound on a Nomex resin bobbin with special high heat treatment to clear the instantaneous maximum allowable input of 1 kW. In addition, the voice coil is designed to move vertically in a magnetic field at all times to prevent drive nonlinearity.In order to provide higher durability for the edge and damper supporting the diaphragm, we use a material that combines phenolic resin with a special resin that is highly resistant to degradation. This material ensures high durability and moderate viscoelasticity, and significantly reduces the Q of abnormal edge resonance and diaphragm resonance. In addition, the waveform of the edge and damper of   170 mm adopts a special linear motion corrugate curve, and realizes symmetrical linearity against the amplitude of the front and rear of the diaphragm.The diaphragm, voice coil and damper are installed with almost no clearance at the cone neck to prevent radial flexural vibration of the voice coil and to stabilize the high frequency characteristics.It has a 15 cm cone type mid-range in the mid-range.The High-M ? T diaphragm is made of a woven fabric of high-elasticity fibers, which is a kind of polymer compound, reinforced with epoxy resin, and realizes wide-band internal loss and high Young's modulus. This enables expansion of the piston motion region and reduction of resonance Q in the divided resonance region, resulting in flattening of sound pressure frequency characteristics.A large ferrite magnet with a maximum diameter of 140 mm is used in the drive system to achieve high efficiency. In addition, a copper control ring is provided in the center pole to improve second and third harmonic distortion due to current distortion by 12 dB, and cavity resonance in the magnetic circuit is eliminated to achieve low distortion and high efficiency.The voice coil of   40 mm is designed to be as heat-resistant as a woofer. The neck portion of the diaphragm is folded back to further increase rigidity, prevent flexural vibration of the voice coil, and prevent distortion due to Dainyu force. The center dome is filled with ultra-fine glass fibers to provide vibration control and sound absorption, and flatten sound pressure frequency characteristics.In order to keep the distance from the voice coil to the diaphragm as short as possible, the diaphragm has a rational structure that eliminates dampers and improves response. In addition, the diaphragm is surrounded by a ????????? and sandwiched with rubber to eliminate the disturbance of characteristics caused by end reflection and improve directivity.The magnetic circuit employs a strontium ferrite magnet with an outer diameter of   120 mm to increase efficiency, and is equipped with a unique control ring with improved sound-pressure frequency characteristics and impedance characteristics by reducing current distortion and preventing cavity resonance. The voice coil is a bobbin with a diameter of 25 mm, which is made of a special aluminum alloy with a thickness of 30 microns and treated with alumite. This reduces weight and improves high-frequency characteristics and provides high input resistance.In particular, the tweeter, which requires precision machining, performs precision cutting of special aluminum alloy plate, and the vibration system is assembled on this plate with precision jigs and tools, and assembled on the drive part.In the network section, the circuit constant is based on -12dB/oct., and phase correction is performed according to the sound latitude characteristics and the sound pressure synthesis state of each unit. After hearing test, the latest parts are carefully selected and determined.The capacitors used are mainly large metallized film capacitors with low loss. (Dynamic Acoustic Scatter) structure.Inside is DENON's unique enclosure combined with heavy porous ceramics, pursuing the ideal of "no standing wave" and "no plate vibration".In the double D. A. S structure, baffle plate, top plate, both side plates and bottom plate are strongly bonded with super-synthetic porous ceramics. The weight of porous ceramics is added to five plates, and the bonding between the plates is strengthened to suppress vibration of the entire plate.As a result, the frame of the woofer is fixed to a rigid baffle with a total thickness of 70 mm (40 mm baffle plate + 30 mm porous ceramics), and extremely precise piston motion is realized without instantaneous high power or with the frame and the enclosure getting shaky.In addition, the porous ceramics dissipates and absorbs the standing waves generated inside the enclosure, improving the low-frequency quality.Second, it uses the R. M. M. (Rigid Monocoque Mount) structure.The tweeter has an airtight structure with a frame and a magnetic circuit embedded in a baffle plate, and the squaker is firmly mounted by a total of 65 mm consisting of 40 mm baffle and 25 mm sub-baffle.This reduces displacement and vibration of the magnetic circuit and frame caused by the reaction when the diaphragm is driven, and transmits the driving force purely to the diaphragm, improving the S/N and sound rise.A 32 cm cone type woofer is used for the low range.The diaphragm uses a boron fiber diaphragm that uses boron long fiber for the first time in the world. It is driven by a magnetic circuit that uses a barium ferrite magnet with a straight line of 180 mm and a thickness of 20 mm.In this diaphragm material, boron long fiber and carbon paper are fused on the back of cross woven long fiber carbon (cross carbon). The high elasticity and high rigidity unique to boron and carbon improve the sound propagation speed. In addition, different materials are combined to ensure internal loss.A 6.5 cm dome type skoker is used for the middle area.The new   - boron diaphragm technology is also been applied to the SCORCAR. A boron compound and titanium oxide are plasma jet welded on a base of titanium, which is light and highly rigid, to ensure an appropriate internal loss.The diaphragm is supported by tangential edges and driven by a large strontium magnet with a direct 156 mm thickness of 20 mm.In addition, in order to control the back pressure of the diaphragm, air vent holes are provided in the center pole and the top plate to improve the fluctuation of frequency characteristics, and the effect of the back sound pressure from the woofer is eliminated by the adoption of a firm back cavity.A 2.5 cm hard dome type tweeter with New   Boron is used for the high range.New   - Boron, which is made by fusing boron compound and titanium oxide on the surface of duralumin foil by plasma jet method, improves sound propagation speed and prevents the squeal of diaphragm material.By improving the shape of the diffuser, we have also improved the directional characteristics of the ultra-high frequency range.The network uses carefully selected audio-only parts such as an independent circuit for each unit and a low-loss, low-distortion silicon steel plate for the choke coil.The attenuator is eliminated in order to improve the purity of the signal transmission system.The enclosure uses a needle-resin-based high-density particle board with a Gerald Ebony wood finish.

sections.title: DENON-COLUMBIA DENON
sections.overview: A speaker system with designs such as collagen cones and symmetrical layouts.In VS-370, DENON's original collagen cone is used for the vibration plate of the unit.In this diaphragm, collagen fibers are extracted from animal skin by a special chemical treatment and fused with the material of corn paper. This allows the corn paper to maintain rigidity while controlling only internal loss to an appropriate value, and more ideally controls the split resonance region and high-frequency resonance.In addition, by using collagen fibers at the edge part as well, the disturbance of the characteristics at the point where the piston motion is removed is minimized. In addition, the flexibility of the collagen fibers allows the lowest resonance frequency to be lowered, and the split vibration of the cone paper is also controlled, further ensuring the flattening of the frequency band.The all-cone configuration prevents differences in tone quality depending on the receiving band, which tends to occur in a multi-way system. In addition, the directivity and vibration mode are matched to minimize differences in tone quality depending on the reverberation time of the listening room or the position of speakers.The low range is equipped with 30RW11B which is 30 cm cone type woofer.This unit uses a non-prescone paper with collagen fibers fused to the diaphragm and a melamine coated double structure that increases rigidity and expands the piston motor cortex range, controlling sharp peaks that tend to appear in the high range of woofer.The voice coil has a special structure that uses an aluminum bobbin to prevent radial deflection and at the same time improve the heat radiation effect.The magnetic circuit uses an Alnico cast magnet with good magnetic energy usage efficiency.The mid-range is equipped with 12RM22 which is a 12 cm cone type skoker.Collagen cone paper is used for the diaphragm, and at the same time as controlling the split resonance region, the rubber cap is used to reduce the high frequency radiation energy from the cap and cut unnecessary bands.In addition, by adopting a large cast magnet for the magnetic circuit, a magnetic flux density of 12000 gauss has been obtained and transient characteristics have been improved.An aluminum die-cast frame is used for the frame, and a back cover is used to cut off the influence of a woofer with large vibration, thereby suppressing inter-modulation distortion.50RT07, which is a 5 cm cone type tweeter, is installed in the high range.This unit is designed to reduce the influence of woofer and squaker by using aluminum die-cast for the frame.For the network part, we have adopted a coil with less DC resistance and used multiple capacitors in parallel to minimize the capacitance error of the capacitor, taking into consideration the effect on the chassis.It is also equipped with a continuously variable level control for the middle and high frequencies.The unit layout of the front baffle is symmetrical with respect to the directional pattern of the left and right speakers at the listening position. The unit is mounted so that the vibration mode of the baffle does not adversely affect music playback. In particular, the frame of the woofer is covered with synthetic rubber and is mounted on the back.The enclosure is hermetically sealed. The front baffle is made of a 19 mm thick lumber core made mainly of Chinese wood, and the other parts are made of a 25 mm thick rigid particle board, giving it a solid finish.A combination of three types of sound absorbing materials with different densities is used for internal sound absorption processing to eliminate standing waves.The exterior is finished with real wood for a simple design.

sections.title: DENON-COLUMBIA VS-450
sections.overview: A 2-way speaker system incorporating technology developed for broadcasting stations.A special amplifier was attached to this speaker system, and it was used as a compact Columbia monitor speaker at broadcasting stations around the country.A 10 cm cone type woofer with symmetric support system is mounted in the low range.DENON's original collagen diaphragm is used for the cone. This is a collagen fiber fused to corn paper after a special chemical treatment applied to animal skin. By giving it an appropriate internal resistance, resonance of peaks and dips of the cone is suppressed.In addition, in order to reduce non-linear distortion at large amplitude, symmetric support system (push-pull support system) is adopted. In this system, edge and damper are integrated into one unit. In order to cancel each other's non-linearity, the same structure as the edge is reversed to form the damper. In addition, the connection part with voice coil is considered rigid compared to the stiffness of edge at low frequency, and one that does not generate resonance at high frequency is adopted.In this way, the distortion is canceled and the linearity to the amplitude is improved because the non-linearity of a certain shape with respect to the deformation direction is unified by reversing each other.The edge is made of a special woven fabric impregnated with a polymer material, and the linearity is greatly improved.A 5 cm cone type tweeter is installed in the high range.The enclosure is a bass reflex type with ports, and the baffle plate is an iron plate with damping material on the back side.Air-core coils are also used in the network.

sections.overview: This is a control amplifier that thoroughly reexamines the equalizer amplifier, which is important for record playback.All stages of the ICL are connected directly to the equalizer amplifier section. Coupling capacitors are installed only at the output terminals. No coupling capacitors are used between the input terminals and stages. This allows for more faithful waveform transmission. The RIAA-NFB (negative feedback) element uses   1% metal film resistance and polypropylene capacitor to ensure highly accurate characteristics.In the first stage, ultra-low-noise FET transistors are used in parallel to sufficiently suppress noise generation, and four transistors are used for differential amplification, which is received by emitter-follower transistors. This realizes an input-equivalent noise level of -138dB (V) and high S/N ratio.The emitter-follower complimentary service is amplified by a class A push-pull current-mirror differential-circuit, and drives a pure push-pull output-stage. The power supply for this output-stage is   38 V high voltage. sections.overview: A control amplifier equipped with a real-time equalizer amplifier that challenges the limits of disc playback.The EQ section uses a non-feedback real-time equalizer amplifier, a further development of the CR type.The configuration consists of two stages of DC linear amplifier with newly developed low-noise FET and CR-type equalizing filter between stages. The first stage FET is parallel differential, and a cascode boot-strap circuit is adopted to prevent degradation of high-frequency characteristics while greatly improving S/N.In addition, the input-coupled capacitor has been removed, not only eliminating the sound coloring by the capacitor, but also Pc800mW ? fTCombined with a 150 v high-voltage power supply operation using a 120 mhz high-power, high-speed transistor, it realizes a high power and wide dynamic range with a clipping level of 47 v.In addition, high S/N has been achieved by reducing impedance of the CR-type equalizing filter.The CR element uses a polypropylene capacitor and   1% metal film deposition resistance.The Phono3 terminal is directly connected to the MC head amplifier composed of 22 transistors.This head amplifier has the same circuit configuration as DENON's top-of-the-line head amplifier HA-1000. For example, a PNP type low-noise transistor, which is advantageous for low noise, is connected in parallel at the first stage.In addition, in order to ensure performance as a dedicated MC head amplifier, a   15 v stabilized power supply with a booster for increasing the power supply is provided inside the head amplifier board to minimize the power supply impedance and achieve high S/N and high speed.The flat amplifier section uses a 10k   low-impedance volume circuit.As a result, the S/N degradation due to high-resistance thermal noise and the mirror effect due to transistors have been combined to eliminate the disadvantages of high-impedance volume such as increased distortion, formation of high-cut filters due to high machining and stray capacitance of wires, and deterioration of slew rate and rise time.In addition, a direct DC servo system is adopted. The parallel configuration of the first stage FET differential amplifier and the servo feedback circuit that replaces the servo amplifier are used to achieve low distortion and high S/N and to eliminate the output coupling capacitor.Each selector switch is a soft push type with an electronic circuit that switches with a light touch in consideration of operability.The lead relay, which does not change over time, is placed in a position that is not affected by the routing of the audio signal wiring so as to give consideration to sound quality.In addition, it is equipped with compound functions such as a one shot muting mechanism in which a one shot trigger circuit is activated when switching and the power to the output side is temporarily turned off.The power supply section is equipped with a large 5-shield toroidal transformer with a winding diameter of 1.2 mm and a capacity of 50 VA. The transformer is resistant to fluctuations in the power supply and fully takes into account leakage flux.In order to send high-quality sound without unnecessary coloring to the power amplifier, the signal from the disk is directly sent from the equalizer amplifier to the flat amplifier without passing through the buffer amplifier. The phono channels are directly connected to the flat amplifier, while the aux, tuner and tape channels are automatically connected to the buffer amplifier by function switching.In addition, the buffer amplifier for impedance matching of Tuner and Tape and for subsonic filter is newly developed symmetrical complimentary service FET-DC configuration, which prevents the generation of second harmonic distortion, which is a problem, and obtains high S/N. sections.overview: This is a stereo control amplifier developed with our original technology as a device for enjoying music in excellent sound as well as pursuing advanced characteristics and performance.In order to bring out the characteristics of the balanced transmission system, we have newly developed and installed an inverted   balance circuit.All the amplifying elements are composed of discrete elements using high-performance and high-quality parts. The power supply voltage is approximately three times (  47 v) higher than that of the conventional method. In addition, DENON's unique non-feedback technology is further developed into a distortion eliminating circuit method to achieve low distortion and high S / N ratio.The FET input method is adopted in all stages, making use of the characteristics of FET such as "little time delay in signal transmission", "very large input impedance does not affect the input / output circuit", and "excellent sound quality because no odd order harmonic distortion occurs".In the flat amplifier section, all the amplifying elements are composed of FET, and good rise characteristics are obtained.The first stage consists of differential amplification of an ultra-low noise FET, combined with a cascode bootstrap method to reduce feedback between input and output and to greatly improve linearity.In addition, the pre-driver stage using MOS FET (Pc30W) has a cascode bootstrap and P-P system similar to the first stage to greatly improve linearity and improve low-distortion and high-frequency characteristics. In addition, the final stage using MOS FET (Pc30W) is composed of a source-follower circuit to achieve both high input impedance and low load drive characteristics.The equalizer amplifier employs a MOS Power FET (Pc30W) at the output stage to obtain the maximum allowable input for wide dynamic range reproduction, and to increase the speed of signal transmission and improve the low-load drive characteristics.For the input stage, we use high-quality parts selected by our own standards for ultra-low noise FET. In addition, we use cascode bootstrap configuration to reduce feedback between input and output and reduce performance degradation due to characteristic fluctuation of the cartridge connected to the input terminal.The MC input uses an MC transformer with an LC-OFC winding with a step-up ratio of 1 : 20 for high-end cartridges.When the Phono input is not in use, this equalizer circuit can be switched on/off to completely shut off the circuit and the power supply, thereby reducing the influence on other circuits.A wide-band LC-OFC winding balanced input transformer is mounted on the CD-2 balanced input.Unlike the IC-based operational amplifier system, it has natural characteristics.It is equipped with a power supply circuit centered on an LC -   type power supply circuit using a large choke coil in order to cut off the influence of noise from digital devices.It consists of four constant power supplies for each unit including the last three of the LC -   type power supply. Current is supplied along the shortest path to the equalizer amplifier, flat amplifier, balance amplifier and control circuit, eliminating interference between each unit.In addition, large toroidal transformers, fast recovery diodes, very thick power cords, and high-sound condenser are used.Equipped with 4 large main large main volume that can be arranged in parallel with 2 channels each of L and R channels.It uses a chassis with large weight feet and thick plates based on sintered metal, and copper plating is used for the front chassis.Epoxy glass composite substrate is used for the print base material.Input switching uses soft touch operation by electronic switch and relay.

sections.overview: Based on the development and design philosophy of real-time audio technology, this preamplifier incorporates pure non-feedback circuits in all stages from MC head amplifier to equalizer amplifier and final high-level amplifier.The pure non-feedback circuit cancels the distortion of the output signal by combining the input transistor and the transistor operating in the reverse mode. The basic circuit is a single-stage amplifier circuit in which a constant current source is inserted at the common connection point of the N-channel FET and the PNP transistor and the P-channel FET and the NPN transistor.Since the output current of the FET has a power transfer characteristic with respect to the input voltage, the distortion generated in the FET is only the second harmonic distortion. The distortion is canceled by combining the N-channel FET and the P-channel FET.Two sets of pure non-feedback circuits are installed in the equalizer amplifier section to ensure high S/N, low distortion rate, and wide dynamic range. Furthermore, by utilizing the characteristics of current amplification, which is a feature of pure non-feedback circuits, and by combining high-precision C and R elements, ultra-wide band and high precision are realized.The circuit consists of 16 ultra-low noise Hi gmFET and 30 transistors per channel.The MC head amplifier uses carefully selected 16 ultra low-noise Hi-channel and 18 transistors (per one gmFET). It is superior to a dedicated head amplifier. It also uses a newly developed high-stability power supply and a floating power supply system that is not affected by power supply ripple to reduce noise.The high-level amplifier section consists of a pure non-feedback circuit (and pure non-feedback tone control).The tone control turnover frequency can be switched. In addition, at the defeat position, the tone control element is detached and the transmission characteristic becomes flat.A 10k   low-impedance volume is used to prevent changes in transmission frequency characteristics, distortion, and deterioration of noise due to the position of the volume.The signal path and each unit amplifier have symmetrical left and right channels and have a structure to shut out interference between the channels to obtain high separation.In addition, a moisture-resistant glass epoxy board, a oxygen-free copper earth line, and a high-quality film capacitor are used to reduce the impedance of the power supply.Non-magnetic aluminum plates are used in the main chassis of power transformers, MC head amplifiers and equalizer amplifiers to prevent magnetic distortion.Each stage of the MC head amplifier, equalizer amplifier and high-level amplifier is equipped with a DC servo amplifier that eliminates unnecessary DC components, enabling direct playback without capacitors in all signal paths from the MC input to the pre-output.The power transformer uses a large-capacity 100 VA toroidal transformer with very low leakage flux and excellent power supply fluctuation factor. The rectifier uses a 1.2A/200V fast-recovery type diode to speed up the power supply.The   60 v power supply for the equalizer amplifier and high-level amplifier achieves high quality by using a 2,200 ? F/100V electrolytic capacitor, a stabilized power supply circuit with low noise and excellent response, a high-quality film capacitor, and a glass epoxy board.In addition to the newly developed high-stability power supply using high-performance tracking regulator IC for the reference voltage, the power supply floating system is adopted for the drive power supply   30 v of the MC head amplifier to suppress noise generation.The front panel uses 15 mm thick flat glass processed with high precision using special diamond processing technology, and the upper surface uses 6 mm thick smoked glass with printing on the back.In addition, the side panel is treated with champagne gold and anodized.Equipped with two subsonic filters.It is equipped with a recording selector switch and a Rec off position to disconnect the tape recording terminal.Equipped with a flashing indicator to display muting, noise is prevented when power is turned on / off or input selector is switched.The muting circuit also has a manual switch to turn off the pre-output.All input / output terminals are gold-plated.

sections.overview: A preamplifier with separate control unit and power supply unit.The attenuator section uses a balanced type rheostat mode attenuator with excellent SN ratio in actual operation and no difference in characteristics between hot and cold sides in balanced transmission.Since the volume is adjusted between hot and cold, there is no variation between hot and cold, and the noise level is linearly reduced as the volume is reduced, which provides better conditions than the catalog specifications at normal listening levels.In addition, there is only one contact point with the resistor, and there is less noise degradation factor than conventional two points, making it possible to transmit high-purity signals.The input circuit is equipped with a NEW inverted   balance circuit so that both balanced and unbalanced inputs can be made under the same conditions.In addition, it has a unique simple balanced direct design that does not require a conversion transformer or amplifier, enabling high-quality signal transmission. The high CMRR the high CMRR balanced amplifier improves the transmission error between hot and cold by the function of the compensation amplifier.In addition, both the hot and cold outputs can be used as unbalanced outputs for GND. Thus, both balanced and unbalanced outputs have the same quality.In order to reduce the influence of noise from the AC power supply, the power supply and signal amplifier are configured as separate units, and a pure power generator is installed in the power supply unit.The pure power generator is equipped with a low-distortion, high-stability sine wave transmitter. The sine wave output is amplified by a BTL configuration UHC MOS single push-pull power amplifier and used as a Iori. The output is used as a power source to protect music signals from harmonic noise and amplitude fluctuation mixed in the power source.In addition, the built-in oscillator supply frequency to be set to 100 Hz, 150 Hz, 200 Hz, 250 Hz, or 300 Hz. This realizes an excellent current supply capability, and the sound field can be controlled by selecting the frequency.The chassis is made of S1 series unique non-magnetic sand castings with excellent vibration resistance and high precision processing without magnetic influence.

sections.overview: Monaural power amplifier using DENON non-feedback system.In the POA-8000, a non-feedback system that does not generate dynamic strain is adopted from the beginning, which is a complete change from the system that cancels dynamic strain.In the non-feedback system, input signals are amplified in only one direction. First of all, a signal transmission and amplification system that does not generate transient response distortion is adopted. Distortion and noise generated in the amplification system are removed by a distortion removal circuit.The circuit configuration of the POA-8000 is such that the main amplification system does not have a phase compensation circuit or ? circuit, and the amplification stage can be reduced by half. Therefore, the main amplification system amplifies the signal in real time from input to output. Moreover, since it is one way without return, no transient distortion occurs, and excellent dynamic characteristics are obtained.The distortion removal circuit is equipped with a voltage type at the first stage and a power type at the last stage.This distortion removal circuit compares the input signal and output signal of the amplifier and detects all components except for the input signal as distortion of the amplifier element. Next, the distortion component extracted here is made to be opposite phase and amplified so that the distortion component on the output side and the mixing point of the main amplifier output circuit become equal. Then, the same distortion component (opposite phase) as the distortion component on the output side is added to the output side.In this circuit, in addition to distortion, dynamic variations such as amplification, frequency characteristics, operating point drift, noise, etc., all components other than the input signal are regarded as distortion and are removed.The basic circuit is composed mainly of 3-stage Darlington power stage, and all stages from the first stage to the last stage are composed of complimentary service A class push-pull circuit non-feedback amplifier.The first stage consists of a complimentary service push-pull configuration of a low-noise, high-gain FET. In this configuration, a no-feedback voltage amplification is performed by a distortion removal circuit. The output is passed through a high-ft small-signal transistor-emitter-follower circuit, reduced in impedance, and sent to the predriver stage.The pre-driver stage has a simple circuit configuration with one stage amplification by complimentary service push-pull, in this case ft130MHz, Pc1W, V.CEOFour 200 v high-voltage transistors are used in parallel to reduce the current load on each transistor and operate under optimum conditions. A high-precision metal deposition type resistor with an accuracy error of   1% and temperature coefficient of   50 ppm is used to determine the gain of this stage, ensuring highly stable characteristics.The power stage consists of a 3-stage Darlington configuration. The fast driver stage consists of a cascode emitter follower circuit with two small signal transistors with high linearity and 400 MHz ft excellent in high-frequency characteristics. The second driver consists of a parallel push-pull circuit with four transistors. The final output stage consists of a 6-parallel push-pull circuit with 12 Pc150W high-speed power transistors.For the circuit board of the power transistor section, glass epoxy board and oxygen-free copper board with copper foil thickness of 140 ? m with minimized circuit resistance are used, thereby reducing signal transmission loss caused by circuit hand-making at high power.The digital display on the front front has a muting counter function that counts down from 7 to 0 when the power is turned on, and a speaker indication function of SP1orSP2 during normal operation.In addition, it is equipped with a self-diagnosis function, which checks whether the set is operating stably, and displays errors in coded English letters (E-7 to 0) to self-diagnose error locations. The display of E-0 indicates an abnormal temperature rise, and the display of E-3 indicates an abnormal voltage at the midpoint of the main circuit. In the event of such an error or incorrect use, the output relay is instantly cut off by the detection circuit.Equipped with peak indication type output level meter.With dB and WATT (0 dB = 200W/8  ), the peak display is from -50dB to + 5 dB. When the peak level of the output exceeds the rated output even for a moment, the red LED embedded in the meter is lit for a few seconds. The peak hold function is also used.The power supply section has a large transformer with four windings on the secondary side, and supplies high voltage and high stability current to the power section (160 v) and voltage amplifier (220 v).The power supply section consists of a high-voltage, large-capacity electrolytic capacitor and an advisory plate that employs a 1.5 mm brass plate.High-density cut 15 mm thick flat glass is used for the front panel and 6 mm thick smoked glass is used for the top glass cover.The top plate is equipped with a ventilator processed by cutting extruded aluminum material treated with black alumite.The side panel, along with an escutcheon bar, is anodized in champagne gold.Uses a 60 mm diameter machined aluminum insulator.

sections.overview: High-quality monaural power amplifier with UHC single push-pull circuit.UHC-MOS (Ultra High Current-MOS) is used for audio circuits for the first time.This device has an improved gm (amplification factor) compared to bipolar transistors, enabling current linearity equivalent to 35 MOS-FETs and 3 bipolar transistors, which are commonly used, with a single device.As a result, we have completed a single push-pull circuit that can handle low impedance loads and withstand large currents.Cascode bootstrap connection is used for the circuit configuration.By keeping the voltage applied to the UHC-MOS constant, we solve the problem of large junction capacitance, and by realizing high temperature stability, we take advantage of the acoustic characteristics of the UHC-MOS even under severe operating conditions.In addition, this circuit achieves a simple and straight configuration of two voltage amplification stages and one power amplification stage without burdening the voltage amplification stage.Stable operation is realized by the UHC single push-pull circuit.In addition, by eliminating the source resistor and output circuit coil, more high-purity transmission is possible.The BTL circuit provides high output power at low power supply voltage, making it possible to use an excellent acoustic device.In addition, by completely separating the output voltage of the speaker from the ground circuit that serves as the operating reference, adverse effects on the music signal are eliminated.The power supply is equipped with two large toroidal transformers, which are connected in parallel to reduce the impedance of the transformer itself by half and improve the power supply capability.We have also developed and adopted an open-type toroidal transformer that removes the upper case to completely eliminate internal resonance.UHC-MOS is also used in the power supply circuit to greatly reduce power loss.The current loss of the UHC-MOS is equivalent to approximately 40% of that of a Schottky barrier diode and approximately 20% of that of a general silicon diode (at 10A), enabling a current supply of as much as 240A.In addition to the weight of the chassis structure, a direct mechanical ground structure is adopted to reduce the vibration from the large toroidal transformer and power radiator used in the output stage.In this structure, the two large toroidal transformers and the heat sink are fixed directly to the leg, and there is no common vibration path with other peripheral circuits, so the influence on other parts of the set is eliminated.As for peripheral circuits, the mounting base has sufficient weight to eliminate mutual interference.Non-magnetic sand castings are used for the chassis and radiator.In addition to the quick damping of vibration, sand castings have the effect of suppressing the generation of electro-magnetostriction caused by transformers and capacitors.
