sections.overview:
Stereo power amplifier using DC amplifier system.All stages of the ICL are directly connected OCL circuits. The first stage consists of a cascode-connected differential amplifier, the pre-drive stage consists of a differential-amplifier with emitter-follower input and naked gain increasing circuit, and the last stage consists of a Darlington-connected pure complimentary service push-pull.A bipolar power transistor with good switching characteristics of Pc = 100W class is adopted for the output stage to obtain a sufficient output.The power supply is constructed by 2 monaural construction using 2 power transformer system with independent left and right channels.The final stage power supply circuit contains a strong transformer for each of the left and right channels and a large-capacity power supply smoothing capacitor of 44,000 ? F (88,000 ? F in total for the left and right channels) to provide sufficient margin for large amplitude input and to prevent crosstalk between channels.A relatively large ripple current and a return current from the speaker flow through the return conductor from the 44,000 ? F smoothing capacitor to the power transformer. Therefore, even a small electrical resistance causes a noise voltage. Moreover, the potential of this part is grounded. It is connected to the first stage or control amplifier of the left and right channels that handle a small signal voltage. This deteriorates S/N and causes crosstalk.In the POA-1003, this part is equipped with a Dual Bussler In (Dual Busline) with symmetrical left and right channels using a copper plate of 1 mm thickness to eliminate harmful effects.Various measures are taken to suppress DC drift, which is a problem in DC amplifiers.In the first stage differential circuit, TR1/2 is thermally coupled, and at the same time, the drain-source voltage is fixed by cascode connection (TR3/4) to reduce the gate current. In addition, to minimize the drift of the constant current circuit, a pattern layout method is adopted in which TR5 and the diode of its base circuit are thermally coupled.In the pre-driver stage, the bipolar transistor TR8/9 of differential amplification is thermally coupled, and a high-precision resistor is used to minimize the effect on the first stage.As a result of these considerations, the drift temperature coefficient is kept as low as 1.6 mV / ? and stable output is achieved.The power stage, pre-drive stage and final stage transistors are supplied with independent power supplies. In particular, the first stage is equipped with a stabilized power supply circuit with low internal impedance. This ensures that even slight voltage fluctuations in the final stage do not affect the first stage and prevents dynamic crosstalk.As a typical use of DC amplifier, the subsonic filter is designed to automatically turn on with a high-performance reed relay in case an abnormal DC voltage is applied to the input.In the POA 1003, the output impedance is reduced to 1/4 of the conventional one by parallel use of relay and switch contacts and direct soldering of wiring.Equipped with a logarithmic compression type peak meter.Two types of peak levels, dB and WATT, can be read.It is equipped with a protection circuit. When the power is turned on, the protection lamp turns on for approximately 10 seconds and no sound is emitted until the amplifier is in the normal state. This prevents the speaker from making a pop noise when the power is turned on.When a DC voltage is generated at the output terminal, the relay that protects the speakers operates and the protection lamp lights up.

The input signal is applied to TR1, and the NFB from the output stage is applied to the gate of TR2.This FET differential amplifier increases the in-phase signal rejection ratio by the constant current circuit of TR5, and cancels out in-phase noise and distortion generated by TR1/2 itself.Emitter-follower TR6/7 receives the first stage output at an extremely high input impedance, and TR10 works to increase the bare gain of the differential amplification by TR8/9/11. The advantage of the current mirror type differential amplification is that the signal of TR8 is inverted by TR11, the output of TR8 and the output of TR9 are class A push-pull operation, so even order harmonic distortion is canceled out, and the output can be taken out at a low distortion rate from small amplitude to large amplitude operation.

sections.overview: A stereo power amplifier with dual super no-feedback amplifier.DENON's original dual super non-feedback amplifier is used for the circuit method, and the essence of amplifier technology such as complete DC configuration and non-switching method is put into it.The dual super no-feedback circuit is designed to eliminate static distortion and inherent noise caused by nonlinear characteristics of amplification elements such as power transistors.The structure consists of three servo amplifiers : a distortion servo circuit in which the N-channel and P-channel transistors in the power stage cancel each other's distortion, and a distortion servo circuit in which the total distortion appearing in the output stage of the speaker is eliminated. The main signal is transmitted to the speaker terminal without feedback, and because there is no NFB circuit, it is not affected by the back electromotive force from the speaker, and there is no increase in distortion when the speaker is connected.F for pre-driver stageTIt uses a 150 MHz high-speed transistor and a direct DC servo circuit with a fully capacitorless signal path (fully DC configuration) for higher slew rate.The output stage adopts a 4-parallel push-pull configuration using a high-capacity high-speed power transistor of Pc130W.In addition, DENON's original bias circuit is used to eliminate switching distortion and reduce crossover distortion.The voltage amplification stage employs circuits and devices designed for high speed and wide dynamic range. In addition to three stage differential amplification using low-noise and low-feedback capacitance FET at the first stage, a Pc25W large-capacity transistor is installed at the final stage.In addition, the Unity Current Interface (UCI) circuit is adopted to emphasize the interface characteristics of the amplifier stage and power stage. This circuit is a system in which the load of the voltage amplifier stage is always constant regardless of the operation of the power stage. By driving the power stage only with voltage, higher speed and lower distortion are realized.The power supply employs a unique pure dynamic power supply system to effectively reduce dynamic IM distortion (intermodulation distortion) caused by interference between input signal and ripple current generated in the power supply.It is also equipped with a 800 VA class large toroidal transformer and 8 10,000 ? F large-capacity block capacitors, and combined with a high-output power transistor to realize a drive that does not fluctuate even when the speaker impedance drops to 2   instantaneously. In addition, the secondary winding and subsequent parts of the power transformer are made into a complete monaural configuration. After the left and right parts are taken out separately, they pass through independent large-capacity smoothing circuits and rectifier circuits, and are supplied to the predriver stage and power stage. This improves static and dynamic crosstalk characteristics.The internal layout is twin monaural construction. The left and right channels are perfectly symmetrical with the power transformer at the center. The pre-driver / power stage, block capacitors, rectifier circuit, volume and input / output terminals are symmetrically laid out.This eliminates the mutual interference between the small-signal line and the large-current line and between the left and right channels, as well as the non-uniform characteristics.Equipped with two input terminals.In normal mode, it is input to the voltage amplifier stage via the volume. In direct mode, it jumps to the volume and is directly connected.A bar line multi-display is adopted in the center of the front panel. When the power is turned on, it blinks for a few seconds until normal operation is achieved and then falls. In addition, when an error occurs in the set, one of the four divided bars blinks to indicate the abnormal operation of overload detection, L/R DC detection and temperature detection circuit.In addition, the newly developed overload protector is built-in, and abnormality is instantly detected.Uses a speaker terminal that can be connected up to 6 mm core diameter.Uses 37   0.26 mm x power cords with polarity display.

sections.overview: This is a stereo power amplifier equipped with DENON class A, which was created by thoroughly investigating class A operation.Equipped with DENON Class A by DENON's unique real bias circuit, it realizes high output while operating as A class amplifier.The output transistor is a newly developed high-speed power transistor (f) with particularly excellent high-frequency characteristics.T: 100 MHz, Pc : 150W). This transistor can be operated at high power.FEIt has good linearity and can maintain the rated output with low distortion even at 100 Hz.This high-speed power transistor has five parallel push-pull connections per channel, dramatically improving linearity and achieving low-distortion characteristics over a wide bandwidth.A real bias circuit has been adopted to solve the problems of low efficiency, heat generation and large size which were the defects of A class amplifier.Because this circuit performs class A linear amplification using the linear region of the amplification characteristics of the transistor without distortion of the signal waveform, it is controlled so that a DC bias current equal to the peak value of the signal current flowing in the transistor is supplied. This allows a stable and appropriate DC bias current to be supplied according to the magnitude of the signal waveform from a small signal to a large signal, saving power consumption and reducing heat generation. In addition, since the bias current is stably controlled by the control function regardless of the temperature condition of the output transistor, the operating state of the best condition is always maintained.In addition, the bias current is controlled to rise earlier than the signal current. In order to prevent the delay cutoff of the rise of the bias at this time, a small fixed bias current is supplied even when there is no signal, so that the bias rises one step ahead of the rise of the signal. Thus, even when a high-frequency musical tone signal with a fast rise comes, the bias rises earlier and increases, so that the operation is controlled to ensure class A operation.In addition, the fixed bias current effectively acts on the non-linear characteristics of the transistor in the small current region, and the output transistor is controlled so that it does not enter this region.This real-bias circuit realizes an efficiency of approximately 1/5 power consumption compared with conventional systems.The driver circuitTA small-signal transistor (f) having a high linearity characteristic is provided.T(400 MHz, Pc : 400 mW) are connected in parallel for each channel.F of the putter transistorTThe cascode connection of this transistor, which has four times the wide-band transmission characteristic of the transistor, further improves the high-band linearity, prevents the influence of the Cob (collector-base junction capacitance) of power transistors, etc., and prevents the degradation of the high-band characteristic by driving the output stage with a wide-band and low impedance.Power is supplied from a power supply circuit independent of the final output stage to prevent mutual interference.The pre-driver stage is balanced by a twin complimentary service differential circuit and the power stage is push-pull driven by a cascode pre-driver.The transistor used is the same f as the driver stage.TA high-speed transistor of 400 MHz is adopted, and a drive circuit capable of power drive is constructed for wide-band and low-impedance amplification.In addition, in order to maintain the stability of the operating point of differential circuits such as pre-drivers, an operation stabilizer circuit is installed to suppress the effect of temperature drift.The first stage employs a low-noise FET differential amplifier and a direct DC servo system that operates in parallel.This is the same configuration as the control amplifier PRA-2000. It is not only a servo to eliminate unnecessary coloring by removing the coupling capacitor of the input part and to obtain stability in the ultra-low range by simply shutting out DC mid-point drift. Since no servo amplifier is added to the feedback system, the noise level does not increase. By connecting differential amplifiers in parallel and DC servo to each amplifier, the noise is reduced by 3 dB and the distortion rate is improved to 1/2.The power supply section uses a separate power transformer system for the output stage and others.The power supply for the output stage consists of a large toroidal transformer with separate left and right windings and a 100,000 ? F large-capacity capacitor with low impedance up to the high frequency range. This transformer has a capacity (1000 VA) approximately twice that of a 200W + 200W B-class amplifier power supply transformer. This transformer is floated in a non-magnetic 2 mm thick aluminum chassis to prevent magnetic distortion.From the first stage to the drive stage, an EI-type power transformer is installed separately to avoid the effect of severe load fluctuation of the output stage. A constant voltage stabilizing circuit is provided to stabilize the power supply and reduce impedance.To prevent an extremely large inrush current (inrush current) when the power switch is turned on from shortening the life of the power switch or affecting other electrical appliances, we have installed an inrush prevention circuit in the power supply part to prevent troubles.Equipped with a large power meter that can directly read the left and right output levels in dB and W.The speakers and transistors are protected by a high-speed protection circuit that also serves as a muting circuit to prevent pop noise that occurs when the power switch is turned ON / OFF.When an error occurs, the protection indicator LED in the front glass flashes.The internal layout of the amplifier is symmetrical, and the power supply part is located away from the first stage circuit as far as possible in terms of position and electrical. The construction gives priority to characteristics.The the meter section of the front panel, thick flat glass is used for the overlay effect and mirror effect. When the power is turned on, the DENON mark is displayed for five to six seconds and then a large peak meter is illuminated.Mirror finish is applied to the side plate.

sections.overview: Stereo power amplifier using MOS super optical class A circuit.The MOS super-optical class A circuit is a further development of Denon's original optical class A circuit. It achieves excellent sound quality and high efficiency by amplifying up to the level of general listening power as pure class A.In the MOS super optical class A circuit, interference between the main signal system and the bias control circuit is eliminated by optical coupling which transmits the control signal from the bias control circuit to the bias circuit, and high speed bias control is achieved by optical element.In the final stage, six large-capacity large-size power transistors of Pc130W are connected in parallel, so that there is enough space to supply current to the load.MOS FET (Pc30W) and MOS Power FET (Pc100W) are connected in inverted Darlington configuration to drive the last stage with sufficient space. The Inverted Darlington driver stage with MOS Power FET allows 10 times more bias current than the conventional one, expands the pure A-class operation range of the driver stage by 10 times, improves the quality at small and medium output, and eliminates sound quality degradation at small output.A differential 3-stage amplifier circuit is used for the voltage amplifier stage.This circuit employs a low-noise, low-feedback capacitor FET selected by Denon's strict standards for the first stage differential amplifier circuit. The pre-driver stage employs a current-mirror differential amplifier to supply a high-level signal voltage to the output stage, and a parallel differential circuit to further improve the quality, resulting in a significant improvement in linearity.The power supply section is equipped with a large toroidal transformer and a large-capacity acoustic power supply condenser. The power supply section supplies power to the power stage and pre-driver stage independently, and the left and right channels are completely independent to create a monaural layout structure. This allows the power supply section to be completely monaural construction through the power stage and pre-driver stage, eliminating the left and right interference caused by the power supply section.In addition, the main signal system and power supply are completely separated via a large heat sink, and the left and right circuits are made into a symmetrical structure to eliminate characteristic differences.The chassis structure employs a 5-point supporting high-rigidity chassis made of thick plate material, and the cabinet is firmly supported by a large heavy-weight foot based on sintered metal.Epoxy glass composite boards with excellent strength and electrical performance are used for printed circuit boards.In addition, high-quality parts such as acoustic resistance and condenser are adopted.The POA 3000 rg can also be used as a monaural power amplifier by switching the switch.High power is achieved by driving the left and right 2-channel amplifiers as positive and negative polarity amplifiers in monaural operation, and the balance input in monaural operation uses the direct balance input method.There are two types of input jacks, an RCA pin jack and a cannon connector. Both unbalanced and balanced inputs are available.The balance conversion circuit for monaural unbalanced input is equipped with Inverted   Balance circuit originally developed by Denon. In order to bring out the advantage of balance transmission system, all amplification elements are discrete configuration using high-performance and high-quality parts. This circuit realizes high power supply voltage, low distortion factor and high SN ratio.The output terminal is a two system large speaker terminal for bi-wiring connection.Equipped with an analog meter for peak output level display.This meter is equipped with a meter switch that can turn on and off the lighting and operation.Equipped with a newly developed protector circuit that can drive low-impedance speakers stably.It is equipped with front operation input level control for stereo and monaural independently.It uses an input level control knob using a briar and a real wood mirror finish cabinet with multi-layer coating.In addition, a 20 mm thick glass window is used in the front.

sections.overview: A full digital AV preamplifier equipped with a DSP (Digital Signal Processor) for digitally processing all processes with high precision.The digital signal processor (D. S. P) is used for surround sound to improve the accuracy of sound field settings.In addition to Dolby Pro Logic and Personal Logic, it is equipped with various modes that can be finely set by 2 types of parameters, main and sub, so that it can be set according to the type of source and listening room conditions.In addition to the full digital Dolby Pro-Logic circuit, it is equipped with "Personal Logic" mode which can be adjusted according to the software and the environment of the room. It enables DSP presence such as theater and live, and fine adjustment of each stage.In addition, a cinema equalizer that takes into account the transmission characteristics of the screen and a parametric equalizer that adjusts the characteristics of the speakers are also digitally processed, making it possible to play a richer sound field according to the space under various conditions.The signals input to AVP 5000 are processed as digital signals in all processes until they are converted into analog signals by the DA converter and output.In addition, the performance of each stage is improved by adopting a discrete digital processing system that processes OPT LINK, DIR (digital interface receiver), DSP (digital signal processor) and DA converter with the latest LSI.An analog input signal is converted into a digital signal and then processed digitally.The DA converter section, which is the final stage of a discrete digital processing system, consists of dedicated DA converters for front, center and surround channels. Each channel is equipped with the latest digital / analog conversion technology according to its purpose.Also, in order to accurately reproduce analog signals from VTRs and other devices, we have adopted the latest technology for the A / D converter. By processing L/R channels simultaneously and performing A / D conversion, we have improved the waveform characteristics.A high-speed, low-optical-transmission distortion optical fiber module with excellent pulse-width distortion and jitter values is used in the optical input section, enabling more stable optical transmission than conventional optical transmission systems and taking into consideration changes in the amount of incident light.In addition, the signal input to the DIR (Digital Interface Receiver) has a digital filter in which the clock timing of the output section is independent of that of the input section, so that the phase relationship of the clock does not affect internal internal operation, thus reducing the effect of jitter during optical transmission.To support Hi-Vision, the video section is equipped with a 20 MHz (horizontal resolution of 1500 lines or more) high-bandwidth video selector circuit.For video output, both S and Composite are equipped with on-screen monitor output and high-quality monitor output for a wide range of applications.The audio input section is also equipped with four discrete channel inputs (rear and center channel dedicated inputs) that support Hi-Vision (3-1 system).The inside of the amplifier is separated into five blocks by a copper-plated chassis and aluminum shield. The power supply circuit, digital circuit, analog circuit, video circuit, and display / control circuit are configured as independent blocks completely eliminate mutual interference.In order to achieve purer signal reproduction, the audio and video / control transformers are separated.Filters are added to each AC line to eliminate mutual interference and to reduce the influence of external devices.The analog signal input section is equipped with a direct reproduction function using high-performance relay, and transmission loss is minimized by transmitting the input signal to the output terminal in the shortest distance.A single-channel buffer amplifier is used for the analog section that transmits signals to the power amplifier, and an aluminum die-cast motor drive volume is used for all channels.When the AVP 5000 is used as an audio-only preamplifier, it is equipped with a video-off function that shuts out the video circuit from the power supply.Equipped with multi-function FL display, 24 characters, dot matrix and display off are possible.A learning remote controller with liquid crystal display and back light is included.

sections.overview: FM/AM tuner pursuing the theme of quality and usability.It is based on a digital synthesizer method that allows easy channel selection and accurate tuning accuracy, and is equipped with a random 16-station preset function to sufficiently cover areas with a large number of receiving stations.The memory is equipped with a memory backup function that keeps the contents of the memory for about one month after power is turned off without using batteries.The memory mechanism employs a "4-way tuning mechanism" that fully applies the features of the digital system to improve usability and practicability.One touch random preset tuning allows you to directly call up the desired station from among the 16 stored stations without switching between FM and AM.Auto tuning automatically finds and tunes radio waves using autoscan.Manual scanning is also available.When the power is turned on, the station is automatically selected to the last station that received the signal.In order to receive FM radio waves with high precision, we have adopted a quartz lock synthesizer system that synchronizes with the precision of the crystal oscillation according to the frequency arrangement of the broadcasting station.The comparison frequency of the PLL is set to 25 Hz, which is outside of the audible band, and the SN ratio is improved by eliminating beat and noise in the audio band by adopting a static control method that eliminates noise from the frequency display circuit, etc. This realizes high basic performance.For the front end part, the analog type uses a varactor diode equivalent to 3 circuits, and J-FET is used for the input part.The IF stage employs a ceramic filter with constant amplitude and constant delay characteristics.The AM section employs a 2-stage 3-terminal high-selectivity ceramic filter and a 1-stage coil-type filter that eliminates 9 khz beat interference, and a low-impedance loop antenna that is resistant to electric-field noise from fluorescent lamps.

sections.overview: The FM/AM tuner was developed with an emphasis on basic performance by making full use of the latest devices and tuner technology at that time.In the front end section, an FET with excellent high-frequency and noise characteristics is used in the first stage, and sensitivity and S/N have been improved by the adoption of a 3-row varicon.We have also improved the image interference rejection capability of neighboring stations.The IF (intermediate frequency amplification stage) has a three stage configuration of linear phase ceramic filter that achieves both low distortion factor and high selectivity. Combined with newly developed Quadrature detection ICs and PLL-MPX ICs, low distortion factor has been realized.The newly developed PLL-MPX IC is used in the MPX section, and noise components due to power supply ripple are reduced by a ripple filter circuit exclusive to the MPX section.In addition, in order to output the music signal obtained by this circuit without degradation as much as possible, a line amplifier is built into the IC and the coupling capacitor between the MPX section and the audio amplifier is removed to make a DC configuration.A frequency control system (servo lock) is built in so that the local oscillation frequency is not affected by ambient temperature change and stable oscillation can be achieved.After optimum tuning is performed by the tuning mechanism using LED, the servo lock mechanism is operated to prevent the tuning deviation.The tuning display at the time of FM reception shows the direction of frequency deviation (indicated by the red LED) and just tuning (indicated by the green LED) by three LEDs. By operating the servo lock mechanism at the time of just tuning, stable reception is always maintained.The signal level of the antenna input is indicated by five LEDs for both FM and AM. The number of LEDs that turn on varies depending on the strength of the radio wave.The AM section consists of an IF stage combined with a coil and two stages of a newly developed 3-terminal type high-selectivity ceramic filter and a double-series varicon. While eliminating 9 kHz beat interference, stable sound quality is obtained.In addition, the antenna is a low-impedance loop type that is resistant to electric-field noise. This antenna is detachable from the back panel and can be installed in a suitable location depending on the receiving location.Built-in oscillator for recording level check (440 Hz, output level : -6dB at 100% FM modulation)Each function of FM/AM/Rec-Cal adopts electronic switching.Power ON / OFF Built-in muting circuit to remove the following noise and inter-station noise.

sections.overview: FM/AM tuners with the latest devices, technologies and designs to improve sound quality and operability.The front-end section uses an FET with excellent high-frequency and noise characteristics in the first stage, and a high-precision 3-row varicon.In addition, the intermediate frequency amplifier stage (IF stage) has a three stage configuration of linear phase ceramic filter that achieves both low distortion factor and high selectivity, and realizes low distortion.The detector uses newly developed Quadrature detection ICs to improve the linearity of the phase characteristics, reduce distortion and improve the S/N ratio.The newly developed PLL-MPX IC is used in the MPX section, and the ripple filter circuit dedicated to the MPX section reduces noise components caused by power supply ripple and improves various characteristics.In order to suppress degradation of the music signal, a line amplifier is built into the IC, and the coupling and condenser between the MPX section and the audio amplifier are removed to create a DC configuration. This reduces the influence on frequency characteristics, distortion factor, S/N, etc.A servo lock circuit is built in to ensure stable oscillation without the local oscillation frequency being affected by ambient temperature change.After tuning by the tuning mechanism using LED, the servo lock mechanism is operated to prevent tuning deviation and to enable stable reception with less distortion.The tuning display at the time of FM reception uses three LEDs to indicate the direction of frequency shift (indicated by the red LED) and just tuning (indicated by the green LED).The signal level of the antenna input is indicated by 10 LEDs for both FM and AM. The number of LEDs that turn on varies depending on the strength of the radio wave.The AM tuner consists of an IF stage consisting of a double varicon, two stages of 3-terminal high-selectivity ceramic filters, and a coil. This ensures stable sound quality while eliminating 9 kHz beat interference.In addition, the newly developed low-impedance loop type antenna, which is resistant to various types of noise in the air, has been adopted for high sensitivity and high S/N. The antenna is detachable from the back panel.Built-in oscillator for recording level check convenient for air check.Each function of FM/AM/Rec. Cal can be switched electronically.It is equipped with a muting circuit that removes noise when the power supply is on / off and noise between stations.

sections.title: DENON-COLUMBIA DENON
sections.overview: A synthesizer tuner that takes advantage of digital tuners to improve operability.It corresponds to the frequency distribution of each FM/AM broadcasting station. It uses a synthesizer method that synchronizes every 100 kHz for FM and every 9 kHz for AM.In this system, the reference frequency obtained from the crystal oscillator and the local oscillation frequency are compared in phase to form a phase-locked loop that controls the varactor diode. Therefore, there is no drift of the local frequency and good and stable reception is possible.Built-in functions such as preset tuning (one touch tuning), auto tuning and manual tuning are also included.Preset channel selection is equipped with a preset function for 7 FM/AM stations each. When you select your favorite broadcasting station, press the memory button and preset button (1-7) to store it.In the Auto tuning mode, if you select Auto with the scan button and press one push of the tuning key up or down, the radio wave is automatically searched for whether the frequency is higher or lower and the radio wave stops at the correct tuning point. Pressing the tuning key again searches for the next tuning point.Manual tuning can be performed by selecting the manual setting with the scan button and operating the up and down tuning keys. The received frequency is displayed with a digital counter enabling you to catch radio waves that cannot be caught with Auto tuning.Equipped with an IC memory circuit, it memorizes all the conditions before turning off the power.The memory circuit uses a backup power supply that operates for more than five years.The front end is composed of a 4-stage varactor diode and a MOS FET, which is equivalent to an analog 4-stage varicon type.The intermediate frequency amplifier stage (IF stage) employs a linear phase ceramic filter that achieves both low distortion factor and high selectivity, improving the distortion factor in all bands.Quadrature detection ICs with linear detection capability over a wide band are used for the detection circuit, and PLL-MPX ICs are used for the MPX part.In order to transmit music signals without degradation, a DC line amplifier without a coupling capacitor is used.In order to improve the AM sensitivity and S/N ratio, the IF stage is composed of two 3-terminal high-selectivity ceramic filters with sharp out-of-band attenuation and a coil combined with the IF stage provides sound quality of 9 kHz without beat interference.In addition, we have adopted a small low-impedance loop antenna that is resistant to noise in space. This antenna can be freely attached and detached from the back panel, and can be installed in a place with good reception within a range of approximately 1m.The power transformer secondary winding of the power supply section is independent for digital display tube, synthesizer section and general circuit, and stable operation of each section is achieved.You can adjust the brightness of the digital display in two levels with the dimmer switch.Built-in oscillator for recording level check convenient for air checkThe output level corresponds to 50% FM modulation at a frequency of 440 Hz.Electronic switching is adopted for each function of FM/AM/Rec. Cal.Power On / Off Built-in muting circuit to remove the following noise and inter-station noise.

sections.overview: An FM/AM tuner that uses a digital synthesizer.It employs a quartz-lock synthesizer system that synchronizes with the accuracy of the crystal oscillation. The comparison frequency of the PLL is set to 25 kHz, which is out of the audible band. It also employs a static control system that suppresses noise from the frequency display circuit. This improves the SN ratio by eliminating beat and noise in the audio band.Equipped with a one touch random preset tuning function that can directly call up 8 stations without switching between FM and AM.It is equipped with four channel selection methods, including automatic channel selection that automatically finds and tunes radio waves by auto-scan, manual channel selection that can receive even weak radio waves by manual scan, and last-channel memory channel selection that calls the station before OFF when the power is ON.The front end section of the analog type uses a varactor diode equivalent to four circuits, and the input section uses a dual gate MOS FET.The IF stage, which controls the total quality, uses a ceramic filter with constant amplitude and constant delay characteristics, and an anti-noise filter to eliminate Birdie generated during stereo operation. This improves the interference rejection capability.It is equipped with a quality indicator that shows a good level of reception.The AM tuner uses a 3-terminal high-selectivity ceramic filter and coil that eliminates 9 kHz beat interference and a low-impedance loop antenna that is resistant to electric field noise.There are 2 variations, black and champagne gold.

sections.overview: FM/AM tuner equipped with SSS (Super Searcher system).SSS is a system developed to eliminate RF intermodulation interference without affecting the quality of radio waves to be received. It consists of a newly developed band suppress circuit built into the antenna input section and a noise level indicator that displays the interference level. This circuit is a filter that rapidly attenuates one of the strong input radio waves that cause spurious signals. The attenuation frequency can be changed by the SSS controller.When interference occurs, the SSS is turned ON and the controller minimizes the noise level, eliminating interference and enabling clear reception.The front-end section consists of a high voltage varactor diode (equivalent to a four string varistor) and a dual gate MOS FET.In addition, the S/N ratio is improved by setting the comparison frequency of the PLL that locks the tuning frequency to 25 kHz, which is out of the audible band.We have improved various characteristics by adopting a static control method for the frequency-display circuit, an IF stage that can be switched between wide and narrow, a ceramic filter with constant delay characteristics (when IF is wide), a pilot canceler, and an anti Birdie filter.Four tuning methods are available : eight FM / AM one touch random preset tuning, auto tuning, manual tuning, and last channel memory tuning.It is equipped with a quality indicator that the LED gives a green sign in good reception.This indicator does not light when sufficient SN ratio cannot be obtained due to insufficient input of radio waves or RF intermodulation interference. Therefore, it can be used for antenna and interference check.A loop antenna is installed to improve AM sensitivity and S/N.Built-in oscillator for recording level check.

sections.overview: An FM stereo tuner with improved characteristics aimed at an FM tuner with better sound quality.The front end is equipped with a 4-row varicon dedicated to FM.In addition, a low-noise dual-gate MOS-FET is used in the RF stage that controls the noise characteristics to enhance the interference rejection capability.The intermediate frequency amplifier is equipped with a high-gain amplifier stage and a 5-stage limiter that employ highly reliable high-integration ICs to prevent audio quality degradation due to interference.The combination of a phase-flat (phase-linear) 6-element ceramic filter and an LC circuit ensures a high effective selectivity of 78 dB. sections.overview: FM stereo tuner with TU 500 and TU 355 technology.The dial scale is 200 kHz equally spaced (3.4 mm) to express the usability and the accuracy of the tuner.In addition, the dial mechanism uses a flywheel with a large moment of inertia, a high-precision stainless steel shaft, and alloy bearings to maintain smooth running.The signal meter circuit employs a multi-stage amplification stage and detection system. This makes it possible to swing the signal meter in proportion to the strength of the input radio wave from the strong electric field to the weak electric field. The strength of the input radio wave at the time of broadcast reception can be measured, and the state of the radio wave can be monitored as with the multi-path terminal.It is also equipped with a tuning meter that provides the best tuning with the least distortion.A boardless package type is adopted for the front end part to improve basic performance such as sensitivity, S/N, stability, and temperature characteristics.It features a high-precision frequency linear 5-row varicon, low-noise dual-gate MOS-FET, and a triple-tune circuit with flat phase characteristics and excellent selection characteristics.The local oscillation circuit employs a clap-type oscillation circuit that is resistant to voltage and temperature fluctuations. In addition, the oscillation frequency fluctuation is minimized by using a temperature compensation capacitor and an oscillation coil that is resistant to temperature and humidity, thereby eliminating the need for an AFC circuit.The IF section consists of two circuits. In addition to the IF amplifier section, it is a sub amplifier (consisting of four transistors) for control systems such as signal meters, multi-pass vertical output circuits and muting circuits.The IF main amplifier circuit uses differential amplification by a discrete transistor with good S/N and two differential amplification 3-stage direct-coupled ICs with ideal limiting (amplitude limiting) function. By using four 2-element ceramic filters as coupling selection elements between them, low distortion and high separation are obtained.A ratio detection circuit is used for FM detection.The MPX circuit uses an IC with a PLL circuit configuration.We have also studied the effect of the distorted waveform on sound quality, and particularly aimed at improving sound quality by minimizing nonlinear crosstalk.In order to completely remove pilot signal (19 kHz) and subcarrier (38 kHz) leaked from the MPX circuit, an independent LC3-stage low-pass filter is used.As a result, the frequency characteristics are kept within -1.5 dB even at the maximum transmission frequency of 15 kHz, and carrier leakage is suppressed to below the noise level (-75dB or less).The audio circuit consists of a two stage direct-coupled amplifier and an emitter-follower buffer stage. The two outputs are low-output impedance, so that there is no degradation in characteristics even when the input impedance of the tape deck or amplifier is low or when two output terminals are used simultaneously.Multi-path terminal is mounted.This terminal is used to detect unwanted reflected waves. It can be used for optimum antenna installation such as selection of appropriate antenna, direction and height.The antenna input terminal is equipped with a 75   F-type connector exclusively for coaxial cable to minimize transmission loss and receive weak radio waves.Built-in 440 Hz test signal oscillator.The test signal level is 1/2 (-6dB) of 100% modulation of FM broadcasting, 0.5 Vrms at the fixed output terminal and 0.75 Vrms at the variable output terminal when the volume is maximum. This output corresponds to 50% modulation of broadcasting and is used as a reference to adjust the level meter when recording on a tape deck.This test signal can also be used for balance check and phase check.Equipped with a muting switch, deep inter-station noise can be eliminated when channel selection.Equipped with a high-blend switch that cancels out noise without destroying frequency characteristics.There was a wood cabinet as an optional item sold separately.

sections.overview: FM stereo tuner using drum type tuning system.A drum type tuning system is used for the dial part.In this system, a 12 cm diameter drum is used for the dial part, and the scale is lengthened while the panel area is reduced. The total travel length of the scale (75 ~ 91 MHz) is 28.3 cm, and it is easy to see that one scale is equal spacing of 200 kHz together with the frequency proportional type varicon.Since high-precision stainless steel shaft and alloy bearing are used for the dial rotation mechanism, even the frequently used tuning knob maintains the initial smoothness for a long time.The tuning instruction is a 2-meter type consisting of a signal meter and a center type tuning meter.The large meter at the left end is also used as a signal meter and can read the input voltage of the antenna terminal.The left and right level meters can also be used as independent measuring instruments.With a high input impedance of 200k  , it is possible to measure the steady state audio signal voltage from approximately -30dB (24.5 mV) to + 33 dB (34.6 V) by switching the front external Att.It can also be used as an amplifier output meter by combining it with an amplifier that does not have a level meter.In the front-end section, the input signal is first passed through a single tuning circuit of a series of varicon, and then the high-frequency amplification of the dual-gate MOS-FET is performed immediately to maintain high S/N against weak radio waves.After that, it is mixed and amplified with local oscillation frequency by a dual-gate MOS-FET through a triple tune circuit of three varicon series, and the configuration is designed so that it does not distort even strong radio wave and does not cause blocking phenomenon with appropriate gain setting.A modified clap-type oscillation circuit is used for the local oscillation circuit. This circuit has many advantages such as that the transistor is less affected by voltage fluctuation and temperature change due to the grounded collector type, and the output has less harmonics.In addition, a temperature compensation capacitor and an oscillation coil with resistance to temperature and humidity are adopted. Moreover, the oscillation output is injected into the second gate of the dual gate FET for mixing through one stage of buffer amplifier, so the oscillation frequency is extremely stable. This eliminates the problematic AFC circuit.The IF section consists of two circuits. It consists of an original amplifier circuit and a sub amplifier circuit for the control system such as signal meter, multi-pass vertical output terminal and muting circuit. This configuration reduces the occurrence of new harmonics, phase modulation and cross modulation interference in the main IF section.The main through differential amplification by transistors with a wide dynamic range, the main amplifier circuit forms multistage amplification with good linearity mainly by IC-2 pairs directly connected to three stages of differential amplification. Four pairs of ceramic 2-element type filters with high selectivity and flat phase characteristics with an emphasis on sound quality are used as coupling and selection elements between them. Finally, a ratio detection circuit for wide band with low output impedance is adopted for FM detection.A PLL circuit is used in the MPX section.Both the left and right channels of the low-frequency amplifier are designed as two stage direct-coupled amplifier circuits.In addition, unnecessary leakage such as pilot signal and subcarrier is cut off with a low-pass filter of LC3-stage configuration.Equipped with muting switch and high blend switch.The Function Selector has a Stereo only position in addition to Mono and Auto positions.This is a convenient function to select only stereo programs from the broadcast.There was a wood cabinet as an optional item sold separately.

sections.overview: FM stereo tuner with drum type dial.A 12 cm diameter drum is used for the dial part to reduce the area occupied by the panel and to read the received frequency accurately.With this rotary drum type dial, the total travel length of the scale is 28.3 cm, approximately 1.5 times longer than that of conventional machines. Combined with the use of a frequency proportional type varicon, the scale achieves an easy-to-see equal spacing of 200 kHz.The dial rotation mechanism uses oil-less, oil-containing polyacetal resin to keep the initial operability of the tuning knob for a long time.The two meter type of signal meter and center type tuning meter is used for the tuning instruction. The large meter at the left end is also used as a signal meter and can read the input voltage of the antenna terminal.In addition to the signal meter, the left meter operates as a level meter for the tuner output L-ch. The performance of this level meter conforms to the regulations of the broadcasting station class VU meter.The large meter on the right is a null balance check meter in addition to the Rch level meter. Null balance is a function to ensure correct electrical balance when balance control a stereo circuit.The left and right level meters also function as independent measuring instruments.The input impedance is as high as 200k   or more, and by switching the external ATT on the front, the steady state audio signal voltage from -30dB (24.5 mv) to + 33 db (34.6 v) can be measured.When combined with an amplifier that does not have a level meter, it can be used as an output meter of the amplifier, and the meter on the right can be used as a null balance checker.Equipped with a multi-path terminal, antenna selection and direction / height adjustment can be performed correctly.The input terminal from the antenna is equipped with a special 75   F-type connector for a coaxial feeder with less transmission loss and induction of neighbor noise. It is directly connected to the front end, giving consideration to the transmission characteristics of weak radio waves.At the front end, a single tuning circuit of a series of varicon is passed through, and high frequency amplification of a single bi-gate MOS-FET is performed immediately to maintain high S/N against weak radio waves. After that, a triple tuning circuit using three series of varicon is added, and mixed amplification with local oscillation frequency is performed by the bi-gate MOS-FET. Thus, the structure is constructed so that even strong radio waves are not distorted and do not cause blocking phenomenon with appropriate gain setting.A modified clap-type oscillation circuit is used for the local oscillation circuit. This circuit is a common-collector type. The operation of the transistor is hardly affected by power supply voltage fluctuation and temperature change, and the output is directly extracted from a resonant circuit with a clean waveform, so that harmonics are less.We also use carefully selected temperature compensation capacitors, oscillation coils with excellent temperature and humidity resistance, and hand wiring to reduce stray capacitance. In addition, the oscillation frequency is stable because the oscillation output is injected into the second gate of the mixing double-gate FET.In the IF section, two sets of three stage direct-coupled differential amplification ICs with ideal limiting (amplitude limiting) function are mainly used. In addition, transistors with a wide dynamic range are used to construct multistage amplification with good linearity.The coupling and selection elements between them are ceramic 2-element type with high selectivity and use 4 sets of flat phase characteristic filters with emphasis on sound quality.FM detection uses a ratio detection circuit for a wide band with low output impedance.The MPX circuit is a stereo decoder IC integrated with PLL switching and pulse oscillation circuits.Both the left and right channels are designed to reduce distortion by stacking two double-stage direct-coupled amplifier circuits for a total of four stages, and by using a newly developed 3-stage low-pass filter to cut unwanted pilot signal and subcarrier leakage.There are two types of output terminal : fixed and variable.In addition to Mono and Auto, the Function Selector also has a Stereo-only position. The stereo output is automatically sent out when stereo broadcast transmission, and automatically stops when it changes to Mono.Equipped with a headphone jack with volume.Equipped with a muting switch, noise between stations can be eliminated.Equipped with a high blend switch, noise can be suppressed without losing frequency characteristics.

sections.overview: FM stereo tuner with built-in monitor amplifier.The front end section consists of a dual-gate MOS-type FET and a 5-series varicon dedicated to FM.This FET has excellent high-frequency and noise characteristics, and by using a high-frequency (RF) amplifier stage and mixer stage, it realizes high sensitivity, high S/N ratio, and excellent interference rejection capability.The IF amplifier achieves both transmission characteristics and separation characteristics between stations by switching between wide-band and narrow-band in two stages. Wide-band consists of two linear phase ceramic filters, while narrow-band consists of five ceramic filters.The FM detection circuit employs a newly developed quadrature detection IC with greatly improved linearity of phase characteristics. Compared with conventional parts, this circuit reduces distortion by half and improves the S/N ratio by 6 dB.Combined with the linear-phase ceramic filter used in the intermediate frequency amplifier, it enables excellent stereo reproduction.The newly developed PLL IC for MPX is used in the MPX circuit.This MPX circuit uses a 19 kHz pilot signal for demodulation into a stereo signal, but this signal is unnecessary as an audio signal and is equipped with a pilot canceler circuit developed to remove this unnecessary component.In addition, the S/N ratio has been improved by using a new IC with a built-in 100% NFB circuit to reduce the distortion in the stereo demodulation section.It has a built-in servo-lock circuit, and by activating the servo-lock after tuning, highly accurate and stable medical examination is possible.Signal tuning display using LED is adopted.Three LEDs are used for the tuning display. When the tuning is performed close to the desired station, the right or left AKAI LED lights up corresponding to the frequency shift, and when the tuning state is entered, the green LED in the center lights up.In this ON the servo lock in this state, the tuning is accurately held.The signal level of the antenna input is displayed by five LEDs, and the number of LEDs lit varies depending on the signal strength.Equipped with a full-scale monitor amplifier using IC, and low impedance / high impedance headphones can be used.Built-in oscillator for recording level check.Multi-path detection terminal is mounted.Long linear scale with effective length of 214 mm is adopted.

sections.overview: An FM stereo tuner that uses a new method developed by DENON acoustic researchers in pursuit of sound quality in the FM detection and stereo demodulation sections.A drum type long scale dial is used for tuning.A low-noise dual-gate MOS FET is used in the high-frequency amplification stage of the front-end section to obtain high S/N and interference rejection capability.In order to achieve both the transmission characteristics for improving sound quality and the characteristics for eliminating interfering signals from the outside, the IF amplifier switches between wide-band and narrow-band characteristics. In addition, a sub amplifier system for the control system is provided separately.In wide-band operation, the sound quality is improved by using a linear phase four element ceramic filter. In narrow-band operation, the number of filter elements is increased to further eliminate interfering signals, and selectivity is improved.In order to improve linearity, the FM detector has wider characteristics than the conventional wide-band ratio detector. Moreover, by matching the impedance between the detector stage and the final stage in the IF section, the amplitude and phase characteristics are flattened and low distortion is achieved.We have also improved the S/N ratio by more than 10 dB compared with conventional ratio detectors by using carefully selected silicon diodes as diodes, which are a major factor in determining the S/N ratio of the detector circuit, and by paying attention to resistors and transistors that generate noise in circuits used around the detector circuit. In addition, fixed bias is applied to the diode to compensate for the rise characteristics of the silicon diode, resulting in low distortion.The MPX section uses a newly developed IC with superior distortion, separation, and S/N. In addition, the MPX beat elimination method using a unique PLL is employed to improve sound quality.This system focuses on the problem that interference signals are generated near the pilot signal in the FM detector or other circuits when there is a mismatch between the connection between the antenna and the tuner, or when reflected waves (multi-path radio waves) mixed with the desired radio waves reach the tuner. This system extracts only the components that shake the pilot signal at the output of the phase comparator in the PLL, and cancels the shake with the inverted signal. This system greatly reduces the shake caused by interference signals very close to the pilot signal.In addition, the newly developed IC incorporates a pilot canceler to reduce unwanted tone components and a 100% NFB circuit to improve distortion, thereby improving various characteristics.Equipped with an oscillator for recording level check.The level meter can be used to measure the power amplifier output level and multi-path.You can measure multipath by connecting an oscilloscope or pre-main amplifier to the multipath terminal.The high blend switch improves the S/N ratio when receiving stereo signals.

sections.overview: FM stereo tuner using digital tuning method.The front-end section uses a newly developed frequency linear type 7-row variable capacitor. High selectivity characteristics and interference rejection capability are achieved by 2-stage high-frequency (RF) amplification and triple-double tune configuration (coupled by 3-stage double-tuned circuit).In addition, to achieve both high S/N and control sensitivity of Quartz Lock APC (Automatic Phase Control), a specially selected low-noise dual-gate MOS-type FET is used, taking advantage of the multiple varicon front-end.The local oscillator has the function of continuously changing the oscillation frequency to catch a broadcasting station placed at 100 kHz intervals. The TU-1000 employs the quartz-lock-APC method, which enables accurate reception by controlling the local oscillator frequency by an integer multiple of 100 kHz obtained by dividing the frequency from a 10 MHz crystal oscillator.Equipped with a digital tuning method and digital display mechanism.The TU-1000 is equipped with a 5-digit digital counter circuit. The upper three digits of the reception frequency are displayed numerically, and the lower two digits are used for digital tuning.For example, when receiving a 82.5 MHz broadcast station, the LED indicating "Just Tuned" will light when the digital counter detects 82.495 MHz to 82.505 MHz. As a result, the difference between the tuning accuracy and the received frequency is kept within   5 kHz (within   1/16,500). This enables high-precision tuning that cannot be achieved with conventional analog tuning methods.When you release the set, the Lock LED lights up to keep the station accurately captured.In order to achieve both faithful signal transmission and interference rejection capability, the IF amplifier is separated into two systems, Wide and Narrow.In the WideBand, a specially designed LC linear phase filter is used to flatten the phase characteristics, thereby realizing a low distortion factor. In addition, the shift between the main signal part (L + R) and the sub signal part (L-R) of the composite (detection output) signal is improved to improve separation characteristics.In addition, the Narrow Band uses a newly developed linear-phase ceramic filter (composed of five filters) to achieve excellent selectivity.In order to realize the high S/N, which is the development theme of the TU-1000, we have analyzed the relationship between the differential gain and differential phase characteristics and the amount of distortion using a ratio detector that is effective in S/N, and have developed a new constant-impedance coupling type ratio detector. With this circuit, the linear region of the S-shaped curve showing the detection characteristics can be expanded by more than 1.5 times, and harmonic distortion and intermodulation distortion are greatly improved.In addition, in order to reduce the noise generated by the ratio detector, a silicon-junction diode, which is also used in the TU-850, is used in the detector to achieve high S/N.The MPX circuit is a Twain MPX circuit with two sets of a PLL circuit for pilot extraction and a switching demodulation circuit.In this circuit, the fluctuation component due to the false pilot signal appearing at the output end of each low-pass filter of the two pilot extraction circuits is canceled to only the DC component. Therefore, the demodulation switching signal does not contain any unnecessary components, and the L/R signal taken out by the switching circuit does not contain any unnecessary components. Thus, clear sound quality can be obtained. As a result, the intermodulation distortion rate is improved by more than 10 dB to 20 dB compared with the conventional model.In addition, the left and right signals obtained from the two sets of demodulation circuits are added to each other, so the SN ratio is improved by 3 dB due to the randomness of the noise generated inside the demodulation circuit.Equipped with a 3-band split separation compensation circuit, it splits into three frequency bands, low, middle and high, and improves the separation characteristics from L to R and from R to L, respectively.It is equipped with a large peak meter that can check the left and right playback sound levels from -20dB to + 5 dB.The 0 dB meter corresponds to a modulation output of 100% FM and can be used for air checking. These level meters can also be used to check the electric field strength (signal meter) or as a multipath meter to detect the presence of multipath.A reliable Hewlett-Packard LED is used for the frequency display and guide lamp.Equipped with a level variable muting function.Equipped with a 2-stage switching type high blend switch.

sections.overview: This is a full auto player with DENON's technology for compact size.A linear drive motor and bi-directional servo DENON quartz are used for the rotating system.The DENON quartz is a quartz PLL that uses a magnetic recording detection method for its speed control mechanism. In the magnetic recording detection method, 1,000 magnetic pulses are applied to the outer circumference of the turntable, where speed changes are most easily detected, and checks are carried out 555.55 times per second (at 33 1/3 revolutions). This high-precision speed detection and phase control by crystal oscillation suppress small fluctuations in rotational speed, and at the same time realize rotational accuracy of less than 0.002% rotational speed deviation.The bi-directional servo DENON quartz used in the DP-7F is designed to respond not only when the rotation is delayed but also when it is too early. It immediately stabilizes at the specified speed when polarized from 44 rpm to 33 1/3 rpm, and also provides a smooth braking effect for electronic brakes.The arm part uses an electronic contactless full auto arm controlled by a microprocessor.The arm has adopted a double-action mechanism, and the manual operation and needle tip cleaning are made easier by expanding the vertical movement range by hand.Uses an electronic needle pressure application method.Equipped with a quick repeat mechanism that enables repeated performance.T4P plug-in connector is adopted, and T4P type cartridge can be replaced.All operations are possible while the dust cover is closed.

sections.overview: This is a microcomputer operated full auto player that has introduced DENON technology in various places.A direct drive system is adopted for the turntable part.The drive motor is equipped with a newly developed linear drive MF (Magne-Float) motor. It uses the attractive force between the rotor magnet and the stator yoke to reduce the load applied to the pivot by the weight of the turntable and rotor. This structure is effective in reducing uneven rotation, prevents wear of the pivot, and maintains smooth rotation performance.The servo circuit employs a bi-directional servo DENON quartz system that combines a high-precision magnetic recording detection system and a quartz lock system. The high-precision magnetic recording detection system uses a magnetic head to detect 1,000 pulse signals recorded at an accurate pitch inside the rim, which is almost the outermost peripheral position of the turntable, and controls them while comparing them with a reference voltage. It has high detection accuracy, high-speed response, and speed detection at the outer circumference where wow flutter appears most often.In addition, both forward and reverse servos provide a severe response to slight increases and decreases in rotational speed, improving static dynamic load characteristics.The tone arm uses a straight-type arm with a lighter weight.This is to bring out the performance of the high-compliance cartridge. Even when the attached cartridge or other high-performance high-compliance type is used, the low-band cutoff frequency is set to around 12 Hz, so that the ultra-low-band noise caused by the warping of the record can be eliminated.The DP-31F is equipped with a damper structure to reduce the resonance of the arm itself, and adopts a newly developed tone arm float system to actively block the vibration of the arm.In this system, four spring plates are attached to the cabinet, and an arm is attached to this plate. The vibration modes of the cabinet, plate and arm base are different, and since the plate operates only in the vertical direction, the arm floats from the cabinet, effectively suppressing howling, etc.The cartridge is equipped with DL-60, a high compliance light weight MM cartridge.In pursuit of high musical expressive power, this cartridge uses a precise vibration system to realize the ability of flat reproduction up to 30 kHz or higher with a needle pressure of 1.8g. It also uses an elliptical needle to reduce tracing distortion in the high-frequency range.The tone arm drive system of the full-auto mechanism uses a unique contactless system to eliminate factors that cause sound quality degradation and to realize excellent operability.The DP-31F has a configuration in which the arm is operated by two precision dedicated angular control motors for horizontal operation and lifter operation. The operation of the arm is commanded by the microcomputer. Therefore, during both horizontal operation and lifter operation of the arm, the arm is in a free state as in manual machines, and the arm is not mechanically restrained even when the auto mechanism is in operation. Therefore, good arm sensitivity and usability are achieved.In addition, with the adoption of an electronic servo lifter, the arm moves up and down at a constant speed. It is not affected by the needle pressure or ambient temperature, ensuring smooth operation and minimizing impact between the needle tip and the record.The operation part adopts a front operation type with push buttons, and a quick repeat system is adopted in addition to the usual autoplay, Oatley turn and autostop.In the click-repeat method, the tone arm does not return to the arm rest during repeated performances, but returns directly to the lead part of the record, allowing for speedy operation.In addition, when the power is switched from OFF to ON with the hands down on the record, the music is played continuously as it is, making it possible to smoothly start recording for copying records to cassettes.Uses an electronic brake.It works when the tone arm starts to return to the armrest, and when it returns to the armrest, the turntable is in a stopped state.Equipped with an electronic anti-skating mechanism.With a non-contact structure that cancels the inside force by controlling the torque of the angular control motor for arm drive, an appropriate amount of cancellation can always be obtained, and sensitivity does not decrease due to mechanical friction.Uses LED to display constant speed rotation. This LED also displays power ON.It uses an integrally molded cabinet made of special hard resin.Integrated mold dust cover is adopted.Uses a low-capacity output cord.Uses a turntable sheet with excellent anti-vibration effect.

sections.overview: This is a player system that pursues ease of use by adopting a new mechanism for the direct drive player.The newly developed electronically controlled servo tone arm is used for the tone arm.By turning the position selector (location knob) on the front panel, the dedicated MC-type angular control motor set at the base of the arm is servocontrol and the arm can be moved smoothly.Moreover, since the arm is contact-free, there is no loss of sensitivity of the arm, and even if the arm is touched while moving, there is no effect.The position selector uses a 2-point contact type touch sensor switch.When you touch the knob for cue, the arm leaves the rest and moves onto the record board. When you turn the knob to position the needle tip of the cartridge, release the hand. If the lifter is pushed, the arm goes down and the turntable rotates to start playing.If you want to listen to it again during the performance, touch the knob again. The arm automatically rises and returns to the position indicated by the position selector again to start the performance.If the repeat switch is set to ON, it automatically returns from the end of the record to the beginning and starts playing without returning to the arm rest.The horizontal movement of the auto arm is performed while maintaining the optimum speed with the servocontrol. Up is performed quickly with the dedicated motor and down is performed slowly with the oil brake.The newly developed MC-type angular control motor for driving the arm consists of a fixed magnet and a movable coil directly connected to the rotating shaft of the arm. The rotating shaft is driven by the current flowing in the coil, and it is contact-free. Therefore, it does not give unnecessary load to the arm and is not affected by external magnetic field.The rotation angle of the arm is detected by the combination of the LED, CDs, and a polarizing plate placed between them. One polarizing plate is attached to the rotation axis of the arm, and the other two polarizing plates are fixed with a polarization angle of 90 degrees each. When the arm moves from the outer circumference to the inner circumference of the record, the polarizing plate rotates, the amount of light incident on the CDs changes, and the position of the arm becomes the rotation angle signal.The position selector emits a signal corresponding to an arbitrary position on the record board, and the arm moves until this signal matches the arm rotation angle signal.The speed at which the arm moves is servocontrol to a constant speed. The rotation angle detection signal of the arm is proportional to the change in the rotation angle, but the rate of change is also detected by the servo circuit and is always controlled to a constant speed.Anti-skating controls the torque of the MC type angular control motor and cancels the inside force.At the innermost circumference of the record, the arm's rapid movement is simultaneously detected by the arm position and lead-out (derived groove), and the dedicated motor for the arm lifter operates.A unique magnetic recording detection rotational speed servo system has been adopted for the turntable drive unit, taking advantage of the quartz lock system.The magnetic recording detection type speed servo detects 1,000 pulses magnetically recorded at an extremely accurate pitch inside the rim of the turntable. The detection accuracy is high and the response is fast. It is highly effective against warping and disturbance of records.The newly developed high-cost performance AC servo motor is used as the drive motor.Newly developed turntable seat is adopted.This turntable sheet was developed based on vibration analysis by laser holographic interference.

sections.overview: Full auto player with almost the same configuration as DP-52F and MM type cartridge installedAdopts a full auto mechanism.The tone arm is driven by a non-contact structure that does not affect the tone arm sensitivity or rotation system, and smooth operation is achieved by microprocessor commands.In addition, it is designed for safety. When there is no record on the turntable, the tone arm does not operate, so there is no trouble of needle tip.In addition, by the adoption of electronic servo lifter, it is not affected by temperature and needle pressure, etc., and the tone arm shows up and down movement at a constant speed, and the impact between the needle tip and the record is minimized.With the full auto function, when you press the Start button, the sensor automatically detects the size and rotation speed of the record (33 1/3 rotation for 30 cm, 45 rotation for 17 cm) and the performance starts. In the case of a record such as a 45 rotation disc for 30 cm records, you can respond by pressing the Start button and then pressing the specified rotation speed button.The tone arm is equipped with a dynamic servo tracer light mass straight arm.As a straight arm with a light mass, the fo is set at around 10 Hz to avoid the influence of the modulation noise in the ultra-low band caused by the warping of records, etc., and further to be out of the audible band.In addition, the dynamic servo tracer controls the Q to an ideal state. This is a method of controlling the current flowing in the drive coil by detecting the minute movement (horizontal and vertical) of the tone arm with the detection coil. This suppresses the force of the arm moving in the direction opposite to the needle vibration at the fo point, greatly improving the tracing capability.The appropriate needle pressure is obtained by operating the vertical axis drive coil of the dynamic servo tracer mechanism.Equipped with an electronic anti-skating mechanism, it has a non-contact structure that cancels the inside force by controlling the current flowing in the arm's horizontal drive coil, so you can always get an appropriate amount of cancellation without sensitivity loss due to mechanical friction.The motor is equipped with an AC servo motor, which is characterized by low electrical noise and no cocking.It uses a DENON quartz speed servo mechanism that combines a high-accuracy magnetic recording detection system with a quartz lock.The magnetic recording detection method employs a speed detection method at approximately the outer circumference of the turntable, which is best detected by a wow / flutter. The magnetic head detects 1000 pulse signals recorded magnetically at an accurate pitch inside the rim of the outer circumference of the turntable. This detection method detects 555.5 Hz at 33 1/3 rotation, which is higher than that of the general FG method. Therefore, it realizes a stable servo system with excellent detection accuracy and response and high gain.The magnetic recording head uses a 2-in-1 type servo mechanism that is effective in both directions. sections.overview: A record player developed by putting in all DENON player technology from broadcasting station player to DP-100M.DP-59L has an auto lift mechanism.The auto-lift mechanism uses a contact-free structure that does not affect the rotational accuracy or arm sensitivity. The end of the record is detected by a unique method combining two methods : optical position detection and velocity detection using magnetic characteristics. This protects the needle tip and record.The turntable has a diameter of 32.5 cm, a wall thickness of 7 mm and a weight of 2.2 kg.A low center of gravity AC servo motor is used as the drive motor.The shaft of this motor is given a large diameter of 10 mm and firmly supports the heavy turntable.Bi-directional servo DENON quartz is used for the servo circuit.In order to maximize the phase control of the quartz PLL circuit, the DENON quartz uses the magnetic recording detection method, which is a high-precision speed control mechanism. This method detects 1,000 magnetic pulses on the periphery of the turntable, where speed changes are most easily detected, and checks as many as 555.55 times per second (at 33 1/3 revolutions), making it the most precise mechanism for rotation control. This high-precision speed detection and phase control by crystal oscillation suppress small fluctuations in rotation speed, and at the same time, achieves rotation accuracy of 0.002% rotational speed deviation.The bi-directional servo DENON quartz incorporated in the DP-59L provides quick response not only when the rotation is delayed, but also when it is too fast. This ensures that even when the rotation is changed from 45 to 33 1/3, the speed is stabilized at the specified speed. It also provides smooth braking effects for the electronic brake.The tone arm uses a dynamic servo tracer.The ultra-low frequency noise generated by the warping and eccentricity of a record is hidden in the ultra-low frequency range with the main component of about 6 Hz or less. This ultra-low frequency noise can be prevented by setting the low-frequency resonance frequency (fo : about 10 Hz) by using a light-mass arm. However, when a high-compliance cartridge is used, the cartridge body itself swings around the low-frequency resonance frequency stimulated by the warping and eccentricity of a record, and the output becomes large.It is equipped with an electronic Q-dump mechanism to eliminate the increase in crosstalk and ultra-low frequency noise caused by this phenomenon, and the effects of record warping and eccentricity are eliminated by the Q-dump mechanism and light-mass arm.Newly developed light weight straight arm is used for the arm.This arm uses a light mass arm pipe with a diameter of approximately 1.3 times the diameter with improved precision of the fulcrum, drawing out the performance of a light needle pressure and high compliance cartridge.The lead wires of the arm pipe are made of Litz wire, which is composed of 11 twisted oxygen-free copper wires. The cross-sectional area of the arm pipe is 3 to 4 times larger than that of the conventional one, and the internal resistance is kept low.Equipped with a pitch control function.Speed can be varied up to   9.9% at 0.1% pitch.The liquid crystal display counter improves operability.A heavy wooden cabinet with a height of 11 cm has been adopted.The exterior is finished with a rose-like luster.Large arm bases, large insulators, 7 mm thick turntables, 5 mm thick turntable sheets, etc., all types of vibration are considered.Non-contact, purely electronic anti-skating mechanism is adopted.Uses an integrally molded dust cover.
