sections.overview: An armless record player developed by integrating all of DENON's player technology.The drive motor employs a 10 kg out Rocester 3-phase AC servo motor with a torque of 10kg-cm that is used for cutting machines as well as for broadcasting station players. This powerful motor has a weight of 6.5 kg and a moment of inertia of 1,260kg-cm.2To 33 1/3 revolutions in only 0.4 seconds from the start.A high S / N ratio has been achieved by the adoption of an AC3-phase drive system that eliminates the third harmonic of the rotating magnetic field, which causes vibration and reversing torque, and by the adoption of a winding system that ensures uniform magnetic flux between the rotor and stator, even if there is a gap between the rotor and stator, and by the consistent vibration resistant structure including the frame.The shaft is made of special stainless steel with a diameter of 14 mm. After heat treatment and high-precision polishing, it is wrapped.A special alloy is used for the radial bearing, and smooth rotation is obtained by lapping, and high durability is obtained by using a mirror-finished sapphire bearing for the thrust bearing that supports the entire rotating system.It is equipped with a safety mechanism to prevent troubles caused by unexpected external forces. It operates when a load of approximately 50 kg or more is applied to the turntable to prevent damage to sapphire bearings, etc.For the turntable, we have further developed the double-structured turntable used in the DP-80 and so on.Structurally, the upper and lower turntables are connected by a spring and a fluid damper, and the lower part is fixed to the motor rotor, so that the upper part where records are placed is vibrationally isolated from the motor and frame, and a high-cut filter is formed by the mass of the upper turntables and the compliance of the spring.In addition, the adverse effect of acoustic feedback caused by sound pressure transmitted directly from the speaker to the record and upper turntable is solved by the difference in vibration mode due to the difference in mass between the two turntables, the fluid damper between the two turntables, and the turntable seat with high vibration absorption effect.These measures eliminate harmful vibrations and eliminate sound coloring, as well as problems such as poor crosstalk caused by affecting the opposite channel in the heavy low-frequency portion of a record, resulting in an unclear sound image.The upper and lower turntables are integrated in the direction of rotation.The servo mechanism uses a double PLL servo system combining DENON quartz and PLL synthesizer IC.DENON quartz has developed and adopted DENON's original magnetic recording detection method that applies 1000 pulse signals. Two pulse detection heads are attached at two opposing positions. This has the effect of mutually canceling the very slight eccentricity of the magnetic pulse recording surface, making it possible to pick up a highly accurate detection signal. By comparing the phases of the obtained signal with the phases of the signal generated by the reference oscillator (crystal), a powerful two way servomechanism that can control the rotational speed more severely is realized. In addition, it is an advanced method that detects the speed at the periphery of the turntable where the wow flutter phenomenon can be detected most prominently.In the double PLL servo system, the oscillation frequency is accurately changed while maintaining the accuracy of the quartz oscillator. This frequency is used as the reference frequency for the phase comparator circuit of the motor servo system, and the pitch can be controlled in a quartz-locked state.The pitch control circuit can be combined with a digital display to set an accurate pitch from high9.9% to low9.9% with an accuracy of 0.1% pitch (half tone = 5.9%) at each specified rotation speed.This powerful servomechanism has achieved load resistance of 1.5 kg in terms of needle pressure.The frame is made of thick cast aluminum with a total weight of 13 kg and is less susceptible to the effects of floors and sound pressure.In addition, a servo circuit, various control circuits, transformers, etc. are mounted floating, and at the same time, vibration and noise are taken into consideration.A solid insulator composed of a spring and a fluid damper is used for the insulator.The low-frequency cutoff frequency is set to 3.5 kg, and vibration transmitted from the floor to the frame body is prevented. Natural vibration caused by the insulator and frame noise are also prevented by the fluid damper.The arm board adopts an arm board exchange system that enables the mounting of internal and external long type tone arms. The arm board is made of aluminum casting, and by floating the board itself, a strong anti-vibration structure is realized.The floating arm board is structurally similar to a turntable. Vibration from the frame is eliminated by a spring and a fluid damper, and disturbance energy due to acoustic feedback and vibration of the arm board are absorbed and attenuated.The replacement armboard was sold separately and made to order.

sections.overview: A record player equipped with a dynamic servo tracer as a tone arm in the mechanism of the DP-100.The DP-100M has a dynamic servo tracer in its tone arm.The low resonance frequency (fo) set by the cartridge compliance and the effective mass of the tone arm should ideally be around 10 Hz in order to avoid the effects of record warping and eccentricity. In DENON, the negative effects such as modulation distortion were reduced by making the single tone arm and the tone arm of the player system lighter. However, if the fo peak (Q) remains high, the cantilever of the arm and cartridge vibrates more than expected in records with warpage, etc., and the needle pressure changes occur and the tracing capability deteriorates, causing intermodulation distortion.In the dynamic servo tracer, the Q of fo is electronically damped to prevent deterioration of sound quality due to increase of intermodulation distortion caused by low-frequency resonance and deterioration of crosstalk.First, the vibration of the tone arm is detected as an electric signal by two detection coils (vertical and horizontal). This signal is passed through a high-pass filter with a variable cut-off frequency volume. After passing through a gain volume, the signal is applied to a power amplification drive coil to provide a signal opposite to the vibration of the tone arm, and the vibration of the arm is controlled.This effectively dampens the low-frequency resonance compared to the non-damped fo characteristic, approaching the ideal low-frequency reproduction with no peaks.Since the low resonance frequency and peak vary depending on the type of cartridge, it is equipped with a variable filter and can be used with various cartridges by adjusting the gain volume.The tone arm is equipped with a long type light weight, high rigidity straight arm.The straight pipe part is heat-cured with a special light alloy similar to the cantilever of the cartridge to achieve weight reduction and sufficient strength.The head shell adopts a three layer laminate structure, and the division vibration of the head shell part is damped by combining a viscoelastic material with moderate viscous and large internal loss between two layers of hard light alloy.The arm pipe is replaceable, and by replacing it with a universal S-shaped arm pipe, it is possible to replace cartridges attached to general head shells.Equipped with an anti-skating mechanism.The DP-100M uses the fo damping mechanism to control the current flowing in the horizontal damping control coil to obtain a canceling effect corresponding to the needle pressure without contact in order to optimally cancel the inside force which changes from the outer circumference to the inner circumference of the record every moment.The arm lifter of the tone arm is driven by a special angular control motor. The speed at the time of descent is variable type, and the signal detected by the speed detection coil for the lifter is amplified and compared with the reference voltage proportional to the set speed to servo the effective speed. In addition, the width of the needle pressure up to approximately 20g is covered for the same set speed.The lifter can be operated with the lifter Up/Dow switch. sections.overview: A record player that compactly condenses the performance of high-end machines.A direct drive system is adopted for the drive part.Quartz lock servo is used in the servo circuit, and by controlling at the interval of light pulse passing through the slit, high-precision rotation without misalignment is realized in the control system. In addition, by using a high torque motor with a torque of 4.5kg-cm for the drive motor, quick operation with a rise time of 0.3 seconds and rotational stability are realized.A large aluminum die-cast turntable with a diameter of 331 mm is used for the turntable.The entire back of this turntable is deadened with silicon rubber to improve the howling characteristics. Also, the attached turntable sheet improves the record holding characteristics by analyzing the hologram vibration and is slightly tapered like a mortar.Equipped with pin-type output terminal, the cable can be changed according to sound quality and cartridge impedance.By using die-cast parts for each part of the tone arm, the rigidity is increased, and the important parts are treated with deadning.MM type cartridge with aluminum die-cast head shell is included.The cabinet is made of MDF material to increase rigidity and improve acoustic feedback by making it compact.In addition, by adopting a large insulator in the leg part, external vibration is suppressed.

sections.overview: A record player that combines a direct drive player with a MM cartridge DL-8.A direct drive system is adopted as the drive system.Since there are no rotational transmission mechanisms such as belts and idlers, there is no wow flutter or rumble caused by them, and friction or deformation does not occur, so initial performances can be maintained for a long time.DENON has developed a highly accurate magnetic recording and playback method for broadcasting stations to detect rotational speed, which is important for direct drive systems. In this method, a pulse signal is recorded on a magnetic substance coated inside the rim of the turntable and detected by a magnetic head close to the magnetic substance to control rotational speed.As a result, excellent characteristics such as wow flutter and startup are maintained.Uses a smooth AC torque motor for the drive motor.AC motors are superior to DC motors in terms of rumble, wow and flutter because they rotate more smoothly in principle.Speed adjustment knob is equipped with Normal position (Klix/Kluk? top).In this position, the internal stable reference voltage automatically adjusts to the specified rotation speed. This is the same system as the high-grade direct turntable DP-5000F.An S-shaped needle pressure direct reading universal tone arm has been adopted for the tone arm, achieving high sensitivity and high tracking performance.In addition, due to the adoption of an anti-skating mechanism, sufficient consideration is given to needle skipping and arm flow.By attaching a special elastic body (viscoelastic body) with moderate viscosity between the tone arm and the cabinet, vibration from the cabinet is blocked.Viscoelastic bodies are also attached to both ends of the cabinet to prevent vibration of the dust cover caused by sound pressure when the dust cover is closed.By using an insulator, howling is suppressed.The cartridge uses the DL-8 MM type cartridge newly designed for the DP 790.DP-790 adopts a stopper finish cabinet and DP-790W adopts a walnut finish cabinet.

sections.overview: A record player equipped with an auto lift mechanism for ease of use without compromising the basic performance of a direct drive player.A direct drive system is adopted as the drive system.Since there are no rotational flutter mechanisms such as belts and idlers, there is no wow transmission or rumble caused by them, and there is no part that causes abrasion or deformation, so initial performances can be maintained for a long time.DENON's proprietary high-precision magnetic recording detection method is used to detect rotational speed.DENON's unique method records 1,000 high-precision pulse signals on a magnetic material coated inside the turntable rim and detects them with a magnetic head to control the rotational speed. Thus, even if load conditions such as needle pressure or arm position change, or even if external conditions such as power supply voltage, frequency fluctuation, or humidity change, rotational speed hardly changes.An AC servo motor is used as the drive motor.In principle, AC motors rotate more smoothly than DC motors, and are superior in terms of rumble and wow flutter.Equipped with an auto lift mechanism with non-contact end detection.The DP 1200 uses a contactless detection method that optically detects the sound of the record and the speed at which the tone arm moves when moving from the groove to the lead-out, so that there is no need to worry about imposing a load on the tone arm.The lift mechanism of the arm works smoothly by oil dump.After the auto lift, the power of the player is turned off and the operation lever is also linked and returns to the off position.Equipped with a standby switch, the turntable can be started / stopped, making it easy to start the beginning of a record and to adjust the needle pressure of the cartridge.Equipped with arm height adjustment mechanism.Cabinet with measures against howling is adopted.The cartridge is equipped with DL-8A, MM type cartridge.

sections.overview: The Direct Drive Player System was developed with an emphasis on operability and durability while pursuing superior basic performance.A direct drive system is adopted as the drive system.In this system, the turntable is directly connected to the motor shaft, and there is no reduction mechanism such as belt or idler, so there is little unevenness in rotation and the motor itself rotates quietly at the same speed as the turntable.DENON's proprietary high-precision magnetic recording method is used to detect the servo circuit speed.In this system, the magnetic head detects pulses that are accurately recorded on the turntable inner circumference and converts them to voltages corresponding to their frequencies. This voltage is compared with a reference voltage to control the voltage applied to the motor. Pulses are recorded with an accuracy of 1,000 pulses and 0.01% wave-length errors. This enables extremely accurate speed detection, extremely fast and sufficient servo control, and realizes excellent wow flutter characteristics.In addition, stable rotational speed can be obtained even if load conditions such as needle pressure change. In addition to temperature compensation, the servo circuit has a built-in DC stabilized power supply so that rotational speed is not affected by fluctuations in power supply frequency, voltage and temperature.The same solid rotor type AC torque motor as the DP-3000 is used for the drive motor.Compared to synchronous motors and DC motors, this motor has smooth rotation characteristics with less vibration. The voltage from the turntable is obtained by detecting pulses magnetically recorded with high precision on the inner circumference of the turntable with a magnetic head and converting them into voltages corresponding to their frequencies. There are 1000 pulses, and the pulse interval is recorded with an accuracy of 1/10000. This pulse enables extremely accurate speed detection and extremely fast and sufficient servocontrol. Wow flutter is suppressed to 0.03% or less. However, it is driven by AC with a beautifully shaped waveform, so there is almost no rumble.By adopting an accurate and quick response speed detection system and a stable servo system, the weight of the turntable has been reduced. As a result, the starting characteristic is less than 1/2 revolution, and the bearing load of the motor is light, so that stable performance can be maintained over a long period of time.Speed switching by electric switch is adopted.Fine adjustment of speed is possible, and adjustment of   3% of the specified speed is possible.The tone arm uses DA 305, a model conforming to the broadcast station specifications.Designed for safe use with light needle pressure cartridges, the DA 305 is a laterally balanced S-shape. This is a cassette deck that pursues real clarity of sound with a thorough anti-vibration structure.The DR-70G is a color variation model of the DR-70, and there is no difference other than the color of the sidewood.The mechanism section is equipped with a highly reliable rotary encoder computer-controlled silent mechanism that employs a closed-loop dual capstan system. This eliminates disturbances such as reel reel vibration between the two capstan pairs, greatly reducing modulation noise caused by tape vibration, and realizes smooth head touch and quiet operation.In the DR-70/DR-70G, the mechanical control and counter display function are controlled by a microcomputer integrated into one chip, which realizes smooth operation.The capstan drive motor uses an electronically controlled DC motor with strong torque and smooth rotation. A special rubber damper for vibration control is used to float the capstan to prevent vibration from being transmitted.The take-up capstan uses a fly-wheel with a large moment of inertia, greatly reducing wow and flutter.Equipped with a non-stop reel drive mechanism, there is no mechanical friction between the motor and the take-up reel stand, so there is no noise or aging change when the tape is taken up, and uniform constant speed running from the beginning to the end of the tape is possible.It is equipped with C. C. C. S (Ceramic Composite Cassette Stabilizer) in order to eliminate adverse effects due to micro vibration of the cassette half.This cassette stabilizer is made of a ceramic composite material. When the cassette half is attached to the cassette, it is firmly fixed by an elastic stabilizer from both sides. This reduces vibration of the half, improves tape running stability and greatly reduces modulation noise.An amorphous core PC-OCC head is used for the read / write head.This head uses an amorphous core, which is a high-permeability alloy with no crystal structure, and uses a non-crystalline oxygen-free copper (PC-OCC) for the coil wire to improve high-frequency and MOL characteristics.The head is mounted on a head block made of aluminum die cast, and it is firmly fixed without interfering with the vertical movement of the head.Equipped with Dolby HX-PRO.Since this circuit automatically reduces the bias amount from the oscillator when the input signal contains many high frequency components, the high frequency characteristics are greatly improved compared with the conventional fixed bias method while keeping the effective bias value of the middle and low frequency ranges constant.Equipped with Dolby B/C NR as a noise reduction system.In the amplifier section, both the recording amplifier section and the playback amplifier are configured as DC amplifiers to improve the quality.The playback equalizer amplifier employs an IC that integrates an L/R channel amplifier into a single chip to greatly reduce the noise level generated in the amplifier section. In addition, by connecting the playback head directly to the amplifier, the degradation of low-frequency characteristics due to the coupling capacitor is eliminated. In addition, by supplying high voltage and high stability power with   2 power supply configuration, the saturation level of the amplifier section is raised and a wide dynamic range is obtained.In order to completely eliminate unnecessary vibration, the top cover is made of steel plate that combines both sides and the top plate, and another steel plate is fixed inside with cushioning adhesive.The bottom cover has a double-layered structure with 1.6 mm thick steel plates and attached to a high-rigidity chassis to reduce the center of gravity.Equipped with a REC return key.With this function, the computer memorizes the starting position of the recording, and when the REC return key is pressed, it automatically returns to the starting position and enters the standby state.Equipped with a real-time digital counter with a tape size selector.When the camera is equipped with an auto tape monitor and the camera is turned on to the Play, Rec, or Play (Rec. sections.overview: This is a cassette deck with an emphasis on the tape running system and proper recording function, as well as usability and tape protection.It adopts a holding mechanism to improve the positioning accuracy of the cassette, and improves the floating and rattling of the cassette which tends to occur in the cassette deck.The DR 350 has a height adjusting pin and a cassette holding spring at the upper and lower positions of the tape guide roller of the cassette half. This realizes stable tape running and ideal head touch. Wow flutter, level fluctuation, and phase distortion between channels are reduced.Equipped with a self-aligning hub drive mechanism.In the case of a cassette deck, the sound becomes muddy due to eccentricity of the reel hub and joint vibration that occurs several times per reel rotation. By adopting the automatic aligning hub drive mechanism, the reel hub of the cassette tape is closely attached to the mechanism stand, and eccentricity of the reel hub is reduced.In addition, since there is no looseness between the reel base and reel hub, the tape can be wound neatly even when fast forwarding or rewinding.Using a 3-stage equalizer and a continuously variable bias adjustment method, the linearity and frequency characteristics of each tape can be optimized.It uses an upright tilting mechanism and a mechanism that tilts the cassette tape. sections.overview: This is an inclined cassette deck designed with many unique mechanisms.A newly developed ATR (Accurate Tape Running) mechanism is adopted to realize ideal tape running and head touch.This mechanism consists of a holding mechanism for fixing the cassette and a self-aligning hub shaft. The cassette is held securely by a height regulating pin and a cassette holding spring at the upper and lower positions of the tape guide roller part of the cassette half. This eliminates the floating and rattling of the cassette that often occurs with conventional cassette decks. Moreover, the right angle between the capstan shaft and the tape running direction is obtained correctly.By combining the fine adjustment mechanism of the head and pinch roller, stable tape travel and ideal head touch are realized.A cassette deck has its own longitudinal vibration several times per reel rotation. This vibration is caused by improper meshing between the cassette hub and the hub shaft of the deck. It can cause noise nigori. The DR-370 eliminates the periodic longitudinal vibration of the tape by driving the self-aligning hub and improving the accuracy of parts, thereby eliminating the noise turbidity.The ATR mechanism is mounted on a rigid frame.In addition, superior performances have been achieved by the adoption of a high-precision flat belt and an ultra-precision capstan shaft, and a high-performance hysteresis synchronous motor.Equipped with a 3-stage equalizer function and a continuously variable bias adjustment function, recording and playback utilizing the characteristics of the tape are possible.The panel layout uses a 4-1 button system with the minimum number of buttons in one place.The 4-1-button system has a layout with left and right recording and playback buttons, center fast-forward and rewind buttons, and upper bar-type stop buttons. This improves usability and reduces operational errors.Equipped with a one touch eject system, the cassette can be ejected with one touch from any mode without a stop button. When the eject button is pressed, the mechanism automatically stops, the cassette cover opens and the tape is ejected by an oil dump mechanism.The cassette tape is tilted 12 degrees from the vertical so that the entire surface of the cassette tape can be seen easily and the performance is improved by the self-weight effect. In addition, the tape is easily seen by using a large semi-transparent acrylic cover so that you can write notes on the cassette label even during recording or playback.Equipped with a full-scale peak meter.This meter uses a backlight type, and letters and symbols are easy to read.The Dolby System is installed as a noise reduction system.The DR-370 uses an integrated circuit to improve reliability.Equipped with timer recording mechanism.Equipped with a memory rewind mechanism.It is equipped with a mechanical pause mechanism that is ideal for cutting CM and unnecessary announcements during recording.

sections.overview: This is a cassette deck with some functions omitted from DR-F3 and DR-F2.The mechanism uses a new 3-head mechanism with improved tape running accuracy and head touch.This mechanism is equipped with a newly developed tension servo sensor to obtain good running performance. In this tension servo sensor, a sensor set between the recording / playback combination head and the erasing head constantly detects the back tension of the tape between the two heads. Minute fluctuations are amplified through the sensor arm and servo bracket, and the pressure force between the erasing head and the erasing head and the pressure post on the opposite side is controlled by the sensor arm and servo bracket. This servo system has an extremely short servo loop and applies direct servo to the tape itself. Therefore, it has an extremely high response and forms a stable tape running system that does not put excessive force on the tape. This eliminates the influence of the tape supply reel in the cassette half, the left side guide roller, and the left side first tape guide, and constantly adjusts the remaining amount of the tape and the tape tension converted by the cassette half.The basic mechanism of tape travel employs a two motor drive mechanism that completely separates the capstan drive and reel drive mechanisms. The mechanism is driven by an IC logic circuit and two plungers.A DC servo motor is exclusively used for the capstan motor. Since there is no external load between the capstan and the high-precision flywheel, rotational accuracy is further improved, and excellent characteristics, stability, reliability and durability are obtained.In addition, by using two plungers, the movement mechanisms of the pinch roller and the head are made independent. When the recording pause state is set, only the head part touches the tape, and when the recording state is set by pressing the PLAY button, only the pinch roller moves. This head plate mechanism prevents erasure during recording, does not give magnetic flux change to the tape while the head is moving, and also prevents unpleasant noise.A non-slip reel drive mechanism drive mechanism that takes advantage of the relationship between the rotational speed and torque of the reel motor, eliminating the general mechanical slip mechanism (using friction between felt and metal, etc.) that is installed between the motor and the take-up reel stand in a general cassette deck.In this mechanism, the voltage of the reel motor is reduced to about 1/5 of the speed when it is fast-forwarded or rewound, and the rotation speed is reduced to about 1/20 to transmit the rotation of the motor to the reel table. Originally, DC motors have characteristics that when the load increases, the rotational speed decreases and the torque increases, and when the load decreases, the opposite phenomenon occurs. This characteristic is used to equalize the winding tape tension and eliminate the slip reduction mechanism.This eliminates the instability of take-up due to changes in environmental conditions such as temperature and humidity, and improves the durability of the mechanism.The head section uses a 3-head system consisting of a read / write combination head and an erase head.An F-ALLOY combination head is used for the recording / reproducing head.The recording head has a wide gap to maximize the MOL of each tape. The reproducing head has a narrow gap width of approximately 1/5 of the recording gap to obtain a flat frequency characteristic up to high frequencies. In addition, F-ALLOY, which has excellent characteristics of high magnetic flux density, high magnetic permeability, and high wear resistance, achieves high sensitivity and low distortion.In order to eliminate the coil winding method and core shape are carefully examined in order to eliminate the influence between both recording and playback heads. A shield mask is inserted between both heads to strictly suppress the magnetic field (cross feed) from the recording head to the reproducing head to -78dB.In addition, by adopting a special core shape, good head touch is obtained, drop-out is reduced and contour effect is suppressed.A double-gap erase head with an E-shaped core is used for the erase head.The core of this erasing head is made of a special ferrite material with high saturation magnetic flux density to enhance the erasing effect.The amplifier section uses an all-DC configuration amplifier with independent recording and playback.In this amplifier, the condenser between the head and the first stage amplifier is removed to eliminate the deterioration of sound quality in the signal transmission system. In addition, all of the microphone amplifier, recording amplifier, equalizer amplifier, playback amplifier, headphone amplifier, and meter amplifier are composed of DC amplifier units, and   2 power supply system is used to drive them. Together with the low-noise differential input push-pull circuit, this amplifier increases the dynamic range and prevents clipping distortion in the signal transmission system.The bias oscillation circuit adopts a push-pull configuration to improve bias waveform distortion.The Dolby System is installed as a noise reduction system.Equipped with a 20 to + 6 dB wide scale VU meter.It also features three LeD peak level indicators : red (+ 8 dB), yellow (+ 5 dB), and green (0 dB).Equipped with a 4-stage tape selector with a bias and equalizer linked together.It is equipped with an output level control function that can also adjust the volume of headphones.Equipped with an auto-cue review mechanism that finds out between songs of more than 4 seconds and automatically enters the play state from that position.Equipped with one touch rec-pause function.The Rec Mute and Pause buttons are grouped together.During recording, if you keep pressing the button, it becomes REC MUTE ; if you release it, it becomes PAUSE ; and if you press the PLAY button again, it becomes recording.When there is no signal, the PAUSE/MUTE LED lights up at approximately one second intervals.It uses a one touch eject mechanism, and regardless of the operation state of the mechanism, the mechanism automatically stops, releases each operation and ejects.Equipped with timer recording and playback mechanism.Remote control terminal is mounted on the front, and operation from a remote place is possible by using an optional remote control unit.

sections.title: DENON-COLUMBIA DENON
sections.overview: Cassette deck without FTS function from DR-F7.We have adopted a flat twin DD motor for the capstan drive motor.This motor is a flat-faced DD motor. The flywheel itself serves as a rotor, and DENON's unique symmetrical arrangement of stator coils is adopted. This system consists of a pair of stator coils facing each other, another pair of stator coils electrically offset by 90 degrees, and a Hall element that controls the current of the coils. This system solves the torque characteristics required to obtain good head touch in a 3-head machine and the problem of capstan vibration (center shake). In addition, there are no brushes, slots, or cores that affect rotational accuracy or noise problems, and only the motor bearing is mechanically worn. This improves the durability of the motor itself.A unique non-slip reel drive system is adopted.By utilizing the characteristics of the relationship between the rotational speed and torque of the reel motor, this method keeps the winding torque constant at all times, eliminating the problem of tape winding. This eliminates the mechanical slip mechanism (using friction between felt and metals) between the motor and the take-up reel stand, eliminating the fluctuation of the winding force due to changes in environmental conditions such as temperature and moisture, eliminating the drop-out caused by uneven winding, and the deterioration of wow flutter and phase characteristics.Equipped with the Tension Servo Sensor II, which is an improved version of the Tension Servo Sensor, a unique servo mechanism. By expanding the servo area, the Tension Servo Sensor II achieves sufficient follow-up performance against large and sudden fluctuations in tape tension.This servomechanism has an extremely short servo loop and directly applies servo to the tape itself, so it has a high response and does not put too much stress on the tape. This eliminates the influence of the structure of the cassette half, stabilizes the back tension that changes depending on the remaining amount of tape, and achieves good head touch.An M & X combination head is used for the recording / reproducing head.The recording head is designed to maximize the MOL of each tape. The reproducing head is designed to have a narrow gap of approximately 1/5 of the recording gap in order to obtain a flat frequency characteristic up to the high-frequency range. In addition to minimizing the azimuth deviation of the A/B plane of the tape by precise assembly technology, the magnetic field (cross feed) from the recording head to the reproducing head is also completely suppressed.The erasing head uses a double-gap ferrite head with an E-shaped core that is compatible with the high retention force and high residual magnetic flux density of metal tapes.In the amplifier section, the condenser between the head and the first stage amplifier is eliminated, and all DC amplifiers are used up to the last stage.With particular emphasis on clipping distortion in transmission systems, the equalizer amplifier uses a low-noise differential input push-pull circuit and a   2 high-voltage power supply to expand the dynamic range.The bias circuit has a push-pull configuration to improve the bias waveform distortion and at the same time obtain sufficient erase current.Equipped with Dolby B Type and Dolby C Type as noise reduction system.In addition, by adopting the double Dolby system, it is possible to confirm the Dolby effect when monitoring simultaneous playback.Equipped with MPX filter switch to prevent malfunction of Dolby system.Feather touch control by IC circuit is adopted for the operation system of the tape running.Timing control is also considered in this circuit to prevent overstretching of the tape.It is equipped with the output level control which can adjust the volume of the headphone.Equipped with a one touch rec pause function, recording standby can be set just by pressing the REC button.The Rec Mute and Pause buttons are combined into one to improve operability.Equipped with one touch eject function, the mechanism is released and ejected just by pressing the eject button even if the mechanism is in operation state.Equipped with a timer recording / playback mechanism capable of intermittent recording.Wired Remote Controller RC-57 sold separately can be used.

This improves the durability of the motor itself.The DR-F8 uses a PLL (Phase Locked Loop) in the motor servo circuit to further improve rotation accuracy and control the change of rotation (temperature drift) in response to temperature change in a severe manner to enhance the completeness.A unique non-slip reel drive system is adopted.By utilizing the characteristics of the relationship between the rotational speed and torque of the reel motor, this method keeps the winding torque constant at all times, eliminating the problem of tape winding. This eliminates the mechanical slip mechanism (using friction between felt and metals) between the motor and the take-up reel stand, eliminating the fluctuation of the winding force due to changes in environmental conditions such as temperature and moisture, eliminating the drop-out caused by uneven winding, and the deterioration of wow flutter and phase characteristics.Equipped with the Tension Servo Sensor II, which is an improved version of the Tension Servo Sensor, a unique servo mechanism. By expanding the servo area, the Tension Servo Sensor II achieves sufficient follow-up performance against large and sudden fluctuations in tape tension.This servomechanism has an extremely short servo loop and directly applies servo to the tape itself, so it has a high response and does not put too much stress on the tape. This eliminates the influence of the structure of the cassette half, stabilizes the back tension that changes depending on the remaining amount of tape, and achieves good head touch.An M & X combination head is used for the recording / reproducing head.The recording head is designed to maximize the MOL of each tape. In addition to minimizing the azimuth deviation of the A/B plane of the tape by precise assembly technology, the magnetic field (cross feed) from the recording head to the reproducing head is also completely suppressed.The erasing head uses a double-gap ferrite head with an E-shaped core that is compatible with the high retention force and high residual magnetic flux density of metal tapes.In the amplifier section, the condenser between the head and the first stage amplifier is eliminated, and all DC amplifiers are used up to the last stage.With particular emphasis on clipping distortion in transmission systems, the equalizer amplifier uses a low-noise differential input push-pull circuit and a   2 high-voltage power supply system to expand the dynamic range. By simplifying the mechanism, durability is greatly improved. In addition, since there is no misalignment of the head position (alignment) caused by wear of the mechanism, initial performance can be maintained for a long period of time.The recording and playback head uses a hard permalloy head with high magnetic flux density and high abrasion resistance. Furthermore, the laminated type improves the high-frequency performance and enables recording with less distortion.The two erasing heads, one for forward and the other for reverse, have a double-gap structure to achieve a strong erasing effect even for metal tapes.In order to match the characteristics of each track of the head, the playback amplifier section uses four playback equalizer amplifiers that are specially tuned for each track. In particular, the first stage of in the first stage to prevent degradation of the quality of the music program.A transistor-based electronic switch is used to select the four playback equalizer amplifiers and to switch between the recording amplifiers, providing durability not found in switches with mechanical structures.The mechanism part is designed to be symmetrical, and the tape drive in both directions is made identical.In this mechanism, the DC servo motor for the capstan always rotates two flywheels and capstan rotating in opposite directions to each other. The capstan for running the tape at a constant speed is designed so that one of the capstan always rotates without contact with the pinch roller. This, combined with the fixed head system, shortens the rise time until the tape is reversed and moves to constant speed, enabling quick reverse of approximately 0.16 seconds.Silence is suppressed to less than 0.4 seconds when reversing the tape.The tape reversal position is detected by an infrared tape sensor set opposite the forward erasing head. sections.overview: A cassette deck developed as the highest quality model of the M series.The mechanism uses a two capstan system, in which two sets of capstan are installed around the head, and the rotational speed of each of the two sets of capstan is slightly changed to achieve appropriate tape tension near the head and stable tape travel.In addition, both capstans and pinch rollers cut off tape vibrations caused by the movement of the hub in the cassette half and the sliding of the tape with the slip sheet before they affect the head surface, thus achieving clear sound quality with less modulation noise.The capstan drive motor uses a direct-drive motor with a flat-faced design to obtain strong rotational torque and eliminate uneven torque. In addition, since it is brushless, it generates no electrical noise and improves durability.In addition, the wow flutter has been improved by directly driving the capstan and directly servoing it in combination with the speed detection mechanism attached to the flywheel surface. This servo circuit also employs an all-round integrated sample-and-hold type FG servo, providing high gain and extremely high stability.The DR-M4 uses a quartz lock system to control the rotational speed, and the phase control circuit using an accurate and stable crystal oscillator makes the FG servo operation more reliable.A silent mechanism has been adopted for the running system.In this mechanism, a motor-cam drive is adopted without using a large mechanical noise such as a plunger. In addition, a microcomputer is placed between an optical detection counter, a unique position detection encoder, and a mechanical control motor (for cam drive), and a computer controls searching for tape points and checking the drive mode.Non-slip reel drive system has been adopted to achieve uniform winding tension.This system takes advantage of the characteristics of the relationship between the rotational speed and torque of the reel motor. It eliminates changes in the take-up force due to changes in temperature and moisture, which are problems with general mechanical slip mechanisms, and improves the drop-out, wow flutter, phase characteristics, etc., as well as the durability of the mechanism.Uses SF (Super Frequency) combination head for recording and reproducing head.Super Permalloy with high saturation magnetic flux density is used for the core of the recording head, and it is compatible with high-level recording tapes such as metal tapes. Moreover, by using Sendust for the dummy core, abrasion resistance is greatly improved.In addition, a high-density ferrite core with low high-frequency loss and excellent abrasion resistance was adopted for the reproducing head for the first time as a combination head. Moreover, by reducing the size of magnetic particles to less than 1/2 of the conventional size, fluctuation of magnetic characteristics due to sliding noise and temperature change, which cause modulation noise, is improved.The SF head is a combination of these heads. In particular, the recording gap and the playback gap, which are indispensable for maintaining high frequency and phase characteristics, are kept within 1/20 degree of parallel deviation, and wide and flat frequency characteristics are obtained. In addition, oxygen-free copper wire is used for the coil to improve sound quality.The power supply circuit completely separates the amplifier circuit from the logic circuit to eliminate mutual interference. The amplifier circuit uses an independent power supply system called an independent power supply to stabilize the circuit.A low-noise differential input push-pull DC amplifier circuit is used for both the recording amplifier and the playback amplifier. sections.overview: This is a cassette deck that uses the highly reliable mechanism originally developed by Denon and Dolby HX Pro.The mechanism uses a highly reliable rotary encoder 2-motor + 1-motor computer-controlled silent mechanism. This mechanism uses a newly developed microcomputer for driving the mechanism that integrates the mechanical drive and counter display control into a single chip, and realizes smooth and silent operation.The basic structure consists of a DC-servo motor for the capstan and a high-torque, low-ripple DC-motor for the reel motor. The capstan and high-precision zinc-die-cast flywheel have been specially treated to increase the friction coefficient. By reducing torque fluctuation (cocking) and running loss, the wow flutter and other basic features are enhanced.The recording / reproducing head uses SF Hyperbolic Hard Permalloy R/P head.This head reduces the contour effect at low frequencies by making the core part that touches the tape a hyperboloid shape.The amplifier section uses a newly developed DC amplifier LSI for the cassette deck. This LSI consists of a left and right channel playback amplifier and a recording amplifier on a single chip. This LSI eliminates differences in L/R characteristics and sound quality, while reducing noise and power consumption.The playback equalizer amplifier has a much higher open gain in the high-frequency band than the conventional operational amplifier and realizes low distortion over the entire frequency band. The amplifier also has a high S/N and a wide dynamic range by greatly reducing the noise level generated in the amplifier. In addition, the quality is enhanced by the DC configuration without the input coupling capacitor.The C. C. D. C. (Constant Current Drive Circuit) is used in the recording amplifier section to eliminate output resistance, and there is no phase shift even in response to the impedance change of the head due to the recording frequency, realizing a wide dynamic range and low distortion factor.In addition, direct coupling between the head and the recording amplifier eliminates sound quality degradation during recording.The power supply is composed of   2 power supplies.Equipped with Dolby HX Pro.The Dolby HX Pro eliminates over-bias, which has been a problem with the conventional fixed bias method. When the input signal contains many high-frequency components during recording, the bias amount from the oscillator is automatically reduced. This greatly improves high-frequency characteristics and reduces distortion over the entire band. In addition, since the effective bias value is always constant even when the impedance of the head changes due to temperature changes or other factors, there is no degradation in high-frequency characteristics even during long-term recording.Equipped with Dolby B Type and Dolby C Type as noise reduction system.The Dolby circuit uses a newly developed symmetrical one chip LSI for left and right channels.The Bias Fine control allows you to fine-tune the recording bias amount.The display is equipped with a 4-digit digital counter with a memory stop function, a bar graph peak meter of + 8 dB to -20dB, and various indicators such as operation status, tape position and memory stop.Equipped with a memory stop function.Equipped with an auto tape selector, it automatically identifies each tape when it is set and automatically sets the bias / equalizer.Equipped with an MPX filter switch, it can prevent Dolby NR malfunction by cutting the 19 kHz pilot signal included in FM radio waves.It uses a Pause/Mute mechanism to combine the pause and mute functions.In recording mode, press the Pause/Mute button (within 0.5 seconds) to create a recording pause. Press and hold the button for 1 second or longer to create a 5-second unrecorded portion and make a recording pause.A one touch rec-pause mechanism is adopted, and recording standby can be performed only by pressing the Rec button.Equipped with a balanced volume.Equipped with a Timer Play-Rec mechanism. sections.overview: This stereo cassette deck has been designed to further improve sound quality by using an anti-vibration structure.The top cover has a double-layered structure with another sheet of steel attached to the inside of the top plate. The bottom plate uses a bi-breath bottom plate composed of three layers of steel plate and plastic film. This plate has an extremely high vibration absorption effect and is also used in Denon CD players.In addition, the capstan motor is mounted on a 1.6 mm thick mechanical base with low repulsion rubber for a floating structure, and a large sintered alloy insulator with excellent vibration absorption effect is used for the leg part.The tape travel mechanism employs a closed-loop dual capstan system using Denon's exclusive drive belt system. This system eliminates disturbance caused by minute vibration of the reel and various factors between the two capstan pairs, greatly reducing modulation noise and ensuring excellent head touch at all times.The capstan motor uses an electronically controlled DC-motor with strong torque and no torque fluctuation, and a flywheel with a large moment of inertia on the take-up side to achieve excellent wow and flutter characteristics.A computer-controlled silent mechanism using a highly reliable rotary encoder has been adopted for the running system.This system consists of optical rotation detection, a unique rotor encoder for position detection, and a motor for mechanical control (cam drive). All of these are controlled by a microcomputer, so that tape position detection and drive mode confirmation can be done quickly and accurately.In addition, in order to ensure the total quality of tape travel, a DC motor and a non-slip reel drive mechanism are adopted for the take-up mechanism, making it possible to obtain the optimum tape tension at all times. In addition, since there is no mechanical friction between the half and the take-up reel stand, there is no noise when the tape is taken up, and tape travel is not adversely affected. Moreover, since there is no friction point, the durability of the mechanism is improved.Equipped with a mechanism to prevent the cassette tape from loosening.An SF combination head is used for the recording / reproducing head.The recording head uses a super-permalloy core with a high saturation flux density to maximize the MOL of the tape and improve abrasion resistance. The reproducing head uses a fine-grained ferrite core with excellent high-frequency characteristics and abrasion resistance to reduce fluctuations in magnetic characteristics due to sliding noise and temperature changes. The coil uses an oxygen-free copper wire (OFC) to reduce distortion.By combining these heads with high precision, we have greatly improved the misalignment of the azimuth between the recording and reproducing heads and the head mount adjustment.The erasing head uses a double-gap ferrite head with a high erasing effect.The power transformer is located as far away from the head as possible to prevent the influence of noise and is mounted on the chassis via a plate to eliminate the influence of vibration. The secondary side of the transformer completely separates the amplifier circuit and logic / mechanical circuit to eliminate the influence of noise.The recording amplifier uses a single-chip LSI developed specifically for the deck to ensure the same characteristics for the left and right channels and high stability. In addition, the recording amplifier uses a C. C. D. C. (Constant Current Drive Circuit) to eliminate the change in the head current due to the change in recording frequency by eliminating the output resistance, thereby increasing the dynamic range and realizing a low distortion factor.A low-noise IC is used for the playback amplifier to improve the S/N ratio.Each of the recording and playback amplifiers is directly connected to the head, eliminating the coupling capacitor that can degrade sound quality.Equipped with Dolby HX Pro.The Dolby HX Pro eliminates over-bias, which has been a problem with the conventional fixed bias method. When the input signal contains many high-frequency components during recording, the bias amount from the oscillator is automatically reduced. This greatly improves high-frequency characteristics and reduces distortion over the entire band. In addition, since the effective bias value is always constant even when the impedance of the head changes due to temperature changes or other factors, there is no degradation in high-frequency characteristics even during long-term recording.Equipped with Dolby B Type and Dolby C Type as noise reduction system.The Dolby circuit uses a newly developed symmetrical one chip LSI for the left and right channels. In addition, the DR-M27HX has a double Dolby configuration in which the Dolby IC is separated into a recording circuit and a reproducing circuit, so that the Dolby effect can be confirmed even during after-monitoring (simultaneous playback).Equipped with a REC calibration control function, the recording sensitivity of various types of tapes can be adjusted by adjusting the tape and source levels using the recording calibration signal of the FM tuner or the single-tone signal of the test record.Bias Fine also allows you to fine-tune the amount of recording bias.The display is equipped with a 4-digit digital counter with a memory stop function, a bar graph peak meter of + 8 dB to -20dB, and various indicators such as operation status, tape position and memory stop.Equipped with a memory stop function.Equipped with an auto tape selector, it automatically identifies each tape when it is set and automatically sets the bias / equalizer.Equipped with an MPX filter switch, it can prevent Dolby NR malfunction by cutting the 19 kHz pilot signal included in FM radio waves.It uses a Pause/Mute mechanism to combine the pause and mute functions.In recording mode, press the Pause/Mute button (within 0.5 seconds) to create a recording pause. Press and hold the button for 1 second or longer to create a 5-second unrecorded portion and make a recording pause.A one touch rec-pause mechanism is adopted, and recording standby can be performed only by pressing the Rec button.Equipped with a follow-up recording function, you can move from the running state of the tape during playback to the recording state as it is.Equipped with a balanced volume.Equipped with a Timer Play-Rec mechanism. By connecting a timer sold separately, it is possible to record your absence or play an alarm.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.title: DENON-COLUMBIA DENON
sections.overview: Cassette deck with horizontal loading mechanism.A tray type horizontal loading mechanism is adopted.By mounting the deck mechanism horizontally, vibration in the thrust direction of the flywheel is suppressed and modulation noise is reduced. In addition to the use of ceramic composite for the cassette tray, a 4-motor configuration with motors for the reel, capstan, head lifting / lowering, and loading realizes stable tape travel and smooth operation without rotational unevenness by using a 4-motor configuration.The mechanism section employs a computer-controlled silent mechanism using a closed-loop dual capstan system.In the closed-loop dual capstan system, disturbance such as vibration of the reel is cut off between two sets of capstan, and modulation noise caused by vibration of the tape is greatly reduced, and smooth head touch and quiet driving force are always obtained.In the silent mechanism, the mechanism control and counter display function are controlled by a microcomputer integrated into one chip, and smooth operation is achieved. Even if the power is turned off during recording or playback, the pinch roller returns to the STOP position to prevent damage to the tape. In addition, the pinch roller rises very quickly after pressing the REC button, and it is strong in recording timing.The capstan motor uses an electronically controlled DC-motor with strong torque and no rotational irregularities, while the take-up capstan uses a fly-wheel with a large moment of inertia, greatly reducing wow and flutter.Equipped with a non-slip reel drive mechanism to always maintain the optimum tension of the tape.In addition, since there is no mechanical friction between the motor and the take-up reel stand, there is no noise or aging change when the tape is taken up, and uniform constant speed running from the beginning to the end of the tape is possible.A cassette stabilizer (C. C. C. S) made of ceramic composite and a cassette tray (C. C. C. T) are used in order to reduce vibration and modulation noise of the cassette half during tape travel. This ensures stable tape travel.A combination head using single-crystal oxygen-free copper (PC-OCC) wire with less signal degradation has been adopted for the read / write head to improve high-frequency characteristics and MOL characteristics.In addition, the head base is made of aluminum die-cast, and by fixing it firmly without interfering with the movement of the head, unnecessary vibration and aberration of azimuth are suppressed.A DC amplifier configuration is used for the playback / recording amplifier section.The L/R channel amplifier is integrated into a single chip IC for the playback equalizer amplifier to greatly reduce the noise level generated in the amplifier section. In addition, by connecting the playback head and the amplifier directly and eliminating the coupling capacitor, the degradation of low-frequency characteristics is eliminated.The power supply section is composed of   2 power supplies to increase the saturation level of the amplifier section and obtain a wide dynamic range.Equipped with Dolby HX Pro.This function automatically adjusts the bias level to the optimum value to prevent over-bias in the high frequency range.Equipped with a Dolby B/C type noise reduction system.Equipped with an auto tape selector, it automatically detects the set tape position and sets it according to type I (normal), II (high position) and IV (metal).Equipped with an auto tape monitor.This function automatically monitors the recorded sound when it is set to Play or RecPlay (Rec Mute). It switches to Source when the tape is not running.Equipped with Rec Return function.The recording start position is memorized by the computer, and when the Rec return key is pressed, it automatically returns to the original start position and enters the standby state.Equipped with an FL peak level meter that can display from -40dB to + 10 dB.This meter is equipped with a peak hold function.Equipped with a manual bias control function, the bias fine volume allows you to fine-tune the optimum recording bias value for each tape, which may vary slightly.Equipped with a linear time digital counter that can display the remaining amount of tape.This counter is equipped with a tape size selector and memory stop mechanism.Equipped with Music Search.Equipped with a slack prevention mechanism.Equipped with a follow-up recording function.Equipped with an auto recording space function, you can make a 4-second space between songs.It is equipped with an MPX filter switch to prevent malfunction of the Dolby system by cutting off the 19 khz pilot signal of the FM signal. The filter is automatically disabled when Dolby B/C Noise Reduction is not used.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.title: DUAL 1229
sections.overview:
Price unknown (cabinet sold separately, around the early 1970 s?)

A turntable incorporating manual / automatic functions and operability into the design criteria of a professional-grade turntable.The 1229 offers four playback modes : a manual turntable, a single-play turntable that automatically plays a single record, a multi-play turntable that automatically plays six consecutive records, and repeat play.In manual play, the tone arm returns automatically and the turntable stops rotating when the play is finished. In single play, it starts with one action of the start switch. When it stops, it returns automatically and the turntable stops as in manual play.In automatic multi-play, a single play spindle is replaced with a multi-play spindle, and six records are set on top of each other. After that, if you press the start switch, all of them operate automatically. After six consecutive playing is finished, it returns automatically and the turntable stops rotating.Repeat Play is a mode that uses a multi-play spindle and 45-turn donut adapter to play the same record repeatedly.The spindle for single play is designed to rotate together with the turntable, and there is no uneven rotation caused by frictional resistance between the center hole of the record and the spindle.We have adopted die-cast turntables.There is a 50/60Hz strobe on the back of the turntable, which can be monitored with a strobe mirror on the panel. By rotating the ring, you can adjust the angle for easy viewing, and you can easily switch between 50 Hz and 60 Hz.The pitch control adjusts the speed by   6%.A newly designed synchronous continuous pole motor is used as the drive motor.The tone arm is made of a light metal pipe with an effective length of 222 mm. This was the longest design for an auto turntable type player at that time. The tracking error is 1   30 "for a record diameter of 110 to 293 mm. The resonance is between 8 and 14 Hz, below the audible frequency, and is designed to be higher than the lowest resonance frequency of the 1229 chassis suspension of 4.8 Hz when the cartridge is installed.The support is a gyro-gimbal type support structure that Dual adopted for the first time as an auto turntable type player. This system uses high-precision miniature bearings for the support points of two inner and outer rings. By improving the sensitivity of the tone arm, it is also compatible with four channel record playback of a discrete method.The anti-skating mechanism corresponds to the needle pressure and the type of needle tip. It is a dial system with red letters as elliptical needles and white letters as conical needles.The needle pressure can be adjusted by turning the dial. The error of the direct reading value is within   0.1g. When the needle pressure of 3g to 5g is applied, it can be adjusted by rotating the counterweight. One rotation can adjust the needle pressure by 0.5g.1229 is used with a needle pressure of 0.25g or more.The counterweight part has a weight and a shaft pre-assembled, and the weight is dumped to the shaft via a rubber shock absorber to absorb resonance and shock of the arm.In addition, when adjusting the 0 balance, this counterweight can be approximately balanced at the front and rear of the whole including the shaft, and by further rotating the counterweight it can be accurately balanced.Equipped with a mode selector, an accurate vertical angle can be obtained.With auto-turntable, the vertical angle differs between single-play and multi-play. With 1229, you can obtain an accurate vertical angle by changing the height of the supporting point of the tone arm with the mode selector. With multi-play, it becomes 15 degrees when playing the third record.This mode selector also has a safety lock function and is designed so that when the multi-play spindle is installed, the automatic mechanism does not operate unless it is in the multi-play position.The head shell is die-cast and the cartridge holder conforms to the EIA standard and is compatible with most commercially available cartridges.The cartridge holder can be easily attached and detached by moving the finger of the head back and forth.It is equipped with queue control (arm elevation mechanism) using Viscos dump cylinder.There were 3 types of player cabinet as an option sold separately.The CK-20/CH-20 is an original player case made by Dual. The front side of the base can be opened and closed, and spare shells, 45 adapters, multi-spindles, etc. can be stored. In addition, the acrylic cover can be fully opened on the upper side, and the front half can be opened and closed with a special acrylic hinge. In addition, the special hinge is detachable so that it can be used with the cover on during multi-play.DB-31/DCOV-3 is a case made in Japan similar to the original. The front of the base can be opened and closed, and spare shells and multi-spindles can be stored inside. In addition, the acrylic cover can be detached with a special hinge, and it can be played with the cover in multi-play.DB-3/DCOV-3 is a standard type case and has the same dimensions and finish as DB-31, but the storage spacer is omitted.

sections.overview: Semi-automatic belt drive player equipped with technologies such as ULM tone arm and floating structure.A belt drive system using 16-pole synchronous motor is adopted for the turntable part.ULM (Ultra Light Mass) type tone arm is mounted on the tone arm part.This arm has inherited the technology of a high-grade machine with a 4-point support gyro structure in the vertical, horizontal and vertical directions, and has succeeded in weight reduction by further simplifying the structure.A dynamic balance type with spring tension is adopted for the needle pressure system, and the arm pipe and the balance weight are separated to prevent the coloring of sound caused by the resonance of the arm.The cabinet structure consists of a tone arm, motor, and turntable mounted on a single rigid board, which is floated from the cabinet by means of a special spring that enhances vibration isolation.With this structure, the mutual relationship between the turntable and the tone arm is kept uniform even when a large shock is applied, preventing howling and needle skipping.Semi-automatic system is adopted for the operation part, and when record play is finished, the arm lifts up and the motor stops.Moreover, when the turntable is stopped, the arm remains lifted up, so that even people who are not familiar with the operation do not have to worry about damaging the needle tip.Pitch control of 12% is possible.

sections.title: DUAL CS-621
sections.overview: A direct drive player with a dual traditional straight arm.The drive motor is different from CS-721.The tone arm uses a straight arm in which the head shell and arm are integrated. The integrated structure eliminates resonance at the joint part of the universal head shell. In addition, the cartridge can be replaced simply by sliding the finger arm of the shell to the side, so that no excessive power is applied to the fulcrum.In addition, the straight arm reduces the effective mass, and aluminum is used for the tone arm and special polymer material is used for the head shell to reduce the weight.Counter weight with resonance filter is adopted.This counterweight consists of two mechanical resonance filters. This is a bulb-type monaural power amplifier that employs a basic and superior circuit that has been simplified as much as possible.The Mark-VI has been released as a finished product and a kit.The circuit employs a parallel push-pull circuit using highly reliable tube 8417 with uniform characteristics.The signal amplified in the pentode section of the composite vacuum tube 7199 is directly connected to the triode section and inverted in phase to provide an accurately balanced drive voltage to the output tube 8417.The output transformer employs a multi-layer balanced divided sandwich winding in a super-large core, resulting in an output transformer with high balance, small distribution capacity between windings, and excellent characteristics.The transformer and tube are connected by an ultra-linear connection. An intermediate tap is provided in the primary winding of the transformer and the screen grid of the tube is connected to the tap. High power stereo power amplifier with large power transformer.There were two types, the Stereo 400 ma with an output meter and the Stereo 400 without a meter.The circuit configuration consists of emitter-follower circuit for impedance matching, OCL complete complimentary service circuit for all stages of differential-amplified main section, and protection circuit for protecting speakers and amplifiers.In addition, an element with excellent bare characteristics is used for the driver stage, and the output stage is operated as class A at low output and class AB at high output to eliminate notch distortion at low output.2500cm2By using a large heat sink, the temperature rise of the output-transistor is prevented. In addition, a Dynabias circuit using ICs is installed to compensate for temperature rise.The speaker protection circuit consists of three stages : a dynaguard circuit, which is a type of power limiter, a speaker protection fuse, and a pure electronic DC detection circuit, in which when DC voltage is detected at the output, a relay operates to disconnect the speaker from the amplifier.The Dynaguard circuit is a variable dynamic power limiter that protects the speaker and allows you to select 20, 40, 80, 120W or off (maximum output) depending on the speaker's allowable input.The amplifier protection circuit uses a voltage / current detection protection circuit for the output transistor, a thermal sensor to protect the transistor from abnormal heat generation, a circuit breaker installed on the AC power line, and a protective fuse for the DC power line.The output meter mounted on the Stereo 400 ma has an excellent instantaneous response meter directly connected to the output, and the 4-step sensitivity selector switch enables accurate reading.

sections.title: DYNACO-SCANDYNA A-30MKII
sections.overview:
41,000 (1 unit, around the early 1970 s?)

This speaker system adopts the dumped bass reflex method.It uses a slightly larger enclosure than the A-25mkII.The dumped bass reflex is a semi-braking system with a special glass fiber filled in the opening of the grating in the lower part of the baffle to give air to the woofer. The inner wall of the enclosure is covered with two layers of glass fiber and rock wool with different sound absorption coefficients to reduce internal reflection.This structure eliminates over-braking of the woofer, which tends to occur in a completely enclosed type, and suppresses the effect of resonance at the opening, which is pointed out as a defect of the bass reflex type.A 25 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.Instead of the heavy vibration system of the long voice coil often seen in the completely enclosed type woofer, a light vibration system with small amplitude is adopted.A dome-shaped tweeter is installed in the high range.Uses lightweight diaphragm as well as woofer.

sections.title: DYNAVECTOR DV-505
sections.overview: A mass separation type dynamic balance tone arm employing an electromagnetic viscous mass control system.It has a unique structure with two support shafts, a main arm for lateral movement only and a sub arm for longitudinal movement only.This increases the inertia mass of the arm mass of the arm, the movement of the cartridge in the longitudinal direction is lightened, and it is easy to follow the warping and dispersion of records.This structure also provides a large margin against howling.In order to eliminate large peaks due to the low-frequency resonance of the tone arm and to further clarify the low-frequency separation, a dynamic damping system is adopted. In this system, the property of coupled vibration is utilized by installing a sub vibration system in the main arm, and the low-frequency resonance is suppressed within 2.5 dB.In order to reduce resonance in the lateral direction, we have adopted an electromagnetic viscosity control mechanism that applies resistance by eddy currents and magnetic field lines.As a result, the deterioration of oil caused by the aging of oil, which occurred in the oil dump type, is eliminated.The cartridge's needle pressure application mechanism adopts a dynamic balance type using a spiral spring.The arm base is in the free position, and the pin cord connector can be mounted horizontally from the arm mounting part.This eliminates the need for drilling the player board.There are 3 variations of blue, silver and black.

sections.title: DIATONE M-T01
sections.overview: This is a compact cassette deck with various mechanisms.2-motor configuration and closed loop dual capstan system are adopted.In this method, the tape is held more securely by two pairs of pinch rollers and a capstan. When the motor rotates, the tape tension in the loop is always kept constant by the difference between the peripheral speeds of the flywheels on the take-up side and on the supply side, and the tape surface and the head are brought into close contact with each other with a stable force. In addition, the two capstan and pinch rollers can almost completely the rotation unevenness and vibration of the reel table, thereby achieving stable tape travel.In addition, the M-T01 uses a 2-motor type, and a PLL servo DC motor is installed in the constant speed motor to achieve excellent tape travel.The operation of the mechanism is controlled electronically, and the feather-touch operation is adopted in the tape control section, enabling direct change from any operation mode to the next operation without pressing the stop button.The head uses a newly developed magnetic Sendust head that combines the superior magnetic properties of permalloy with the ultra-long life of ferrite, enabling sound quality to be maintained as it is during initial adjustment for a long period of time.It is equipped with ASPS (Automatic Spacing Pause System) which automatically creates a non-recording area at a fixed interval on the tape during recording.If you press the ASPS button during recording, the ASPS lamp lights up and the tape continues to run while cutting the recording input signal. Approximately three seconds later, the deck automatically moves to a pause state, the ASPS lamp goes out, and the ASPS state changes to a PAUSE state.Equipped with a peak meter.Equipped with a 3-stage switching tape selector with independent bias and equalizer.It is equipped with Memory Stop and Memory Start yesterday.Equipped with an MPX filter that can be turned on / off.When used with an external audio timer, absence recording is possible.Microphone input and line input can be adjusted independently to enable microphone mixing.It has a built-in Dolby circuit.We have mono my Kujac on Lch.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-9Z
sections.overview:
150,000 (1 unit, released in November 1986)

This is a speaker system that aims to realize flexible expressive power by introducing DIATONE technology and conducting a thorough review.WooferA 20 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The diaphragm uses hybrid weaving of PAN-based high-density carbon fiber and aromatic polyamide-based aramid to achieve a high-dimensional balance between high specific elastic modulus and loss factor.PAN-based high-strength carbon fiber is a fibrous material of carbon-based particles and has an extremely high elastic modulus. Aramid fiber is an aromatic polyamide fiber material with low density and moderate internal loss in addition to high strength and high elasticity. In order to summarize the advantages of these materials in a high dimension, various interrelations such as the blending method of the resin and the relationship with the thermal expansion coefficient are developed into a hybrid structure. This results in a specific elastic modulus of 3.7x10.11cm2/sec2And internal loss of 0.06.In addition, a 22 cm honeycomb diaphragm has been completed by optimizing the carving design through computer simulation.The frame uses Diatone's unique D. M. M. method, and the entire magnetic circuit is firmly fixed with a strong frame to achieve excellent start-up characteristics.In addition, the DS-9Z has a thorough anti-magnetic design to eliminate adverse effects on the network due to leakage flux from the magnetic circuit. The anti-magnetic cover uses spheroidal graphite cast iron to achieve a balance between the anti-magnetic design and rigidity. This material is also used in piano frame structures and has both high rigidity and damping characteristics. Moreover, when mounted on an aluminum die-cast frame, the resonance dispersion effect is enhanced due to the effect of dissimilar metals.TweeterA 2.5 cm dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.The diaphragm uses a D. U. D. boron diaphragm developed by Diatone.In the D. U. D system, the voice coil bobbin and diaphragm are integrated to eliminate energy loss and enable high-speed signal propagation.In addition, the DS-9Z has been examined and improved from various angles so that it can be completed as a tweeter suitable for a small 2-way system. As a result, the aperture is set at 1 inch, and acoustic control is applied to optimize the back pressure and resonance inside the diaphragm. In addition, a newly developed edge is used to support the diaphragm with good linearity. This edge uses a material with damping coating on a fine cloth cloth to increase the strength, and a tangential design to improve the tracking performance in minute amplitude.The D. M. method is adopted for the frame part, and the magnetic circuit is mounted directly to the enclosure by making the plate part of the magnetic circuit into a mount plate.For the DS-9Z, the D. M. method has been revised from the basic point of view in order to match the higher rigidity with the magnetic shielding design. The sub-frame is made of copper alloy casting with excellent damping characteristics, and the magnetic shielding cover is coated with thick baking paint to enhance the damping effect.NetworkSingle-crystal oxygen-free copper wire with increased wire diameter is used for all wiring in the network section, and the sleeve of crimp wiring, which is used to eliminate metallic boundary strain of current, is all gold-plated.In addition, due to a thorough review of the current density, we have adopted a power supply system that can supply the appropriate current to each unit, and to prevent electromagnetic interference between the power supplies to the two units, we have adopted a completely two part distributed configuration for the network.In consideration of electromagnetic coupling between inductors and modulation of system internal pressure, a spruce material with excellent vibration damping characteristics is used for the base of the network.EnclosureThe trapizoidal enclosure is used to minimize sound sources and to eliminate unwanted resonance.In an ordinary enclosure, because the top plate and the tweeter are close to each other, the sound in the mid - and high-range region is polluted by resonance of the top plate. Furthermore, unnecessary radiation caused by vibration of the plate from the top plate causes resonance of the entire box. The baffle plate in the vicinity of the mid - and high-range unit as small as possible to reduce the resonance area.To solve these problems, the DS-9Z has a trapizoidal shape that achieves both miniaturization and rigidity of the top panel. As a result, the top panel area has been reduced by 20%, rigidity has been increased by approximately 1.5 times, and the diaphragm radiation area near the tweeter has also been reduced by approximately 9%.The baffle plate is made of beautiful sounding spruce material, and has a lumber core structure to ensure the best match between material properties and high-rigidity unit.OtherIn order to achieve high purity in the entire system, RUNNET is eliminated and a bolt cap is adopted.Dedicated Speaker StandThe DK-90Z sold separately is a newly developed stand exclusively for the DS-9Z. It adopts a unique shape considering low-frequency radiation.Consideration is also given to the lumbar core structure of the stand in order to enhance the completeness of the system as a whole.
