sections.title: DIATONE DS-10B
sections.overview: A compact speaker system that can be mounted on the wall, pursuing high efficiency and sound reproduction.A 20 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The edge uses a rubber-like urethane edge to achieve high compliance and low symmetry. In addition, by using a strong frame, resonance of the frame itself, which occurs during heavy bass reproduction, is suppressed as much as possible.A 5 cm cone type tweeter is installed in the high range.This unit is equipped with a sub-frame with an orifice structure in the chamber. By eliminating standing waves in the chamber, it prevents unwanted sound from sticking and realizes high-sound reproduction with excellent transient characteristics.In addition, the center cap is made of titanium alloy with high rigidity and excellent specific elasticity, and by suppressing split vibration, a smooth high sound range is obtained.A 90 dB output sound pressure level is achieved by adopting a powerful magnetic circuit and a bass reflex system.In addition, the voice coil has excellent heat resistance to provide sufficient input resistance.A 15 mm thick plate is used for the enclosure, and a strong structure is achieved through repeated modal analysis and hearing tests.Wall mount brackets on the rear of the enclosure allow for wall mount to suit room conditions and preferences.

By weaving these two fiber intra-ply structures and hybrid weaving, the skin material with high specific elastic modulus and optimum loss factor is obtained. D structure in which the driving voice coil is directly wound around the diaphragm, we have achieved a wide response band and high-speed response to pulsed input at a high dimension.The unit structure adopts Diatone's unique D. M. (direct mount) structure.In the D. M. structure, part of the magnetic circuit is framed and mounted directly on the baffle plate. In the DS-77HR, the entire plate is wrapped with aluminum alloy casting material and mounted in the enclosure in order to convert the resonance of this material into frictional heat generated at the interface between dissimilar metals and attenuate it. Diatone analyzed this using computer technology such as the finite element method, and developed A. D. M. C. which effectively suppresses magnetostriction.First, we examined the shape of the center pole to enhance the symmetry of the DC magnetic flux distribution across the voice coil. At the same time, we placed a conductive short ring on the center pole to offset the AC magnetic flux from the voice coil, thereby suppressing the magnetostriction caused by the superposition of DC and AC magnetic flux.Furthermore, by reducing the disturbance of the DC magnetic flux due to the AC magnetic flux in the magnetic circuit, the drive energy is stabilized and distortion is reduced at a high level.High-rigidity R. S. frame is used in the frame part to suppress unnecessary resonance.midrangeThe mid-range is equipped with a 10 cm cone type squaker.For the cone part of the diaphragm, we use an intra-ply hybrid diaphragm made by hybrid weaving of organic fiber aramid and inorganic fiber PAN-based high-strength carbon fiber. By combining PAN-based high-strength carbon fiber with extremely high specific elastic modulus and organic aramid with high strength and moderate internal loss, we realize a diaphragm that takes advantage of each other's characteristics.The center diaphragm of the diaphragm uses S. R. titanium dome, which has high specific elastic modulus and internal loss by surface hardening of titanium.The edge uses a tangential edge that has been coated with a special damping material to improve responsiveness.In order to control resonance, this edge has a laminated structure of two tangential cloths to realize flattening of characteristics and reduction of strain.The voice coil uses an extremely high-purity oxygen-free copper of 6N (99.9999%) to realize a sound with little distortion.The R. S. frame, which strongly supports the magnetic circuit and controls resonance, has been adopted in the frame part for higher rigidity.TweeterA 2.5 cm dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.Boron D. U. D. dome is used for the diaphragm.Boron is second only to diamond in hardness and has excellent characteristics such as sound velocity. At the same time, it has physical properties closer to porcelain rather than metal. In addition, DS-77Z has been reviewing boron in various ways, focusing on characteristics such as high specific elastic modulus, high durability and weather resistance, and proper sound control.In addition, the D. U. D structure that integrates the diaphragm and voice coil bobbin transfers driving force to the diaphragm without loss, and realizes high limit frequency, linearity, and improved input resistance.The frame structure adopts D. M. method, and the plate part which is a part of magnetic circuit is directly mounted.The DS-77Z has a hybrid structure in which the entire plate is mounted with aluminum alloy sheathing in order to eliminate resonance of the magnetic circuit components. In addition to high rigidity, the DS-77Z has an appropriate damping property.NetworkA crimping wiring method is used for connection of the network section, and an independent power supply method is used to eliminate interference between each unit and network.In addition, the split structure with separate woofer elements prevents noise from becoming cloudy due to magnetic flux leakage.Laminated oriented cores are used for coils, oxygen-free copper wires are used for electrical wires, and capacitors and resistors are also carefully selected.EnclosureThe front baffle uses a 2-side round baffle to suppress sound quality degradation caused by the diffraction effect of sound waves.The enclosure has a highly rigid distributed resonance structure utilizing our unique analytical technology.In addition, a 30 mm thick baffle is adopted to further increase rigidity, and resolution is improved.OtherThe DS-77Z has a full-scale anti-magnetic design.There were 2 kinds of variations for the speaker stand sold separately.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-97C
sections.overview:
101,000 (1 unit, released in November 1988)

A floor-type speaker system for rich low-frequency playback.A 31 cm cone type woofer using an intra-ply hybrid honeycomb cone is mounted in the low range.The Intra-Ply Hybrid Honeycomb Cone uses a hybrid weaving skin material of PAN-based high-strength carbon fiber and aromatic polyamide aramid for the front skin and a cellulose fiber skin for the back skin. This hybrid structure realizes a high specific elastic modulus and moderate internal loss.Equipped with 12 cm cone type skoker in the middle area.The diaphragm is made of a hybrid weaving skin material woven with aramid and carbon at a ratio of 1 : 2. It is lightweight, highly rigid, and has high internal loss. In addition, a 2-ply structure using carbon cloth skin material realizes high specific elastic modulus and high loss factor. The center diaphragm is made of S. R. Titanium Dome, which achieves both high specific elastic modulus and loss factor by surface hardening of titanium. The hybrid structure of dome diaphragm and cone diaphragm makes sound connection smooth.Roll edge with excellent linearity of amplitude is used for the edge part, and wooden back chamber is used for the mid-range to ensure sufficient volume and high strength to prevent interference with low range.A 2.5 cm dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.The diaphragm is made of Diatone's original diaphragm, Boron, and the diaphragm and voice coil bobbin are integrated into a D. U. D structure. The driving force generated in the voice coil bobbin is transmitted to the diaphragm without any loss, thereby improving transient response, high upper limit frequency, linearity and input resistance.The D. M. (Direct Mount), which is a highly rigid unit structure, is also a hybrid structure. The entire plate is mounted with aluminum-alloyed sting in order to attenuate the natural resonance of the magnetic circuit itself. As a result, in addition to high rigidity, an appropriate damping property is obtained.All units have an anti-magnetic design with anti-magnetic structure.In order to suppress the natural sound radiated from the surface of the unit mounting bolt, a damping bolt cap is used for all units.A low-distortion air-core coil is used for the tweeter coil in the network part to transmit sound without coloring.In addition, interference between each unit and network is eliminated by independent power supply system and split network arrangement, and crimp wiring is used for connection system.The front baffle uses a 2-side round baffle to reduce the diffraction effect.The enclosure is designed as a bass reflex with a volume of approximately 80 liters.The front baffle is made of 2-plywood with a thickness of 30 mm, and resonance is suppressed by obtaining sufficient strength. In addition, by mounting the woofer almost in the center of the baffle plate, low-order standing waves generated especially in the vertical direction are suppressed. In addition, by dispersing the resonance frequency by the reinforcement material, the use of sound absorbing material which applies excessive damping to the low range is minimized.The bass reflex port uses 5 mm thick inorganic filler mixed polypropylene. This port has a shape with a gentle vent and changes from a perfect circle at the inlet section to an elliptic shape without changing the cross-sectional area. This prevents high-order standing waves inside the cabinet from being radiated from the duct and reduces the flow path resistance. This shape also reduces the natural resonance of the duct itself.The net grill has a large open side to increase the rigidity of the double frame and make it a structure with good permeability.A dedicated acoustic base is included.

sections.overview: This is a bookshelf speaker system developed by inheriting the concept inherited from the DS 505 to the DS 503.A 32 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.A newly developed Polykraft honeycomb cone is used for the diaphragm. This diaphragm has a structure in which a skin material, which is made by impregnating special resin into paper pulp, and a Kraft honeycomb core, which is also impregnated with resin, are joined together with a polyamide adhesive. By using a composite material like this, while taking advantage of the large internal loss, low density, and excellent mass productivity of paper, it realizes a high specific elastic modulus which is about four times that of paper. By using a honeycomb structure, internal loss is improved by 20% compared with paper. In addition, harmonic distortion due to split vibration is reduced by 15 dB compared with paper cone.In the DS 501, the resonance is reduced by using Polykraft honeycomb cone and attaching polyamide fiber to the center cap to improve the resolution in the middle and low frequencies. In addition, the magnetic circuit is equipped with a low-strain ring to eliminate the strain generated from the drive system.The mid-range features a 6.5 cm dome mid-range.A newly developed D. U. D. ? - titanium diaphragm is used for the diaphragm. The ? - titanium diaphragm is heat-treated in a special atmosphere. The surface hardening improves the Young's modulus of the diaphragm. By this, the upper limit frequency is passed to the higher band, and the reproduction frequency band is expanded. In addition, by making this material a D. U. D structure, the driving force generated in the voice coil can be transmitted to the ? - titanium diaphragm without loss, and the response to input signals is improved with less attenuation in the high frequency range. In addition, in the D. U. D structure, the heat generated in the voice coil is directly conducted to the diaphragm, so the heat radiation effect is increased, and linearity and input resistance characteristics by input signals are improved.In addition, a newly developed tangential edge is used for the edge part, and appropriate internal loss is given by molding it into a multi-layer structure using cloth as a base material and special binder.A 2.5 cm dome-shaped tweeter is installed in the high range.This unit uses a D. U. D ? - titanium diaphragm similar to the mid-range.The network circuit uses Diatone's unique low-distortion network circuit.In this method, elements such as coils and capacitors that make up the network are strictly checked, and a crimping wiring method using OFC crimping is used for connection.When the level control is set to 0 point, the level control circuit jumps completely.The enclosure is a high-rigidity enclosure developed from the latest vibration analysis technology such as modal analysis.The DS 501 uses the well-known wrapping and fixing pattern splice, and the baffle plate is made of 12 mm + 12 mm laminated plywood to further increase rigidity.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-503
sections.overview: This speaker system was developed using the know-how obtained with the DS 505 as a digital reproduction standard system.A 32 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The diaphragm uses a newly developed honeycomb cone that incorporates the know-how of the aramid honeycomb diaphragm mounted on the DS 505. This diaphragm uses high-tensile polyamide fiber as a skin material and greatly reduces strain caused by the diaphragm by suppressing axisymmetric split resonance.In addition to the installation of a low-distortion magnetic circuit, an edgewise coil made of a flat oxygen-free copper wire and a voice coil bobbin made of glass-fiber polyimide film are employed to reduce the distortion of the drive system itself.The mid-range features a 6.5 cm dome mid-range.6.5 cmDUD Boron Dome is used for the diaphragm. Conventional metal diaphragm has high Q and sharp resonance, so measures such as attaching absorbers to the diaphragm itself have been taken. However, as a result, the residual sound, which is a component of the sound, is eliminated, which adversely affects the musical quality. To improve this, the Boron Dome used in the DS 503 has a non-treatment structure that does not apply any brakes to the diaphragm itself. Taking advantage of the features of DUD, the back pressure is controlled by inserting an equalizer in the upper part of the pole piece, and the diffuser in the front part is also eliminated.In addition, in order to satisfy the two opposing conditions of good rise and no squeal, tangential edge is adopted by sandwiching aramid fiber with special butyl rubber. Aramid fiber has excellent damping characteristics and good response to quick rise sound. In addition, special butyl rubber is made by adjusting loss factor by slicing graphite and applying filler treatment to butyl rubber. Material with these two opposing properties is made into a sandwich structure, and by adjusting the film thickness, the response during attack is improved and squeal is suppressed.A 2.3 cm dome-shaped tweeter is installed in the high range.The diaphragm uses a DUD boron dome. In addition to the excellent characteristics of boron itself, the diaphragm and voice coil bobbin are integrated into a DUD structure to improve linearity and input resistance characteristics against input signals.A low-distortion circuit is used for the network circuit. In particular, the mid-range network k circuit uses a newly developed electrolytic capacitor-based circuit instead of conventional film condensers to bring out the superior sound quality of the DUD-mid-range.A oxygen-free copper Litz wire is used for connection between the tweeter and the network circuit to prevent lowering of the level at high frequencies due to skin effect and to improve response to instantaneous input.Crimping sleeve wiring by oxygen-free copper is used for all connections.The enclosure is of a distributed resonance type, and further rigidity is increased by joining the wrapping and fixing handle.In addition, rigid straight aluminum pipes are used for the bass reflex duct.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-505
sections.overview: This 4-way speaker system is designed to be a bookshelf that exceeds the bookshelf type and is compatible with digital audio.The DS 505 has a 4-way configuration with a mid-bus unit, and the mid-bus unit is equipped with fundamental bandwidth to achieve both high resolution in the mid-range and high quality in the low frequency range, which was difficult to achieve with the conventional 3-way system.A 32 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The diaphragm uses a newly developed aramid honeycomb cone. Aramid fiber is an aromatic polyamide fiber that combines high strength and high elasticity with low density and moderate internal loss. Diatone uses a special blend of flexible resin reinforced with aramid fiber to create a honeycomb diaphragm with a large internal loss in the resin itself. This skin and aluminum honeycomb core bonded together.The voice coil uses a polyimide film with three times the Young's modulus of conventional aromatic polyamide film and excellent heat and cold resistance. It is designed to dramatically improve input resistance and to transmit the driving force generated by the voice coil to the diaphragm without loss.The magnetic circuit is equipped with a low-distortion magnetic circuit. In this method, a nickel-based magnetic alloy material with excellent linearity of magnetization characteristics is developed and installed in the vicinity of the magnetic pole gap using a metallurgical engineering approach to reduce non-linear strain. Furthermore, regarding strain based on non-uniformity of magnetic flux density distribution in the magnetic gap, the effects of shapes, dimensions, materials, etc. of the pole piece and plate are analyzed by a computer to realize a structure with uniform magnetic flux density distribution and less strain.A 16 cm cone type midbus unit is installed in the middle and low range.This unit uses voice coil and low distortion magnetic circuit using aramid honeycomb cone and polyimide film as well as woofer.A 4 cm dome type mid-high unit is installed in the middle and high area.This unit uses a sandwiched boronized diaphragm made of titanium treated with high-temperature boronization. Moreover, this diaphragm has a DUD structure unique to Diatone, which integrates the voice coil bobbin and diaphragm. This diaphragm prevents a decrease in rigidity caused by bonding the diaphragm and voice coil bobbin and eliminates high resonance frequencies out of the audible band. In addition, by eliminating energy loss at the bonded part, the driving force generated in the voice coil can be transmitted to the diaphragm without loss, reducing attenuation in the high frequency range. Moreover, since the heat generated in the voice coil is directly conducted to the diaphragm, the increase in conductor resistance of the voice coil itself due to temperature rise is prevented, and linearity and input resistance to input signals are improved.A large strontium magnet is used for the magnetic circuit, and the distortion of the drive system caused by the magnetic circuit is eliminated by operating the magnetic circuit in the saturation region.A 2.3 cm dome-shaped tweeter is installed in the high range.Similar to the mid-high unit, this unit uses a boronized diaphragm and a large strontium magnet.In order to reduce distortion in network circuits, we have been studying constituent parts and elements.The coil for the network is designed to take advantage of both the good damping of the core and the low distortion of the air core. Therefore, the shape of the coil is thoroughly pursued and the winding diameter is increased to 1.4 mm to reduce DC resistance and distortion. In addition, careful attention is paid to the production of the element such as using a bonded iron core made by heat-pressing silicon steel plate with a special adhesive in order to suppress harmful core noise.We have adopted a polyester film capacitor with excellent high-frequency characteristics. This capacitor is also designed with double vibration isolation structure in consideration of its own vibration. We have also adopted a low-distortion type electrolytic capacitor with extremely low leakage current and dielectric loss.We also pay attention to the layout of network components and wiring methods, and reduce distortion to minimize interference between components.Oxygen-free copper wires are used mainly for network circuit wiring.Compared with general tough pitch copper wires, oxygen-free copper wires have superior characteristics such as high conductivity, no hydrogen embrittlement, excellent workability, and low content of impurities such as dissimilar metals.In addition, we have eliminated the need for soldering and adopted a crimping connection using a oxygen-free copper sleeve.The enclosure uses a joint structure and material determined by modal analysis and repeated thorough hearing to bring out the performance of the unit. Also, the mounting position of the unit was determined by modal analysis and repeated listening of various prototype model systems. By this method, the midbus unit is placed on the upper part and intermodulation distortion is suppressed.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-700
sections.overview:
138,000 (2 units 1 set, sold in June 1989)

The History Series speaker system uses a staggered multi-drive system.The DS 700 uses LCP (Liquid Crystal Polymer) as the diaphragm material.This liquid crystal polymer has a self-reinforcing effect and has a specific elasticity comparable to that of titanium. In addition, since it is a polymer material, it also has a large internal loss close to ideal. This material is made into an ultra-thin diaphragm using an injection molding method to increase rigidity and specific elastic modulus. In the DS 700, LCP is used in all units, and the diaphragm with the same physical properties is made into a 2-way constant sound speed for all bands.It is also designed to prevent magnetic flux leakage by installing a repulse magnet in the magnetic circuit.Two 16 cm cone type woofers are installed in the lower range.In addition to the usual two way system, the DS 700 uses a staggered multi-drive system with a low-band booster woofer, enabling rich low-band playback. In this system, the woofer is divided into two types, one for mid-low band and the other for low-band, and each has its own network circuit for smooth connection with the tweeter.The two woofer units are designed according to each band, and a net cap is used for the middle and low band woofer to eliminate the natural sound.A 2.5 cm dome-shaped tweeter is installed in the high range.The tweeter unit uses LCP diaphragm with Diatone's unique DUD structure, and realizes high-speed playback by integrating with voice coil.The magnetic circuit uses a DM structure to increase rigidity and eliminate unnecessary vibration, and the frame area is reduced to minimize unnecessary radiation.A high-performance coil consisting of a laminated oriented core and oxygen-free copper wires is used for the coil of the network section. Crimp wiring is used for connection, and carefully selected materials are used for each element and input terminal.In addition, interference between the networks of each unit is eliminated by adopting an independent feed system, and intermodulation is eliminated by adopting a 3-division network board.All 6 sides of the enclosure have a genuine mahogany veneer finish.The internal structure is of a distributed resonance type, and the baffle structure is of an enveloping and retaining frame to eliminate the effect of vibration.There was a speaker stand with the same mahogany veneer finish as the enclosure sold separately.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-1000
sections.overview: This new concept speaker system was developed by returning to the starting point of speaker production and reviewing the unit structure itself.A 27 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The honeycomb cone is used for the diaphragm. It is a honeycomb-curved cone with high tensile polyamide fiber as skin material. Until now, it was difficult to form the honeycomb diaphragm into a cone shape, but it is molded into the curved cone with the technology of Diatone. By this, the high-frequency reproduction frequency can be set wider than the conventional straight cone, and the high-frequency resonance peak is suppressed lower.The DMM (Direct Magnet Circuit Mount) system is adopted for the frame part. The whole unit including the magnetic circuit is wrapped in a strong aluminum die-cast frame so that it is pushed from the rear, and it is strongly supported by the cabinet. This suppresses the vibration of the magnetic circuit itself caused by the input signal and realizes high resolution.Mid-range with 5 cm dome mid-range.The diaphragm uses a DUD boron dome. The boron used in the DS-1000 has improved the boron diffusion growth more strongly than the conventional one, and the boronization of the titanium matrix is further promoted by the crystal growth boron. This, combined with the rigidity of boron, suppresses the natural sound of titanium metal.In addition, a Direct Mount (DM) system has been adopted for the frame part. By using a monocoque structure that integrates the magnetic circuit plate and the mounting frame that supports the unit itself, the rigidity is increased, vibration is suppressed, input energy is transmitted to the diaphragm without loss, and high-speed playback sound is realized. In addition, a damping sheet is attached to prevent reflection from the frame around the diaphragm to improve the S / N ratio of playback sound.A 2.3 cm dome-shaped tweeter is installed in the high range.A DUD boron dome is used for the diaphragm as in the mid-range. The DS-1000 tweeter diaphragm has a shorter bobbin section to improve the high-speed response, and realizes better high-sound reproduction.Low distortion network circuit is adopted for the network part.By eliminating the attenuator circuit, electrical and mechanical factors such as natural resonance are eliminated and the S / N ratio of reproduced sound is improved.The enclosure is hermetically sealed.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-1000C
sections.overview:
150,000 (1 unit, released in September 1989)

A floor-type speaker system that uses a staggered multi-drive system.WooferTwo 22 cm cone type woofers are installed in the low range.New Aramid Hybrid Honeycomb diaphragm is used for the diaphragm.The front skin of this diaphragm is made of organic fiber aramid with high strength and moderate internal loss, and aramid hybrid FRP with intra-ply structure of inorganic fiber amorphous silica with 15% higher rigidity than conventional ones. The back skin is made of cellulose skin with excellent internal loss. By making these two skins into a honeycomb structure, high rigidity and internal loss are combined in a high dimension.Furthermore, the adoption of a high-rigidity R. S. frame suppresses unwanted resonance.ADMC (Advanced Magnet Circuit) is used for the magnetic circuit.In this system, the magnetic distortion generated in the drive system is thoroughly analyzed using the finite element method and effectively suppressed. First of all, the center pole shape has been fundamentally revised in order to increase the symmetry of the DC component of the magnetic flux that crosses the voice coil and the distribution of the AC magnetic flux. In addition, the AC magnetic flux from the voice coil is AC magnetic flux from the voice coil and suppresses the magnetic distortion caused by the superposition of the DC magnetic flux and the AC magnetic flux. In addition, the disturbance of the DC magnetic flux due to the AC magnetic flux in the magnetic circuit is also reduced.Mid-rangeMid-range with 5 cm dome mid-range.Boron DUD is used for the diaphragm.Boron has excellent properties such as high specific elasticity, high durability and weather resistance, and suppression of natural noise. The DUD system has a high-rigidity diaphragm structure in which a diaphragm and a voice coil bobbin are integrated, and the driving force generated in the voice coil is transmitted to the diaphragm without loss, thereby improving response to input signals.A laminated tangential edge is used for the support part.This edge has a hybrid structure made of butyl rubber with aramid fiber excellent in damping characteristics, and has excellent linearity and suppresses the natural sound of the suspension itself.The frame uses the DM method, and the mounting plate of the magnetic circuit is integrated with the frame, and the magnetic circuit is mounted directly in the enclosure for higher rigidity.In addition, the frame is made of a brass material with a high anti-vibration effect to achieve even greater rigidity.TweeterA 2.3 cm dome-shaped tweeter is installed in the high range.NetworkEach of the two woofers has a dedicated network circuit for the mid-range and low-range channels, and a dedicated network circuit for the low-range channel. This ensures a smooth connection with the mid-range channel and enhances fundamental bandwidth.Independent power supply system is adopted to eliminate interference between each unit and network.In addition, crimping wiring with a oxygen-free copper sleeve is adopted to prevent the metallic interface distortion of the current.EnclosureThe enclosure uses a bass reflex system.The enclosure is made of 40-mm-thick double-layered laminated particleboards for higher rigidity. It is also a dispersion resonance type that suppresses resonance modes by utilizing measurement and analysis technology such as vibration analysis of the enclosure.In addition, a rear bass reflex system with a capacity of approximately 60 liters is employed to achieve richer low-frequency playback.The base is made of a solid material with a thickness of 50 mm, and the enclosure receives points to minimize the effect of installation conditions.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-1000HR
sections.overview: This speaker system was developed by applying the technologies cultivated in the DS-10000.WooferA 27 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The diaphragm uses polyamide, honeycomb and curved cone.The honeycomb vibration plate has a high specific elastic modulus and most of the volume (about 90%) is an air layer, so the density is 0.1 to 0.25g/cm.3The DS-1000HR uses high-tensile polyamide fiber, a long-fiber-reinforced composite material, for the skin of the diaphragm to further improve the quality of the diaphragm. The DS-1000HR also uses a curved cone shape to reduce high-order harmonic distortion in the low-frequency range expand the high-limit frequencies.The frame structure adopts the DMM method.In this system, the whole unit including the magnetic circuit is strongly supported from the rear by a strong aluminum die-cast frame. The magnetic circuit and the frame are effectively integrated. This reduces vibration of the magnetic circuit and the frame. Furthermore, the S/N ratio is further improved by adding a new concept of damping control to suppress resonance of the second and third higher modes.midrangeThe mid-range features a 5.0 cm dome mid-range.50 mm boron DUD dome has been adopted for the diaphragm.The DUD used in the structure of the diaphragm is an integrated diaphragm and voice coil bobbin. It can transmit the driving force generated in the voice coil to the diaphragm without loss. As a result, characteristics such as improved transient response, higher upper limit frequency, improved linearity and input resistance have been achieved.In addition, in the DS-1000HR, the diffusion growth of boron used for the diaphragm material has been further improved, and the boronization of titanium base metal is further promoted by crystal growth boron, and the perfection as a diaphragm is enhanced.Laminated tangential edge of Conex base material with double-sided butyl coating is used for the support part of the diaphragm.DM system is adopted for the frame part.This system has a monocoque structure in which the magnetic circuit and frame are integrated. By mounting the magnetic circuit directly in the enclosure, the input signal is transmitted to the diaphragm without loss. As a result, even minute level signals show excellent rise and fall characteristics.In addition, the back cover uses an 8-point stopper that is stronger than the conventional one to improve the damping characteristics in the middle range.TweeterA 2.3 cm dome type tweeter using the enhanced diffusion Boronized titanium DUD diaphragm is mounted in the high frequency band as well as the middle band.We have also improved the start-up characteristics by adopting the DM method for the frame.NetworkIn the network section, we pay attention to the metal-interface distortion caused by soldering, and have adopted a crimping wiring method using a oxygen-free copper sleeve.The DS-1000HR also focuses on equalizing the current density to each unit. Each unit can balance the current density under the same density under the same condition, and a radial distribution plate that can directly supply power is adopted.In order to eliminate the negative effects of electromagnetic coupling between the inductors constituting the network and leakage flux due to the voice coil driving current of each unit, we have adopted a network circuit consisting of three sections and three pieces, paying attention to the circuit configuration and element arrangement.In addition, vibration analysis technology is applied to the mounting method, and the arrangement is calculated to minimize the adverse effects of the enclosure vibration and the internal pressure of the speakers. In addition, spruce with beautiful vibration damping is used for the network substrate.EnclosureThe baffle plate of the enclosure is made of 30-t-thick particleboards to increase rigidity, and the back plate is made of three layers of birch plywood and particles to realize excellent attenuation characteristics and beautiful sound.Using various computer vibration analysis technologies, we analyze sound radiation and acoustic mutual impedance caused by vibration of each unit itself and vibration of each plate surface of the enclosure. High-order modes are suppressed by the disperse resonance structure of the Diatone tradition, and low-order modes increase the rigidity of the enclosure itself as a box and achieve high-resolution reproduction by balancing the overall vibration.A round baffle is used to prevent degradation of the sound field due to diffraction effects. In addition, the upper and lower surfaces of the baffle plate are tapered to increase the three dimensional sound field reproduction capability.OtherThere was a speaker stand as an option sold separately.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-2000
sections.overview: A high-density and high-resolution speaker system designed to achieve high-speed start-up response.In the development of the DS 2000, digital measurement was introduced ahead of the industry. Problems in time domain response are discovered through modal analysis and energy time response analysis, and the results of each research and analysis are fed into each department to enhance the completeness.WooferA 30 cm cone shaped woofer with Diatone's unique honeycomb construction cone is installed in the low range.In the DS 2000, high-tensile polyamide fiber is used for the skin material, and along with the development of special matrix resins, the diaphragm itself is reduced in strain. In addition, the curved cone shape is used to reduce high-order harmonic distortion, and the upper limit frequencies are expanded.The voice coil bobbin uses a polyimide film that has three times the specific elastic modulus of conventional aromatic polyamide film and excellent heat and cold resistance. This improves input resistance and response to input signals.DMM (Direct Magnet Circuit Mount) system is adopted for the frame part.In this system, the whole unit including the magnetic circuit is wrapped in a strong aluminum die-cast frame pressed from the rear so that the magnetic circuit and the frame are effectively integrated.In addition, the DS 2000 incorporates new technologies such as 8-frame and uniform 8-point fastening based on vibration analysis using a vibration pickup. By integrating the frame and fastening screws, resonance of the magnetic circuit and frame is suppressed.midrangeA 6 cm dome type squaker using a newly designed 60 mm reinforced diffused boron D. U. D. diaphragm is mounted in the middle area.The diaphragm structure of this unit uses Diatone Unified Diaphragm (D. U. D.).In this structure, the diaphragm and voice coil bobbin are integrated by a simple structure in which the voice coil is wound directly on the diaphragm, and the driving force generated by the voice coil is directly transmitted to the diaphragm without loss. Therefore, the damping of the high frequency range is small, and the transient response to the input vibration is improved. In addition, there is no decrease in rigidity due to adhesion, and the upper limit frequency can be set high, and the increase in conductor resistance due to temperature rise is reduced by the excellent heat radiation effect, and linearity and input resistance are improved.Boron is used for the diaphragm.Boron is second only to diamond in hardness and has excellent acoustic properties such as specific elastic modulus. At the same time, boron has physical properties closer to magnetism than metals. By this property, characteristics at the resonance frequency can be smoothed, and neither braking nor acoustic equalization to the diaphragm itself is required, thus realizing an ideal diaphragm.In addition, in order to further develop the characteristics of the boron diaphragm in the DS 2000, boron diffusion growth is strongly promoted, and boronization of the titanium base metal is promoted by crystal growth boron to improve the completion of the diaphragm.In addition, the diaphragm itself is a no-treatment diaphragm that does not use any damping material to take advantage of the excellent response characteristic of the D. U. D structure.DM (direct mount) system is adopted for the frame part.In this system, the magnetic circuit itself is made into a frame by integrating the magnetic circuit and the frame into a monocoque structure, and by mounting it directly into the enclosure, the rigidity of the whole unit is increased. In addition, by comprehensively examining magnetic flux density, magnetic flux leakage, rigidity, etc., and determining the optimum shape and dimensions using a finite element method using a computer, high-density mid-range reproduction is achieved.In addition, the plate portion is 8 mm thick with allowance, and it is fixed to the baffle plate at 8 equal points in high rigid incorporation, and the unit input terminal position and structure are also devised in order to minimize the diameter of the baffle.TweeterThe high-frequency band is equipped with a 2.3 cm dome type tweeter using an enhanced diffused boron D. U. D. diaphragm in the same way as the mid-frequency band. In addition, the DM system is adopted in the frame part to improve the rise characteristics.NetworkIn order to reduce the effects of electromagnetic interference between network circuits and vibration of the enclosure, a 3-piece separation and division method is adopted for the network section. In addition, the mounting position is optimized by modal analysis. In addition, a oxygen-free copper sleeve crimping method is adopted for wiring to reduce the strain at the metallic interface.In addition, the DS 2000 adopts a direct balance power supply system using a radial power distribution plate to supply power to each unit under the same conditions.EnclosureThe enclosure is designed using modal analysis and other computer-based vibration analysis technology.In the DS 2000, materials with high rigidity and low natural sound are selected. The high-order mode is suppressed by the dispersion resonance structure of the Diatone tradition, and the low-order mode increases the rigidity of the enclosure itself as a box to balance the vibration as a whole. In addition, the joint strength of 6 especially important enclosures is also examined. The machining accuracy of the joint surface is improved by improving the accuracy of the machine tool, and a sturdy box assembly is realized by joining with strong adhesive and reinforcing with angle block.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-2000HR
sections.overview:
200,000 (1 unit, released in October 1987)

This speaker system aims for more natural sound by pursuing three elements : rising sound, continuous sound, and rising and falling sound.WooferA 30 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The diaphragm uses Diatone's unique intra-ply hybrid curved honeycomb cone.This diaphragm is an extension of the honeycomb diaphragm. The front skin has high rigidity for high-speed reproduction and appropriate loss, while the back skin pursues beauty of attenuation after the signal disappears.The front skin uses hybrid weaving in which aromatic polyamide aramid and PAN high strength carbon fiber are woven into an intra-ply structure. Aramid fiber is an aromatic polyamide fiber material that is lightweight and has moderate internal loss in addition to high strength and high rigidity. PAN high strength carbon fiber has an extremely high specific elastic modulus by using polyacrylonitrile as raw material. In addition, aromatic polyamide aramid is used for the back skin to improve loss factor by moderate internal loss.The hybrid structure of the finished skin materials maximizes the physical characteristics of each other, and the hybrid weaving of the dust cap is also carried out thoroughly.In addition, we have obtained an optimal loss factor by using a proprietary flexible resin.Advanced DMM system is adopted for the frame part.The DMM system achieves excellent start-up characteristics by fixing the entire magnetic circuit with a rigid frame. The Advanced DMM system further develops the high rigidity concept of the DMM system to improve vibration damping characteristics of the entire structure.First of all, the high rigidity suppresses the magnetic circuit firmly and maintains the rigidity with respect to the fundamental wave, and for the higher mode, a new structure to disperse the higher mode has been completed by computer simulation. This suppresses the natural sound of the center pole and the natural vibration of the frame that pollutes the middle and high range, enabling clear reproduction with good S/N.midrangeThe mid-range features a 6.0 cm dome mid-range.The diaphragm uses a 60 mm reinforced diffusion Boronized titanium DUD.The DUD used in the structure of the diaphragm is an integrated diaphragm and voice coil bobbin. It can transmit the driving force generated in the voice coil to the diaphragm without loss. As a result, characteristics such as improved transient response, higher upper limit frequency, improved linearity and input resistance have been achieved.In the DS 2000 hr, the diffusion growth of boron, which is used for the diaphragm material, is further advanced, and excellent characteristics such as high specific elastic modulus, high durability and weather resistance, and suppression of natural sound are acquired.A DM system is used for the frame, and the magnetic circuit is mounted directly in the enclosure by a monocoque structure in which the plate part of the magnetic circuit is made into a mount plate, thus realizing further rigidity.The DS-10000HR incorporates the technology introduced in the DS- 2000 Club.First of all, in order to suppress the natural sound of the suspension part supporting the diaphragm, aromatic aramid fiber with excellent damping characteristics is used as a bias, and butyl rubber mixed with graphite slices is molded to form a 3-layer structure with laminated tangential edge.In addition, the acoustic cover, to which back pressure from the diaphragm is directly applied, has been hand-made by spinning processing, and resonance mode is not concentrated in one place, but structurally dispersed.In addition, the front cover has eliminated the hard steel wire mesh to reduce unwanted radiation, and instead incorporates hard steel wire and copper wire into a hybrid structure to reduce unwanted resonance.TweeterA 2.3 cm dome type tweeter using the enhanced diffusion Boronized titanium DUD diaphragm is mounted in the high frequency band as well as the middle band.This unit uses a laminated tangential edge with a special coating on the edge part to suppress unwanted resonance and make the sound of the DUD diaphragm stand out.We have also improved the start-up characteristics by adopting the DM method for the frame.NetworkIn order to reduce the effects of electromagnetic interference between network circuits and vibration of the enclosure, a 3-piece separation division system is adopted for the network section. The base material is a highly damped spruce material. In addition, a floating structure with damping material is adopted to attenuate vibration from the back plate.No soldering is used for the network wiring. At the same time, a oxygen-free copper sleeve crimping wiring is used to focus on the strain at the metallic interface. In addition, direct power is supplied to three units under the same conditions by radial power distribution.All wiring materials are linear crystalline copper wires with few copper crystal interfaces, and each element and arrangement are carefully selected.EnclosureA 40-mm-thick 2-layer laminate particleboard is used for the baffle plate of the enclosure, the rigidity of the body plate and the back plate is enhanced, and a distributed resonance structure is used to suppress resonance modes by utilizing computer analysis to enhance the rigidity of the entire enclosure.In addition, by carefully examining the chip structure of the particleboards themselves and carefully selecting ones with high internal loss, and by ensuring sufficient bending rigidity by using the three layer structure of the back plate with large internal pressure, damping characteristics are improved by dispersing the natural resonance of each plate, and beautiful damping is realized.The exterior features a beautiful wood-grain sassafras veneer finish.The mounting bolts of the unit are equipped with damping caps to eliminate the influence of resonance at the bolts.OtherAs an option sold separately, there was a speaker stand DK 2000 designed exclusively for DS 2000 hr.The DK 2000 uses the same high-density particleboards as the enclosure for the legs and a hybrid structure consisting of graphite cast iron and particleboards for the bottom.In addition, we focused on standing waves generated between the speaker bottom plate and the stand bottom and between the two legs. The stand bottom is rounded and the legs are arranged non-parallel.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-3000.
sections.overview: This is a 4-way speaker system that uses the excellent technology of Diatone to achieve high rigidity.The DS 3000 combines a high-speed, high-volume low-frequency sound with a rich sound field. The low-and medium-frequency sound is carried by an independent unit, and the woofer is used exclusively for the heavy low-frequency sound. This configuration also prevents the fundamental band from being intermodulated by low frequencies.WooferA 32 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.An aramid honeycomb diaphragm is used for the diaphragm.Aramid fiber is an aromatic polyamide fiber with low density, excellent tensile strength and high modulus, and excellent damping vibration characteristics. Aramid honeycomb diaphragm is made by sandwiching aluminum honeycomb core with skin material specially mixed with flexible resin to create a sandwich structure. This is light weight, high rigidity, and moderately large internal loss, preventing the occurrence of natural resonance of diaphragm itself and increasing vibration damping.In addition, the large thickness reduces distortion caused by non-axisymmetric split vibration and axisymmetric split vibration, and realizes rich low sound reproduction.DMM (Direct Magnet Circuit Mount) system is adopted for the frame part.In this system, the whole unit including the magnetic circuit is strongly supported from the rear by a strong aluminum die-cast frame, and the magnetic circuit and frame are virtually integrated. This suppresses the phenomenon that the magnetic circuit itself moves before anything when an input signal enters the voice coil, and transmits input energy to the diaphragm without loss.MidbusA 16 cm cone type mid-bus unit using an aramid honeycomb diaphragm is installed in the middle and low range.The DMM system is used for the frame part like the woofer.Mid-highA 5 cm dome type mid-high unit is installed in the middle and high area.DUD-boron diaphragm is used for the diaphragm.The DIATONE Unified Diaphram (DUD) is an integrated structure of a diaphragm and a voice coil bobbin. By winding the voice coil directly around the diaphragm, the driving force generated in the voice coil is transmitted to the diaphragm without any loss. This reduces high-frequency attenuation and improves response to input signals. In addition, it eliminates loss in adhesion and allows high resonance frequencies to be set.In addition, by obtaining a high heat radiation effect, it is possible to prevent an increase in conductor resistance caused by temperature rise, and to improve linearity and input resistance to input signals.Boron, the diaphragm material, is second only to diamond in hardness. It has high specific elastic modulus at high resonance frequency, and excellent durability and weather resistance. In addition, the non-metallic nature of boron, which is similar to porcelain, has the effect of suppressing the sharp, pinky sound peculiar to metal diaphragms. The DUD structure simplifies the resonance mode and realizes a no-treatment diaphragm without the absorber as a peak canceller.This diaphragm has been realized by the original deep drawing technology developed by Diatone, and has been successfully integrated with high precision of 1/100mm.DM (direct mount) system is adopted for the frame part.The DM method takes note of the fact that the magnetic circuit moves according to the input signal like the DUD method. Taking full advantage of the structure of the dome type unit itself, the magnetic circuit is mounted directly to the enclosure by the monocoque structure with the frame. By this, the input signal is transmitted to the diaphragm without loss, and the high-speed response realized by the DUD structure is further enhanced.TweeterThe high frequency band is equipped with a 2.3 cm dome type tweeter using DUD boron diaphragm similar to the middle and high frequency band.This unit also uses the DM system in the frame part to improve the start-up characteristics.NetworkHigh-purity oxygen-free copper wires are used for all internal connections and terminals of network circuits. In addition, oxygen-free copper is used for crimping sleeve to eliminate interface distortion between dissimilar metals, thereby improving sound quality from the signal system material itself.The input terminal uses the highest grade gold-plated terminal that can be used for very thick cables.EnclosureThe enclosure is made of Siberian pine plywood to provide a beautiful and natural sound while maintaining high rigidity. Siberian pine grown in cold regions has dense fibers and maintains high rigidity. In addition, it also has the beauty of sound attenuation unique to coniferous trees.In addition, we have reviewed the design of the mid-bus unit, which covers most of the fundamental band, and adopted a large back chamber focusing on the standing wave mode. In addition, we have adopted a round baffle in consideration of the characteristic disturbance caused by the diffraction effect.In consideration of the acoustic characteristics inside the enclosure, we use felt, a natural material with natural and gentle sound absorption, as the sound absorbing material.OtherThere was a speaker stand DK-5 designed exclusively for DS 3000 and DS 2000.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-5000
sections.overview: This is a speaker system developed by Diatone using all sound technology at that time.A 40 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.An aramid honeycomb diaphragm is used for the diaphragm. Aramid fiber has properties of high strength and high elasticity compared with conventional materials. Moreover, it has excellent characteristics such as low density and moderate internal loss. This aramid fiber is used as a skin material for honeycomb cone. It is impregnated with a special mixture of flexible resin so that the resin itself has a large internal loss. It is made into a honeycomb structure by sandwiching an aluminum honeycomb core. By this method, it is light in weight and high in rigidity, yet has a large internal loss compared with conventional materials. In addition, performance such as E / ? and internal loss is improved by improving the multi-tuning ventilation cell structure.The magnetic circuit is equipped with the largest magnet and realizes a total magnetic flux of 286,000 Maxwell.It is equipped with 25 cm cone type midbus in the middle and low range.As with the woofer unit, an aramid honeycomb diaphragm is used for the diaphragm, while the curved cone is used for the midbus to further increase the high-resonance frequency.A 6.5 cm dome type mid-high is installed in the middle and high area.A D. U. D. boron diaphragm is used for the diaphragm. This diaphragm realizes 1/100mm precision integrated molding processing by deep drawing of titanium using a unique molding method, and it is manufactured by subjecting it to high-temperature boronization processing. In addition, the diaphragm used for the DS 5000 has a powerful improvement on boron diffusion growth, and the boronization of the titanium base material is further promoted by crystal growth boron. This, combined with the rigidity of boron, suppresses the natural sound of metal titanium.In addition, we focus on the processing of the sound after leaving the diaphragm, and refine the sound to the range of distant sound separation by tuning suitable for the highest model.A 2.3 cm dome-shaped tweeter is installed in the high range.The diaphragm uses a D. U. D. boron dome diaphragm as well as the mid-range diaphragm. In addition, the DS 5000 has a 3-layer sandwich structure consisting of a suspension with a polymer damping sheet as a core material and a fiber film on both sides. This realizes high-speed response and improved transient characteristics.A non-resonant prepreg core is used for the inductor of the network, the highest-purity oxygen-free copper winding is used for the winding, and gold plated oxygen-free copper crimp terminals are used for the connecting parts focusing on gold with a small ionization tendency.Level control is provided for the middle and high frequencies.The enclosure uses a bass reflex system.The DS 5000 enclosure was developed with all the know-how of Diatone, and more than 40 pre-production cabinets have been developed and considered.The baffle plate is cross-laminated with high-quality lauan plywood. The other parts are made of Canadian softwood 2-ply particleboards. Solid walnut material is embedded in the center of the baffle plate to suppress intermodulation distortion caused by interference between middle and low frequencies.Two independent pairs of input terminals are provided for low-range and mid-range input terminals. Bi-amplifier connection is possible.There was an acoustic cube DK 5000 which is a stand developed exclusively and sold separately.The DK 5000 is made of Canadian maple (Canadian Maple), which has excellent vibration damping characteristics. Moreover, it has a lumbar core structure with 12 blocks. This makes vibration damping more beautiful. You can also adjust the bass characteristics by adjusting the setting method.Comes with oxygen-free copper spacer.In addition to the DS 5000, the DK 5000 can also be used as a setting block for DS 3000, DS 2000 k, DS-1000HR, floor type and bookshelf type speaker systems, CDs, audio equipment such as amplifiers, etc.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-10000
sections.overview:
* Order-made, limited to 300 sets  350,000 (1 unit, released in 1985)

This speaker system was developed with the aim of creating a speaker system with a heart of compassion that produces a warm sound like a musical instrument, by putting in all the technologies that Diatone engineers have and all the sensitivities they have.A 27 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The diaphragm is made of an aramid honeycomb curved cone. The honeycomb cone skin is made of a special matrix resin that contains a flexible resin reinforced with aramid fibers and has a large internal loss.The honeycomb structure is made by bonding the skin material with an aluminum honeycomb core, and the design is optimized by computer simulation. The diaphragm is curved, and the voice coil uses an edgewise coil with precision winding processing. This improves the effective energy and the sense of volume and texture in the low to middle and low range.In addition, Diatone's unique DMM structure is adopted in the frame part. The whole unit including the magnetic circuit is wrapped in a strong aluminum die-cast frame and supported from the rear. Thus, the magnetic circuit and frame are integrated. This completely suppresses the vibration of the magnetic circuit part and transmits input energy to the diaphragm without loss.Mid-range with 5 cm dome mid-range.The diaphragm uses a reinforced diffused boronized DUD diaphragm. By integrating the diaphragm and voice coil bobbin and winding the voice coil directly around the diaphragm, the high-speed response, input resistance, and transient characteristics are greatly improved. The edge uses a tangential edge with a three layer structure of butyl rubber and polyamide fiber with controlled hardness.The frame uses a DM system in which the magnet and frame are integrated to reduce the effect of vibration on the magnetic circuit.In addition, in the DS-10000, the acoustic cover, to which the back pressure from the diaphragm is directly applied, is formed by hand drawing, and the resonance mode is structurally dispersed so that it does not concentrate in one place. In addition, the sub-frame supporting the vibration system through the suspension is made of machined gunmetal with controlled vibration attenuation.A 2.3 cm dome-shaped tweeter is installed in the high range.The diaphragm of this unit uses the reinforced diffused boronized DUD with multi-stage drawing, which was first installed in the DS 5000. This multi-stage drawing allows maximum strength to be obtained with a limited vibration diameter, further expanding the excellent characteristics of the diaphragm.As with the mid-range, the sub-frame uses parts made of carved gunmetal. In addition to the strict dimensional accuracy of the movement, the vibration damping of the gunmetal itself realizes high frequency reproduction with a beautiful afterglow.All wires in the network section are made of extremely thick linear crystalline oxygen-free copper wires with sufficient wire diameter. All sleeves of the crimping wire are gold-plated to eliminate the metallic boundary strain of the current. In addition, the radial power supply system is adopted to enable the proper current supply to each unit from the thorough review of current density. Thus, the performance and reliability are thoroughly improved.In addition, the network circuit uses a particularly large MP capacitor, and is designed taking into consideration the electromagnetic coupling between the inductors and the modulation caused by the internal pressure of the speaker. In addition, the base material is made of spruce with beautiful attenuation characteristics, and a three piece separation and division structure is adopted.The front and rear baffles of the enclosure are made of spruce, which is used as a piano soundboard. In order to match the material characteristics of spruce with the high rigidity unit, the DS-10000 is adopted as a lumber core structure. In addition, the direction of each lumber core material is changed to disperse the resonance mode between the baffle and the rear.The surface of the DS-10000 has a jet-black finish in consideration of acoustic characteristics. The paint used in the DS-10000 has sufficient surface hardness compared with commonly used urethane paint, improving the speed of attack and resolution.Also comes with polishing wax and polishing cloth.The DS-10000 is primary aged one by one.There was a specially designed speaker stand that was sold separately.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-V5000
sections.overview:
550,000 (1 unit, released in November 1989)

This 4-way floor type speaker system was developed as the second product of the DS-V series by introducing Diatone technology.It has a 32 cm cone woofer in the low range and an 18 cm cone midbus unit in the middle and low range.Super Aramid Honeycomb diaphragm made of Super Aramid Fiber is used for the diaphragm of Woofer and Midbus.Super Aramid Fiber has high strength, excellent vibration damping characteristics, low mass (25% lighter than carbon fiber), and a large increase in elastic modulus of 40%. Super Aramid Fiber is used as the skin material of honeycomb vibration plate and is hybrid structure with excellent core material to ensure excellent specific elastic modulus and moderate internal loss equal to paper.The A.D. M.C. - I (Advanced Magnet Circuit-impulse) is used for the magnetic circuit of Woofer and Midbus.In the A. D. M. C., AC magnetic flux from the voice coil is offset by double conductive rings on the center pole. This suppresses magnetostriction caused by the superposition of DC magnetic flux and AC magnetic flux. In addition, disturbance of DC magnetic flux due to AC magnetic flux in the magnetic circuit is also reduced. Stability and low distortion are realized.The A.D. M.C. - I developed the basic theory of the A.D. M.C. and realized high-speed response by adding the examination of AC magnetic field analysis. In A.D. M.C. - I, response to input signals is increased by placing a strain suppression ring with optimum dimensions, shape and property values. In addition, the AC magnetic flux density component passing through the magnet is minimized, and vibration at the operating point of the magnetic circuit due to DC magnetic flux is suppressed, thereby stabilizing the operation of the magnetic circuit against transient response. In addition, stability in the time domain against AC magnetic field is improved by suppressing the total amount of generated AC magnetic flux density component and improving symmetry.The midbus unit is provided with a magnetic shielding of spheroidal graphite cast iron to eliminate electromagnetic interference.A back chamber is also used to prevent interference caused by internal standing waves.A 6.0 cm dome mid-high unit is installed in the middle and high range, and a 2.3 cm dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.B for the diaphragm of mid-high and tweeter4C (pure boron) diaphragm is adopted.B4C is 5 times as large as that of titanium and 2.2 times as large as that of a titanium boronized diaphragm (sound velocity value 12.1 ? 10).11cm2/sec2The sound velocity, which indicates the propagation speed of sound, has excellent physical properties exceeding 11,000m/sec in actual measurement. Moreover, the internal loss has a high value that cannot be achieved with a metal-based diaphragm. However, B4While C has excellent properties, it has a very high melting point of 2,450 ?, which makes it extremely difficult to form it into a dome shape.In diatone, B is produced by a unique plasma spraying method.4C is melted in an ultra-high-temperature plasma flame of 15,000 ? or higher, and sprayed at high speed onto the surface of an object to form a film. After spraying, it is fired at high temperature in an inert gas atmosphere to produce B4By strengthening the coupling between C particles, a pure boron diaphragm with uniformly distributed pores has been realized.B4In order to make the best use of the superior characteristics of the C-diaphragm, the Mid-High and Tweeter are equipped with a high-rigidity diaphragm structure D. U. D and a high-rigidity unit structure D. M. (direct mount).In the D. U. D structure, the driving force generated in the voice coil can be transmitted without loss by integrating the diaphragm and voice coil bobbin, and it is firmly mounted in the enclosure in the D. M., and the monocoque structure directly mounting the plate part of the magnetic circuit realizes a robust unit.The protective nets for the mid-high and tweeter use a hybrid structure of hard steel wire and copper wire.A flat surface is used to reduce the adverse effect on sound caused by the unevenness of the frame. A vibration-proof cap with fewer protrusions is attached to the set screw that mounts the unit to the enclosure to provide continuity with the frame, thereby suppressing the diffraction of sound waves and preventing reflection.In addition to the use of damping material for the set screw, we also use special paint with damping effect for unnecessary radiation from the frame and plate to completely suppress unnecessary radiation.If the units are arranged close to each other in order to realize the optimum sound image localization of a 4-way 4-speaker system, the frames of the middle and low frequency units will disturb the sound radiation of the middle and high frequency units.In order to prevent this, an elastic material with less unnecessary radiation is used for the middle and low frequency frames, and diffraction is effectively prevented by providing a large number of small spherical projections on the surface of which the shape and dimensions of the optimum micro-domains are calculated.The network section is designed by computer simulation and uses components with minimal DC resistance and distortion.It uses capacitors that have been selected through repeated measurements and viewing, crimping wiring with a oxygen-free copper wire sleeve that reduces metal-interface distortion and realizes high reliability, and high-purity oxygen-free copper is used for internal wiring.Uses a large gold plated input terminal.The front baffle is a large rounded baffle made of 38 mm thick Siberian karamatsu wood cross-glued with a solid and beautiful sound. The rear baffle is made of Sitka spruce lumber core with excellent attenuation and beautiful sound used in piano materials. The other parts are made of Canadian conifer 2-ply particle board.In addition, walnut veneer is pasted on both sides of each plate to realize high rigidity and weather resistance.The top panel of the enclosure uses a solid material set-in structure with excellent damping characteristics and emphasis on beautiful sound, and the acoustic strength of the cabinet edge is improved.The internal structure adopts the Diatone traditional distributed resonance structure.Exterior is finished with urethane coating.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-V9000
sections.overview:
1,000,000 (1 unit, sold in November 1988)  933,000 (1 unit, around 1989)

This floor-type speaker system was developed by bringing together the best of Diatone acoustic technology.It has a 40 cm cone woofer in the low range and a 25 cm cone midbus unit in the middle and low range.The Woofer and Midbus use Advanced Intraply Hybrid Honeycomb Diaphragm.This diaphragm is based on the Intra-Ply hybrid honeycomb diaphragm which pursues high-speed reproduction capability by high rigidity of the front skin, moderate loss, and attenuation beauty after the signal disappears by the uraskin.In the advanced intra-ply hybrid honeycomb diaphragm, the front skin is overlaid with an aromatic polyamide aramid and PAN-based high-strength carbon fiber intra-ply and a new aromatic polyamide aramid. In addition, the back skin is also overlaid with an aromatic polyamide aramid, and an aluminum honeycomb core is sandwiched in a double hybrid structure. This realizes a diaphragm that takes advantage of the characteristics of aromatic polyamide aramid with high strength rigidity, light weight and moderate internal loss, and the advantages of PAN-based high-strength carbon fiber with extremely high specific elastic modulus.The A.D. M.C. (Advanced Magnetic Circuit) is used for the magnetic circuit of Woofer and Midbus.This magnetic circuit was realized by analyzing and pursuing various magnetic circuits such as ferrite, alnico, and anti-magnetic type from various viewpoints such as complex method and finite element method. It is intended to reduce magnetic distortion caused by distribution shape of DC magnetic flux, current distortion due to AC magnetic flux of voice coil current, AC component in magnetic flux, etc.In the A. D. M. C., the center pole shape has been revised in order to enhance the symmetry of the DC magnetic flux distribution shape crossing the voice coil. The AC magnetic flux is offset by arranging conductive short rings above and below the center pole. This suppresses the magnetic fluctuation caused by the superposition of DC and AC, stabilizes the magnetic circuit, and reduces harmonic distortion. In addition, the adverse effect of AC magnetic flux in the magnet on the DC magnetic field is also suppressed.Additionally, the Woofer and Midbus use Advanced D. M. M. (Direct Magnet Circuit Mount).In the D. M. M., the whole magnetic circuit is firmly fixed by the frame in order to aim at high rigidity of the unit, and excellent start-up characteristics are realized. The Advanced D. M. M. is a further development of this. The rigidity of the magnetic circuit is high for the fundamental wave, and the osae komi of the magnetic circuit is stable, and for the higher mode, the damping is fast and natural. This suppresses the natural sound of the center pole and the natural sound of the frame that stains the middle and high range, and realizes high-resolution reproduction with good S/N.A 6.5 cm dome mid-high unit is installed in the middle and high range, and a 2.3 cm dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.B for mid-high and tweeter4C (pure boron) diaphragm is adopted.Pure Boron has a specific elastic modulus 5 times that of titanium and 2.2 times that of Boronized titanium. It also has an appropriate internal loss due to its nonmetal nature. However, because of its extremely high melting point of 2,450 ?, it was impossible to mold it into a dome shape using conventional technology.Diatone solves this problem by plasma spraying at a high temperature of 15,000 ? using a unique plasma spraying method, followed by high-temperature firing in an inert gas atmosphere.4A pure boron diaphragm with strong bonding between C particles and few voids has been realized.B4In order to make the best use of the C-diaphragm characteristics, the Mid-high and Tweeter units have D. U. D. and D. M. structures.The D. U. D structure can transmit the driving force generated in the voice coil to the diaphragm without loss, resulting in less attenuation in the high-frequency range and improved response to input signals. In addition, it can set the high-frequency resonance frequency to be high, and the linearity and input resistance to input signals can be improved by high heat radiation effect.In addition, the D. M. (direct mount) structure is a high-rigidity unit structure unique to Diatone. The monocoque structure, in which the plate part of the magnetic circuit is made into a mount plate, allows the magnetic circuit to be mounted directly in the enclosure, making the rigidity of the whole unit high.The magnetic shielding covers of all units are made of spheroidal graphite cast iron, which has excellent magnetic properties, a high balance of high rigidity and damping properties, and is also used for piano frames, etc., to prevent magnetic interference from the outside.In order to minimize the effects of magnetic interference and vibration on the network, the network section is divided into two sections. After that, we thoroughly review the body materials and determine the layout.All network circuits are made of the highest-purity oxygen-free copper wire, and the same oxygen-free copper wire is used for wiring. In addition, the connection by sleeve crimping method and direct balance power supply method are adopted to suppress the deterioration of sound quality in the network section.Two separate sets of input terminals for low frequency and high / high frequency band are mounted for bi-amplifier connection.All terminals are gold-plated.In order to prevent mutual interference between units inside the enclosure, a round-shaped back chamber is installed around the midbus, and the rear of the midbus unit is made into an independent space. It is made of a material that is highly rigid yet has a beautiful sound. Moreover, the perfect R-shape realizes a highly rigid structure that resists back pressure.In addition, by controlling the radiation impedance at the back of the unit, it contributes to suppressing standing waves in the vertical direction in the cabinet.Sound radiation analysis is used to determine the optimal placement of each unit in the enclosure. The structure of the entire enclosure is also thoroughly examined, and the high-rigidity method is advanced in every corner while the damping characteristics are further pursued.The front baffle is made of 38 mm thick Siberian Karamatsu Plywood with excellent damping characteristics and beautiful sound. In addition, computer analysis is used to enhance the rigidity of the front baffle. At the same time, the four corners of the enclosure are reinforced with highly rigid Tamo Sawn Board.A dedicated acoustic base is included.

sections.title: DIATONE DP-EC1
sections.overview: A record player that achieves both basic performance and automatic mechanism by introducing EC (Electronic Control) system.In order to maintain high basic performance even after automation, we have adopted a non-contact arm position detection mechanism that does not apply any side pressure to the arm.Since the arm lifter is designed to operate while detecting the state of the arm lifter (whether the arm is up or down) and the position of the arm within the horizontal drive without contact, automatic operation is possible from any position. In addition, manual operation is possible without switching between auto and manual operation except when the arm is moving with auto.The system uses a reflector to detect the size of a record. In this system, a reflector (prism) emits light from obliquely above the record, guides the light to a sensor corresponding to each record size, and sends the output from the sensor to a logic circuit to determine the size of the record.This size detection mechanism automatically determines the needle down position, performance end position, and turntable rotation speed during automatic performance.A true black switch is used for the control knob.The automatic mechanism is controlled by an IC-based logic circuit. This control section is composed of a combination of highly reliable ICs to eliminate problems such as wear and misalignment.The tone arm is equipped with a unique mechanism that incorporates a damper inside the counterweight to damp resonance. In addition, the rigidity of the pipe section is increased by using a stronger stainless steel pipe instead of conventional aluminum pipe.The plug-in part for attaching the head shell adopts a chuck type plug-in mechanism, and by tightening the head shell from four directions, the connection between the head shell and the pipe part is more reliable.In addition, by expanding the span of the vertical pivot and adopting a full-scale radial ball bearing for water plain bearing, the force acting in the direction of pulling and twisting the pipe is reduced.Separate motors for the horizontal and vertical directions are used to drive the tone arm to prevent it from affecting the turntable drive system.The drive motor is a direct drive motor that uses an integral type FG method for detecting rotational speed (a method that converts rotational speed into frequency for detection). In addition, the direct drive type has a disadvantage in torque because it does not have a reduction mechanism, but by using a DC motor with a starting torque of 1.2 starting torque of kg ? cm.In addition to the 1.8 kg turntable, consideration has been given to the turntable seat.The turntable sheet is designed to have a slight mortar shape based on the results of the examination of hardness, specific gravity, thickness and adhesion to the record and sound quality. The material is determined based on the tone arm and other properties, and is designed to have a maximum thickness of 5.5 mm, specific gravity of 2.0, and hardness of 40.Electronic slide system using LED is adopted.In the case of a strobe device using a neon lamp, since the light emission time is long, the stroboscopic stripes move during the light emission, causing blurring. To reduce this blurring, an electronic circuit generates a signal with a pulse width as short as 1/1000 second using a commercial frequency and drives the LED by this signal.It is equipped with an electronic muting mechanism.Uses precision die-cast base.
