sections.title: DIATONE DP-EC1MKII
sections.overview: An EC (electronically controlled) full auto player released as a successor to the DP-EC1.The counter weight of the tone arm has a built-in anti-resonance filter. This anti-resonance mechanism reduces resonance in the 30 Hz to 80 Hz range and improves resolution in the low frequency range.In addition, stainless steel pipe with high rigidity is adopted for the pipe arm instead of the conventional aluminum pipe, and it is combined with the counter weight with the damper built-in, and the deflection of the pipe part is almost eliminated.A force is applied to the tone arm in the direction of twisting or pulling the pipe. If the pivot is loose at this time, these forces will be applied to the needle tip and the sound quality will deteriorate. To prevent this, the span of the pivot is expanded, and a full-scale radial ball bearing is used for water plain bearing. This eliminates the looseness of the pipe and suppresses resonance.The tone arm is driven by two separate motors, one for horizontal direction and the other for vertical direction.All the conductors in the arm and the head shell are made of pure silver wire with special coating, which reduces DC resistance and improves the sound rise to improve the sound quality in the mid and high range.The head shell is made of magnesium alloy.The automatic record size detection mechanism uses an optical system to detect the record size without touching the record.The principle of this automatic record size detection mechanism is that a reflector emits light from obliquely above a record and guides the light to a sensor corresponding to each record size. The light to the sensor is blocked or emitted depending on the record size, and its output changes depending on the record size. The output from the sensor is then sent to a logic circuit that determines the size of the record. Then, the needle down position, performance end position, and rotation speed of the automatic performance are determined automatically.In addition, with DP-EC1mkII, it is possible to finely adjust the position of the needle effect on the record board by pressing the button.The DP-EC1mkII is designed to operate without contact at all times while detecting the state of the arm lifter (up / down) and the horizontal position of the arm, so that it can operate automatically from any position.Manual operation is possible without switching between Auto and Manual except when the arm is moved by Auto operation.Equipped with a quick response mechanism, even when the arm is moving up or down in automatic operation, if you instruct a new operation with the button, you can immediately move to the next operation.A quartz PLL system is used to control the rotation of the turntable. In this system, the rotation speed of the motor is controlled by a high-precision reference signal from a crystal oscillator. The motor also uses a 4-phase 12-pole quartz PLL / DC servo motor with a starting torque of 1.2 kg ? cm.The turntable has an outer diameter of 333 mm, a weight of 1.8 kg, and an inertial mass of 353g-cmS.2Turntable is adopted.With an emphasis on record adhesion, it uses a turntable sheet designed slightly above the mortar. As the material of this sheet, it uses NBR flexible sheet which was selected after consideration of hardness and specific gravity. It has a thickness of 5 mm, specific gravity of 1.5, and hardness of 45.The electronic flash unit uses the quartz oscillation frequency to generate a signal with a pulse width as short as 1/1000 second and drives the green LE.By gathering all operation buttons on the front of the cabinet, it can be operated even with the dust cover closed.The cabinet consists of a die-cast player board combined with a wooden laminate board, and the bottom lid is made of a heavy resinamic material.Equipped with a muting mechanism to cut noise.Equipped with a needle tip protection mechanism, the tone arm does not come down even if you lead in when there is no record on the turntable.

sections.title: DIATONE DP-EC1MKIII
sections.overview: A full auto player based on DP-EC1mkII with further improvements.An electronically controlled full-auto mechanism allows all tone arm operations to be controlled simply by pressing the operation buttons. In addition, a single-chip LSI circuit is used for quick and accurate response.It uses an automatic record size detection mechanism by applying an optical system.In this system, the reflector emits light from obliquely above and guides the light from the turntable seat reflector to the sensor. This light is emitted or blocked depending on the size of the record and changes the output of the sensor. This output is sent to a logic circuit that automatically detects the record size.Based on the detected record size, the needle down position and rotation speed are automatically determined.Equipped with a quick response function, it operates while always detecting the condition of the arm lifter and arm. Therefore, it is possible to perform auto operation from any position. Thus, even when the arm is ascending or descending in auto operation, if you indicate the next new operation with the button, it will move immediately to that operation.For button operation, feather touch type using micro switch is adopted.Equipped with a muting mechanism to cut noise.In order to suppress the resonance of the tone arm, a weight case and a butyl rubber damper are added to the structure of the needle pressure knob and main weight, and an anti-resonance filter is adopted. In addition, by expanding the span of the pivot, looseness of the pipe part is eliminated, and high sensitivity is achieved in both vertical and horizontal directions.The tone arm is driven by a dedicated motor that is independent in both horizontal and vertical directions.Titanium alloy is used for the material of the tone arm.Special coated OFC (oxygen-free conductor) is used for the inner arm conductor and head shell conductor.The head shell uses a magnesium alloy head shell.The turntable is driven by a quartz PLL system that controls the number of revolutions of the motor according to the reference signal of the crystal oscillator.A high-torque DC servo motor with a precisely finished bearing mechanism is used as the drive motor.The cabinet structure is a combination of die-casting, wooden frame, and resinamic.In consideration of the effect of the turntable sheet on playback sound, we have adopted a turntable sheet that has been examined from both the shape and material. This sheet is slightly mortar-shaped in consideration of the thickness and warpage of the record to enhance adhesion with the record. In addition, in consideration of the material, hardness and specific gravity, etc., we have adopted a filled SBR sheet.

sections.title: DIATONE DP-EC3
sections.overview: EC (electronic control) full auto player developed by inheriting the technology of DP-EC1mkII.The counter weight of the tone arm has a built-in anti-resonance filter. This anti-resonance mechanism reduces resonance in the 30 Hz to 80 Hz range and improves resolution in the low frequency range.In addition, stainless steel pipe with high rigidity is adopted for the pipe arm instead of the conventional aluminum pipe, and it is combined with the counter weight with the damper built-in, and the deflection of the pipe part is almost eliminated.A force is applied to the tone arm in the direction of twisting or pulling the pipe. If the pivot is loose at this time, these forces will be applied to the needle tip and the sound quality will deteriorate. To prevent this, the span of the pivot is expanded, and a full-scale radial ball bearing is used for water plain bearing. This eliminates the looseness of the pipe and suppresses resonance.The tone arm is driven by two separate motors, one for horizontal direction and the other for vertical direction.Sound quality is improved by keeping the total DC resistance from the head shell to the output cord and pin plug low.The head shell is made of magnesium alloy.The automatic record size detection mechanism uses an optical system to detect the record size without touching the record.The principle of this automatic record size detection mechanism is that a reflector emits light from obliquely above a record and guides the light to a sensor corresponding to each record size. The light to the sensor is blocked or emitted depending on the record size, and its output changes depending on the record size. The output from the sensor is then sent to a logic circuit, which determines the size of the record. Then, the needle down position and the end position of the automatic performance are determined automatically.For DP-EC3, the rotational speed is manually determined.The DP-EC3 is designed to operate without contact at all times while detecting the state of the arm lifter (up / down) and the horizontal position of the arm, so that it can operate automatically from any position.Manual operation is possible without switching between Auto and Manual except when the arm is moved by Auto operation.Equipped with a quick response mechanism, even when the arm is moving up or down in automatic operation, if you instruct a new operation with the button, you can immediately move to the next operation.A quartz PLL system is used to control the rotation of the turntable. In this system, the rotation speed of the motor is controlled by a high-precision reference signal from a crystal oscillator. The motor also uses a 4-phase 12-pole quartz PLL / DC servo motor with a starting torque of 1.2 kg ? cm.The turntable has an outer diameter of 333 mm, a weight of 1.8 kg, and an inertial mass of 353g-cmS.2Turntable is adopted.The electronic flash unit uses the quartz oscillation frequency to generate a signal with a pulse width as short as 1/1000 second and drives the green LE.By gathering all operation buttons on the front of the cabinet, it can be operated even with the dust cover closed.The cabinet is a triple structure cabinet using die-casting, wooden frame and reginamic.Equipped with a muting mechanism to cut noise.Equipped with a needle tip protection mechanism, the tone arm does not come down even if you lead in when there is no record on the turntable.

sections.title: DIATONE LT-1
sections.overview: A linear tracking system full auto player developed by gathering DIATONE technology.It employs a linear tracking system in which the arm moves linearly on the record board in the same way as the cutting machine. In this system, the tangential direction of the groove is accurately traced, so tracking error and harmonic distortion can be reduced. In addition, since there is no inside force, the needle tip can contact the object, so that overall tracking capability can be improved.A stainless steel wire is used for the drive of the moving base that fixes the tone arm. This wire combines 49 fine wires of 0.05 mm diameter with nylon coating to obtain excellent durability and flexibility.Tracking error is detected by the potential difference between the two photodiode outputs at the rear of the arm, and the error angle is suppressed to 0.03   to 0.05  .As for the vibration caused by the movement of the arm base, the vibration generated in the moving base of the arm should be minimized. Second, the vibration generated in the moving base should not be transmitted to the needle tip.Therefore, prior to designing, we have modeled a movement-based mechanism, established equations of motion, and conducted computer simulations to optimize the actual values of each element. We have also carefully determined the position of the optimum driving point and the position of the arm support point based on the center of impact theory.It uses an electronically controlled full-auto mechanism. This allows all tone arm operations to be controlled simply by pressing the operation button. The circuit uses a 1-chip LSI for quick and accurate response.It uses an automatic record size detection mechanism by applying an optical system.In this system, the reflector emits light from obliquely above and guides the light from the turntable seat reflector to the sensor. This light is emitted or blocked depending on the size of the record and changes the output of the sensor. This output is sent to a logic circuit that automatically detects the record size.Based on the detected record size, the needle down position and rotation speed are automatically determined.Equipped with a quick response function, it operates while always detecting the condition of the arm lifter and arm. Therefore, it is possible to perform auto operation from any position. Thus, even when the arm is ascending or descending in auto operation, if you indicate the next new operation with the button, it will move immediately to that operation.For button operation, feather touch type using micro switch is adopted.Equipped with a muting mechanism to cut noise.In order to suppress the resonance of the tone arm, a weight case and a butyl rubber damper are added to the structure of the needle pressure knob and main weight, and an anti-resonance filter is adopted. In addition, by expanding the span of the pivot, looseness of the pipe part is eliminated, and high sensitivity is achieved in both vertical and horizontal directions.Titanium alloy is used for the material of the tone arm.Special coated OFC (oxygen-free conductor) is used for the inner arm conductor and head shell conductor.The turntable has a double-metal structure consisting of an aluminum die-cast turntable and a stainless steel plate. When vibration occurs on the turntable, slip occurs between the two metals and vibration energy is consumed to reduce vibration.The turntable is driven by a quartz PLL system that controls the number of revolutions of the motor according to the reference signal of the crystal oscillator.A high-torque DC servo motor with a precisely finished bearing mechanism is used as the drive motor.The cabinet structure consists of a die-cast player board and a 40-mm-thick laminate fixed to it.Weight 700g Equipped with brass disk stabilizers to promote close contact between the record board and the sheet, improving the SN ratio and resolution in the low frequency range.

sections.title: DIATONE LT-5V
sections.overview:
LT-5V :   69,800 (around 1979)LT-5VC :   79,800 (around 1979)

A vertical-type record player that uses a linear tracking system.There were 2 types, LT-5V without cartridge and LT-5VC with Diatone original cartridge MM-2 made by Orthophone.The LT-5V has a vertical structure that is rare for a record player.In a typical horizontal player, since the direction of vibration of the cartridge and the direction of floor vibration are the same, when mechanical vibration caused by tracing of the sound groove is converted into electrical signal by the cartridge, floor vibration is combined with the reproduced signal, which causes howling phenomenon.On the other hand, the vertical player has a structure that is resistant to howling because the direction of floor vibration does not interfere with the direction of vibration for the cartridge to generate power.Since the direction of the weight of the cartridge is different from the direction of the needle pressure, once the appropriate needle pressure is set, there is almost no trouble of readjusting the needle pressure even if the cartridge is replaced.The tone arm uses a linear tracking system. In this system, the tone arm is moved horizontally along with the fulcrum, so it operates in exactly the same way as a cutting machine that cuts a sound groove in the original record.The LT-5V consists of two parts : an optical sensor part that detects the verticality of the tone arm and a drive part that operates the tone arm based on commands from the tracking servo circuit. First, an optical sensor detects the verticality of the tone arm part and the base part, which are supported from the arm base in the direction of gravity (downward), and the output generated by the angle difference is transmitted to the tracking servo circuit. The optical sensor that quickly reacts to even slight angle difference and the tracking servo circuit with high accuracy rotate the horizontal drive motor accurately.The optical sensor is designed to detect the verticality of the tone arm by engineering using the outputs of two highly sensitive photo-couplers.The tone arm uses a short and straight type stainless steel arm with high rigidity and low inertial mass to reduce partial resonance and compound resonance.In order to securely hold the record on the turntable, the record holder is equipped with a special stopper combined with a spring, and the shape of the Center shaft connected to the stopper is also modified.In addition, by making the turntable seat into a slightly mortar shape, it is possible to firmly support even a record with a sled.The turntable is driven by a double flywheel drive system, which combines a flywheel on the back of the turntable to improve the moment of inertia and is driven by a PLL / DC servo motor.In addition, stable rotation is achieved by balancing each piece with high precision using a balancing machine.The full auto mechanism adopts optical sensing logic control by LSI developed by Diatone.In the automatic record size detection mechanism, the light emitted from the reflector reacts with the sensor corresponding to each record size. The output from the sensor is then sent to the logic circuit, which automatically detects the record size and also determines the position at which the needle drops at the start of the performance, the position at which the performance ends, and the number of revolutions.In addition, it is equipped with a needle tip protection function, so that even if the operation button is pressed by mistake when the record board is not set on the turntable, the needle will return to the armrest without going down to the turntable.Equipped with muting function to cut unpleasant click noise when record is inserted.It is equipped with an optical display which shows the movement of the tone arm in real time with LED.It is equipped with a tracking monitor to check the verticality of the tone arm. When a tracking error occurs, it is quickly caught and an LED warning is issued.

FM tuner using quartz PLL synthesizer system.Quartz PLL synthesizer system is adopted, and the local oscillation frequency is controlled by 100 kHz basic signal which is 1/64 of the high precision crystal (6.4 MHz) as oscillator. sections.title: DIATONE M-F01
sections.overview: FM stereo tuner using quartz PLL synthesizer system.A quartz PLL synthesizer method is used. In this method, a 100 kHz reference signal is produced by reducing the frequency of a 6.4 MHz signal obtained from a crystal oscillator with high frequency accuracy to 1/64 with a frequency divider. The phase of this 100 kHz pulse is compared with the phase of the local oscillator output, and if there is a phase difference, the local oscillation frequency is controlled so that the phase difference becomes small.A pilot cancel type stereo demodulator is used.This pilot cancellation method cancels the pilot signal by adding a pilot signal of opposite phase to the input of the decoder, so that the output of the stereo demodulator does not leak the 19 kHz pilot signal.The front end section uses a special precision 5-row varicon for FM to obtain accurate dial accuracy and stability.We have also obtained excellent spurious and intermodulation interference characteristics by using carefully selected dual-gate MOS FETs with low noise figure for the high-frequency amplification stage and mixing stage, a double-tuned circuit for the RF tuning circuit, and a 4-pole phase-linear LC filter for the mixer transformer.The local oscillator circuit uses an oscillation coil with an aluminum core and a Teflon trimmer capacitor, and these components are mounted on a glass-epoxy board.The IF stage employs a 4-pole phase-linear LC filter with a linear phase over a wide frequency range.The new design of the discli-transformer and PLL MPX IC realizes excellent characteristics.It has a built-in air check oscillator (calibrator) that oscillates the signal sound of 440 Hz at the same output as that of 50% FM modulation.

sections.overview: A bookshelf type speaker system that is compact but pursues excellent localization and sound quality.By lowering the "fo" (lowest resonance frequency) of the system to 80 Hz, we aim to enhance the low-frequency range and achieve a well-balanced playback sound. In addition, by devising the installation method as shown in the figure (below), it is possible to achieve superior low-frequency playback.A 10 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The edge of this unit is made of butyl rubber with little distortion even for large amplitude. sections.title: DIATONE DS-28B
sections.overview: A speaker system developed to realize dynamic and high-presence playback.A 25 cm cone type woofer, PW 2521 bma, is mounted in the low range.The cone paper of this unit is composed of a mixture of three kinds of pulp and moderately beaten Japanese paper with excellent physical properties placed as a key point. It realizes a diaphragm for sealed use with both airtightness and moderate loss.In addition, the U-shaped edge with excellent dynamic linearity is used for the edge. The neutral position of this edge is slightly shifted in the stationary state so that the neutral position can be kept well in the operating state. In addition, the newly developed material is used. Various aspects such as the study of the physical properties of the fiber itself, the thickness of the fiber for a non-directional weave, and the ratio of warp and weft are examined. The surface of the edge is coated with a mixture of thermosetting resin and viscoelastic resin in several times, and a special damping treatment is applied at the final finish to ensure smooth movement.The magnetic circuit uses an expensive Alnico cast magnet to reduce distortion and stabilize dynamic characteristics. In addition, the magnet material uses MK magnet (made by Mitsubishi Steel) with large BH product developed for high-grade speakers.A 4 mm thick aluminum die-cast frame is used for the frame to reduce the natural vibration of the frame and unnecessary sound emission from the frame itself.The mid-range is equipped with PM-1021CM which is a 10 cm cone type squaker.A catenary curved cone is used for the cone. The cone section of this cone follows the catenary curve. When the cone paper is panned from pulp, it is panned in a very natural manner so that no strain occurs inside the fiber. In addition, since the stress vector generated inside the cone from the voice coil to the edge direction follows a natural form, no abnormal or natural vibration occurs, and smooth characteristics and stable physical properties are obtained. In addition, by adopting a matched resonant type with corrugation, a wide range of directional characteristics and cone strength are obtained.In addition, the center cap is subjected to a damping treatment to suppress the natural vibration of the cap itself by analyzing the vibration mode using laser holography, thereby suppressing the radiation of strain sound from the center cap and adverse effects on the vibration of the cone paper.V-shaped Cross Edge is used for the edge part. This edge is V-shaped considering that it has excellent linearity within the practical range of amplitude and is strong against lateral vibration. Thick fiber is used for the material to realize the edge with high stiffness. In addition, by coating damping and quantity on this V-shaped Cross Edge, airtightness is increased and linearity is further improved. This V-shaped Cross Edge greatly improves linearity at small amplitude.This unit is equipped with a fully enclosed back chamber in the rear part of the diaphragm. By using an acoustic load type in which sound absorbing material is filled in the air quality, interference with the woofer is suppressed and intermodulation distortion is reduced.A 3 cm dome type tweeter, DH-2203CMA, is mounted in the high range.A polyester resin diaphragm is used for the diaphragm. This material was determined by vibration analysis of the diaphragm using laser holography. Since it has appropriate rigidity and internal loss, it has high efficiency and smooth characteristics.In addition, in order to prevent performance degradation due to rolling phenomenon and aging, a very narrow straight edge is adopted at the edge. This straight edge is supported by a unique sandwich structure and fixed via an elastic body, thereby eliminating abnormal resonance and unnecessary sound at the edge.The network section uses a soft displacement type coil with no change in sound quality from low level to high level and good sound expansion even with large input.In addition to improving sound transparency, we have adopted a bipolar capacitor that uses plain foils, which are highly reliable even under the influence of Dainyu.Level control is provided for the middle and high frequencies.The enclosure is hermetically sealed and has a unique distributed resonant structure.In the distributed resonance enclosure, the vibration pattern of the cabinet is physically analyzed and the reinforcement elements are unevenly distributed. No simple joining methods are used in the cabinet joint structure, and all joints are made with a strong structure requiring advanced woodworking techniques. This disperses the resonance modes and prevents the cabinet from resonating too much in a certain bandwidth.The cabinet is made of high-density multi-layer particleboards with excellent acoustic characteristics.The front baffle has an edge-less structure.Instead of the recessed front baffle used in conventional speakers, the edge around the baffle plate has been removed to improve directional characteristics.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-32B
sections.overview: This bookshelf speaker system offers a wide range and a wide dynamic range.A 25 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.This unit uses a low-distortion magnetic circuit equipped with an FN ring, which is also used in the DS-35BmkII, etc., to greatly reduce the distortion of the magnetic circuit. In addition, by installing a 120 mm diameter magnet in the magnetic circuit, the amplitude distortion is suppressed and a damped low sound is obtained.In addition, in order to realize the slow low sound reproduction characteristic of the bass reflex system, the press pressure of the cone paper is relatively low and close to non-press. The voice coil is equipped with a damping ring made of special synthetic rubber, which increases internal loss and reduces noise turbidity caused by unwanted sound.Die-cast frame is used for the frame.The mid-range is equipped with a 10 cm cone type squaker.The diaphragm of this unit is designed to conform to a catenary curve and to a matched resonance type by arranging corrugation. In addition, the dry press method is adopted to obtain the appropriate hardness and internal loss, and each fiber is connected together without being damaged in an unforced state.The edge has a V-shaped edge that has excellent linearity with a small amplitude within the practical range and is strong against lateral vibration. In addition, the material is a Cross Edge made of thick fiber. It is subjected to a damping treatment to realize bright and extended middle and high frequency reproduction.A 4-cm cone type tweeter is installed in the high range.In addition to the small aperture of 4 cm in order to improve the directional characteristics, the center cap is made of titanium with excellent rigidity to suppress the generation of split vibration. As a result, almost flat characteristics are obtained up to 30 khz frequency band.The damper is mechanically braked with special synthetic rubber, and combined with electromagnetic braking by a powerful magnetic circuit to achieve high temperature with effective damping.Aluminum die-cast is used for the frame.The network section is designed to be low distortion and is designed by repeating physical and hearing tests.The parts include a core coil with low transmission loss and a metallized polyester film capacitor with low distortion.Equipped with level controls for the middle and high frequencies, each of which can be switched in four stages.The front baffle has a symmetrical unit layout with the squaker and tweeter positioned slightly inward from the center line of the baffle plate to improve sound image localization.The enclosure has a large depth and an internal volume of 45 liters. It uses a bass-reflex system with a wooden duct. It uses a 210 mm long wooden duct made of strong 15 mm wood to eliminate resonance to eliminate resonance and suppress distortion down to low frequencies below 100 Hz. In addition, a twin triangle duct with rectangular ports divided diagonally is used to suppress standing waves.In addition, the internal structure is a dispersion resonance type with a strong joint structure and special dispersion type reinforcement materials. By dispersing the resonance mode, vibration of the enclosure itself is suppressed and box rumbling phenomenon is prevented. Board material is 15 mm thick (front baffle is 20 mm thick) particleboards are used.The exterior is finished with a walnut pattern.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-35B
sections.overview: A speaker system that reduces distortion by adopting a low-distortion magnetic circuit.The newly developed low-distortion magnetic circuit is used for the magnetic circuit of Woofer and midrange.Drive system distortion, which is non-linear distortion generated from the speaker, is caused by non-linear magnetic characteristics of magnetic material near the voice coil and non-uniform magnetic flux distribution in the gap where the voice coil is placed.In order to reduce this problem, the low-distortion magnetic circuit uses a special magnetic alloy material with excellent linearity of magnetization characteristics, which is produced by the metallurgical optical approach, in the vicinity of the magnetic pole gap. This reduces the non-linear distortion of the drive system generated from the magnetic circuit to less than 1/10 (-20dB) compared to conventional speakers.A 30 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.By placing an effective corrugation on the cone paper and examining the material, molding method, additives, etc. from all angles, distortion due to split vibration, etc. is reduced.In addition, a die-cast frame is used for the frame.The mid-range is equipped with a 10 cm cone type squaker.The edge of this unit is made of polyester resin film, which had been considered difficult to put into practical use until then. Special damping treatment is applied to control the characteristics. In addition, this edge has excellent linearity in minute amplitude, and suppresses the generation of distortion by preventing the rolling and torsional vibration of the cone.Die-cast frame is used for the frame.A 3-cm dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.GFRP (Glass Fiber Reinforced Plastics) composite material is used for the diaphragm. Since this material is light and has high rigidity, the piston vibration range is extended and divided vibration is reduced. Moreover, since natural vibration is difficult to occur, high-end characteristics are also flat.Level control is provided for the middle and high frequencies.The cabinet adopts a distributed resonance type, and vibration is suppressed by a strong joint structure and a special distributed reinforcing bar, and box ringing phenomenon is suppressed by dispersing resonance mode.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-35BMKII
sections.overview: This speaker system further reduces distortion by introducing new technology based on the DS-35B.The low-distortion magnetic circuit used in the DS-35B is used for the magnetic circuit of Woofer and Skoker.In this magnetic circuit, a special magnetic alloy material with excellent linearity of magnetization characteristics developed by a metallurgical engineering approach is installed in the vicinity of the magnetic pole gap. This reduces the nonlinear distortion of the drive system generated by the magnetic circuit to less than 1/10 compared with conventional speakers.The DS-35BmkII employs a low-distortion network circuit to further reduce distortion and improve sound quality.This circuit has been fully examined from the materials of the coil and condenser to the circuit configuration through physical and hearing tests. By adopting a laminated core, the L element considering DC resistance is used, and by using a condenser which has been examined for sound quality, distortion is reduced.A 30 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The cone paper of this unit has been processed by a new method of vacuum molding (a method of molding using vacuum) that does not lose the composition of the fiber, and it also contains thick corrugation. The cone paper pressed by the vacuum molding method has an appropriate internal loss and sufficient strength because the fibers are bonded together without being damaged in a natural state. It also has durability that can withstand a large input.In addition, a newly designed octagonal die-cast frame has been adopted for the frame and the edges have also been improved.The mid-range is equipped with a 10 cm cone type squaker.Polyester resin film is used for the edge part. Special damping treatment is applied to control the characteristics. This improves the start-up characteristics and response to a pulsed signal, and prevents the corn paper from being distorted by preventing it from being swayed or twisted.A strong die-cast frame is used for the frame, and a straight tapered shape is used for the flange part to solve the characteristic disturbance caused by reflection.A 3-cm dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.The diaphragm is made of GFRP (Glass Fiber Reinforced Plastic), which is light and highly rigid, to suppress split vibration. In addition, it has moderate internal loss, so natural vibration is less likely to occur and smooth high-frequency characteristics are obtained.In addition, the edge of the tweeter has been specially processed to suppress the squeal at the edge.The mid-range and high-range are equipped with four adjustable level controls.The enclosure uses a symmetrical unit layout to improve sound image localization.The internal structure is of a distributed resonance type, and vibration is suppressed by a strong joint structure and a special distributed reinforcing bar, and box ringing phenomenon is suppressed by dispersing resonance mode.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-38B
sections.overview: This is a bookshelf-type speaker system developed with the aim of achieving a grand playback sound that exceeds that of a bookshelf.The DS-38B is designed to be highly efficient, and its input resistance is also greatly improved.As a result, the maximum output sound pressure level can be increased and playback over a wide dynamic range is possible.A 30 cm cone woofer is installed in the low range, a 12 cm cone squaker in the middle range, and a 2.3 cm dome tweeter in the high range. All of these units have been newly developed. They use materials for vibration components suitable for each band, a powerful magnetic circuit, and a die-cast frame to achieve high expressiveness and scale.Large high-performance coils are used in the network section to reduce network distortion.The cabinet structure adopts a distributed resonance type.In this structure, the vibration pattern of the cabinet is physically analyzed to avoid the concentration of resonance modes, reinforcing bars are distributed unevenly, and the joints are firmly connected by sophisticated woodworking techniques. This reduces the vibration of the cabinet and suppresses the box ringing phenomenon in which the cabinet resonates strongly in a specific band.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-40C
sections.overview: A floor-type speaker system with low distortion and improved resolution.A 30 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The cone paper uses a loose curved cone with corrugation. The voice coil diameter is designed to be large to increase the allowable input.The center dome has a conical shape to improve the characteristics and suppress the natural vibration of the diaphragm. The bass reflex duct uses a rectangular wooden duct, which is firmly assembled with baffle plates to reduce noise pollution caused by resonance of the duct.The interior of the enclosure is reinforced with a distributed resonance structure, an airtight structure with special attention to air leakage, and an arrangement of sound absorbing materials.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-70C
sections.overview:
130,000 (1 unit, sold on November 11, 1978)

A floor-type speaker system incorporating a 33 cm honeycomb cone type woofer into a large bass reflex enclosure.A 33 cm cone type woofer using a honeycomb cone diaphragm is mounted in the low range.The honeycomb cone is a honeycomb core made of thin aluminum foil and sandwiched between thin glass fiber reinforced plastics (GFRP) films on both sides. As a result, the air layer occupies around 90% of the entire diaphragm, achieving both high rigidity and lightweight.The low distortion magnetic circuit adopted in the DS-35B is used for the magnetic circuit. This magnetic circuit has a structure in which a special magnetic alloy material with excellent linearity of magnetization characteristics developed by a metallurgical engineering approach is mounted near the magnetic pole gap. This reduces the nonlinear distortion of the drive system generated from the magnetic circuit to less than 1/10 (-20dB) compared to conventional speakers.Newly designed 12 cm cone type skoker is mounted in the middle area.In this unit, the weight is reduced by fundamental consideration of the material of the cone paper, and by applying moderate braking to the center cap, incidental noise, which was difficult to suppress in the past, is eliminated.In addition, the upper part is molded to match the bass reflex method, and distortion is reduced by adopting a low-distortion magnetic circuit and die-cast frame.A 4 cm semi-dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.The diaphragm is made of GFRP, which is light and highly rigid, in the shape of Konica Le Dome. By extending the piston vibration range, smooth frequency characteristics are achieved up to the high end.In order to reduce the distortion of the network section, physical tests and hearing tests are repeatedly carried out. In addition, the materials of coils and capacitors, windings, and circuit configuration are examined.The DS-70C uses an L-element with sufficient consideration for DC resistance through the use of a laminated core, and metalized polyester film and condenser that have been carefully examined in terms of sound quality. This reduces distortion in all bands.It is equipped with 4-position switching type level control for the middle and high frequency ranges respectively.The front baffle has been adopted for the front baffle, and the sound image localization has been improved by placing the squaker and the tweeter inside the center line of the baffle plate.The enclosure uses a newly designed bass reflex system. The port of the bass reflex duct is located at the same height as the skoker, so that it is less affected by the floor surface. In addition, a twin triangle duct with rectangular ports divided diagonally is used to prevent port noise by preventing the occurrence of standing waves.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-90C
sections.overview: This high-end floor speaker system was developed by combining the latest technology and know-how accumulated through many years of speaker production.A 40 cm cone type woofer using HC (honeycomb construction) cone is mounted in the low range.The HC cone has a honeycomb-shaped honeycomb core made of thin aluminum foil sandwiched between thin glass fiber reinforced plastic (GFRP) films on both sides. As a result, the air layer occupies around 90% of the entire vibration plate, realizing a lightweight and highly rigid vibration plate. The HC cone has an extremely large weight-to-strength ratio and weight-to-rigidity ratio compared to other vibration plates, so the strain generated from the piston vibration region can be significantly reduced. In addition, by attaching a foam damping sheet on the back side of the vibration plate, an appropriate amount of internal loss is given and natural vibration is suppressed.A low-distortion magnetic field circuit is used for the magnetic circuit. In this magnetic circuit, a special low-distortion ring (FN ring) made of iron-nickel alloy is installed in the magnetic pole gap to reduce non-linear distortion of the drive system generated from the magnetic circuit to less than 1/10 (-20dB) compared to conventional speakers.A 16 cm cone type squaker is mounted in the middle area.It uses low-distortion magnetic circuits that are also used in the Woofer, selected cone paper, Cross Edge with moderate viscoelasticity, voice coil with excellent input resistance, and die-cast frame. It has been developed through careful measurement and hearing tests.In addition, since the directivity of the woofer begins to deteriorate at around 500 Hz, the crossover frequency is set to 350 Hz and used up to 3.5 kHz in order to compensate for this.A 5 cm semi-dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.The effective vibration radius of the cone is designed to be as small as possible. In addition to maintaining excellent directivity up to high frequencies, the piston vibration range is extended to reduce split vibration, and transient is improved by suppressing distortion. The allowable input is increased by designing the voice coil diameter to be large. In addition, the center dome has a special conical shape to increase rigidity and extend the piston vibration range to improve characteristics.The squaker and tweeter are fixed in a sturdy diecast baffle 10 mm thick to prevent cavity resonance in the back of the squaker for a clear mid-to-high sound range without turbidity. The symmetrical arrangement of the units improves the directional characteristics of stereo playback.A triangular duct is used for the bass reflex port to prevent resonance inside the duct and standing wave inside the cabinet.The enclosure is a large enclosure with an internal volume of 206 liters. The internal structure is of a distributed resonance type. The vibration pattern of the enclosure is physically analyzed and reinforcing bars are distributed unevenly to suppress box rumbling.The joints are firmly fixed using sophisticated woodworking techniques.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-201
sections.overview: A small bookshelf speaker system that employs an acoustic air suspension system.A 20 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.In addition to the strong magnet used in the magnetic circuit, the FN ring with excellent linearity in magnetization characteristics is used to reduce distortion. In addition, the sound quality near the crossover frequency is improved by attaching a damping ring to the voice coil.A 5 cm cone type tweeter is installed in the high range.This unit uses a back chamber with an orifice structure to improve the transient.A 1.6 cm dome type super tweeter is installed in the super high band.A switch on the front baffle switches the Super Tweeter ON / OFF.You can enjoy 2 kinds of sound quality by switching according to the program source, listening room condition and preference.The unit layout of the front baffle adopts a symmetrical design to improve sound image localization.In addition, the enclosure uses a distributed resonance type, and the strong joint structure and special reinforcing materials disperse the resonance mode to prevent the box ringing phenomenon.DS 201 has a wood-grain finish and DS 201 DB has a dark brown finish.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-251
sections.overview: The third installment of the DS Series is a 3-way speaker system that adds a super-tweeter to the 2-way speaker system.The DS 251 sold a total of 600000 units until the model was changed to the DS 251 mkII in 1973 and production was discontinued in 1976.A 25 cm cone type woofer, PW 2517, is installed in the low range.This unit was developed at the same time as the DS 301 Woofer and uses special press cone paper.A 5 cm cone type tweeter is installed in the high range.This unit is an acoustic type unit in which sound absorbing material is packed in the air chamber at the rear of the diaphragm. Since the lowest resonance frequency is as low as 600 Hz, crossover at low frequencies is possible, and the connection with the woofer is smooth.The same 3 cm cone type super tweeter as DS 301 is mounted in the super high range.This unit uses aluminum alloy molded plates for the diaphragm and suspension.Equipped with a step-type attenuator, it can change from 2 kHz to 25 kHz in 3 dB steps.This attenuator can be used to turn the Super Tweeter ON/OFF.Acoustic air suspension is used in the enclosure, and 300g of sound absorbing material is packed tightly in a closed enclosure with strong joint structure to improve transient characteristics and distortion in the low frequency range.The exterior is finished with natural walnut, and the front is made with double secondary RUNNET.Also, the front baffle is covered with black leather.

sections.overview:
28,500 (1 unit, released in 1973)  32,000 (1 unit, around 1974)

This is a speaker system based on the DS 251 with improved performance and design.A newly developed 25 cm cone type woofer is mounted in the low range.This unit uses a 4 mm thick aluminum die-cast frame to increase mechanical strength and eliminate resonance and vibration of the frame itself. The cone paper is strong enough to withstand the acoustic air suspension system's internal sound pressure. The voice coil uses a heat-resistant thermosetting adhesive to improve input resistance.A 5 cm cone type tweeter is installed in the high range.A 3 cm cone type super tweeter is installed in the super high range.The diaphragm of this unit uses hard aluminum with an effective vibration radius of 1.2 cm and a thickness of 70 ? m and is finished by precision press.The front baffle is equipped with a step-type level control that can set the high frequency range of 2 kHz or more to 3 steps with a vertical width of 3 dB.You can also turn the Super Tweeter ON / OFF with this level control.The enclosure uses an acoustic air suspension system to improve transient characteristics and distortion in the low frequency range.In addition, an edgeless cabinet is adopted in which the edge around the baffle plate is removed from the conventional design in which the outer periphery of the front baffle protrudes, and directivity over a wide frequency band is improved.Stainless steel pipe is used for the front net.

sections.overview: A 3-way speaker system using a specially developed unit.It has a 25 cm cone woofer for the low range, a 5 cm cone tweeter for the high range, and a 1.6 cm dome super tweeter for the ultra high range.These units were newly developed for the DS 261. Die-cast frames are used for the frame of each unit to eliminate natural vibration of the frame itself.In addition, the volume of the back chamber of the tweeter section is increased to reduce the reverberation, and the reproduced sound with good damping is obtained.It is equipped with 3-position switching type level control for high frequency.The enclosure uses an acoustic air suspension system, in which a large amount of sound absorbing material is packed inside the enclosure, enabling rich bass reproduction in a small system.We have also adopted a V-shaped reinforcing bar developed by Diatone and reduced the resonance of the baffle plate by assembling it with a strong joint structure.

sections.overview:
62,000 (1 unit, released in 1970)  75,000 (1 unit, around 1974)

A four way speaker system that employs an acoustic air suspension system.PW 3020, a 30 cm cone type woofer, is installed in the low range.This unit uses specially pressed reinforced cone, alnico magnetic circuit and roll edge with excellent linearity to achieve excellent low sound reproduction.The mid-range is equipped with DM-2210, a 5 cm dome type squaker, and the high-range is equipped with DH-2201, a 3 cm dome type tweeter.By adopting a dome type, directivity is improved, and by installing an acoustic diffuser, orientation is improved.A 3 cm cone type super tweeter using an ultra-light mass aluminum diaphragm is mounted in the ultra-high frequency range.Equipped with continuously variable level control for each band from 1.5 kHz to 6 kHz and 6 kHz to 25 kHz.The enclosure uses an acoustic air suspension system. Each unit is carefully patted to prevent air leakage. Transient characteristics and distortion in the low frequency range are improved. The enclosure is reinforced to a sufficient thickness to prevent box rumbling.The exterior has a natural walnut finish and the front baffle is covered with black leather.A double net is used for the front net.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-303
sections.overview: This speaker system was developed as a high-end model following the DS 301.In order to realize an excellent speaker, it is designed not only by measuring in an anechoic room, but also by measuring under various conditions such as characteristics when placed directly on a floor plate and characteristics when embedded in the ground assuming an infinite baffle.A 30 cm cone type woofer, PW-30BM is mounted in the low range. 3040 bm.It is equipped with DM-6010CM which is a 6 cm dome type squaker in the middle range, DH-2310CM which is a 2.3 cm dome type tweeter in the high range, and DH-1670BM which is a 1.6 cm dome type super tweeter in the ultra high range.The diaphragms of these units are made of phenol resin, paper, and soft aluminum from the viewpoint of performance and sound quality, respectively, and we have succeeded in obtaining natural sound connections.The mid-range, high-range and ultra-high-range are equipped with independent coil tap step-type attenuators.You can control four levels each for the middle and high ranges, and three levels for the ultra high range.In the DS 303, the Woofer unit is damped at 600 Hz, which is one octave lower than the piston vibration limit, and connected to the Skoker unit. In addition, the Woofer unit is connected to the Tweeter unit at 5 kHz, which is one octave lower than the limit frequency of the Skoker. In addition, the Tweeter is connected to the Super Tweeter at 10 kHz, which is one octave lower than the frequency at which the characteristics begin to be disturbed as it enters the divided resonance range.As a result, the crossover frequency is naturally connected and the power response is smooth. The good range of piston vibration stabilizes the characteristics of the speaker unit and stabilizes the physical characteristics and sound quality of the system.The enclosure uses a symmetrical design for the first time as a diatone. By improving directional characteristics, the difference in sound quality between the left and right sides of the system is eliminated.In addition, an edgeless cabinet with a flat outer periphery of the front baffle has been adopted to improve the directional disturbance that occurs when the outer periphery of the front baffle protrudes from the design of old speaker systems. In addition, to eliminate the influence of the front net, a slit is installed on both sides of the front and left sides.The selection of cabinet materials is based on physical data and audibility tests. Multi-layer particleboards are used for the five sides except for the back, and Canadian douglas fur with excellent damping characteristics is used for the back plate.In addition, the use of a dispersion type reinforcing bar prevents resonance from concentrating and provides natural attenuation characteristics.The DS 303 is designed to determine how much power should be used to drive an amplifier when listening to music.In order to ensure a sound level of 100 dB (instantaneous value) in stereo reproduction in a large listening room of 12 to 16 tatami mats, an input resistance of 100W is required for efficiency, and an output power of at least 40W is required in order to satisfy the conditions in a small room of 4.5 or 6 tatami mats.For this reason, it was recommended that the DS 303 be driven by an amplifier with an output of approximately 40W to 100W.(See graph below on listening level and distance from speaker system)

sections.title: DIATONE DS-401
sections.overview: A high-quality bookshelf speaker system that uses honeycomb cones.A 30 cm cone type woofer using honeycomb cone is mounted in the low range.The honeycomb cone consists of a honeycomb-shaped honeycomb core made of thin aluminum foil sandwiched between thin glass fiber reinforced plastics (GFRP) films on both sides. For this reason, the air layer occupies nearly 90% of the entire diaphragm, and it is light and highly rigid. In particular, the weight-to-strength ratio and weight-to-rigidity ratio are extremely large compared to other diaphragms, and the strain generated from the piston vibration region is greatly reduced. In addition, the honeycomb cone has an appropriate internal loss by sticking a foam damping sheet on the back side of the diaphragm, and the generation of natural vibration is suppressed. The lowest resonance frequency of the DS 401 is set at 37 Hz, which is combined with a low-distortion magnetic circuit to increase the reproduction capability of heavy bass.The low distortion magnetic circuit adopted in the DS-35B is used for the magnetic circuit. In this magnetic circuit, a special magnetic alloy material with excellent linearity of magnetization characteristics developed by a metallurgical engineering approach is installed in the vicinity of the magnetic pole gap, and the non-linear distortion of the drive system generated from the magnetic circuit is reduced to less than 1/10 (-20dB) compared to the conventional one.The mid-range is equipped with a 10 cm cone type squaker.This unit is made as light as possible by adding fundamental consideration to the material of the cone paper. In addition, by applying moderate braking to the center cap, incidental noise which was thought to be difficult to control is eliminated. In addition, it is molded to be strong to match the air suspension system well.A low-distortion magnetic circuit is used for the magnetic circuit like the woofer, and a die-cast frame is used for the frame to further reduce distortion.A newly designed 4 cm semi-dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.The diaphragm is made of Konica Le Dome GFRP, and the piston vibration range is extended to achieve smooth frequency characteristics up to the high end.By adopting new technology in the network section, distortion is reduced.In addition to pursuing physical characteristics by strictly checking the materials of coils, capacitors, and resistors, as well as the winding and circuit configuration, hearing tests have been conducted to an extent that is audibly satisfactory. As a result, we have adopted a core coil for the coil to improve damping, a metallized polyester film capacitor for the capacitor, and a well-examined cement resistor for the level adjustment resistor.This low-distortion network circuit realizes clear playback sound in the entire playback band from the heavy low range to the super high range.It is equipped with 4-position switching type level control for the middle and high frequency ranges respectively.The front baffle has a symmetrical vertical single row unit configuration with a squaker and a tweeter positioned slightly inward from the center line to improve sound image localization.The enclosure employs an air suspension system, which brakes the cone paper by suppressing the air in the enclosed enclosure.In addition, by adopting a dispersion resonance type enclosure with a strong joint structure and special dispersion type reinforcing beam, the resonance mode is dispersed and the box ringing phenomenon is suppressed.The exterior features a natural walnut veneer finish.

sections.overview: Diatone's most representative 16 cm full-range speaker unit.The P-610 was the first model, and after detailed model changes, it was sold almost as it was when it was released until 1996.The P-610 is the first in the industry to pass the BTS standard established by NHK.The initial model P-610 is equipped with a matching transformer and can be used with 2 impedance types of 6   and 600  .For this reason, the mounting hole of the transformer remains in the P-610 series which was released later.In addition, only impedance is different from P-610A/P-610B.A pure iron is used for the magnetic circuit to increase effective flux density, and excellent damping and high efficiency are obtained for a 16 cm class.The cone section adopts a matched resonance form designed by the direct attack method, and achieves broadband characteristics with a single cone by corrugation and free edge.

sections.title: DIATONE Mitsubishi
sections.overview: The first amplifier announced by Diatone.A quasi complimentary service SEPPP OTL parallel push-pull circuit is used.The preamplifier section uses a 3-stage direct-coupled amplifier with a large amount of negative feedback to minimize degradation of various characteristics.The equalizer amplifier section is also an NF type with a 3-stage direct-coupled amplifier, and the quality is controlled within 0.5 db of the deviation from the RIAA curve.The tone control section employs a step-type tone control using a rotary switch. It has a characteristic and straightforward change curve depending on the method of switching elements.An electronic switch type protection circuit using a silicon thyristor is adopted to protect the power transistor.It is equipped with a muting circuit that cuts off the speakers for 3 to 7 seconds after power is turned on to prevent damage to the speakers due to clipping noise when power is turned on.A 4-channel volume is used for volume adjustment, and the S/N ratio for small output is improved by adjusting both the input and output sides of the preamplifier section.A highly reliable epoxy-based printed circuit board is used.The preamplifier section and main amplifier section can be used independently.In the DA-55U, terminals are provided on the horizontal surface and part of the upper lid of the cabinet is made into a slide mechanism to improve operability.Uses the same Eurasian cheek oak finish as the diatone speaker.

sections.title: DIATONE DA-U680
sections.overview: This is a pre-main amplifier whose characteristics are improved by DC conversion after the high-level input.In order to improve phase distortion and transient distortion in the low range, dual FET developed by Diatone is adopted in the power block for DC. In addition, the pre-block has ICL-OCL configuration to eliminate capacitors from the signal path after high-level input and improve the rise and transient characteristics of sound.We have also improved the S/N ratio by reviewing the usage of the first stage transistor.The MC head amplifier uses a different type of transistor based on the idea of looking at the transistor itself. In addition, a circuit configuration that reduces noise is adopted for the circuit, which improves characteristics compared with the case of using a step-up transformer.Phono1 can be used exclusively for MM cartridges, and Phono2 can be used for both MM and MC types of cartridges.The DA-U680S is equipped with a power level indicator ON/OFF switch with 15 LEDs arranged in a V-shape.Since the power supply for the pre-block and power block is independent, it is difficult for the high temperature and magnetic influence generated from the power block to reach the pre-block, and stability of elements and circuits is improved.Two tape decks can be connected and the tape duplication mechanism facilitates copying from Tape 1 to Tape 2 or Tape 2 to Tape 1.The turnover frequency of the tone control can be switched between two levels for both Bass and Treble.It also has a tone defeat switch.Equipped with a -20dB muting switch and subsonic filter.There were two types : the DA-U680 equipped with a rack-mount carrying handle and omitting the power level indicator ON/OFF switch, and the DA-U680S equipped with an indicator ON/OFF switch.

sections.title: DIATONE DA-U750
sections.overview: The OCL system directly connected to the front stage realizes high power.As for the temperature drift of the DC voltage at the output terminal, a new amplifier circuit is adopted which shows extremely small drift over a wide temperature range, and high performance is achieved by using parts with large current capacity.An ultra-low noise transistor developed by Diatone low-concentration diffusion technology is used for the first stage differential amplification.Compared with conventional low-noise transistors, the 1/f noise is reduced by approximately 2 dB and the dynamic range is also improved.The power stage and driver stage use a pair transistor with uniform bare characteristics to reduce distortion in open loop.This reduces distortion at low output and contributes to the expansion of the dynamic range.In order to shield it from high heat and magnetism generated by the power block, it is clearly separated, pre-block is placed on the front part and it is also shielded.As a result, the temperature can be kept 10 ? lower than that of the power block under normal operating conditions, and the stability of the transistor with high temperature dependence and the reliability of each component are improved.The power section and pre-section are connected under both blocks, so it is designed to be less susceptible to aging.Equipped with a presence control that can amplify the mid-range in 1 dB steps.The center frequency can be switched between 800 Hz and 2000 Hz.The tone control circuit has a circuit configuration in which the time constant circuit is disconnected at the flat position to obtain a flat frequency characteristic.Both the tone control amplifier and the presence control independently employ highly stable amplifiers with a wide linear operating range of transistors.A 22-contact attenuator is used. Both attenuation deviation and gang error are within 1 dB of attenuation up to 28 dB and within 1.5 dB of attenuation 30 dB or higher.Power ratio 2.8.

sections.overview: An AV amplifier designed for surround sound but with a focus on CD playback.Equipped with a super-dynamic delay line circuit, the dynamic range is improved by 30 to 40 dB compared with conventional analog delay circuits, and a dynamic range of 90 dB or more, comparable to that of digital delay systems, is secured.Multi-feedback servo system is used for the feedback circuit of the amplifier section.In this system, the servo circuit consists of two systems, a main loop for controlling the music signal and a servo loop for increasing stability in the ultra-low frequency range. sections.overview: Feature series preamp.The power supply for each left and right channel and each unit amplifier are of a separate monaural configuration for the left and right channels, and the volume and switches are used with sufficient consideration for separation.This improves the separation.In addition to improving the separation by minimizing the number of auxiliary circuits that cause sound quality degradation, a constant voltage power supply is used for the power supply at the heart of the amplifier to eliminate interference between the circuits.The tone circuit uses a current mirror circuit with high voltage amplification, symmetric drive and low distortion, and the filter circuit uses an inverted Darlington emitter-follower circuit to achieve low distortion.A low-noise transistor developed by Diatone is used in the first stage differential amplifier stage of the equalizer amplifier to obtain an input equivalent noise of -126dB (V) (IHF, A-curve correction).A variable resistor with a unique switch is used for the tone control, and the time constant circuit is completely disconnected in the flat position to obtain a flat frequency characteristic.The tone control volume is provided separately for the left and right channels to improve the separation, and the sound quality can be adjusted separately for the left and right channels.A muting circuit using a reed relay is adopted to prevent noise when the power switch is turned on and off.The remote control allows direct speaker switching of the power amplifier.It can be docked with Feature series power amplifiers.

sections.title: DIATONE DA-P15
sections.overview:
DA-P15 :   75,000 (around 1978)DA-P15S :   74,000 (around 1979)

A preamplifier aiming at low distortion by reviewing the basics.The first stage of the equalizer amplifier uses a low-noise FET that is carefully selected from many transistors in terms of noise and performance to minimize the noise generated by the first stage transistor and improve the S/N ratio.Also, the S/N ratio is improved by lowering the impedance of the RIAA feedback circuit.As for residual noise, which greatly affects the performance of the tone amplifier, we use a low-noise FET that carefully examines the noise characteristics of the first stage transistor to reduce the noise like the equalizer amplifier.In addition, the impedance of the feedback circuit is reduced to improve the S/N ratio.Both the equalizer amplifier and the tone amplifier use a two stage differential amplifier circuit with a current mirror load. This circuit reduces distortion at the time of open loop and further increases the band width to improve bare characteristics sufficiently, and provides stable negative feedback to reduce distortion.We have also succeeded in reducing the distortion to less than 0.03% (Phono MM) and 0.002% (AUX) near the limit in the 20 Hz to 20 kHz band by spending many days studying the device and circuit configuration with less distortion.As for the MC head amplifier, from the perspective of reexamining the transistor itself, we adopted a transistor different from conventional ones and devised and adopted a new circuit to reduce noise.In addition to the signal circuit, it uses a two monaural construction that separates the left and right channels from the power supply to the ground.It has a tape-duplicate switch.It has a built-in headphone amplifier.Built-in tone defeat mechanism.Equipped with a subsonic filter to cut out ultra-low frequency noise.Turnover can be switched.Built-in muting relay when power is ON.There were 2 types, DA-P15 with a rack-mount carrying handle and DA-P15S without a carrying handle.

sections.overview: A control amplifier paired with the DA-A100.The base potential of the first stage transistor is made equal to the ground potential by the adoption of the irregular 2 power supply (+ 75 V, -12V) so that the leakage current of the coupling capacitor is eliminated. sections.title: DIATONE M-P01
sections.overview: A small preamplifier of discrete configuration realized by a push switch and 4-layered printed circuit board.Built-in MC head amplifier with new type transistor adopted for DA-P15 type.In the first stage of the equalizer amplifier and tone amplifier, we use a low-noise FET that is carefully selected in terms of noise and performance in order to minimize the noise generated by the transistor. In addition, we increase the S/N ratio by reducing the impedance of the feedback circuit.Also, in terms of circuit, we have adopted a differential 2-stage amplifier circuit + class A push-pull circuit with a current mirror load with less distortion. This circuit reduces distortion in open loop and improves bare characteristics such as a wider band. This enables stable negative feedback and low distortion factor.Equipped with digital tone control by fixed resistor and push switch.Accurate tone control can be achieved in 2 dB steps by selecting plus or minus and the amount of change with the push switch. Note that the CR time constant circuit of the tone control circuit creates undulations in the frequency response even at the tone control flat position. Therefore, the M-P01 has a tone defeat switch, so that the time constant circuit is completely disconnected when the switch is turned on to obtain a flat frequency response.A large-capacity power supply is used for the power supply section, and DC voltage is supplied to each unit amplifier through a constant voltage circuit, enabling stable operation of each unit amplifier.Tape duplication allows you to listen to other sources while the tape is being copied.Equipped with a subsonic filter.Built-in muting relay prevents click noise when the power is ON.The phono input terminal is gold-plated to prevent changes over time.

sections.title: DIATONE DA-P7000
sections.overview: A reference AV preamplifier with separate video and audio components.The DA-P7000 uses an AV separate structure in which the video selector and audio circuits are housed in separate housings to eliminate interference such as noise.The control signal is supplied from the audio section to the video section via a power line with an independent video winding transformer and a photocoupler. From this signal line, only the minimum required current and the signal for controlling the video selector are sent. Thus, the audio and video sections are completely isolated.The video amplifier section uses a discrete configuration using a wide-band high-frequency transistor. Combined with the use of a video-only switch, it realizes a wide bandwidth of 20 MHz.All selector circuits are equipped with a dedicated video bipolar switch IC. Since the bipolar switch consists of an emitter follower with low-output impedance and broadband characteristics, it provides excellent switching performance for video signals.In order to prevent Y and C signals from interfering with each other, we have adopted a three dimensional board structure in which only the Y signal selector part of the signal processing circuit is composed of another board, and this board is made to stand upright on the C signal selector board so as to have the shortest wiring distance.As a result, the Y signal and C signal are arranged at the shortest distance without crossing each other, and various characteristics are improved.Y/C isolation circuit expert DCF is installed.This circuit calculates the vertical and horizontal uncorrelated energy of video signals on a pixel-by-pixel basis and selects three types of optimal filters (BPF). It is an IC-based circuit that uses a horizontal band-pass filter (1-D) when the horizontal correlation is strong, a vertical band-pass filter (2-D) when the vertical correlation is strong, and an oblique band-pass filter (1-D + 2-D) when neither is strong.This greatly reduces both horizontal and vertical dot interference and color fading compared to conventional products.The video circuit has a two power supply configuration similar to the audio circuit. By separating the power supply circuit from the ground circuit, the inflow of unnecessary circuit current into the ground circuit is greatly reduced and high S/N is achieved.In addition, the input-output coupling capacitor can be removed, resulting in higher picture quality.Full digital audio signal processing is used in the audio section, so that analog input signals are converted into digital signals by an A/D converter and processed as digital signals until they are finally converted into analog signals and output.The D/A converter uses a newly developed variable current discrete 1-bit DAC that brings out the original merits of the 1-bit type.This DA converter drives an electronic switch at a constant current so that the circuit is not affected by power supply fluctuations. It also uses a constant current type PWM method to eliminate power supply voltage fluctuations by making the load current of the power supply constant. The differential amplifier and current / voltage conversion circuit use an audio OP amplifier (manufactured by PMI Inc. of the United States) with excellent power supply fluctuation rejection capability. DC servo is applied to eliminate coupling capacitors. This eliminates AM modulation distortion and maximizes linearity.Digital volume is used for the volume circuit.This volume has a structure in which the current value of the constant current source of the differential switch can be changed by the volume control circuit, and the rotation of the knob is detected by the rotary encoder linked to the volume knob, so that bit dropping does not occur at any volume value from 0 dB to -72dB.To eliminate jitter and prevent degradation of sound quality, a jitter-free digital sound collector is used in the jitter elimination circuit.This circuit has a dual PLL configuration consisting of two 1st and 2nd PLL circuits. The 2nd PLL uses a newly developed wide-band lithium tantalate oscillator with frequency accuracy and stability comparable to those of quartz crystal, and with a frequency variable width of more than three times that of conventional ones and   3,000 ppm or more.The digital input signal is first demodulated by a clock generated by the 1st PLL, and the data is written into a memory buffer of three words by a dedicated IC. The 2nd PLL resynchronizes the clock of the 1st PLL to generate a high-precision clock with less jitter. This clock is used to read the data written into the buffer and eliminate jitter.In addition, if the response of the PLL circuit is fast, the oscillator in the loop will follow the jitter and create a clock with a lot of jitter. Therefore, the slower the response of the 2nd PLL, the better the jitter removal effect. However, if the response is too slow, the lock will be released easily and the sound will be cut off. Therefore, by changing the response of the 2nd PLL to two speed automatic transmission and switching between fast and slow speed depending on the situation, stable lock is secured and the ultra-slow response of the PLL is achieved.An independent shunt regulator is applied to the power supply of the PLL circuit for each block to suppress the generation of jitter caused by the inflow of power supply noise.An ID interface is used to prevent the deterioration of sound quality caused by noise generated during transmission of digital audio signals that have undergone surround processing and other processing by DSP.The ID interface is structured to transmit not the digital signal itself information contained in the signal, not the digital signal itself. It consists of two C-MOS FET analog switches, which are connected to the power supply when one is ON and to the ground when the other is ON. Both the power supply and the ground are kept clean with little noise. The digital audio signal is not directly input to the D/A converter, but when it is used as an open / close signal for two analog switches, the switch on the power supply side is ON when the signal is HIGH, and the switch on the ground side is ON when the signal is LOW. Thus, the high-low relationship of the newly created digital signal corresponds to the input signal, but the uncorrelated noise of the digital audio signal is shut out and clean D/A conversion is realized.In addition to Dolby Pro Logic, MHT Logic and Mono Logic are available as surround modes.MHT Logic is Mitsubishi's original surround mode that supports Dolby Surround encoded software. Sound field effects are fully digitally processed by DSP, and associated bit loss is handled by all-channel noise shaping to achieve high-quality surround playback.The center mode can be selected from REAL mode and VIRTUAL mode.The REAL mode is set when the center speaker is used. The entire band from low to high is output to the center speaker. The VIRTUAL mode is set when the center speaker is not used. The two LR2 speakers direct speech to the center using a directional enhancement circuit.Furthermore, by adjusting the arrival time of the center channel signal with the C (CENTER) PRESENCE function, it is possible to improve the center orientation.With the MULTI DELAY function, you can use two to four rear speakers to create a surround sound field similar to a room with six to twelve rear speakers. You can adjust the size of the sound field by switching between modes.With REAR DELAY you can adjust the DELAY time of the rear speaker.With the REAR FILTER you can adjust the cutoff characteristics of a low-pass filter that cuts out the high-frequency range of the rear-channel signal, usually set to 7 kHz, to 9 kHz for more sound, or to 4 kHz for a milder sound.With the THEATER LPF, you can adjust recorded sources for movie theater playback with high-frequency enhancements.With the AZIMUTH function, if the angle (azimuth) of the playback head is out of alignment with the recording head during the process of creating the software, you can adjust the offset of the azimuth of the software.With the AUTO INPUT function, you can improve the situation in which speech sounds like dialogue from the center are heard through speakers other than the center channel.Equipped with a subwoofer output. Digital processing of the low-pass filter enables three levels of switching between 40 Hz, 63 Hz and 80 Hz according to the characteristics. Cutoff characteristic is 24dB/oct.In Mono Logic mode, you can add surround sound to monaural recorded video and LD software.It is equipped with an on-screen function that enables you to adjust the surround sound mode and dub processing while checking the screen.There are three types of displays : the main screen for selecting the input / output source and surround type, the sub screen for determining the volume of each speaker and whether the subwoofer is ON/OFF, and the REC monitor screen for checking the recording status.In addition to superimposing, it can also be displayed on blueback Antilope cervicapra.It is equipped with the ambisonic surround system licensed by Nimbus Records UK.This surround system provides surround sound for normal stereo sources, but it is especially effective for four channel ambisonic-encoded software.Comes with a wireless remote control with a lighting function that lights up when the button is pressed.This remote control is equipped with an auto-function function that enables you to perform a series of operations with the touch of a button in a system composed of Mitsubishi AV devices that support auto-function. It is also equipped with a learning function that enables you to learn and operate the remote control functions of other AV devices.

sections.title: DIATONE DA-A10DC
sections.overview: This is a DC stereo power amplifier.We emphasize phase distortion in the low frequency range and eliminate distortion by realizing DC without any capacitor that acts as the time constant of the amplifier circuit.In the high-frequency range, distortion is reduced by improving the frequency bandwidth before NF is applied, enabling low-distortion reproduction over a wide range.We have developed and adopted a dual FET with excellent characteristics, large gm (mutual conductance), and extremely low noise.
