sections.title: DIATONE M-A01
sections.overview: A compact stereo power amplifier that maintains high performance.In order to improve low-frequency phase distortion and transient cross-modulation distortion, we have adopted DC without any capacitor, which is the time constant of the circuit, thereby realizing flat characteristics up to the DC range.A RET (Ring Emitter Transistor) is used for the power transistor in order to improve the elongation of the high-frequency range. In addition, the gain before applying negative feedback is optimally distributed to each stage to improve the bare characteristics, making it easier to apply stable negative feedback to high frequencies.Specifically, we propose distortion by reducing the negative feedback at low frequencies and increasing the negative feedback at high frequencies.In the first stage, a unique low-noise dual FET with uniform characteristics, high gm (mutual inductance) and extremely low noise is adopted, which improves the S/N ratio.The power supply consists of two 55V/20,000 ? F filter capacitors and a 250 va power transformer with a highly efficient and compact cut core. This power supply occupies approximately 40% of the volume inside the amplifier and is small but has a strong power supply.It is equipped with peak level indicator by 12 LED display of one channel.In order to reduce the size, the power supply circuits other than the power transformer and heat sink are integrated on a single printed circuit board.In addition, attention is paid to the coupling of magnetic flux generated by the large power supply. In order to eliminate the coupling of magnetic flux between input and output, detailed consideration is also given to the arrangement of parts of input and output circuits and the routing of copper foil patterns.In addition, with regard to the problem that the copper foil pattern becomes narrow by reducing the size of the printed circuit board and affects the impedance of the pattern, we have widened the copper foil pattern in proportion to the magnitude of the current to reduce the effect of the pattern impedance.The heat sink is exposed on the right and left sides, and air is taken in from the lower part of the front panel, and convection is generated inside the set to ensure thermal stability that can withstand large output.Independent protection circuits are mounted on the speaker side and amplifier side respectively.

sections.title: DIATONE M-A05
sections.overview: This is a stereo power amplifier that inherits M-A01 technology.A 2-stage differential amplifier, a current mirror drive, and a direct-coupled pure complimentary service OCL circuit are used for all stages. A highly reliable NPN/PNP silicon transistor with excellent pair characteristics is used for the final stage.In addition, twin transistors with excellent pair characteristics are used for the first stage differential, and the pre-driver stage is a differential amplification configuration with a current mirror circuit assembled, thereby improving the DC stability of the circuit and achieving high gain.A peak level indicator with 5 LEDs per channel is provided.The indicator circuit logarithmically compresses the input signal, and the detection and detection signal are peak-held for approximately 0.1 second. The level is detected by the comparator, and the LED lights up corresponding to each level.In addition, the x0. 01 range selector switch is provided so that accurate level can be read even at low volume.Built-in protection circuit that combines electronic circuit and relay.When a DC potential higher than a certain level is generated at the output terminal of the power amplifier, this protection circuit operates. This separates the output of the amplifier from the speaker and protects the speaker from damage.It is also designed to work as a muting circuit that prevents unpleasant clicks that occur when the power is turned on and off.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-66Z
sections.overview: This bass reflex speaker system is a condensation of Diatone technology.It is equipped with 27 cm cone type woofer which uses for the low range.The New Aramid Hybrid Cone is used for the diaphragm. This diaphragm is made of aramid hybrid FRP with an intra-ply structure of aramid organic fiber aramid, which has high rigidity and an appropriate loss factor, and inorganic fiber amorphous silica, which has high strength. The DS-66Z has 15% higher strength of amorphous silica than the conventional one and is woven into the hybrid structure to achieve both higher specific elastic modulus and appropriate internal loss.The frame is a strong R. S. frame that is firmly mounted in the enclosure.The mid-range is equipped with a 10 cm cone type squaker.The cone section of the diaphragm is a New Aramid Hybrid Cone similar to the Woofer diaphragm, and the center diaphragm section is a newly developed Omega Titanium Dome with high specific elastic modulus and internal loss.A 2.5 cm dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.The diaphragm is made of boron, which has excellent characteristics such as high-speed response to input signals and suppression of noise inherent in metal materials. By integrating the diaphragm and voice coil bobbin into a D. U. D structure, the driving force generated in the voice coil is transmitted to the diaphragm without loss. This improves transient response, high upper limit frequency, linearity, and input resistance.In addition, the D. M. system of hybrid structure is adopted for the unit structure, and the whole plate is mounted attenuate the natural resonance of the magnetic circuit itself.It is a magnetic shielding design, and the screen is not adversely affected even on the side of the cathode ray tube.A crimping wiring method is used for connection of the network. Wires are passed through a sleeve and then crimped and crimped to eliminate the strain at the boundary between dissimilar metals caused by soldering. In addition, in order to reduce power supply loss due to the wiring system, the wiring after the input terminal is independent for each unit, and the wiring from the input terminal to each unit is connected by a one point concentrated crimping method to ensure a well-balanced current supply.In addition, laminated oriented cores are used for coils, oxygen-free copper wires are used for electrical wires, and capacitors and resistors are carefully selected after repeated measurements and listening tests.A two sided round baffle enclosure with a round shape on both sides of the front baffle prevents diffraction of sound waves.In addition, Diatone's unique computer analysis technology such as modal analysis is utilized in the design of the enclosure to realize a highly rigid distributed resonant enclosure.There was a special speaker stand sold separately.

Also, by radiating back pressure of the rear drive unit from the bass reflex port, dynamic low-range playback is possible.The DS-100Z drives the diaphragm more smoothly by optimizing the acoustic characteristics and volume ratio through computer simulation.A newly developed 13 cm cone type full-range unit is mounted for all band, and a 10 cm cone type unit is mounted for rear drive.The magnetic circuit of each speaker unit uses a strontium magnet to increase the magnetic flux density, and is designed with a cancel magnet and a magnetic shielding cover to prevent magnetic field.There were two variations of the enclosure finish : wood and black wood.There were a stand for hanging from the sky with adjustable angle and a holder for hanging on the wall which were sold separately.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-20000
sections.overview:
* Order-made, limited to 300 sets  500,000 (1 unit, released in 1992)

This speaker system was developed by Diatone Kobo using various sound and woodworking technologies.A 27 cm cone type woofer using an aramid honeycomb cone is mounted in the low range.Aramid fiber is an aromatic polyamide long fiber with high strength and high elasticity as well as light weight and moderate internal loss. By using a special matrix resin, which is a special combination of aramid fiber and flexible resin, for the skin material of honeycomb cone, moderate internal loss is obtained. When bonded to the core, honeycomb structure diaphragm is made.The edge uses a triaxial woven aramid fiber that exhibits uniform strength in all directions, and achieves piston motion with excellent linearity and less rolling.In addition, the magnetic circuit is equipped with an A. D. M. C. -m (Advanced Magnet Circuit-music) magnetic circuit to improve response to input signals, stabilize operation against transient response, and stabilize time domain against AC magnetic flux.We also pay attention to the air flow generated by the vibration of the diaphragm, and we are trying to improve the S/N in terms of audibility by examining the back surface of the diaphragm which is radiated into the cabinet in detail.B for the middle area4Equipped with 7.5 cm dome type mid-range using C diaphragm.B4C has a high specific elastic modulus second only to crystalline diamond, and also has moderate internal loss because it is a non-metal. Because this material has a high melting point of 2,450 ?, it is molded by Diatone's unique plasma spraying method. By controlling this manufacturing method with high precision, large diameter B4The C diaphragm has been realized, and the diaphragm has a D. U. D structure integrated with voice coil bobbin to ensure excellent linearity to the input signal.Both sides H. D. (High Damping) tangential edge is used for the edge part. This edge uses non-directional non-woven fabric as the center material. In addition, cotton cloth containing moderate damping material is used. It has a 5-layer structure including the adhesive layer. This reduces unnecessary radiation sound and suppresses the behavior of the diaphragm except for the direction of vibration.The drive train is equipped with an A. D. M. C. -m with an alnico magnet with a diameter of 90 mm. In addition, the sub-frame that supports the diaphragm through the suspension has a larger diameter. By increasing the contact area with the magnetic circuit plate surface, the vibration damping effect due to the contact of different metals is increased. The surface of this sub-frame is coated with paint with high vibration damping capacity to thoroughly suppress unnecessary radiation. The material is also carefully examined, and after repeated trial listening, copper alloy is selected.B for the high range4It is equipped with a 2.3 cm dome type tweeter using C diaphragm.Similar to the mid-range model, this unit has a voice coil bobbin integrated D. U. D coil bobbin. In addition, the magnetic circuit uses a D. M. (direct mount) system in which a plate is directly attached to a baffle plate. The large diameter copper alloy sub-frame thoroughly suppresses unwanted resonance.Wire materials suitable for each unit are used for the internal wiring of the network section. Crimping wiring with a gold-plated sleeve is applied to eliminate the distortion of the interface of the current. In addition, a radial power supply system is adopted to realize the appropriate current supply to each unit.The layout of the network circuit is determined by repeated trial listening to the directivity of the elements (inductors and capacitors), and high sound quality is achieved as a ??????? that does not constrain the elements themselves to the network base. In addition, the network base is made of spruce wood with beautiful attenuation characteristics. In addition, the 3-piece division structure and division arrangement give consideration to electromagnetic coupling between inductors and modulation caused by sound pressure inside the enclosure.In addition, consideration is given to eliminating mutual influence on the position of wiring materials from the network to the unit.Gold plating is applied to the machined oxygen-free copper for the input terminals.The concept of the enclosure is to finish the best wood selected from all over the world with the best woodworking technology. On top of that, Diatone vibration analysis technology has been introduced and manufactured.The baffle plate and back plate are made of spruce wood, which is also used as a piano resonance plate. This spruce wood is made from Sitka spruce grown in the Sitka region of North America in a lumber core structure. In addition, in order to suppress delicate movements of wood in this lumber core structure, two layers of the front and back surfaces are bonded together, and a Black Cherry thrust plate is pasted on top of it.The enclosure components are joined together with hard maple corners that are used in stringed instruments such as body plates, back plates, and faggots. In order to bring out the beautiful sound of vibration as a plate, the end surfaces of each component are not specially processed for joining and are joined together in a simple shape so that the vibration mode is not complicated.The surface is finished with a polyester thick glossy coating that is applied only to top-of-the-line grand pianos for export. With this coating method, 35 steps are taken from surface treatment to final buffing. Compared with common urethane and layers, the surface is hard enough to give a sense of attack speed and improved resolution.Gold plated sleeve for crimp wiring and gold plated oxygen-free copper for input terminals. All possible high-purity transmission technologies such as radial power supply system, 3-piece division structure and division arrangement have been introduced.The DS 20000 is pre-aged at the factory to provide sufficient aging effects.This aging used a unique signal that provides a large suspension amplitude for the low range and a noise signal close to the spectrum of the music signal for the high and high range.Polishing wax and polishing cloth are included to maintain the gloss and maintenance of the enclosure.There was a specially designed speaker stand that was sold separately.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-20000B
sections.overview:
* Limited Production 200 Sets  550,000 (1 unit, released in 1998)

This is a limited model speaker system that uses DS 20000 as a base and has been further matured and fine-tuned as a piano finish "Clavier".All units were reviewed in accordance with the development theme of "sound", and piano soundboard grade material was used for the enclosure, and it was completed after detailed tuning and thorough hearing.WooferA 27 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.An aramid honeycomb cone is used for the diaphragm. This diaphragm has a honeycomb structure with high bending rigidity and uses aramid aromatic polyamide organic fiber with excellent skin properties. By obtaining a large thickness and a high sound velocity value, the distortion caused by the diaphragm is minimized. In addition, by having a larger internal loss than paper, the harmonic distortion is reduced. In addition, the DS 20000 b has a triaxial woven aramid edge that exhibits uniform strength in all directions at the edge part, and achieves piston motion with excellent linearity and less rolling.Mid-rangeThe mid-range features a 7.5 cm dome mid-range.B for the diaphragm4Uses C Pure Boron DUD vibration plate.B4C has a specific elastic modulus five times higher than that of titanium and second to that of crystalline diamond. Even at the sound velocity value, the measured value of C is 11,000m/sec, and the internal loss is 0.01, which is one order of magnitude higher than that of titanium or beryllium. Because this material has a very high melting point, it was difficult to form it into a dome shape. However, at Diatone, this has been realized with high precision by introducing plasma spraying method and high-precision computer control robot.In addition, in the DUD (Diatone Unified Diaphargm) structure adopted for the diaphragm, the voice coil bobbin and diaphragm are integrated, and transmission loss of driving force is suppressed by directly driving the diaphragm, and high-speed rise of sound with less distortion in high-frequency range is realized.For the magnetic circuit, ADMC-m (Advanced Magnet Circuit-music) magnetic circuit using ring-shaped alnico cast magnet is adopted.ADMC-m is a magnetic circuit that reduces the influence of the magnetic field generated from the input signal by analyzing the magnetic field using the finite element method. It has excellent response to the input, and achieves good transient and low distortion by realizing stable driving.DM (Direct Mount) system is adopted for the frame part.In this system, taking advantage of the structure of the dome unit itself, the magnetic circuit is fixed directly to the enclosure by the frame-shaped monocoque structure, which realizes higher rigidity and transmits the input signal to the diaphragm without loss.TweeterB for the high range as well as the mid-range4It is equipped with a 2.3 cm dome type tweeter using C pure boron DUD vibration plate.EnclosureThe enclosure is sealed, and the baffle and back plate are made of a piano soundboard material, spruce.The DS 20000 b enclosure has been hand-finished by skilled craftsmen to create a solid enclosure with no looseness or gaps.The exterior is finished with a black piano finish with polyester thick glossy paint.OtherThe input terminal uses a gold-plated large terminal that can securely fix extremely thick wires and can also be connected to banana plugs.It also has four inputs and can be used for bi-amp and bi-wiring.The DS 2000 b Diatone Kobo had primary aged each unit before shipping them.There was a special speaker stand sold separately.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-A3
sections.overview:
180,000 (1 unit, released in October 1994)

This speaker system is the 50th anniversary model of the Diatone Kobo. While inheriting the blood line of the broadcast station monitor, it also emphasizes musical expression such as the warmth of human voice and the luster of string instruments.The DS-A3 uses a cone-shaped 2-way system, which is the system configuration of the broadcasting station monitor 2S-3003.In addition, by using the same material for the diaphragm of woofer and tweeter, the speed of sound is made uniform and it becomes equal sound speed 2-way.A 16 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The diaphragm is made of an aramid cone. The aramid fiber is light and strong, and has the ideal characteristics of suppressing natural sound and reproducing uncolored sound. The DS-A3 is close to the warmth of human voice, while the Woofer is made of resin, which used to form the aramid diaphragm, to enhance the strength and flexibility of the aramid fiber.The magnetic circuit is equipped with a unique A. D. M. C. -m (Advanced Magnet Circuit-music). By analyzing the magnetic field using the finite element method, the influence of the magnetic field generated from the input signal is suppressed, and by realizing stable drive with excellent response to input, good transient and low distortion are realized.A 4 cm cone type tweeter using an aramid cone is installed in the high range.The network section emphasizes musical performance and employs a high-purity network conforming to DS 20000. In addition, a method for optimally tuning the energy balance to each unit is employed.With regard to wiring, we have eliminated the need for soldering to reduce the strain at the metallic interface. Instead, we use a oxygen-free copper sleeve for crimping wiring. In addition, for high-quality playback, we use parts that have been subjected to repeated trial listening, such as laminated orient cores, capacitors, and coils.The enclosure is designed using computer technology such as the finite element method, and is designed based on numerical values obtained by analyzing the vibration of the enclosure to achieve an extremely rigid structure.The baffle plate that supports the unit is 46 mm thick and has a walnut veneer finish. In addition, both sides of the baffle are made of natural Canadian maple with a beautiful sound. It is designed to sound music with a natural warmth. In addition, the upper and lower ends of the baffle are made of natural walnut. In consideration of the characteristics of the wood, the right material is placed in the right place.In order to create a beautiful sound field with a sense of scale, the bass resonance frequency is tuned to the order of 40 hz, which is a reduction of the contrabass. The opening of this bass port is fitted with a large oval port carved out of solid walnut, and the inside is designed as a bent angle port. This makes it possible to play back low sound with a sense of scale.The large round-shaped baffle used in the 2S 3003 and artificial leather around the high-frequency unit prevent the diffraction phenomenon and diffuse reflection of sound.The input terminal uses a large gold-plated terminal to which a banana plug can be connected.There was a special speaker stand sold separately.The height of the stand is designed to meet your ears when you lean on the sofa. In addition, the center of the stand pillar is made of solid Canadian maple, a three layer structure with high density and beautiful sound.

sections.title: DIATONE VS-900F
sections.overview:
200,000 (1 unit, around 1988)  186,000 (1 unit, around 1989)

A toll-boy type speaker system that pursued the voicing theory.In the VS-900F, the standing wave inside the cabinet which dulls the sound afterglow is removed by the arrangement of the unit.Conventional speakers use sound absorbing materials to suppress standing waves, but this method also loses a lot of acoustic energy. Therefore, the VS-900F is designed based on the positional relationship of units obtained by analysis techniques such as the finite element method. By preventing standing waves without using sound absorbing materials, it eliminates only the adverse effects of standing waves without damaging the afterglow of natural sounds.Two 18 cm cone woofers and two 16 cm cone woofers are installed in the lower range.The diaphragm of these units is made of LCP (Liquid Crystal Polymer), a material with high specific elasticity and large internal loss due to high-speed injection molding using self-reinforcing effect, and has acquired excellent characteristics as a diaphragm.In addition, ADMC (Advanced Magnet Circuit) is adopted for the magnetic circuit, and magnetic distortion is eliminated by canceling the AC magnetic field with attention paid to flux fluctuation in the magnetic circuit.A 3-cm dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.This unit also uses an LCP diaphragm to enhance the connection of sound with the low frequency range, and a DUD structure that integrates the diaphragm and voice coil bobbin realizes high speed.The enclosure is made of rear R-plywood to reduce internal standing waves.In addition, the unit layout is inline so that when combined with a large-screen TV, the sound is centered on the screen.

sections.title: DIATONE DIATONEF1
sections.overview: This is a bookshelf type speaker system using the newly developed bass reflex method.A bass reflex system is used for the enclosure, and a newly developed underwater center duct is used for the bass reflex port.In a 2-way system, there are two causes of cross modulation distortion : one is that the high sound emitted from the tweeter hits the diaphragm of the woofer and the high sound modulated by the vibration of the diaphragm is radiated, and the other is that the vibration of the woofer is transmitted through the baffle plate and causes the tweeter to swing by the vibration and cross modulation distortion is generated.In order to reduce the cross modulation distortion caused by these causes, the extrinsic center duct adopted in F1 has a bass reflex duct installed between the woofer and the tweeter, and the opening of the duct protrudes from the baffle plate. This structure prevents the sound emitted from the tweeter from reaching the woofer by blocking the duct, and at the same time prevents the vibration transmitted from the woofer to the baffle plate from being transmitted to the tweeter, thus reducing the cross modulation distortion.A 30 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The cone paper is equipped with an effective corrugation, material, molding method, and additives to prevent distortion due to split vibration. The sound quality is also improved by a powerful magnetic circuit and a die-cast frame weighing approximately 1.4 kg.A 5 cm semi-dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.A semi-dome type with a wide frequency range is adopted in order to reproduce the middle and high frequencies well. In addition, by increasing the voice coil diameter, generation of distortion is suppressed and transient is improved.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-C1000ZV
sections.overview: A center speaker developed for multi-channel playback in Dolby Digital and DTS.The DS-C1000ZV is designed as a center speaker with the same tone as the ZX series while focusing on the playback of the voicing band.Two 16 cm cone type woofers are installed in the lower range.The diaphragm uses an aramid cloth diaphragm to achieve the same sound quality as the ZX Series. This diaphragm uses an organic fiber aramid, which is lightweight, highly rigid, and has an appropriate internal loss. The two layer structure eliminates the binder such as epoxy resin, which has been conventionally used for moldability and airtightness. Thus, the diaphragm is lighter in weight. It also takes advantage of the large internal loss of the aramid and improves the effect of reducing the natural sound.In addition, by adopting a double woofer system, the vibration area is secured and excellent power response is obtained.A 2.5 cm dome-shaped tweeter is installed in the high range.The diaphragm is made of boronized titanium, which achieves an extremely high specific elastic modulus by diffusing boron into titanium. In order to take advantage of this material's superior characteristics, a DUD structure, in which the voice coil bobbin and diaphragm are integrated, enables high-speed, clear, high-frequency reproduction.The enclosure uses a bass reflex system.The front bass reflex port can be closed with the attached duct damper to adjust the sound quality in the low range.There was a special stand with tilt mechanism sold separately.With this stand, you can adjust the angle of the speaker in 4 stages from horizontal to 25 degrees according to the distance between the listening point and the screen.

sections.overview:
* Made-to-order (delivery date : 4 months)Approx.   2,500,000 (released in 1985)

A woofer system using an 80 cm diameter woofer unit.Diatone developed a large woofer when it received an order for stage speakers for NHK Hall around 1978.Since the horn type cannot be used due to space limitations, a woofer with a maximum output sound pressure of 130 dB and a low-pass limit frequency of 30 Hz was required. This was the reason for the development.The system using an 80 cm cone woofer developed at that time was placed in the NHK Hall in 1979.The D-80 has an 80 cm cone shaped woofer in the unit.This unit uses a honeycomb diaphragm for the diaphragm, and realizes weight reduction by using aluminum alloy for the honeycomb core and CFRP (carbon fiber reinforced plastic) for the skin material.In addition, the Alnico magnet is used for the magnetic circuit, and a highly heat-resistant bobbin is used for the voice coil to achieve high input resistance.There were two variations of the enclosure, a closed type and a bass reflex type.The inside is made of steel balk with wood pasted on.It seems that this speaker has also been delivered to laboratories of kobe university and Central Research Institute of Electric Power Industry which study noise and vibration.

sections.title: DIATONE D-160
sections.overview:
* Made-to-order (delivery date : 4 months)Approx.   30,000,000 (released in 1985)

A woofer system using the largest woofer unit of Diatone developed in 1980.The unit is equipped with PW 1600 which is a 160 cm cone type woofer.A honeycomb diaphragm is used for the diaphragm. Aluminum alloy is used for the honeycomb core and CFRP (carbon fiber reinforced plastic) is used for the skin material to realize weight reduction. The weight of the diaphragm is reduced to 3 kg even though it is a super large woofer.We have also adopted a field coil for the magnetic circuit. At the design stage, when calculated using permanent magnets, the weight exceeds 800 kg even if a strong magnet is used. Therefore, we have decided to use a field coil to reduce the weight. This coil uses electric wires for train motors, and the field coil alone weighs 400 kg.A high heat-resistant bobbin is used for the voice coil to achieve high input resistance.Since the frame cannot be cast as a single unit, four parts are assembled with bolts. This unit weighs 600 kg as a single unit.The enclosure uses a bass-reflex system and is made of a steel balk covered with wood.It seems that the unit with the unusual size of 160 cm had a lot of difficulty in the characteristic test.At the Koriyama Test at the Koriyama Factory was carried out in the measurement room at first, but it was stopped because fluorescent lamps on the ceiling fell due to vibration. It seems that the characteristic test was carried out at the ground in the factory premises.The outdoor test seemed to have a negative impact on the neighborhood. At a distance of about 100m from the speaker, it was felt as sound, but at a distance of more than that, it was transmitted as vibration and earth rumbling instead of audible sound. Within a radius of 2 km from the factory, there were damages such as vibrations like earthquakes and earth rumbling, and sound of walls and windows.The first one opened to the public was Kobe Portpia Mitsubishi Miraikan in March 1981.In addition, it seems to have been used in a quiz program on Tokyo Broadcasting System at that time to ask, "If you ring it in the prefabricated house, will the window glass break?" It seems that the glass broke easily.It seems that this speaker has been delivered to laboratories of kobe university and Central Research Institute of Electric Power Industry which study noise and vibration.

sections.title: DIATONE DS-W3
sections.overview: A subwoofer with built-in amplifier using the Kelton method.The Kelton method is used to reproduce low-order harmonics below the fundamental sound contained in bass instruments such as bass guitars and bass drums. In this method, the front of the unit is sealed as a air suspension, and vibration without energy loss is emitted from an optimally designed duct. The energy condensed in the duct is further condensed into a clear low-frequency band by cutting mid-range noise with the front filter port.16 cm cone type woofer is used for the unit.Uses a power amplifier.This amplifier has two band widths, narrow and wide, so that it can be used in a wide range of systems. Narrow position cuts frequencies above 63 Hz, wide position cuts frequencies above 100 Hz.Designed with amplifier width, it is easy to fit in an audio rack or TV rack.

sections.title: DIATONE DP-105
sections.overview: A CD player with technologies such as 3-beam laser pickups and servo circuit LSIs.Equipped with Diatone's original 3-beam system laser pickup.In this method, the laser light emitted from a semiconductor laser is first divided by a grating plate into a light for reading signals and a left and right laser light for tracking servo. The left and right reflected lights have the same output, but if there is even a slight difference between them, there will be a difference in brightness between the two.This allows us to catch tracking errors and control the signal detection beam so that it always follows each pit line.It is equipped with a focus servo that optically detects the coupling state on the photodiode by the combination of a converging lens and a cylindrical lens.In this servo circuit, if the image of the laser beam connected to the photodiode is a true circle, the focus is judged to be normal, and if it is an ellipse, it is judged to be a focus error. Based on this, the up-and-down motion of the rotating disk is detected, and the pickup is controlled so that the signal detection laser beam from the objective lens reaches an accurate end point on the disk.It adopts a unique tracking mechanism using a rotary mirror.In addition, the use of special rubber material eliminates vibration noise during high-speed search.In order to obtain sufficient resolution and aberration, the objective lens is mounted with a machining accuracy of less than 1 / 2 of the laser wavelength. In response to the focus error signal from the servo circuit, the objective lens is moved at high speed by the change of magnetic flux density.In addition, the suspension has been removed in order to eliminate resonance noise during driving.We have developed and installed special LSIs for servo circuits such as tracking servo, focus servo and pickup feed servo.A one chip microcomputer is used for the circuit that processes the sequence control commands.The D/A converter is equipped with an integrating D/A converter with 16-bit accuracy.The analog filter after D/A conversion uses a Chebyshev type low-pass filter with a unique circuit configuration.No lead wires are used in the signal circuit from the D/A converter to the line output terminal. Moreover, the output terminal is directly mounted on the printed circuit board. This reduces signal transmission loss and eliminates degradation of high frequency characteristics and noise generation.The printed circuit board has been designed with an optimum pattern to improve channel separation.An independent DC stabilizing power supply circuit is installed in the analog amplifier section to prevent noise generated from the digital system and servo circuit from adversely affecting the analog circuit.It is equipped with a random program of up to 30 songs, a cue in the index display and a 4-mode repeat function.

sections.title: DIATONE DT-4700
sections.overview:
DT-4700 :   71,800 (around 1978)DT-4700S :   69,800 (around 1979)

A stereo cassette deck equipped with a number of new mechanisms focusing on recording functions.A DC servo motor is used as the drive motor.The built-in tacho-generator constantly controls the rotational speed at a constant speed. This makes it possible to control uneven tape speed even against load fluctuations that cause wow and flutter, thereby enabling stable tape travel.Equipped with a Record Master Volume that can adjust the recorded signal level from all input jacks without moving the Line or Mic input control knobs.An ultra low noise PNP epitaxial silicon transistor developed by Diatone is used in the first stage of the reproduction equalizer amplifier, and a low noise PNP transistor is used in the first stage of the Line input amplifier.By using a carefully selected ferrite head, the characteristics are improved.Equipped with a meter indicating the remaining amount of tape.This meter detects the rotation speed of the supply side reel rest first, converts it to voltage, and causes the meter to swing. Therefore, the change in the rotation cycle of the supply side reel rest appears as a change in the meter oscillation.In addition, this tape level indication meter is equipped with a reference voltage generator using a zener diode and a temperature guarantee circuit, so that it can respond to fluctuations in power supply voltage and ambient temperature, enabling accurate indication.Mixing recording is possible.Equipped with a peak level indicator that lights up when the distortion level (+ 5 Vu) is reached.Equipped with a memory rewind mechanism. Before recording or playback, turn on the memory switch, set the tape counter to 000, and press the REW button to automatically stop the recording when it has been rewound to 999.Equipped with L/mono My Kujac mechanism. When a microphone plug is inserted into Lch of My Kujac, both channels are automatically recorded in mono.By connecting to the separately sold audio timer, you can record your absence or play the alarm clock.The cassette case is equipped with a tape illumination lamp.Equipped with an oil dump type soft eject mechanism.Equipped with Dolby circuit.There were 2 types, DT-4700 with a rack-mount carrying handle and DT-4700S without a carrying handle.

sections.title: DIATONE D-102
sections.overview: A digital audio processor that enables you to enjoy digital audio from a video cassette by simply connecting to a home video deck.The D-102 is equipped with a non-feedback active filter that is also used in the D-1, the first EIAJ digital audio processor announced in 1979. In addition, the D-102 has improved this non-feedback active filter by selecting a capacitor and reducing its size to improve sound quality.A newly developed simple deglitch circuit is used in the deglitch circuit that eliminates the glitch signal generated during D/A conversion in the playback mode. This circuit reduces the degradation of the mid - and high-frequency range caused by the CR integration circuit and high-speed operational amplifier that occurs in circuits composed of conventional analog switches, CR integration circuits, and high-speed operational amplifiers.The parts used for analog circuits and power supply circuits are carefully selected.Only tantalum-based resistors are used. Capacitors are based on electrolytic acoustic capacitors with the best energy balance, and copper foil styrene capacitors, acoustic film capacitors, etc. are used according to the operation and function of each circuit part.In addition, pure copper and copper-plated products are used for the housing, screws, wiring materials, etc., and only those with the best balance of characteristics are used, such as the adoption of low-feedback capacitance operational amplifier.By reducing the power consumption of the digital circuit itself, improved sound quality and built-in power supply circuit have been realized.The D-102 uses a C-MOS type, which has the advantage of low power consumption compared with the conventional N-MOS type, when the digital circuit is integrated into an LSI. It also uses a C-MOS type for a 16k-SRAM for wow and flutter removal and an 8-bit 1-chip microcomputer. This realizes low power consumption of 0.5W or less, while the power consumption of the N-MOS type is 3-4W.The power supply is equipped with a Current Controlled Voltage Regulator (CCVR) power supply circuit developed based on the basic concept of "a power supply circuit suitable for digital audio." This improves the SN ratio of the power supply output by approximately 30 dB and does not use any capacitor in the power supply line.Equipped with an auto fade-in / fade-out function using a digital fader circuit.

sections.title: DIATONE DA-Q100
sections.overview: This is a 4-ch decoder dedicated to components with an SE logic circuit mounted on the decoder section that contains three types of matrices (RM, SQ, and QM-4), which dramatically increases the separation degree of the matrix 4 ch.The SE logic circuit is used to improve the crosstalk problem of the matrix 4 ch.This circuit uses the main signal to create a negative-phase signal, eliminating and suppressing only the crosstalk components that leak into each channel, and achieves discrete-like separation.This logic circuit is based on the principle of the logic circuit. First, a comparison detection circuit detects the magnitude of the signal between the opposite channels and converts it into a DC control signal. This signal is sent to a gain control circuit (gain control), and the main signal is controlled to become an erase signal with phases opposite to each other of 0   and 180  . Then, the main signal (the output of the matrix) and the erase signal are mixed by an addition circuit, and the crosstalk component is eliminated.This structure ensures distortion-free sound quality unlike AGC, which directly controls the gain of the main signal, because the main signal is adjusted without any modification.The decoder has built-in RM (Regular Matrix), SQ and QM-4 matrix, and is designed for wide adaptability to 4 ch playback.As a result, most commercially available records can be played in 4 ch by switching the switch.The CD-4 system can also be used as a 4-ch control center by installing a demodulator connection terminal.Equipped with terminals for discretes, you can enjoy discretes just by connecting a tape deck.It uses 4 large level meters of front and rear.

sections.title: DIATONE AS-4001
sections.overview: The world's top-class speaker system was completed in 1966 (1966) in cooperation with NHK General Technology Laboratory.By using a multi-amplifier system with amplifiers for each band, high, middle, and low, crossover frequency characteristics are excellent and intermodulation distortion is extremely small.In addition, since the distortion is very small even at a large sound output, high-fidelity reproduction in a wide music hall is possible.The speaker units consist of two 40-cm large-diameter speakers for low frequencies, three 12-cm speakers for middle frequencies, and four 5-cm speakers for high frequencies. The performance and technology of these units were the culmination of the efforts of Mitsubishi Diatone speaker engineers at that time.Since it is developed for stereo, it has a symmetrical unit arrangement.All the units used are for monitor, and 4 units of TW-25 type used for the 2S-305 are used for one side, and the middle and low frequency units are used only for AS-4001 and AS-4021 (strictly speaking, the Woofer unit has different impedance).The structure is such that the volume is adjusted and distributed by the MA 031 type distribution amplifier, and it is amplified by the MA 401 type in each sound range of high, middle and low.* AS 4001 and AS 4021 have been delivered to the National Institute of Technology, NHK Broadcasting Center, Tokyo Bunka Kaikan, Osaka University of Music, Musashino Academia Musicae, etc.BTS-4101 21P3B is the standard input code tip.

This speaker system was created after 3 years of improvement from the 2S 660 announced in 1955.It was developed in collaboration with NHK Technical Research Institute.For many decades, the 2S 305 has been designated as the R305 for sound quality monitoring specified in BTS 6131. It has been used for standard playback by domestic and overseas broadcasters as well as by sound manufacturers and sound research institutes.In addition, in order to complete each part as a system made with high technical accuracy, all the process from the manufacture of the enclosure to the assembly and mounting of the parts was done by hand by skilled craftsmen.A 20 cm cone woofer, PW 125, is installed in the lower range.The vibration system of the PW 125 is a mechanical filter that attenuates the high-frequency range at a crossover frequency of 1500 Hz or more, so there is no unnecessary high-frequency radiation even without using a network.The TW-25, a 5 cm cone type tweeter, is installed in the high range.The diaphragm of this unit has an effective vibration radius of 2 cm, and the magnetic circuit is made of iron-cobalt alloy, which is considered to have a higher saturation magnetic flux than other magnetic materials, to achieve higher efficiency.The enclosure uses a bass reflex method. In addition, thin plates of hippopotamus and lauan are bonded one by one to make the exterior angle round, preventing the influence of the diffracted phenomenon on the middle and high frequency range and increasing the mechanical strength.Measured data in an anechoic room was attached to each unit.There were also 2S-305C (gray) for hanging on the wall and 600   matching transformer.There was a special caster as an option sold separately.

A compact monitor system for the digital age that brings together the best of diatone and monitor technology.A 16 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The diaphragm uses aramid cloth and cone. sections.title: DIATONE 2S-2503P
sections.overview: A monitor speaker system developed in 1977 (1977).The 2S-2503P is a speaker system with a small floor space for monitoring in a small studio.In terms of sound quality, it follows the sound quality of the AS-3001S model, and it was designed and manufactured after thorough sound quality comparison.It adopts a passive radiator system, and by using a 25 cm cone type passive radiator, it is possible to uniformly reproduce sound in the low frequency band.A 25 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.This unit uses a nickel-base alloy FN ring with excellent linearity in magnetization characteristics near the magnetic pole gap of the magnetic circuit, thereby suppressing distortion in the glaze range to less than -50dB (0.3%) and realizing clear reproduction.In addition, sufficient anti-vibration measures have been taken by adopting die-cast frames and bases.A 5 cm cone type tweeter is installed in the high range.Two V-shaped reinforcing bars are used inside the enclosure to reduce vibration and prevent the box from ringing.There were exclusive casters and exclusive amplifiers sold separately.

sections.title: DIATONE 2S-3003
sections.overview:
* Made-to-order products  1,500,000 (1 unit, released in 1990)

This speaker system was developed as a monitor standard for the Hi-Vision era by integrating all the technologies of Diatone.While inheriting the basic design of the 2S-305 model, we pursue a wide range, low distortion, and high input-resistant efficiency.A 32 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.A 3-axis woven aramid honeycomb diaphragm is used for the diaphragm. In this diaphragm, aromatic polyamide aramid fiber with extremely high rigidity and excellent vibration damping characteristics is changed from the conventional vertically and horizontally woven fabric to 3-axis woven fabric to obtain strength in all directions. By using this skin material as a diaphragm with honeycomb structure, dispersion resonance at high input is suppressed, and low distortion and excellent response are realized.The magnetic circuit uses the Alnico magnet version of A. D. M. C. -m (Advanced Magnet Circuit-music), which boasts high magnetic flux density. The A. D. M. C. -m focuses on the fluctuation of magnetic flux in the magnetic circuit and has a structure that cancels the AC magnetic flux from the voice coil. This minimizes the movement of the center of the voice coil with respect to the magnetic pole at large amplitude and enables clear and quick start playback.A 5 cm cone type tweeter is installed in the high range.B which is pure boron for the diaphragm4C is adopted. B4In order to maximize the potential of the material for the C-diaphragm, we have adopted the plasma spray method, which is an ultra-high precision molding method that enables thin film and light weight, and expanded the playback band toward the mid-range while trying to reach the limit point of the high-range.In order to prevent the transmission deterioration of the woofer unit, the network section is composed of only tweeters.The enclosure uses a rounded baffle that is also used in the 2S-305 to prevent the diffraction phenomenon of sound waves.We measured the overall characteristics of each unit in an anechoic chamber and attached it as a test report to guarantee the quality.There were special wagon-type stands sold separately and special cables using stress-free 6N high-purity oxygen-free copper.

sections.title: DIATONE 4S-4002
sections.overview: Large 4-way monitor speaker.The 4S 4002 was developed to cope with the improvement of program source performance by adoption of direct cutting and PCM deck.The main targets are wide-band wide-band playback from 20 Hz to 30 kHz and low distortion of -50dB or less. In addition, improvements in phase characteristics, which have a significant effect on sound quality, and input resistance, which is required as the basic performance of professional speakers, are also being sought.Based on this speaker, the 4S-4002P was developed and sold since 1977.A high-rigidity diaphragm using a honeycomb sandwich cone is adopted for the diaphragm in the middle and low frequency range, and reproduction characteristics which uniformly extend to 20 Hz in 2   space are obtained.In addition, the magnetic circuit is made of permalloy to reduce current distortion, thereby realizing a lower distortion than ever before. In addition, the voice coil is made of newly developed heat-resistant epoxy imide adhesive to improve input resistance.40 cm cone type woofer and 40 cm cone type passive radiator are mounted for low range.The mid-range is equipped with 18 cm cone mid-range.A 5 cm cone type tweeter is installed in the high range, and a 2.3 cm dome type super tweeter is installed in the ultra high range.These units are equipped with a protective circuit to protect against excessive input and contribute to improved input resistance.In order to improve the phase characteristics in the network section, a phase correction circuit is installed in the units above the mid-range.The network configuration is designed to allow switching between multi-amplifier mode and full-range mode.At the top of the rear of the enclosure there was space for the driver amplifier.
